Very comfortable I bought these for my son who is on the autism spectrum.  Because of his sensory issues,  he hates the ear loops on his mask that he wears to school.  These are super comfortable and the mask loops can be moved to the side buttons.  I was a little concerned that he would get hot wearing a hat all day, but they are very lightweight and breathable.
Poor quality It fell apart after a few uses

Glows under a blacklight I bought these for my daughter who loves cosmic bowling.  I thought these would be great for tying her hair up and would look nice under the blacklight.  They are made out of a fluffy chenille material that is super stretchy.  They look nice in regular light, but really shine under a black light.

Super cute I bought these for my daughter who loves unicorns.  She is also on the autism spectrum so she has a lot of sensory problems.  Brushing her hair can be a challenge because she hates when it pulls her hair.  These are a great idea because they are so comfortable.  The plastic bristles massage her scalp and the paddle shape smooths her hair without snagging.  Plus she loves the cool unicorn designs.

Good for makeup removal I bought these for a friend who does theater.  He has to wear a lot of pancake makeup that is kind of hard to remove.  These are so much better than regular makeup wipes because of the texture and strength.  He can use a dry one first off to wipe away a lot of it then another one with make up remover to clean off the rest.  Afterwards,  he can throw them out instead of trying to wash a dirty washcloth every time.

Super cute I bought this for my sister who is having a baby.  Her nursery has a black and white theme which kind of makes me feel like I am inside a domino,  but this fits in great.  A full sized refill pack of diaper wipes fits in it easily so there's no guesswork about how many to put inside.  The silicone lid ensures that it is airtight and the wipes don't dry out.  I mainly bought it for the big container,  but I really like the travel one that it came with too.  It's easy to fill and has a handle little handle for carrying it.

So easy to use [[VIDEOID:cb9b4f9df532525269b6bd626cc29f60]] I have heard horror stories about people accidentally gluing their eyes shut with eyelash adhesive.  My sister wanted to try some for her wedding and I thought this would be a safer option.  It's as easy as applying eyeliner.  The magnets on the back of the lashes automatically stick to the eyeliner and stay in place until you remove them.  They seem well made and look natural.  The set includes 8 pairs of lashes, a case with a mirror,  the special eyeliner,  and even a pair of tweezers made for eyelashes.

Gross I love lemon balm and I even grow my own.  I wanted to buy some to get me through the winter,  but this is not it.  I have no idea what it is, but it tastes like grass.  It's definitely not lemon balm.  At least I didn't spend too much on it.
Poorly designed top I bought this for my homemade herbal tinctures.  Unfortunately,  the top was damaged and leaking.

Nice starter kit I use essential oils for many purposes and this 3 piece set is a great starter kit for those who love lavender, lemon and peppermint. They smell great and are very versatile. Mix them with your favorite oil (I like coconut) and apply topically or add a few drops to a diffuser for a peaceful night sleep. I recently had a cold and mixed the peppermint and coconut oil and applied to my chest for a cough. It was soothing and helped with the sinuses as well. Makes a great gift because it comes in a cute little box as well.

Small but cute I ordered the pink headband set and these are really cute styles. The material is good and the band fits my small head well. If your head was on the larger side, they'd stretch but might feel tight behind the ears. They're durable and will keep my hair in place.

Broken in pieces I was not able to use this product as intended since it was in several pieces when it arrived. I liked that it was spf50 to protect the skin on my face but unfortunately, I can't use it.

Interesting texture I need a good face scrub to clean out the pores but it needs to be gentle at the same time to not inflame my skin. This scrub didn't really irritate my skin but the granules in the scrub are very rough. I found it to be more so than other scrubs I've used. Thankfully, it didn't irritate my skin. I just had to be extra gentle. That said, my skin was smooth again so it does work.

Small travel pack Great if you're heading out for a trip. There's 15 pads in a little container so makes it easy to use. The pads clean well and are gentle to use. One step cleaning and easy to tote with you to the gym, plane or wherever you need a clean up.

Nicest organizer of this type I have seen has clear attention to detail Plastic and/or acrylic organizers come in all sizes, shapes, configurations and qualities. MelodySusie® has blown me away with this three part, multiple sectioned organizer with drawers. Just so you're clear, you get a base with four drawers, each with an flattened oval shaped pull, each lined with a black textile that can be removed or used as you choose. The edges of the drawers are beveled, giving this an aura of elegance, but most importantly, each drawer slides in and out with ease, regardless of whether or not the drawer is packed or empty. The bottom of the base has a little strip in the form which raises this organizer from sitting directly on the counter, so if it is used in a bathroom, air can circulate around the entire piece and grungy mildew and such is reduced from forming. Don't forget to dust, though. The exterior edges are beveled, giving them a very finished appearance, unlike those sharp edges on many similar products in the marketplace.

Included with this organizer are two additional pieces, each is the same dimension as the interior of the top ridge of the chest organizer, so you can decide which one you want to put on top and which one you want to put next to the main component. Or you can separate them entirely and use the top of the organizer to put items and use the two multi-sectioned components separately. You could line them up side by side along a dresser top and have more width rather than extended height.

I love the assorted sizes of the sections and the angles top of the shorter of the two pieces. I also love the rounded design in the sections of the taller component. Every aspect of this trio is outstanding, high quality, and it makes quite the impression in addition to comfortably storing whatever you like in each compartment. Each edge is finished, every detail has been considered, and it is even practical in that it can quickly be cleaned with no harsh detergents. This lovely item was made in China and it is clear that quality control is important to the manufacturer because I saw no defect even after intense examination. Be prepared for a weightier set than you might expect, because there was no skimping on the materials. It is perfectly packed for protection and is ideal for presenting as a gift. It is well worth its price point. A sample was provided for review.

Love! Easy, affordable, effective. This is, I think, my third order of Rio De Keratin. I'm able to get 3-4 treatments out of each kit with my hair ranging from super short to just below my shoulders. I usually still iron my hair, but it stays flat, even in Alabama's subtropical humidity. Otherwise, it doesn't matter what I do: by the time I walk from my house to the car, my hair is frizztastic. But with a keratin treatment, I can even just blow dry my hair and it look fantastic. This saves so much more time and it makes styling last for days. I also hike and get sweaty and my hair still looks great after it dries. Once, after a day of kayaking, I rode in the back of a friend's truck back to the marina, and my hair still looked terrific. This of all things has given me the hair I've dreamed of. And at $10-$15 per treatment, this price is right.

Of course, it does smell terrible. And the fumes can sting your eyes, both as you apply it to your hair and as you iron it out. I like to open the back door and aim a cyclonic fan into the bathroom while I use this stuff so I don't choke on the fumes.

Good cream without sunscreen This is one of La Prairie's less expensive moisturizers and it's good. It can be used day and/or night alone or over a serum or one of their other products per directions. I use this cream during the day because I don't really need a sunscreen. I've also used this at night when I run out of night cream. In my opinion all of La Prairie's products are excellent and worth the high price - I don't use makeup so it's important for me to make my face look as good as it can be. I'm 61 years old and have been using this line for about 7 years. Depending on skin type and age I think some of their products work better than others. As with all their products a little goes a long way. The current price on Amazon is quite a bit lower than what I have to pay in a department store which is more than $200 for the same size jar!

Love this lotion... This is the best glycolic acid lotion I have ever used. I have been using face acids on my face and neck for dark spots and wrinkles for many years. It feels great and it burns just a tiny bit. I thought nothing could actually make my face tingle and you only need to apply a dime size. I also
use a tiny amount with my eye cream. If you are not accustomed to using glycolic acid be careful with this brand. It is very potent. I suggest mixing a small amount with a moisterizer. I do that for my neck. A bit of redness and peeling is common. I will absolutely order again.
Works on tough toenails. Works as intended on tough toenails.

Heady Sweet Skin Cream When I first tried this Marshmallow Vanishing Crème a few weeks ago in a sampler kit, I purchased five more kits and then a 1.5 ounce glass container of this product. Can I say it is addictive? Yes, I guess it does have a banana scent and the texture is similar to a banana cream pie topped with whip cream. To say this is decadent is an understatement. You will be very tempted to slather your entire body in a good helping of this cream. Fortunately, it goes a long way and absorbs extremely well. In fact, that is why they call it "vanishing" crème. The ingredient list is impressive and contains rose water, mango butter, beeswax, grapeseed oil, rosehip seed oil, Vitamin E, marshmallow extract, willowbark extract, calendula flower extract, and a heady fragrance.

Grapeseed oil is one of the most powerful antioxidants and is high in proanthocyanidins, a group of bioflavonoids that are superior because they are water soluble. This ingredient also prevents skin cell damage caused by pollution and sun exposure.

"Marsh Mallow" is actually a pink flowering herb found in marshes and damp meadows. It has been used for centuries as a food and a medicine. The leaves and roots secrete an emollient fluid with healing properties for inflamed skin. In the past, people boiled the roots in wine to make a cough remedy.

I found this luscious creamy dreamy product to be healing for the body and mind. Not only will you feel comforted by nature, your skin will be baby soft and this product can be used for all-over body healing. The silver lid and glass jar have an unusually cute appeal. If you love this product, you might want to try the Pore-refining mask, Evening Primrose Overnight Crème and the very unique parsley blemish stick. To take luxury to the next level, try the Shea Butter Decollete Crème on your feet, hands or all over your entire body. What an amazing line of products. They heal, protect and soothe your mind.

I'm still trying all the Burt's Bees products, and love how these products make me feel. They add a level of protection to your skin care routine and the clay mask I recently tried cleaned my pores like a dream.

~The Rebecca Review
A Total Burt Bees Fan Until the End of Time

Warm Soothing Scent Kama Sutra Treasures of the Sea is an intriguing bath salt with a warm sensuous room enveloping fragrance. One scoop of the salts in a tub of water and you transform everyday bathing into bubbles and water the color of the ocean.

The color reminded me of the turquoise waters near the Aiya Napa white caves in Cyprus. The texture of the water turns silky and you may notice your skin is more moisturized from the natural oils, especially the Wheat Germ Oil.

While many may see the color as "Azure" there is a definite green vs. purple color mingling in the depths of blue and this does contain Algae. The texture of the salt is more like a sand than a salt and the shimmering finely ground blue salt crystals mingle with what looks like tiny pieces of broken marble. Of course, this all dissolves quickly and the bubbles last through the entire bath. In fact, the more you move around, the more bubbles appear.

The warm scent soothes the soul and the color is dreamy and the bubbles look like clouds floating across an open sky. A shell of salts is all you need and a beautiful shell is included.

I had so much fun taking a bath with these salts, that I ran my husband a bath too. These salts seem to inspire sharing and recently inspired a poem:

Soul comfort misplaces cares

Troubles dissolved

Sinking down the drain

The wisdom of silence

Bliss of Escape

Liquid remedy

Immersion in solitude

~The Rebecca Review

Get O3 for the best look - Elegant Manicure Why pay tons of money for a French manicure when it is so easy to do at home on your own schedule? I received this product free in exchange for a review. This review is my honest opinion. I keep looking at my nails as I type. This look is so pretty.

Use as an Ingredient in Body Butter I recently made myself a body butter and used this oil in place of the almond oil the recipe called for. It worked really well. I will say however that this one bottle seems to be 125 ml as it filled up a half a cup. Using this in the body butter made the butter very luxurious. I now use it nightly on my hands and feet. You could also use this as a massage oil. I'm finding this really does make my skin look younger. After about a week you may notice a difference too.

~The Rebecca Review

I received one free bottle for review purposes. This review is my honest opinion.

Strongly Scented I have never purchased pure cocoa butter before but I needed some for making some body butter. I found it very difficult to get this butter out of the container. I managed to get half a cup out with a dessert spoon. I can't see how anyone could use this on a regular basis. I'd only recommend it for making natural recipes. It has a very strong scent of chocolate.

Super Moisturizing Does dry weather get you down because your hands feel uncomfortable and dry? Welcome to the experience of J.R. Watkins hand creams. I've tried nearly every scent and love them all. I have a lavender one I love using at night. This one is great for daytime as it is floral scented. You really don't need a lot so it lasts a lot longer than other less rich hand creams. This one is super moisturizing with luxurious shea butter, apricot kernel oil, coconut oil, aloe leaf juice and safflower seed oil. It also has a calming flower extract. So your hands get pampered to the max. I've pretty much stopped buying other hand creams and just reach for this.

Cooling and Calming If you live in a dry climate you will especially love this moisturizing, calming mask. It goes on like a gel and cools the skin while it refreshes your complexion. I can't say enough good things about this mask. I have sensitive skin and it calms redness and irritation completely. The truth is you will want to use this every day. I put the mask on at night before bedtime and leave it on for ten minutes. Once washed off my skin is baby soft and plumper. Hours later it still feels like my face is cool and comforted. It especially helped to calm my skin down after I used a serum with retinol in it. So this is something I will want on hand at all times as it is very healing.

The oil is sort of yellow like a turmeric oil and contains rosehip, neroli, chamomile, rose, frankincense, lavender, and bisalolol essential oils. So you can see how healing this also is. I don't notice any scent from the oil it seems relatively mild. I think this bottle is going to last me a long time since I use so little of it. The results are great (including smaller pores!) and I'm happy I tried this product. It is a time saver since I don't have to blend my own oils.

~The Rebecca Review

Pretty decent product but do your research Overall, this product isn’t horrible compared to others on the market. It is paraben-free, sulfate-free, EU Allergen free and uses minimal ingredients however it also contains alcohol, silicone and is not safe for fungal acne. After running this product through a cosmetic ingredient safety checker, it scored an 88% one the EWG Health Rating. Most popular, name-brand face lotions are around 65%-80% on the EWG Health Rating. I use the EWG (Environment Working Group) as a reference when checking products and try to stay away from the alarmist side. Only 8% of this product is considered “moderate risk” mainly polyarylamide, Fragrance (unnecessary additive; possible allergy) , alcohol denat. (Bad for dry skin, bad for sensitive skin, potentially block pores) and BHT (also found in edibles, rubber products and is banned in UK and EU due to limited research showing BHT is linked to cancer). This product is good for brightening, anti-aging and promotes wound healing. It also contains steric acid which can potentially block pores.

Keep in mind, everyone’s skin is different and what effects one person may not effect another. Learn your skin and what products work best for you. Personally, I would stay away from this product if you have very dry skin and/or sensitive skin. I have “normal” skin (no sensitivities, not overly dry or oily, limited acne, no allergies) and didn’t have any issues with this product so far. It has a light scent that isn’t overpowering but completely unnecessary (I HATE fragrance in beauty products; stick with essential oils). It absorbed nicely and didn’t leave my face feeling oily. I am giving this product 4 stars as of February 21, 2021 due to the minimal ingredients and will update this review once a larger amount of time has passed to fully understand how to works with my skin.

The stamper works great, I didn't even wash it first (even though you should always wash new stampers before first use), and it's slightly (I do mean slightly) softer then other clear stampers I own.

If you're new to stamping or not familiar with clear stampers, they are more delicate than opaque ones and tear easily, so be gentle with it. Wash it with dish soap & warm water, dry with a paper towel and clean it with a lint roller or tape. Never buff it or use acetone, you'll make it cloudy defeating the purpose of a clear stamper. When picking up, ROLL GENTLY over the image if you apply too much pressure it won't pick up. When applying the image to the nail press straight down (again, with GENTLE pressure) and rock side to side or roll from side to side. Don't push the tip of the nail into it, it will tear.

All the plates stamp great, I didn't swatch every image, although plates 29 & 41 have shallow etching (in my experience this is normal for BP plates) so the thinner scraper is a nice addition. It's not as thin as the 0.5mm and not a thick as the 1mm ones I own, I'd say it's 0.75mm (I didn't get out the calipers). There are different size images, a little for every nail size. The stamping guide works like it's supposed to, I've added a photo to show how it's used just in case it's confusing. I have a set of 4 templates from another brand already, there's not much difference in size or thickness of the metal but the designs are different. The edges aren't finished, like a plate with no backing, but I don't think it would cause anyone to slice their finger open unless you're being extremely careless.

This smells heavenly! I'll get a whiff of sage while reading in my bedroom, even though the bars of soap are in a nearby bathroom. And it is DELIGHTFUL -- like the great outdoors! Invigorating.

I'm using this in the shower as a body scrubber -- it's abrasive, with bits of sage in the soap.

It may seem a bit pricey, but these are large bars of soap.

Love, love, LOVE Pre' De Provence!

Very Hydrating & Lightly Abrasive My husband and I have both used these. I like the hydration, the hydroxy acid and the feel of these -- I do not find them too abrasive at all. I find them to have a very mild exfoliation and very mild peeling effect. My husband says that his skin tingles after shaving because they have alcohol (this has very little alcohol because it is listed way at the end of a long list of ingredients). So, I like them much more than he does! These pads are embossed with charcoal powder that draws impurities out of the skin and clarify the pores. My skin feels extremely soothed and hydrated after using these!

Rash I'm bummed, because this seems to be working (eyelashes are way softer and less brittle), but it gave me a rash on my eyelids. I have lupus, and my skin is really sensitive, so this probably won't happen to you.

Very Fine Floss These picks use plastic, but very little compared to other floss picks. The floss itself is also very fine, which makes it great for my tight teeth. East to carry. Easy to use. Wish it had no plastic, but that's why I save these for the road, and just use a water flosser at home.

Differentiating Among retinol creams can be a chore. The stuff is what it is, and retinol is good stuff, if you want to turn over your skin cells the way they used to do it for yourself.

This cream has an excellent formula of retinol, moisturizers, and antioxidants. What it also has that many others don't is a pump that keeps air and light from destroying the ingredients. It's 3% retinol, which is pretty strong, so patch test.

Recommend.

Expensive Machines The NuDerma wand has done a lot for my aging skin. There are a few creams and sera I swear by -> modern science is pretty cool. It used to be that anything topical just sat on your skin doing nothing (except the one with the french name and gazillion dollar price tag - which, btw, you can get much cheaper in the blue german tin plus seaweed serum). Anyhoo - enter the era of home treatments. Thermal machines are great if you have the money, and for less (but still not cheap) you can get these wands that are practically miraculous.

Used correctly and alongside good skincare practices, they can clear acne, minimize lines, and restore an awful lot of tone and some volume to aging skin. They don't work for everyone, but my skin is thin from prednisone use and it's aging, and the NuDerma wand has been great at firming and plumping over time.

Mine came with the red wands, and I wanted to try the blue on my kid's pizza face. Did I mention that these things zap you?

Yeah, that's important. They zap you. You want to get some numbing cream. Anyway, he's never going to let me do this again, but it's too bad because it cleared his skin beautifully. And fast. And no giant pores from popping stuff. And because they are combination wands, I can use them on my skin.

All for a very affordable amount.

Clean, Citrus, Pine I bought this out of curiosity about foam cleansers and because a reviewer said it smells like coconut. Actually, it smells like citrus pine to me, which makes a lot more sense looking at the pinecones on the package and the fact is says there pine leaf, grapefruit, and citron extracts. It's a nice scent if you like those. Anyway, I'm finding one pump of these foams work for me (maybe I would need more if I was wearing makeup, and I wish I could tell you how well this removes makeup). This spread thicker than other foams I have used so far. It felt like it did a good job cleaning and left my skin soft and fresh. The price is on par with other foam cleansers I've tried. This would last me a long time since I only need one pump, but I'm just as happy with cheaper cleansers with scents I prefer.

Working well I needed a brush for my cats because the one I've been using removes almost too much hair and hurts my one cat plus it's uncomfortable to hold. The brushes I've been seeing look flimsy and painful with their wire tips. I liked the rubber tips on this so took the chance. It's working great so far. I can tell it doesn't hurt my cat...although she still doesn't love what's happening. It smoothed their hair without pulling it all out. The bristles kept their shape. The button pushed all the hair up, so I could cleanly and easily pull it all off. It's more comfortable to hold, and the cover is actually helpful to keep the bristles clean and protected from being bent. It's a little large for even my large cats but totally doable. It would definitely work for larger dogs as well. The price is reasonable and considering so many other similar brushes received poor reviews, I'm especially happy with this for the price.

Maybe better for older skin? I've used a drugstore pressed powder for years and always gotten compliments, so it's hard to think I need to pay $52. I can't say I was especially impressed by this. HOWEVER, I'm getting to the age where I'm starting to notice my makeup can look dry and accentuate lines I didn't even think I had. I'm not wearing much makeup these days, but based on reviews, I got this with the hope it will work for maturing skin. I can see this also washing you out a bit as another reviewer mentioned. It's white, and even though I'm fair, I felt this needed a very light application. The good news is if such a thin dusting can live up to the reviews, it makes the price a little better. I was surprised how low quality the puff felt. It's very thin and almost felt rough.

Very glittery I have a lot of orange-gold lip colors because I find them very flattering on me, so I was pretty confident I would like this. The color is beautiful and not too orange. While I like the gold too, the specks of glitter are larger and more obvious than I would like. Some gold is really fine and distributes as an even shimmer across your lips. With this, you can see the glitter speck here, the glitter speck there, the glitter speck falling a little outside your lip line that will probably end up somewhere else on your face. It has more of a youthful, party feel. I agree it's a color reminiscent of sunsets, suited for summer and fall. The case is possibly the most sophisticated I own though. It has a nice weight, and the magnetic closure feels good. It came in a box and in a sealed bag. I don't mind wearing this color, but I wouldn't buy it again. I think I like the case the best, but I'm not convinced the color or feel add up to make it worth $38.

Dry rub The tube had a foil seal. There is a pineapple scent. You're supposed to massage the gel on dry skin for 2 minutes. As soon as you start, it starts to pill. I feel like most of it immediately dries up and falls off though I'm sure it's grabbing dead skin too. While it's gentle in that it's not using coarse particles, I didn't enjoy the dry rubbing and tugging at my skin. You can only avoid that over 2 minutes by applying a generous amount of gel, but it's a small tube. My skin looked a little brightened afterwards but not as soft and bright as many other exfoliators (scrubs, peels, masks, serums, etc). This is $12.99, which doesn't seem like as great of a value after seeing how much you need to use. I didn't like the application, results, or price enough to reorder this.

Okay cleanser The bottle came in a sealed box. It's a light pink gel. The scent is nice but more fruity-rose like you might find in products scented for children. It cleans okay. I don't feel it's worth $16, but I don't think I would buy this one again regardless.

Gentle exfoliator If you love strawberries and/or are seeking a gentle scrub, this is a good choice. The sealed tub also had a plastic cover under the the lid and was boxed. The scrub had a little brown in it like what you might see when fruit starts to rot or in yogurt, but it's dated good until 9/14/2023, so I felt okay using it. The red particles made my husband and I realize we didn't confidently know the color of strawberry seeds, but I think they are. They feel kind of squishy, and the scrub feels more like a creamy moisturizing lotion. It does smell like strawberries and makes skin soft. This is a different scrub that feels gentle. I personally prefer one that feels like it's polishing and cleaning more than moisturizing though. This is currently $12.

Prefer the Hydrating Instant Mask I really like Everyday Beauty's Hydrating Instant Mask so was hopeful for this Night Cream, but I wasn't as impressed. It didn't seem to leave my skin quite as velvety soft or last as many hours, yet the Night Cream is more expensive at $38/1 fl oz. The Mask is $22/1.7 fl oz and can be used overnight as often as needed. I use it as the last step in my skincare routine. This cream came in a box, unsealed and simply smells like a cream.

Soft & soothed skin I used this later in a day, after derma rollering, and I felt it helped soothe my skin. No lingering irritation or redness from the derma roller. I'm not sure if it was this serum alone or how it worked in conjunction with my other skin care products, but my skin felt velvety soft afterwards. I enjoyed the lavender-scented milky texture of this serum. It came in a sealed box. It's affordably priced at $9.99. I would get this again.

Good for the price This came with a foil seal in a bag. It's a very sweet scented gel that feels nice on the skin - like a soft layer/barrier, but unlike other overnight masks I've tried, the effects weren't really apparent once you remove this the next morning. It's currently $12.99.
Five Stars Love this product and the price much better than Mugler site!

Seriously, ditch the pouf. You NEED this :) My new love- Good bye pouf balls. This is amazing, really feels like it is exfoliating, especially now with my dry itchy winter skin. I love this. Kept one, will be giving the other two away with nice shower stuff as gifts, then will order more for myself. I wish I had of found these years ago.

Adding to previous review- I am finally ordering another 3 pack. I gave away 2 of the first 3 pack as stocking stuffers to family. Now everyone in my family is talking about these and wanting them. *Please note, if you have really sensitive skin (like me) these work great, just remember don't scrub as hard as you would with your everyday pouf ball thing. These do the exfoliating job just great without lots of pressure. Also, mine has held up beautifully. I throw it in the wash and air dry, still looks new. I really love how I can use on back. I know it sounds silly to get this lathered up (hahahaha) over a product, but this is a game changer.

Good Light Perm Solution Had been using this perm for years when the store quit carrying it. Was glad to find it on Amazon. It is not a strong permanent solution so it rarely burns the hair.  I'm sure you could but it really is good for fine hair. It does have a strong perm solution smell that lasted through the first shampoo, but since it is so good with my hair, it is a small price to pay.  It is important to do a test curl if your hair is a bit longer in order to ensure the bottom curls as much as the top. I didn't time it right last time and the bottom of my hair didn't curl as tightly as the top. A test time would have helped. Still, overall it is an excellent perm for thin delicate hair.

Works great I have fine hair and I was concerned that the boar bristle would pull my hair or get entangled in it.  So far I'm loving this brush - one benefit over others is that the tips are coated which helps keep it from getting tangled.  It is a lightweight brush but seems to be very well made.  I've used brushes before (including boar bristles) and I like this one just fine.  I've only had it a couple of weeks so if anything changes, I'll add to this post.  So far, thought, it seems quality and gives me a perfect curl under on my ends!

Great for the whole body Yes, I do love this product. Not so much for my face because it's probably the most emollient moisturizer I've ever used, and I don't like the feel of anything heavy on my face, particularly during the summer when the humidity is high. But on the rest of my skin? This feels like heaven. As I've gotten older my skin has gone from mixed to quite dry, and this facial moisturizer just ends the flaking and itching, just stops it dead.

I can't say if there's an anti-aging effect going on here since the only place my age shows on my skin is on my face, but if the way my skin feels after applying it is any indication, I'm getting younger by the day. It's a generous 3.4 oz of cream for your money, and you don't need to apply a lot to get the bene fit. So if you have dry skin anywhere on your body, I would say don't hesitate to try this stuff. You may just be happier inside your skin than you have been in a long time.

Pleasant A little goes a long way with this foaming cleanser which is probably why you don't get a lot in the bottle. It lathers up nicely, and comes off leaving a slight slickness on my skin like most moisturizing face or body washes. My face felt good after I used it, clean but not tight or dry.

It is awfully pricey for what you get, so I can't tell you to rush right out and get yourself a bottle. I couldn't afford to use it all the time. I note that it comes with instructions on how to reuse the bottle, thereby cutting down on waste. Unfortunately it came wrapped in several layers of paper in a special box, so... Not quite as small a footprint as they're saying.

Nice enough, but not a necessity.

COol I love the wide selection of soaps, so many to choose from. The soaps are long lasting but can make you a little dry, which is normal for bar soaps I think. It's a great deal and a good way to sample multiple scents. THe bar is a square about the size of my palm.

Emergen-C is a staple for me... Pink Lemonade is a great flavor! I count Emergen-C among my top ten can't live without products. I have at least one everyday. Not only do they taste great (most of the flavors), they really do make me feel better, healthier and go a long way toward reducing headaches.

The pink lemonade? I was skeptical of it at first but it is REALLY good! My top three favorite Emergen-C flavors are Cranberry, Raspberry and now Pink Lemonade. All very tasty.

Pink Lemonade will now be a regular part of my Emergen-C rotation. Yum!
Four Stars Very nice but pads are a bit dried up which is weird!

Candle Wax With Vanilla Extract This stuff is about as much a deodorant as an airplane with no wings. Cakes up under your arms, has a faint smell
somewhat like a flavoring extract. The very faint smell sure isn't sandalwood. I surely WOULD NOT recommend to
anybody. Truth is truth, Fact is fact. You have been advised...

A great way to trim your beard! This is a great way to trim your beard. A definite step up from traditional trimmers. The magic in it is the vacuum that captures and stores trimmed beard and mustache hair instead of letting it fall into your sink to make a mess. You don't make your lady mad, and everyone is happy.

The trimmer itself fits comfortably in your hand. It has an detachable cord that allows the unit to be charged. It can operate on the cord or off it's batteries for cordless use. The trimmer is NOT submersible.

The attached guard can be adjusted to 9 length settings with a rotating selector. It can also be taken off for trimming necklines or other areas. There is also a separate smaller attachment that can be used for precision cuts.

The vacuum is power and made more powerful over earlier models through the use of the "Turbo" button that amps up the cutting power and vacuum power substantially. When you are done cutting your hairs are captured in a removable tray for disposal. There are still a few hairs that don't get sucked up but it a huge improvement over using trimmers without suction.

The only negatives are that the hair capture cup is a tad small. There is also a plastic piece that guides hair into the cup that makes neck and cheek-line trimming a little tricky until you get the hang of it.

Overall a great trimmer for those of us real men with beards. A must have!!

Great hair cutter, easy to use. My wife is a professional hair stylist. She cuts my hair every 2-3 weeks and relies heavily on using electric shears to do so. This unit works very well. It can work plugged in, or with battery, which should give you about 40 minutes of time per charge.

The shears are sharp and do a great job of cutting through my thick hair. The attachments are also very nice. Unlike other units that have 6 or 7 different guards depending on what you want to do. It has a fixed length one, a short variable one, and a long variable one. For my hair she used the short variable one. The settings go from 1/16 of a inch up to about 3/4 inch, and the long variable one goes up from there.

Having the variable length guards is great as it reduces the number of guards you need and allows you to change lengths on the fly.

Using the shears without the guard is also good for trimming to the skinline, edging and shaping.

The only complaint my wife had is that she wishes it were a little more powerful on battery, but wasn't really lacking in power, it is just that she usually uses professional shears. This unit is actually as powerful or more powerful than most shears you buy at walmart or the like.

Overall a great shear for home hair cutting.

This is nice oil. Works very well as a beard oil. I have a big fluffy beard. Unfortunately in the winter, it more resembles a brillo pad in texture and I sometimes look like a homeless person.

This oil works well to condition and treat your beard, and the skin underneath. I apply it right out of the shower after towel drying my beard while it is still damp. I use three squirts of oil, placed in my palm, run my hands together and massage into my beard. It keeps my beard soft and supple all day, and treats the skin underneath to stop dryness and itching.

I almost thought of trimming my magnificent beard down because it was so rough, and it was itchy, this is allowing me to continue to grow it.

My beard hair is soft, manageable, and free of knots.

The glass bottle is heavy duty, so you can take it when you travel.

My ONLY complaint is the cost. It's pretty expensive, but I think a bottle would last you 2 months or so, but it's still a pretty hefty price to pay for a soft and manageable beard, free of itchiness.
broke after 3 uses These worked great the first three times I sprayed my plants.  Then they broke. Junk.

GREAT soap! This soap is great for gifts or yourself!  There are 2 bars nicely wrapped together.  Lavender and peppermint both smell great.  The peppermint has a nice cooling sensation.  They suds nicely and rinse clean with no residue.  Would highly recommend it!!!

Great neon gel polish set The bottles are a nice size, with plenty of polish to work with!  2 thin coats is all I've need to get full coverage. These are a great variety of neon colors.  So fun to work with!  Great for using as a base for stamping.  If applied correctly as directed I have had the polish last for up to 2 weeks.  This is a great value and I highly recommend this polish.

Good size These are actually pretty nice and a good size to use on nails. Also great for my art projets, i like to paint with acrylic paint so these will look great on my art. They took a month to arrive so if you need them right away better think about it. They sont come with a case so ao you will haveto get one to store them.
Good for watercolors [[VIDEOID:e755d7eeac7a1ab5fd83430a2e2ae613]] I got these for my watercolors which I make. They work perfet for it. Good quantity and good price.

Nice scent Even though i dont like scented lotions that much this one is good. The scent it has is very nice. I can take this in my bag  and it does moisturizes my hand plus it leaves them smelling good.
Has acetone Great nail polish. It contains acetone.
Works well Biore delivers again. I am very happy with its cleaning power. Not sure how much this will sell for, but I’d be willing pay about $6 for this.

Good economical shaver The shaver is sharpe and shaves closely, making for a nice shave. It does not have the most sturdy or well built feel to it as it is all plastic, but it will be a good shaver for traveling with.

A box full of fun! This is a really fun facial kit, and Lord knows that the way things have gone with covid we could all use more fun in our lives! This would be a perfect kit to send to your friends and have a spa day over zoom. It has everything you need to feel pampered and it is super affordable!

Surprisingly good! This deodorant has a very strong lavender scent (which is a plus for me!) It went on smooth, though it was difficult to get the plastic cover off of the stick for the first time. It did a surprisingly good job of keeping odors to a minimum, even in the middle of running errands in the heat of summer. Overall I was very impressed with this product.
A nice balance of colors Very nice palette but some of the colors did not survive shipping. The stay on well with eye primer. I need apply only once and they last all day.

Nice colors I bought the wrong product as I wanted nail lacquer and not gel. However, the colors are very pretty and I have a nail gel lamp, so I will keep them. My bottles have samples of the colors on the front. I have not tried them yet, but I hope they are as pretty as the photo.

Semi-permanent way to add volume If you have the patience to put these in and take them out carefully, then it is worth the extra time. This between a wig and a weave. The glue tabs are not bulky and can add volume to thin hair when layered. You will need more than one package for full coverage. I got these to fill out thinning hair. A wig is sometimes too hot to wear and a weave can be too painful. I can put these in and take them out when I am ready. There are plenty of videos about this. I got both off black and dark brown to match my hair color. This can be a fun way to get more fullness without spending hundreds of dollars.

Blends well with oils and micas This is my first attempt at DIY lip gloss. I wanted something that was more moisturizing and in a color I wanted. The base blended well with oils, food grade mica and flavoring. I made a neutral tint with a touch of gold for shimmer. It feels nice on my lips. The gloss did not feel heavy and stayed on my lips. However, the mica color might be richer in clear rather than white. Overall, I am satisfied with my first attempt but I will order clear.

Good bottles.... The bottle are a pretty fair quality, everything fits. I use them for my inks for crafting, and they have held up well. Took a little bit to receive, but it wasn't too long of a wait.

All around, a good headset Used this on a PS4 Pro and it worked great- clear sound from the game and in chatting. It's bulky but not heavy and comfortable to wear- even for hours at a time. The mic is a good length and able to bend a bit, if needed. The cord seems durable and connected well to the PS4 controller. The controls for the headset itself all work good. All around, a good headset 👍

Bling! This is definitely a statement headband! For whatever you decide to use it for, it's big (thick/height wise), flashy and very noticeable…yet very pretty and has a lot of bling 🙌🏽 My 10 year old loves it too and says it's like a queen's headband. The soft lining underneath does help make it comfortable and it fits well!

Nice and great size Having health issues that causes very dry skin, I appreciate a lotion with better ingredients and moisturizing. This one isn't as thick as some but it's doing the job hydrating. It's a great size too!
Cute! Soft. Decent quality. Very pretty coloring with the black roots and silver-gray. The length and style look pretty, too. Fits good and is styled nicely. Looks good, overall like it!

Cute It's really cute and sparkly. Quality is fine but feels slightly off compared to other similar headbands in this price range that I've tried. Hopefully it holds up well, if taken care of. Slightly narrow fit but not too uncomfortable. Liking the look and color!

Liking it The skin on my neck has lost a lot of elasticity. I wouldn't say it's in bad shape but I feel it is for being in mid 30s. Having health stuff going on, former daily tanning machine user, former smoker and my weight goes up-and-down- all things that have contributed to my skin changes and my neck is no exception. This cream is soothing and leaves a lot of moisturize but not a lot of goop. I feel like my skin looks smoother, though I'm sure more consistent and long-term use will bring the most benefits and results. The texture of it is so creamy and thick and feels great on! Arrived sealed and packaged-up really well.

Like the look Soft and pretty. I really like the length and the ombre coloring looks good. Stays fastened pretty well on it's own, though, I use a wig-grip band and it keeps in place well. Great for cosplay, dress-up or just because🙌🏼

Fun and pretty! The coloring looks really cool and pretty. I like that it's got the multiple colors, I personally haven't had many that do. The length and style combined with the colors is a lot of fun. It sheds a little. I try to be careful with the ends as they've been a little tangly but it's a costume wig so I often experience that with other costume wigs, especially with length and curls. Overall I really like it and think it looks good
Liking it Very pretty, soft and the coloring looks even better in person. I feel it's a nice wig, especially for it being more of a costume/cosplay type wig and for the price

Salon Perfect Nails! I just wan't ya'll to know.. I have never given myself a gel polish manicure in my LIFE before yesterday. I had been wanting to for the longest time, but I wasn't 100% prepared to make the commitment to purchasing the light and the top coats and the bottom coats and the paint, etc, etc..

Well if you are on the fence, jump it!

First of all, the lamp works. You set your timer and once you do that, all you have to do is put your hand it and it starts automatically. Awesome! Like a real salon. I was able to do my hands in 45 minutes. It would have been even faster but I did a test run on my thumb before doing them all at once to make sure I didn't mess anything up.

Overall, I am SO happy to have this nail curing lamp!

Junky I think the pony tail holders may work for my little girls but the clips - definitely not. The clips are literally all the same just with different accessories glued on. I'm sure my girls will be able to use them on their dolls. Such a shame. The organizer box though is nice! I'm sure I'll be able to use it for something else.

Elevate for Facials! I love having this Rose Quartz Roller Face Massager for applying all types of face masks and treatments to the face.

When I put a facemask on I like to roll this over it. The rose quartz feels cool and it just feels so refreshing on the face and neck. It's also easy to clean which is nice. I also apply some lotions / creams with it. I like to apply my hyaluronic acid with this. It seems like it works better than using my fingers alone.

What has really impressed me though is the Microneedle Derma Roller. I only use it a few times a week but I really feel like it has helped with my dry flaky skin around my t-zone which has always been a problem for me. My face has never looked better!!

Excellent for Dry Skin If you are an ashy kind of gal then you need some body in your life!

I'm always up for trying something new so I was excited to try this ULTRA LIGHT FULL SPECTRUM BODY OIL.

I think it works best if you put it on while your skin is still damp right out of the bath or a shower. I also try to exfoliate a little bit especially on my legs and other problem areas like elbows and knees.

It's lightly scented which I like because if it's too overpowering it can really flare up my allergies.

I wouldn't use something like this on my face because I do tend to be on the oily side. But for the body it really works great!

I see some results I'm not even going to lie to ya'll... I wear my mascara thick with multiple layers. This makes it SO hard for me to get off. It's not unusual for me to accidentally pull out my eyelashes trying to get my mascara off. This has left my eyelashes looking very sad. I decided to give this a go and I think I see results. My problem is I am defeating the purpose by wearing too much mascara! I think I just need to invest in some fake lashes.

Fresh & Clean I don't know what it is about goat milk soap/cleansers, but they are so luxurious! This is no exception. I have a pre-teen daughter who is on the cusp of puberty and has been suffering from a little acne. She has extremely sensitive skin so this face wash was the perfect option for her. It has kept her face clear from blemishes without drying out her skin.

if u need a quick wig the bundles are ok. I bleached them and died them and they are still soft. received the same day which was awesome for hair. If u need in a hurry this is the place. true to length ( in spots), no odor, bleached the knots and did not thin out the hairline it was ok. The frontal was super large, which i found crazy cause i have a large head. but better it be big than small and tight. Overall a good purchase for my first wig making adventure. probably would order again if the seller can guarantee the frontal and bundles match.

Update: a month after I have made my wig, the 360 frontal holding up. the bundles are ok. I have died and fried this hair many times. it is holding well.
a must have for large lace wigs good

too good to be true,  NO GO ON THIS ONE bundles are thin.  i have an undercut and both sides shaved  i used all except 1/2 bundle.  hair sheds, ends are thin.  so thin in fact i cut off about  4 inches off the ends.  it doesn't tangle that much.  no smell.  hair is dry and doesnt hold curls well.  the curl patter fell straight out the pack.  the hair is not true to length.  the 28 is more like 24 and after cutting the ends its like 20.  not the best or worst.  wont purchase again
OK closure i purchased this to match other hair.  blended perfectly.

WORST CLOSURE EVER got this to add to my bundles,  HORRIBLE, sheds, is nappy, and brittle, I have never had  closure this awful.  EVER. Thin I am more of a thick hair girl so I was not amazed at this wig.  I have a large head so the wig looks very thin on me.  The construction is superb and the  knots are bleached and the hairline plucked.  perfect if you have a thin face.  The length is fine
Does not stick to my greasy face I was very hopeful for this item but sorry it does not work for me I have oily skin and they do not stick after a while.

Great lashes Great lashes, soft and east to put on.  they look so real and make my eyes pop.  I have used them several times and they do not fall off easily.  Very full and dramatic but natural.  Love them.  will purchase more.

Great lashes Good lashes but not dramatic enough for me.  They are lightweight and stay on for at least a week almost two.  The length is good but the drama isnt there.  These are good for everyday use for me.  I would buy again.

My go to lashes Great for daily wear, I even sleep in them.  They come off easily when I need to remove and do not pull my own lashes out.  They do not feel like mink lashes and seem more of a plastic feel, but are soft and mimic mink lashes great.  They are think and luscious but are not cartoony. Not so Starry Thank you in advance to the Amazon VINE program for providing an item to review. A positive review was not required, nor was it requested, and all words are my own.

Getting my nails done is not just a relaxing experience, but it is also an expressive/creative one.

Seeing this colorful and glittery set – I had to get it.

I don’t know about others’ experiences – mine did not come with a brush or applicator for the little “gel pots”. I remembered what my nail techs used to use – small make-up brushes – and thankfully I had some. That seemed to work.

Overall, I’m not too unhappy with it. It’s not something I would likely purchase again.

And, they worked! They don’t pinch at all; even my mom used them and said she could barely feel them.

Light weight and fairly durable. There are enough for two people to use at the same time, or extras on hand if they ever break.

If used for poly gels, I’m sure they would work just as well.

Not The Best Set Out There Be warned, this is NOT “dip powder”. This is indeed acrylic powder in VERY small jars.

This does not come with instructions though – at least mine didn’t. So that could make this a bit hard to work with.

The colors are pretty though.

This isn’t the best kit out there, I have seen better ones. The packaging isn’t that stable or durable. I ended up putting the jars in a pencil case.

I honestly wouldn’t get it again. As far as durability, I usually do my manicure every week or so.

There are a few issues with it, but I’m overall pleased.

Very easy to use.

Not The Worst, But Definitely Not The Best I really wanted to LOVE this scrub – there was just too much wrong with it to even LIKE it.

First of all – this is FAR TOO THICK to squeeze out of the tube. I had to SMASH it with my arm to get it to MOVE.

The scent? If you’re looking for Bath & Body Works type of Cherry Blossom, you’re not going to get it.

Once you get it out, and can take the scent – after it is applied, it is a soft, moisturizing and no slip scrub.

This isn’t something I’d get again or recommend.

Barely Made a Wave I have been trying, for well over 30 years, to get a curling iron that actually did what it was supposed to – curl my hair.

Hot curlers – no good results

Curling Irons (¼, ½) – no good results

Wrap-Around Fabric Curlers – nothing there

I saw this and thought it couldn’t fail. Simple to use – plug in, turn on, heat up, section hair, and use – put hair in, count down.

Works in theory, fails in execution. First up – there is NO heat seating guide for SAFE curling. THIS DEVICE IS CELSIUS (C) ONLY, NO FARENHEIT (F) OPTION. Google is strongly needed here.

According to Redken: “For those with fine or thin hair, keep your iron set below 200 (so below 100°C on this device) degrees Fahrenheit. Any higher and your strands may burn. For those with coarse or thicker hair, have your curling iron set between 200 degrees and 300 degrees (148.9°C or on this device 150) Fahrenheit for optimal curls” [9 Curling Iron Secrets You Need to Know About/Redken]

Using that, as well as Glamour’s 8-10 second rule [How to Curl Your Hair Correctly: 7 Mistakes to Avoid – Glamour; “Drill it into your brain: You should hold an iron on your hair for eight to 10 seconds max”], along with using thinner groups of hair – I should have SOME wave. Nope. I even went 25 seconds. Nothing.

As my hair has become a bit thinner, has been color treated, and exposed to SO much – I wasn’t about to turn this up hotter.

The curler is designed much like a crimper, but the “width” can make it difficult to handle, especially by yourself. There is a “guard” which heats up as well and it is easy to burn yourself.

It wins with innovative idea as well as the digital temp gauge. Also, it does heat up SUPER fast, as well as cool down just as fast when lowering the temp.

For use by myself – this is a two star deal. Perhaps if someone else were around it might be easier, but this definitely did not work well.

Has most everything needed and easy to store. Love the pretty case. Price is great as well.

Each tool is functional and works great.

It Slightly Works This product as a lot going for it. I love the idea of the individually gift boxed tubes, the cap is wonderful (huge and easy to use), the product is generously sized.

The problem is that this stuff is runny, doesn’t absorb that well on me, and the “scent” that is there – it isn’t that great.

For $15 before tax, that is roughly $3.75 a tube, and while they’re smaller – I’d honestly stick with Bath & Body Works.

This isn’t something I’d get again and I wouldn’t recommend it. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.

Great for Travel As most have said here – these are great for travel, especially when you can’t find soap around but have water. Though I wouldn’t carry a bar of soap, I have used “travel” size body wash as a hand soap. If it cleans the body, should clean the hands, right?

Anyway …

The metal container I got was dented, but that is okay as I don’t intend to travel where I won’t have soap. So, I’m using these at my bathroom sink.

LET ME STATE THIS AS A WARNING: HANDS MUST BE DRY BEFORE GRABBING A SOAP SHEET.

I know all caps is yelling, but trust me – it is for a VERY GOOD reason. As one reviewer said, even a drop of water can damage these.

Basically I grab a one with dry hands, hold it in palm, turn water on, let it dissolve. Good lather, I don’t really smell a “scent”, hands wash clean. They don’t dry out, but I do use a moisturizing sanitizer, and hand lotion after.

I wouldn’t say these go years – if you’re like me and using them as an alternative to other hand soaps to preserve waste, they might last about a month (8 washes per day, 30 days). If only as travel backup – they might last a few years. Again, it depends on how they’re used.

I personally find them a bit on the pricey side at almost $10 before tax. That’s just me.

I do have other soaps, and these should last me a while. I would not recommend them as a body wash. As opposed to carrying a bar of soap, try a travel container with body wash. Just my suggestion.

Wax On, Wax Off, Hair Still There I think a lot of us want an easier way to remove hair. Shaving, especially for a bigger girl like me, is not that easy. It’s worse when you have long legs, short arms.

It’s bad when you have certain chin hairs (thankfully not that much it isn’t manageable another way).

I tried some sugar wax kit back about 20+ years ago. That was a NIGHTMARE! It was supposedly edible. I think you microwaved the container, spread it on, let it cool, used a paper strip (supplied) to remove the hair. It didn’t work and stung.

I then moved to a hair removal cream, that partially worked.

After that? Back to the hold stand-by –> shave foam/cream and a razor. For my main body parts, that’s always worked. Tough “chin” hairs –> using a tweezer work. No, the dermaplaning tool didn’t work on them.

I got a wax warmer, so I thought all beads/beans were equal.

These came with ZERO instructions, and the after spray bottle was busted. The warmer kit at least had some. And, my warmer kit had specially made, disposable “cups”.

These beads/beans, in a smaller cup, took over 90 minute to melt. And, the warmer was on 180°(F).

I tried a small amount on my arm. The wax was sticky, not liquidy, and it cooled almost as soon as it hit my skin.

I let it sit there for a few minutes (over 5), and peeled the max off. It didn’t hurt, sting, or cause redness – then again …

THE HAIR WAS STILL THERE

Okay, so my hair on my arm is a little thin. But, if this removes thick hair, shouldn’t it remove thinner hair?

I found another patch, got some warm wax – tried it again. Nope. Tried legs, arms, and under my chin. Nothing. Then again, I see I'm not the only one experiencing issues with these beads/beans.

I may have gotten a bad batch. But, I definitely wouldn’t get these again.

Beautiful But Need to Be Cautious When Using This is, for less than $10, a lovely comb.

Can function at a wedding or other event. However, the cons outweigh the beauty.

Given how delicate this is, there is NO storage box or bag. So, after use – where does one put it? That is an issue for me. Even a simple velvet type bag would be a good idea.

Second? The comb itself.

While absolutely stunning in design – function is a bit questionable because of the construction. The combs are “OPEN” design – thus loose hairs can weave in, particularly those with thick and curly hair. This makes removal or readjusting a bit difficult if not a tad uncomfortable.

This is also for thicker hair, not thin, and thus circles back to the issue I just presented.

While pretty, it isn’t something I am particularly pleased with. It isn’t something I would get for myself again. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.
