You get two mirrors for the price of one, a regular mirror and one with a higher magnification for those times when you need a closer inspection.  The light has a lovely, and very helpful, color temperature that's pretty close to daylight, just a bit warmer, and is featured around both mirrors.  It's operated by a switch on the bottom, so you aren't wasting your batteries.  It runs off of two coin batteries.  The mirror is larger than most. The best. After having used this product for a month, I find myself hooked. As YMMV when taking someone's word on shave gear, I thought I might provide some background about me: I have gentle to oily skin and stiff, tough neck hairs. I used to think I had sensitive skin until I married someone with actual sensitive skin. But the combination of the tough hairs and the gentleness of my skin leads to irritation on the neck when I am not careful. I learned to shave with a gillette adjustable years ago(which I still use), but out of "convenience" (really, a lack of good shaving products and knowhow) I stopped using it for cartridge systems in my early twenties. Since I started shaving right, some time ago, I got an EJ-89 which I use when I'm feeling raw, and an old type open comb gillette (which, for the moment at least, I favor for its closeness- I use personna lab blue blades or sharper in it). I've tried a number of different soaps and a few creams, most of which are good. Mitchell's is excellent. It has a simple, clean smell like fresh linen and is the most thoroughly hydrating shaving product I have ever used. It lathers up easily- I've used my beat up old drugstore boar brush which is now probly 15 years old and a silvertip badger brush.. In either case, the lather whips up in a minute or less with no complications. I'm not one of these people that soaks the puck either, I just heat it up in its dish, in a basin of hot water as I soak my brush and it is good to go. I've heard that water hardness and temp can make a difference with this stuff, but as I have decidedly soft water here in the city, I can't really comment on that. But once you get the lather right, with enough water, it is eaaasy on the face. Amazing even.. I dreamt wetshaving was like this as a teenager..
One might be put off by the price which may seem hefty for a newcomer to the wetshaving game, eager to start saving money (previously lost on walking the cartridge treadmill) and reticent to buy apparently expensive luxury shaving soaps, but aside from being a quality product, It lasts for a quite a while. I was really going to wait until I had exhausted mine to write this review but it's been a month, and the puck looks basically the same size! Growing up on Williams soap and favoring Van der Hagen as a drugstore standby these days, I notice one soap generally lasts me a month (some less than that), but aside from the simply larger size of Mitchells (4.4 oz to 2.5 oz for standard mug size soaps), you just get more bang for your buck. I'm guessing this one will last me three months or more.. So at that rate, the price basically factors out altogether.
To sum up, if you have gentle or easily irritated skin and aren't looking for a heavily scented product, this is the grail of soaps for you. One word: I wouldn't spring for the dish because I am cheap. You might not be.. But the soap itself does perfectly fit a rice bowl or large ramekin, in case you were wondering.. Probably not a mug though, unless it were seriously oversized..

Works well (Reviewed by my wife):

Great stuff-takes of gel polish easily! Anyone knows-use acetone to remove the toughest of nail polishes-or so I thought! This stuff works! Literally works! The good, the bad and the ugly... My review consists of the good, the bad and the ugly. First,
the good - I finally found a curler that 'fits' my eyelid. Huh, you say? Well, it appears that most of the manufacturers believe I have golf balls instead of human eyes. The tool's shape is long and shallow enough of a curve to catch most of the eyelashes. It is comfortable to use, but takes a bit of practice. Once you are comfortable with the scissor motion (sorry, no other way to describe it) used to make the curl, you are rewarded with a nice, non-crimpy curl. The pad in this one is the best I have used. This tool also opens wide enough that even the most nearsighted or lush lashed amoungst us can get it close to the base of the upper lashes. The design over all is very well thought out. I recommend using an magnifying mirror if you have to use bifocals (I do). All that said, now...
the bad - there is no replacement pad and I am questioning how sanitary this is going to be in the long run. I agree completely with folks here who advise to REMOVE ALL EYE MAKEUP before use. Ain't nothing pretty about an eye infection. I am wondering out loud how to properly clean this curler to be certain it remains safe. If you are prone to sties and other types of infection, I would be asking the same questions. Which leads to...
the ugly - until you practice and are used to it (won't take long) the results are a bit odd looking. The black pad is plushier and looks to be made of silicone and not the usual hard rubber. I have found that the hard rubber pads are chiefly responsible for that weird ugly crimp you can get. Not so with this one. I mentioned before the squeezy scissor action your thumb and index finger have to use can be tricky. If you have coordination issues, well - things could get ugly.
SUGGESTIONS for use...wash your hands before use. I keep the little plastic clip to keep the tool closed. You could follow the advise of one person here to heat the tool with a dryer, but I think I may skip that. Use a makeup mirror to assist you. Practice when you have some time. Enjoy, Ladies - get out there and be lovely.

Love Derma-nu Hyaluronic Acid? I never knew what it was until recently :) sounds like something you use in the brakes on your car. hyaluronic acid (also known as hyaluronan) is a glycosaminoglycan, a type of molecule composed partly of sugars. Hyaluronic acid is actually a natural structural component of skin, and, in fact, is present in connective tissue throughout the human body.

The awesome thing about Hydrolic Acid is its ability to retain moisture; it’s considered to have a greater capacity to hold moisture than any other natural or synthetic polymer. In fact, one gram of hyaluronic acid is able to hold up to six liters of water. The hallmarks of youthful skin is its moisture content. A dried up face will age you quicker then anything.

Hyaluronic acid can improve your skin’s moisture content and at the same time strengthen skin’s barrier; that is, the outer layers of your skin. A healthy barrier looks and feels softer, smoother, and plumper. This does all of that. Sense menopause I have suffered from dry skin. This has made a big difference in how my face looks and feels. Don’t love it but don’t hate it This foundation is a tricky one. There are things I really like about it and things that I don’t.
I bought it in the shade 04 Honey. In the bottle it looks like an almost exact match to my skin, but when I put it on it’s much paler with a decidedly pink undertone, yet it doesn’t look orange or too pink in my skin. I prefer a neutral undertone though since my skin can be both yellow and pink.

I love the bottle and packaging. It comes in a frosted glass bottle with a pink pump and pink cap that snaps on tightly.

The coverage is much higher than I expected and it is heavier than expected for a luminous foundation.

It covers blue tones better than redness. I have typically had to build it up in areas I have more redness (and we’re talking average redness, not anything extreme) and doing this makes it look much heavier so I end up using a concealer instead. The problem with this lies in the finish.

So this foundation’s finish is very confusing and hard to describe. It is very glowy and luminous without being shimmery but it has the heaviness of a matte. I know, confusing.
Areas can look too greasy or too dry. It settles into fine lines and creases around the eyes and nostrils. For this reason this is not a foundation I choose for the daytime. It’s much too heavy and shiny for the day, which is a shame because I enjoy it’s longevity. Once I set it with some powder around the eyes and my nostrils I really enjoy it for a night out.

I should also mention it is heavily perfumed with a floral scent so those sensitive to scented foundations will likely want to give this a pass. It’s not bothersome to me personally but fragrance can irritate really sensitive skin.

All in all I don’t use it as much as I hoped I would and probably won’t repurchase based on that and how heavy it is. At 36 I want a foundation with decent coverage but a lighter feel. It’s also not the easiest foundation to completely remove and when I wear it I have to use a cleaning oil and a cleanser both AND a miceller solution.

I have combo skin that can be prone to breakouts with certain brands but I haven’t broken out from this foundation.

I enjoy Holika Holika’s BB cream which is why I gave this a shot (and I like a luminous foundation) but I’ll probably stick with the BB cream in the future since it’s lighter.

The All Natural way to remove nail polish! I'm puzzled by this product. I loved the idea of having a natural, non-toxic nail polish remover. I paint my own nails quite often, skipping the nail salon to save money and time. I've been giving myself manicures and pedicures since 6th grade, so I'm pretty good at it (if I do say so myself) and am well-versed in many of the products out there. I typically use a 100% acetone remover, which is AWESOME, but I hate that there are so many harmful chemicals, not only on my nails, but also in the fumes I'm breathing in every time I use it. So, when I saw this product, I was excited and motivated to try it and like it.

When it arrived, I was also pleased with the size. I had assumed it would be pretty small because of the way the dropper looks next to it in the picture, but it's actually a good sized bottle. Before using any product, I read the directions and particularly with a new type of product like this non-toxic, all-natural nail polish remover. That's when I saw that you have to leave the product on the nail for 2-5 minutes. I don't understand this because once you use the dropper to apply the product to the nail polish that's on the nail, it immediately starts dripping down the sides of the nails onto your hands and makes a bit of a mess. It's also pretty inconvenient to sit there for 5 minutes when I could use my regular nail polish remover and would have clean nails in 30 seconds to a minute. I decided instead to try pouring the product into a shallow bowl and soaking my nails in it instead. This did make it much easier and created less of a mess, but it also requires you to use a lot more of the product than you would just using the dropper.

I waited 2 minutes and took a cotton ball to swipe the nail to see if the polish would come off. It started to, but just the top layer. I re-soaked them in the product for 3 more minutes, and I was able to remove the polish from my nails. I should also mention that I use Orly bonding base coat, which helps the polish adhere to the nail. I also had 3 coats of polish, and a top coat, so that might be why the polish was so stubborn to come off. Plus, it was a deep red, which is difficult to remove no matter what you are using, and it usually dyes my nail beds a bit when I'm removing the polish anyway. As a positive, I did notice that this product was MUCH less harmful on my nails. My acetone remover immediately dries out my nails and strips all the healthy oils from the nails and nail beds. This did not do that. My nails had a nice, healthy shine to them and the nail beds retained their moisture, which is nice.

So, in summary, I love that this product is natural and non-toxic, but it's just not practical for me to spend 5 minutes soaking my nails to wait for the polish to come off. However, if you are super green and more willing to commit to being patient in order to be able to use something that has no chemicals and is good for your body and those around you (which I commend you for!), then this is a great substitute for chemical nail polish removers.

In that 3rd pic, the first piece of hair is out of the pack, not washed or dyed; the second piece of hair is the bleached portion, and the third piece is just cowashed.  You can see beautiful curls in all three parts, so feel free to wash or bleach, the curls seem to be here to stay. Lastly, the length is very true (slightly longer, actually).

The least amount of tangling of all the brands I've ... The least amount of tangling of all the brands I've tried so far.  THe color is a shiny 27/30 color.  I wiish it came in 26".  Will def buy again.

Yes, yes, yes!!!!! I hope this seller stays in business 4ever! Wish I could order single bundles... Will definitely order again. Longer next time. This time, I got the 14,16,18. The color is gorgeous and a true 30 color. I did lightly bleach it to bring that ombre 30 higher/closer to the weft (I wanted the lighter color closer to my eye area and not just on the bottom half of the hair. I attached photos to show how the curl pattern was affected by the bleach (deep curl pattern still in effect, just went from a jerry-4a to a 3b/3c (see the first and second pics). In that 2nd pic, the first section of hair is out of the pack, not washed or dyed; the second section of hair is the bleached portion, and the third piece is not bleached, only just cowashed. You can see beautiful curls in all three section, so feel free to wash or bleach (be careful, though), the curls seem to be here to stay. Lastly, the length is very true (slightly longer, actually).
Three Stars 'Meh', compared to their volume lashes...

Will buy again. Was disappointed at first sight because of how thin the individual lashes used to make the clusters were...until I put them on. They do not fail to fan out and quickly make themselves known.  Being so light keeps them from weighing down my own fragile lashes, which is a good thing.  I do have that glam look now and plan to keep that way...until I get bored.

So far, so good It seems you should go in one direction or it will pull the hair a bit.  In the other direction (you'll have to discover which way for your self), it is completely painless.  Even in the 'wrong' direction, it's not bad and I'm not super pain tolerant. Needs no batteries, so that's great, too.

BUY THIS FREAKING HAIR!!! I bought the curly wavy version of this hair (is tighter than wavy  but that's what I wanted) and I bought the kinky curly version of this hair.  Both take bleaching very well without losing the curl integrity (very important to me).  I mean, I bleached and toned and bleached again to get to the 27 color and the hair didn't fry.  The curly wavy still looks great after three months and I expect the kinky curly probably will, too.  Love this company and will continue to buy from them as long as the prices are this great.

This cream is great This cream is great. The bottle it comes in is beautiful. It is a black lucite jar with a screw top lid. I keep this hand cream near my computer. My skin is very dry, and I noticed that this cream keeps my skin soft for most of the day, even through washing them. The cream is unscented. I can read all the ingredients on the panel. Almost all of them are oils. This product is all natural. There is no greasy feel and it absorbs very quickly.
I received this hand cream at a promotional price in order to share my honest and unbiased opinion.

great taste, price is high Rocky Mountain Hemp Hearts have a great taste. I have ordered them a couple of times and used them a number of ways as have other reviewers, but favorite recipe is to add to a smoothie. They taste great and I have never found a hull. I was introduced to them by a local smoothie place which charges about $2 for a scoop, so I decided to find and buy my own and did on Amazon. I agree with the a couple of other reviewers,: 1-The lid of the container does come off too easily, so I wish Rocky Mountain would provide a container with a more secure top. 2: These are very expensive in comparison to other brands. After reading reviews, i have decided to try Nutiva. If it has a lot of hulls, then it's not worth the lower price and I'll I'll post an update.
* Suggestion for Rocky Mountain: lower the price and place them in a bag and customers can transfer to their own containers as most do anyway.

Provide long-lasting, bouncy curls without the headache These are soft and pliable.  I find them a nice alternative to curling and flat irons. The curls from these last several days (personal experience) and the curls are fluffy and bouncy. The larger the roller, the larger the curl.  Mixing them with different size rods has been very successful and gain many compliments. They require being applied to dampened hair if hair is fine, straight. They are soft to sleep on, and when I'm in a hurry and applied for a half hour or so or while showering, they were just as effective as wearing for several hours.

Nifty idea but I'd worry about it holding mask in place What's that saying about necessity being the mother of invention? Well here we are in a pandemic wearing face masks. Someone came up with the idea of a head band with buttons to hold the mask mask in place.

This is a thin material. Think very thin t shirt type material. The headband measures about 18 inches and just over 3 inches wide. I like the material for a headband. However, its use as a mask holder is iffy. Many people complain that the elastic that holds the masks in place makes their ears pop out. That is definitely true of some masks. They can also be wearying on the ears, having that elastic against your ears all day, so this headband is a great concept.
I put the headband on and as I stretched it over my head, I heard a pop, so some stitching gave somewhere.

I attached two types of masks, one at a time. First, it was a bit fiddly to get the elastic over the button. Once it just sprang off.

One mask using the buttons fit well. Another did not. The latter mask opened up on the sides.

I would hesitate to wear this out thinking that everything would stay put for hours. I like the headband as a headband. It's nice material. A sort of light grey merle, but if you are looking at this for long-term safety, I would say no.

Good clay mask I liked this clay mask a lot. The mask cream is very thick indeed, and it takes a squeeze to get it out of the tube. It goes a long way, but at the same time, this is a small tube (3 oz). It dries quickly. And it's the type of mask that makes your face feel TIGHT. The type where you can't smile.
After about 20 mins, I washed this off. It was easy to remove. After using a few times, I think it does indeed have a brightening effect on the skin. It doesn't moisturize. At least it didn't for me, and I had to lather on cream afterwards as my skin felt a bit dry after the mask.
Overall I liked this. I like how it worked but it is on the pricey side.

A new experience I've never quite tried anything like this. The cleanser is a light green gel--almost slime but not slimy. Instructions say to apply with wet fingers.
At first I used too much as the cleaner went far further than I expected. It has a wonderful light fruit smell and smears easily over the face. I have very sensitive facial skin and this cleaner did not present any problems. It was easy to wash off. My skin felt nice afterwards--not dry at all.

I love the purple This great set is a larger square and two small circles. The material is so soft, you want to rub your face all over it. Each piece comes with a handle for easy storage/drying. Instructions say these can be machine washed and dried but I hand washed mine and they came out just as lovely as before.
The seams are very well sewn with some type of lightly corded material.
Very nice indeed. The colour is purple but it's a heliotrope purple. Quite beautiful.

fairly gentle I have very sensitive facial skin so I have to be careful with any products. This did not irritate my skin. I would say that it is a very mild facial scrub. It didn't take much to use on my face, but it didn't feel as though it did a while lot either. Pleasant enough but I wouldn't be tempted to buy it.

Great box The box is the best thing here. I had high hopes for the mascara. It's string, so it doesn't go on easily. It clumps. And I also found it very difficult to remove, Of course it is waterproof and that feature works. It took many swipes with oil to start to break this up and off the lashes.

Moisturizes nicely This cream is very moisturizing. It feels a bit decadent to be honest. It's a light green and not quite as cucumber-y as I would like. The cucumber smell is there but it's more delicate than another cucumber cream I have on hand.
It's silky smooth, goes on easily and is very quickly absorbed. It is pricey, but it makes my skin feel soft and supple.
It's especially good on some tough spots--neck and elbows.

not that strong This is a fairly weak retinol formula. I have several on my shelf and I can tell from using them which ones are stronger. This isn't the worst I have tried but I would place it in the middle range. It's rather expensive for what you get. It's also quite thin and runny.

Oily If you look at the ingredients listed, there are a lot of oils: coconut oil, Jojoba oil, Clary Sage essential oil, organic Ylang Ylang essential oil, neroli essential oil, geranium essenatil oil, sunflower seed oil, lavender oil, rose absolute, Jasmine absolute and a vitamin E oil blend. I think I got them all.
The name of this item says 'cream.' It is an oil. It is far too greasy for my face. I used it on my arms and legs and liked it but as you can expect, it leaves an oily shine. It had a woodsy type scent not too strong. If you are expecting 'cream' this is not it. Oil, yes.

Well this is fun I wasn't sure what to expect from this product, but it is really fun. Who thought that pink eyelashes would look great?
I am not a make up expert and I don't think I am that good at it either, so I have no problem admitting that MY end result did not look like the pictures. And I will also admit that this may be my fault.
The pictures show eyelashes that look solidly pink (or whatever colour you buy); mine did not come out like that. The brush tends to carry a lot of mascara so I got some clumping.
My eyelashes, which are black, ended up pinkish over the black near the base but with pink tips and I actually think it looks better than the professional pics. The only way I could get solid pink eyelashes ended up with too much clumping. So it was possible to get solid pink eyelashes and I did, but then I had to gently wipe off all the excess mascara and that left me with pink tips.
Honestly, I liked it that way, I think it looks more subtle and not so obvious. The pink mascara goes great with mauve or nude eyeshadow IMO.
This needed a couple of minutes to dry but after that it didn't smudge. And it really does lengthen and thicken lashes. I'm happy with the look and like it more than the professional photos on site.

More vanilla than musk I liked this shower wash. The liquid is thick and feels rich. It produces a heavy lather. I like both musk and vanilla and found this to be a pleasant blend with its emphasis on vanilla.
I had no issues with my skin using this.

Quite surprisng This is a very pale mud mask. It spreads really easily. It's not as 'mud' looking as most of the other ones I've tried. Makes you look like a ghost appearance wise or someone who is very pale.
I left this one for about an hr. It never cracked, but it was there as a very light mask. Easy to wash off. My skin felt very soft afterwards. I was surprised really as I had left it on for so long I'd almost forgotten about it.
I feel that the mud mask did have a restorative effect to my skin. It also has a very subtle (and I mean subtle) flower scent. I liked the scent but was happy that it wasn't too strong as I have extremely sensitive facial skin and perfumed skin products make me itch.
My skin still feels softer 24 hrs later.

Sold! I just recently started using purple shampoo. I have grey hair, btw. I liked the results I had with another brand so was eager to try this brand. First, at least at the time of this review, the price is decent.
The purple shampoo is a deep violet. I applied it to my wet hair and worked it in. Loved the purple lather. Then applied the conditioner which is more of a deep inky blue. The instructions said to leave it in for a few minutes. When I wash it out, my hair feels differently--it feels as though there's still something there on my hair, but deeply mixed in. It feels differently than when I use regular shampoo.
Anyway, I love what this does for my hair. It seems to brighten the light silver and darken the darker grey. At least that's what it seems like. No frizzies either and that's important for me.
I used Great Clips brand before trying this, and while I really liked what Great Clips Purple shampoo did for my hair, I prefer this brand. Anyway, I'm sold. I like the tones and depths the purple shampoo gives my hair.

Ok for costuming, teens etc My head measures about 22 1/2 around. On me the wig seemed to be on the small side. The hair is obviously fake as it is meant to be so so problem there, and it's a nice quality nylon or nylon type material. I love the colours.
It comes with a hair net, 2 wig caps, a pearl-type clip and a pair of druzy post earrings. The latter were a surprise and a pleasant one.
I had a hard time getting the wig to cover the very front section of my hair. I think anyone who has masses of hair, or really long hair may find this wig doesn't cover easily.
The hair hangs awkwardly. It falls forward into the face. I trimmed it a bit.
IMO this is a great wig for costuming and/or teens, but those with masses of long hair may find it problematic.

Great colours The best thing about this wig is the colours: fantastic fantasy cosplay colours: it's just beautiful. The 'hair' is soft and not too shiny. Too shiny would really spoil this IMO.
The hair is REALLY full, so it's going to either look The Shining scary, or else, you are going to need a crown or something to keep the hair off your face. You can also style it off your face too.
The hair is cut in a long shag style, with some bits in the back much shorter. This gives it the full look. The hairline section is the wig's weak point and it looks fake--well it looks fake anyway with the colours, but it's hard to make the wig look GOOD. Again back to styling, crown, or some type of headband to smooth over the hairline section.

3-1. Love the purple Of the three wigs here, the purple is the best. I would give that wig 5 stars. The colour is fantastic; it's not the same purple all over; it's got different shades and the hairline is fantastic.
The black wig is bad. I'd give that 2 stars. It's super shiny but the worst thing is that there is NO way I can hide my hairline unless I pull the wig farther down on my forehead. It's also not cut that well, but that's possible to fix. The hairline issue is not fixable.
The grey wig---I love that one too. My second favourite. It's got those great dark roots. It is very long so tangling may be an issue depending on use. But it looks great, fits well etc. So.. 2 out of 3 ain't bad.
Overall a great deal as long as I accept that one wig is fairly useless for me.

Ever wanted to know what you will look like with grey hair? The colour of this wig is very attractive. It's a beautiful silver but there's black subtly peppered in here too. It's not that obvious at all until you get up close.
The hair is on the shiny side, but IMO that goes with the grey.
The tresses are loosely curled and the side area of the hair is cut much shorter--below my ears so this could do with some styling.
The biggest issue is the hairline. I can see the cap and the very center part of the hairline cap does not want to sit flat. So it needs work.
Very attractive overall--I'm going to have to work on the hairline....

I love this wig This is a super wig and I'm very happy with it. The stretchy lace cap inside is a sort of cafe-au lait colour which matches the wig. The wig looks a slightly different colour than it does on MY screen but that can't be helped at times. IMO the green is prettier. In person it looks like a pale Jade. Plus the colour is not uniform as there are lighter hairs too so the overall effect is FAB. The bangs are great. Had to trim just a bit (as expected) and they help with the hairline.

really pretty One of the headbands was aurora borealis and the other was black. The aurora borealis is beautiful and all the rhinestones catch and reflect the light so there's a huge WOW factor. At first glance, the black one seemed a disappointment in comparison but once under the light, the silver tone sets off the black rhinestones well. It's more subtle and not as WOW as the other headband but it's also very pretty.
The headbands have lots of flex and are very comfortable to wear. The inside of the band is a soft black velvet which is pleasant to the touch. Well sewn. No loose ends

Very pretty Whoever designed these hair clips knows that little girls LOVE unicorns. The sequins on one clip project a gold-fuchsia vibe while the other is magenta, gold and blue.
The wings and star are glued on and I can see these coming off in time but hey I've got a glue gun. The front of strong clips (the bit you see) are covered in the dusky pink grosgrain ribbon, and the endings look neat and tidy. These are a big hit with a 6 year old

A bit big I have a number of pink ombre wigs. This one is Ok but not my favourite. The top section is mostly dark but it looks more chocolate brown than black (I like black). I like the length of this. The pink sections are very nice and I like the chade of pink. Not salmon but not dusty pink either. The hair has a nice wave to it--nothing too extreme. It's soft but doesn't have that static thing that some wigs have that causes the hair to stick to your arms. '
The mocha coloured lace cap is nice and stretchy but it is a tad big for my head. It does have adjustable straps inside. The biggest issue I had with this is the shape of the head section. It's rather dome shaped. I think the cap is overly wide.

For kids This is a fun little set geared towards little girls. It has the nail spacer included in a lovely glittery purple. The nail polish tends towards the clumpy so I added some thinner. I don't expect perfection anyway with nail polish for kids as the little girl in question doesn't sit still long enough for it to dry properly anyway. But thicker polish is destined to be a problem. So thinner is great.
The colours are perfect for a little girl and she was thrilled with this set. Teens... may require something a bit more sophisticated.

A lovely gift set This would make a lovely gift set for all those people you don't know 'that ' well. But since the 3 enclosed bath bombs spell MOM, then the box is limited... The gift box wrapping is lovely. Take off the mocha silk ribbon which matches well with the paper, and underneath is a plain cardboard box.
I love these combo boxes: inside: 3 bath bombs which are very lightly scented, a box of dried rose petals (yeah potpourri bags) and an adorable, square bar of soap. I put the soap in my shower near the shower head as the water drips release some of the scent over time as the soap melts.
Anyway, a very nice, gentle set. I wish the bombs didn't spell MOM as then this would be very giftable to something other than MOM.

way too strong I tried the Lavanda. It is way too strong. It's suggested to spray it on clothes, on the body and perhaps even in air.
The spray is ejected in a tiny amount. I thought to myself it was too tiny an amount until I smelt it. It has all the good labels, no cruelty to animals, gluten free (I did pan on eating it!), etc etc. With just a small amount on my wrist, the smell was overpowering. I thought it might wear off but I ended up washing it off. It was just too strong. Smelled chemically to me--not a bit like flowers. Can't imagine putting this on a baby or baby clothing.

Happy with the purchase Bought as gift to a natural queen
She absolutely loves it

Nice Ingredients This organic eye cream has an excellent list ingredients, plant based with natural oils.  It's thick and a bit oily.  I like the feel of it, but recommend it for drier complexions.  Use smaller amounts.
A Beautiful Shadow!! A beautiful Shadow from colourpop!!! Greats Great! Last All Day!
A great buy Love this!! Work beautifully !

After workout wipes Works great cleaning me up after a workout when I cannot get to the shower.  I feel clean and refreshed.  Thick, large wipes that are easy to use and clean you totally up.  Great for the money too, you get 140 wipes, so sick of paying a ridiculous amount for only 25 wipes from other brands.

Lovely exfoliating scrub I absolutely love how well Plu berry mix body scrub exfoliates the skin.  It gets rid of dry, dead skin without being abrasive and does not cause any irritation.  I have been using this scrub daily and love the results.  It not only smells beautiful but it leaves my skin smooth and silky.  Definitely a new favorite go to body scrub for me!

Powerful Defuser!! I’ve only owned 2 defusers before and this one by far takes the cake! The amount it pushes out vs my older is INCREDIBLE. You can actually smell it within the first few seconds of turning on. I do wish you could completely shut off the little light or at least have the option - which has been my only con.
Hasn’t Done Much For Me Not the best for my skin type.
Wonderfully Packaged, Gift Set! Gifted for my husband, he uses these almost everyday and loves the way it smells and applies. Extremely great gift for the man in your life!
Wrong Color For Me This would probably have been a better product for me however the shade is just too dark and looks ridiculous when I wear.

Seamless Golden Hour! Even though this took me about a solid 4 minutes to figure out how to *slide* open...my frustration flew out the window the second this beautiful product was revealed! I love the two tones you can combine for seamless color! This applies flawlessly and leaves such a gorgeous glow! This is one HEAVY “little” compact, but definitely makes it feel that much more well made with the length of quality this brand went through. Wonderful bronzer I plan to continue using!

Nothing to get excited about only curls one way, does t get really hot, very very small sections of hair at a time. If you have thick hair, forget unless youave a couple of hours. Plus side, you do get your refund quickly
Great quality, very easy to handle Great quality, bend very easy to tie hair in. I WANT TO STRESS the company that you purchase from, ARE AMAZING they stand behind their products, great to work with.

Not great for exfoliating, but a pleasant experience Not great for exfoliating, but a pleasant experience.  All the salt in this product is less than I would’ve expected and very fine grained so the exfoliation experience isn’t what I expected. What I did like about it was it was not as oily as many of the products that I’ve had in the past. It did leave my skin feeling soft and refreshed. And I do think the price is very reasonable for the quality of the ingredients that are in it. I took one star off for the misrepresentation of the exfoliation product.

Good quality Sturdy components, good quality glass bottle, sprays a perfect super fine mist.  No complaint at all about the quality, the price...a bit steep even for this quality but I don't find it obscene, hence only one star removed.

Love this oil! I don't think there is a part of your body that wouldn't benefit from this oil.  I use it on my hair, and mix a bit in my conditioner.  Great for the skin and especially the face.  I also use it for dried cuticles.  Perfect size.

The Covid answer to post gym workouts! The Covid answer to post gym workouts!  If I were a gym owner,  I would keep these well in stock! This is a nice big cloth, used to clean up after a workout. It is not dripping wet but it is adequately moist. There is a slight clean scent to it, but nothing perfumy or anything that would fight with a perfume. It did a nice job, however other than doing may be under arms face and chest one of these towels would not be enough if you really wanted to clean yourself up.  These would also be great during camping trips. Or even long car trips when you like to refresh. For what it is, I don’t think the price is unreasonable. If I were a gym owner I would give each patron two of these towels when they arrived. I thought the product was good, the towel was really soft and enjoyable to use.  The towel itself is also as strong as it is soft. I will make sure to have a couple of these in my purse at all times.

Nice quality but overpriced Nice quality but overpriced.  The bottle is quality glass, the sprayer is sturdy with multiple functions, you can spray or stream. It even has nice chalk type labels included. They are perfect if you want to make your own natural cleaning supplies, and the dark amber color will protect your essential oil’s, but I feel that the price is way out of line. I’m not debating the quality, the quality is there. The price… Not.

Adorable for DYI gifts I like making my own hand lotions and sanitizers and these little keychain lotion bottle and holders are just adorable for those projects. What’s really nice about them is they make a nice gift for a guy and a lot of these types of holders are way too feminine to give to a guy as a gift. Any patriot would certainly love it.  The price? I found it to be fair for the novelty that it is.

Great for homemade projects! Great for homemade projects!  I would’ve like them to be a little bit more flexible for pushing thicker lotions out. But if you’re going to be putting liquids and it won’t be an issue. Well packaged. I felt it was a decent value.

Nice quality These well made bottles are big and perfect for cleaning solutions.  The sprayer works well and I liked the addition of the metal funnel and the labels.  That being said, $5 each for a glass spray pump bottle is pricey...they back it up with quality, but if your buying 4 of them I think the price should be lower.

Great for DYI projects I used these for a homemade essential oil facial spray.  The mist is really fine which I liked.  It has a double cap which is nice as it stays secure in your purse.  Well constructed and just cute.  I felt for a buck a bottle it was a good value.

Great value! These pumps are good quality, solid construction meant for larger bottles to pay attention to the type of bottle it fits or you will be unhappy.  The same company sells a smaller pump, set of two for $6 which I found way overpriced so I was surprised to find these pumps so reasonable and a good value.

Great price for a quality product! Great price for a quality product!  Are use a lot of castor oil in lotions and creams that I formulate myself. I like to use the best quality caster oil I can find and I find this product compatible with brands that I spend the same amount on for a 4 ounce bottle. So I find this to be an amazing value.

Just okay The mist is fine and the pump works well, make sure not to fill it all the way as when you prime the pump you need a little wiggle room.  The quality is not great, and this company makes a beautiful set of six with much better materials and gold accenting for two dollars more...spend the money on the other set.  The airless pump will keep ingredients from oxidizing too quickly.  Not a bad set, but since I've used the other one...I'm spoiled, so this one is just okay.

Nice quality oil but... This is a nice quality oil, it absorbs well and leaves the skin soft.  At the time of this review there was no price listed, but I have to wonder...with good quality almond oil, even organic available in 16 ounce bottles for well under $20, what price will they put on this tiny bottle with less than 2 ounces.

Beautiful scent! I read off a perfume website that this was a great substitute for jadore by Christian dior. It's true that jadore has been reformulated and it's not as lasting and beautiful as it once was. Well,  I ordered this and my God it is extremely similar to jadore. I actually like it more than the current jadore bottle I have. Jadore is way more expensive than this edt so it will sit and look pretty on my glass perfume shelf while B.U. Golden kiss goes with me back and forth in my purse.  At such a great price, I went ahead and ordered 2 more. This is one of the best fragrance buys ever in my vast experience with scents over the years.

Definitely not universal, but great if you have a dryer that it fits I don't think this item should be marketed as a "universal diffuser." I tried it with a mid-range Remington, a high end T3, a mid-range Conair, and a low end generic dryer. The only one this diffuser worked with was the Conair. Unless you have a BIO IONIC dryer you run the risk that this item will not fit your dryer.

When I finally found a dryer that worked with this diffuser, the diffuser worked well. This diffuser is very well made compared to the diffusers that come with most dryers. First, it's larger than typical diffusers. Second, it swivels to open and close the air vents. I find that it's best used when my hair is nearly dry to put the finishing touches on. I was a bit skeptical of what a diffuser would offer at this price point, but I think the build quality warrants the price.

Overall, I proceed with caution when ordering this product unless you have the BIO IONIC. If you do own the BIO IONIC, this item is fantastic and I highly recommend it.
Such a pretty, non-sticky gloss over my lipstick or alone Fast shipping! Product is as promised. Really makes my teeth sparkle!! Such a pretty, non-sticky gloss over my lipstick or alone! Yay!!
Looks like salon finish 2nd order so nice

Pretty Pricey But Worth It! Love, love, LOVE this moisturizer. I love it so much that I may have replaced my Avon Anew. This one costs quite a bit, but the tiny travel sized tube will last a while. This is a VERY watery product, but that's great for 2 reasons: 1) a little bit goes a long way, and 2) it absorbs really well into the skin. The best way that I have found to apply this is to tap the lotion onto my fingertips, then just sort of dab it onto my face before rubbing it in. This saves on product and keeps me from spilling any from the tube. Like I said, this has a very "wet" texture, so you won't have to use much. The price is way up there but, compared to using a lot of a cheaper product (that doesn't work as well), or a same-priced product (but using more of it), this is the best value overall. I'm going to see how long the travel-sized tube lasts while I save up for a larger size. Since this is something I have to save for, I really wish there were more size/price choices. Still, I love this and I think my skin is getting addicted to it!

Great item, but there are more affordable alternatives This works and works well. The reason I can't give it a full  5-star review is because of the price. There is a very similar product that is way cheaper and works as well or better than this one. I found Sole Magic online for about a dollar cheaper than this one. In superstores and drug stores, I found it for a couple of bucks. This one does work and I can't say one negative thing about it - other than the price. When a pedicure is around $20 (even here in Alaska where prices are high), and I can do upkeep with a similar foot smoothing pad for about $2, I just can't see paying almost $9 for this one. If other customers do want this one, I can tell you that it works, the shape is nice and makes it easy to grip and use with either hand. It's also nice that their is a coarse side and a finer side. One thing that I disagree with is that you could use this anywhere but on your feet. I don't know what would have to be going on with anyone's elbows or knees for them to use this on! All in all, a great product, but a bit overpriced when there are cheaper alternative items that are just as effective.

Like the way it makes my natural & nappy hair feel This has the very, very *very* faintest plant-like scent (which is clean and pleasing). It's also thicker than I expected - almost like a whipped lotion. Before I used it on my hair, I rubbed some into the back of my hand to see if I'd have any kind of skin reaction. I did not. What I noticed is that once this absorbed, there was absolutely zero residue. I don't know what that means, but I was just curious. When I rub in other types of hair masks & treatments, I always get a sense of something left that I need to wash off. When I used this on my hair in the shower, I left it on for about
2 to 3 minutes after I had massaged it in according to the directions. (I have to stop and mention that I was also using the Daelong shampoo and conditioner set beforehand. That might be why I got my results.) This rinses out extremely well. My hair felt conditioned but with a lot less of the residual slip from other conditioners. That kind of worried me. I like to know that a treatment is doing something & the only way to tell until you've used it for a while is by the way your hair feels. Where I became so happy with this is an hour after rinsing it out. I have coarse and "nappy" natural African American hair. My hair tends to be extremely dry - especially after washing. A good conditioner keeps things in check until I can apply my leave-in products (oils, butters, sprays, etc.), but this time, my hair stayed soft and easy to comb through for at least 2 hours. It might have been longer, but I went ahead and applied my usual leave-ins. Still, I know that this did soften my hair (the day after, my hair is retaining softness without any more leave-in applications) without making it feel fragile. With they type of hair I have, I have to worry about breakage. I realize that I have probably been clogging up my scalp by over-doing it with the oils and butters. I like that I haven't had to use more of them for my hair to feel manageable. As a test, I'm going to try easing up on using so much leave-in stuff while I continue to use this.I think these guys are on to something here. I will have to come back and update this review as I use this for a while but, for now, I love the way this makes my hair feel, even after just one treatment. Normally, I only fully wash my hair once every four weeks or so. I will do a co-wash about every other week to keep it clean without stripping it. While I am testing this out, I plan to use it at least once a week as my co-wash. Like I said, I am also using the shampoo & conditioner of this brand. That might be a big part of why this worked so well for me, but I think that this would work just as good on its own. By the way, I'm going to alter my washing regimen for a while to use the shampoo and conditioner at least every other week. I almost forgot to mention the other thing I was concerned about: the label says that this makes the hair "straight and silky" - which is exactly what I, personally, DO NOT want. I love my texture and want to keep it. My texture is the kind that is prone to slow growth (because of breakage) so... I'm not worried about losing my naps. I'm thinking that this aids in stopping breakage more than anything.

OK I tried this on thick curly 3c hair. The results were quite decent. You first wash your hair with the pre-treatment shampoo to clarify the hair and remove dirt and oils. I could move the mat while I put my makeup on, but I don't have many places to put it on where I get ready, so this would be a huge inconvenience. Plus, regardless of where i put the mat, it will still collect dust overtime and have the same cleaning issue.
As a solution to cleaning the mat, I started running it under warm water and using a dish brush with bristles to scrub the mat and get in those difficult grooves, which has been successful as far as perfectly cleaning the mat - it's just a little more tedious than I'd like it to be.

Works for Eye Puffiness & Amazing Off-Label Headache Relief!! This eye cream was far different than I was expecting -- but in a GREAT way. I'm 29-years-old, so the lines around my eyes aren't terribly deep, although they are probably deeper than many other females my age due to my sun-worshiping in earlier years. I do suffer, however, from severe seasonal allergies and am constantly plagued with dark circles ("allergic shiners" as they call them) and extreme puffiness of both my upper eyelids and just under my eyes (the infamous "bags").

To be honest, my impression of this cream at first glance wasn't too great. For starters, the jar of cream was much smaller than I had imagined, but I guess that's my fault for not noticing the (very) small-printed "0.5 fl oz" on the label in the picture. (I do think that this was a little deceitful though, because the size/amount of this cream is not listed anywhere on the product description.) In addition, while trying to read the teeny tiny print on the jar, I also almost immediately noticed a spelling typo on the front of the label that reads "Nautral & Healthy" rather than "Natural & Healthy." I know this seems like a rather minuscule and knit-picky detail to point out, but it did make me at least wonder about this company's quality control standards.

Despite my initial impression, I gave the company/cream the benefit of the doubt and have been using it for the last few days. With my first application under my eyes, the cream felt more on the "thin" side (similar to a lotion rather than thick cream), but while rubbing the cream into my skin in a circular motion, the moisture that the cream delivered was far better than I anticipated. It takes at least 3-4 minutes before your skin feels like the cream is completely absorbed, which gave me ample time to slowly massage the area during absorption (and felt very soothing and relaxing). I had absolutely no issues with any side effects or skin reactions such as burning, tingling, redness, or irritation. I noticed a small "immediate" reduction in the pores and fine lines of the areas I applied the cream, though not as impressive as some of the Retinol and Vitamin C serums that I've used in the past. There was no obvious difference in the dark circles or puffiness right after application, however, within about 30-45min, the puffiness started to visibly decrease and the area all around my eyes felt less tender/achy in general.

With each subsequent application, I noticed the same resulting decrease in puffiness as was observed initially. My puffiness did return each morning, but I expected because I'm still constantly being exposed to my allergens. (After all, the cream is meant to relieve a symptom of my allergies, not be a miracle cure for my chronic systemic condition.) I've noticed that if I apply the cream immediately before bed and spend more time rubbing it into my skin in the circular motions, I do have a noticeable decrease in the morning when I wake up compared to before I started using the cream. As far as the under-eye dark circles, I can't tell a difference so far - but in all fairness, I've only been using the cream for 4 days (twice daily) so there's still hope.

Now for the best part (in my opinion, at least). On the second night of using this cream, I had yet another one of my throbbing headaches (allergies are the worst!!) About 15-20min after my evening cream application, I noticed that my headache felt a little better -- I'm not saying that there was some miraculous change here, but it did feel less severe. This was very unusual for me, as I hadn't taken any ibuprofen or Zyrtec at that point (my usual go-to medications when my headaches are severe). The only thing I could think that I had done differently this time than any other time was that I applied the cream -- it was a strange connection, but stranger things have certainly happened to me. I went back to look at the ingredients listed on the jar and saw that it had rooibos in it. I had absolutely no idea what this was (and probably didn't notice it the first time I looked because I don't have a magnifying glass), but I looked it up online and read that it's an herb from South Africa with a laundry-list of health benefits -- including antioxidant properties and... headache relief?!?! Although still relatively skeptical that this was just a coincidence and that I had gotten "lucky" on my google search, I was still optimistic and proceeded to rub the eye cream on my temples and at the base of my skull to see what would happen. After a good 30-45min, my headache was almost completely gone. I know this headache thing sounds ridiculous and obscure, but I encourage anyone to research this mysterious Rooibos for themselves. I haven't had a headache as severe as that one since, but I have had a few headaches start to come on, and with each headache, I applied the cream to my temples, under my eyes, and to the base of my skull and the feeling has gone away each time within about an hour.

With all of this said, I couldn't rate this "eye" cream turned headache remedy anything less than 5 stars despite my initial less-than-thrilled first impression. Because the cream is light and only requires a very small amount with each application, I think the small jar will actually last me a reasonably long time, too. Between the headache relief and the disappearing eye bags, I would be confident in recommending this product to others. I was also fortunate to receive my first jar of this cream at a discounted price or free in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

Simple to Use & Perfect Results Every Time!! I LOVE these bun makers!! I have an old bun maker that I've been using for years, but that one just got tossed in the trash because these new ones are SO much easier to use and the finished product looks much better!! These bun makers are unique in that they are foam, which helps to grip your hair to better hold it in place. They also have a very strong inner wire that holds them in place in a perfect circle. I have relatively long (just past my bust line) hair with long layers - the trick to getting all of the end pieces of the layers to stay tucked in place is to pull the bun maker down the length of your ponytail just before you reach the end of the shortest layer. Then, fold all of the rest of the ends upward over the hair piece and tuck them inward towards the center of the ponytail. As you roll the hair piece upwards, continue to tuck any loose ends in so that they are held in place by the rolled hair. The other trick to getting a perfectly round bun is that once you have rolled the hair piece all the way up with your hair, fold the ends inward towards each other to form a circle, but make sure to tighten this circle as much as possible by pushing the ends as close together as you can. Otherwise, these hair pieces are fairly self-explanatory to use, and there are step-by-step instructions included with each of the four bun maker pieces. In addition to these four pieces, this product also includes 2 sets of 8 bobby pins -- 1 set is about 2" long each and the other set is about 3" long.

What is Hyaluronic acid? According to WebMD, "Hyaluronic acid works by acting as a cushion and lubricant in the joints and other tissues. In addition, it might affect the way the body responds to injury."

(+) Does it work? I've used the Hyaluronic serum every night for a week now. Not sure if I can say 100% that I have noticed no fine lines around my eyes, but I've had 2 friends remark that my skin is looking great. As we women know, that's a good endorsement right there.

(+) Texture: As you can see in the photo, the Derma-nu serum is a clear, slightly viscous consistency that goes on clear. You can feel it on your skin for quite a few minutes afterwards. It does NOT leave your skin feeling greasy (big pet peeve of mine) when you wake up in the morning.

(+) Smell: This is not a scented beauty product. There is a very slight almost medicinal scent - that's the best way to describe it. It is not unpleasant, it is extremely mild, but it smells like it has some ingredients that 'have a purpose', vs. beauty products that have fragrances added.

(+) Packaging and ease of use: The pump is well made - it dispenses a small amount of serum, which I am finding is enough for applying to the corners of both eyes. I'm having to "prime" the pump about 2-3 times before it dispenses the serum, so be careful, you don't want to double pump the serum unless you are OK putting possibly 2x the amount on your face than you might have intended.

(+) A little goes a long way. I travel a lot, so the compact bottle and efficient dispensing from the pump are bonuses for me.

(/) Organic. The bottle indicates that 72% of the ingredients are organic. It doesn't clarify which of the ingredients are/are not organic. It would be nice to see this get to 100%.

Bottom line: So far, my skin has felt good, I've had a few compliments, and I'm pleased with the way Derma-nu packaged the Hyaluronic serum so that it is easy to dispense.

Another winner from Majestic Pure I have many Majestic Pure products (from skin care products, to hair care, to essential oils), and have always been very satisfied. I am also pleased with the retinol cream. Having very sensitive skin, I tend to use products containing retinol quite sparingly (aka, every few days, vs. daily) as they tend to cause my skin to become quite irritated or scaly after a few days of daily use. I’ve been using this around just my eyes every evening (about 1 hour after applying a hyaluronic acid serum), as my skin is so sensitive that using anything with retinol on my entire face seems to really cause a lot of scaliness. And, this is where the fine lines are really beginning to show.

The results – after using a cream with retinol in combination with hyaluronic acid serum for 3 weeks, I’ve been noticing a definite reduction in the fine lines. They are still there but they were becoming really noticeable.

The cream has ingredients that are highly moisturizing (again, which I like to follow up on a serum with). The consistency is pretty thin (not thick and creamy like a lotion), and there is no noticeable fragrance. It seems to absorb quickly and is not oily.

Some note on the ingredients:

Retinol 2.5% - Retinol is another name for Vitamin A, which is an antioxidant (helps reverse the damage caused by free radicals, apparent in wrinkles and aging), encourages the production of collagen, and elastin.
Jojoba Oil - closely resembles sebum (a waxy substance produced by our skin glands), packed with vitamins and minerals - Vitamin E, B, copper, zinc, selenium, iodine and chromium.
Green Tea - Tea is high in anti-oxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, whether ingested or applied topically. Green tea contains tannins which can reduce puffiness and inflammation of the skin. It also contains polyphenols, which can combat free radicals (which contribute to aging). The catechins in tea can combat the bacteria that contribute to acne.
Propolis - Propolis, “bee glue or bee penicillin” is the resinous material gathered by honeybees from flowers and leaf buds of various plants. It contains dozens of anti-oxidants,
Shea Butter - The moisturizers in shea butter are similar to those produced by the skin’s sebaceous glands, making it one of the best choices for super-dry or cracked skin. Shea butter also contains anti-inflammatory compounds – great for applying to inflamed or irritated skin (think eczema, chapped skin, bug bites)
Vitamin B5 - A humectant (a water-binding substance that attracts and retains water). Particularly good for the skin as it stabilizes the skin barrier, increasing hydration and improving softness and elasticity.
Vitamin E - A powerful antioxidant, that neutralizes the oxidant effect of free radicals, which are molecules that damage collagen and cause skin dryness, fine lines and wrinkles

*I received the retinol cream for evaluation and review

First I made sure my face was freshly washed and found a quiet area where I could apply the mask and lay back and relax for 20 minutes. By quiet area, I mean I made sure I was home alone so no one would bother me, I turned the television off and played some soft soothing music to relax myself and to really give myself that spa experience.
Applying the mask was super simple and it completely fit all the contours of my face evenly. Thereby giving my face all the wonderful benefits of this rich hydrating formula. Then I just relaxed and let the mask do all the work. I have sensitive skin and was pleased that the all natural ingredients in this mask did not irritate my sensitive skin what so ever. In fact, it actually helped improve the look and feel of my skin after just one use. After the 20 minutes were up, I was amazed at how soft and hydrated my skin felt. One Of My Favorite Shave Soaps. Of the traditional great shaving soaps, MWF is the postshave king. Barrister & Mann, L&L, Wholly Kaw, A&E, Italian Extro, there are wonderful soaps out there. They all have great scents and most can match MWF in slickness, cushion and glide. And they’re really close on the post shave. But good old MWF still rules the post shave roost. I love Mitchell’s Wool Fat. I have a Simpson’s Emperor badger brush that was very expensive. Tried and tried to get it to work with MWF, couldn’t get a lather no matter what I tried. I liked the stuff anyway. Then I got a $20 synthetic Plisson knockoff brush. It is the missing link. Loads in 30 seconds, face lathers wonderfully.

If you are having trouble lathering MWF do what I did and get a fat synthetic brush. It transforms the Mitchell’s experience.

Combined with my favorite razor, the Rockwell 6s set to “3” with a Feather blade, a good aftershave lotion and cologne, I’ve got an awesome shave here.

Provides plenty of slickness and cushion like any traditional tallow soap. But the addition of unsaponified lanolin (which also makes it hard to lather) gives this stuff its unparalleled post-shave feel. You will love your soft face after shaving with Mitchell’s and so will your wife, girlfriend or both.

Clean off with a hot damp washcloth, then pat dry and hit with a generous amount of Speick aftershave splash. Your pores will immediately tighten up, whiskers will retract, and you will have a perfectly smooth face.

If you are going to use Feathers, the samurai sword of DE blades, you need a slick soap like Mitchell’s to keep from cutting yourself. Mitchell’s does its job well.

Get some. It might be your favorite too. I will always keep it in my rotation.

You can set the steam for a continuous output or intermittent.

The until must be cleaned after 10 hours of use. It doesn’t hold a great deal of water, so I was wondering if that was going to be inconvenient. I ran it for two continuous hours and I could tell that filling the tank twice would be about 10 hours. So THAT’S easy to keep track of!

All in all, I couldn’t be happier with this unit! It checks all the boxes and I can enjoy my essential oils in an peaceful, comforting environment. Highly recommended!!

Better than the loofa one I have. I recently started using one of these with loofa on it. It works for me, even if loofa does take a while to break in. However, it also absorbs quite a bit of soap. I like this one much better.

I was a little hesitant to order it. How would silicone feel against my back? It turns out that it feels fine and works well. I like that it needs much less soap since it doesn't absorb it. Instead of spreading it all over the thing - I like the side with little bristles like a brush - all you need is to put some in the center. Moving the brush over your back spreads the soap out nicely and does the job without a lot of waste. It squeaks a bit on un-soaped skin, but that's pretty easy to get over and doesn't last long. It was just a surprise, initially. It feels like a gentle scrub, and that's the important part. It also rinses off easily and dries quickly, an important point here in our humid climate. The interior relative humidity in our house hovers around 55% in the summer, so things can get moldy fast. That's what usually happens if a loofa or any other kind of absorbent surface isn't dried properly. I just hang this up on the thoughtfully provided suction hooks and forget about it. It's great, and I'm really glad I gave this a try!

Don't get me wrong...it's not an Earth-shattering change, but it's a step in the right direction.

The reason this didn't get 5 stars is because every single shampoo bottle I have ever purchased has been faulty. They leak, the pump either breaks or doesn't work from the start, and the plastic is flimsy. If it's been mailed to me, it inevitably leaks all over the package and I lose a substantial amount of product, which is pretty frustrating.

Overall though, a great product!

Beautiful, but lightly pigmented. The color is beautiful and it provides the perfect pop of brightness with a more neutral, smokey eye...BUT!  (You knew there was a but coming, right?)  It's not super pigmented and you have to go over it several times to get a good pop.  Since it's lighter, it's not ideal for a winged eye either.  I usually just flick it out on the edge a little, but don't do a full-on wing.  I'd say the color trends more toward violet (with red undertones), than purple (with blue). It doesn't bleed or run, and for the price, I think it's a good choice, if you're looking for a little spark with your eye make-up routine.

My skin seems to like this product... I've only used this a few times so far, but so far, so good.  It does a great job removing make-up gently...including eye make-up.  Since it's oil based, I was worried it would break me out.  I'm 41, but my skin is very sensitive and I'm still prone to break-outs, particularly in my t-zone area.  Thankfully, so far, my skin seems to be liking this product.  I do think it's a little pricey for the size of the bottle you receive, but overall, I'm pleased.

Takes a lot of work to look good... 3.5 stars

I have many thoughts on this wig. We ordered this to compliment my daughter's Mad Hatter Halloween costume and honestly, it looked like a hot mess when it arrived. The bangs were going everywhere, the curls were tangled, there was no part...it was awful.

My daughter, who is 12, has long, VERY thick blonde hair. When the wig arrived, we tried it on with her hair down to make sure it fit. It did. Fast forward to Halloween...I braided her hair and pulled it into a knot at the back of her head. Lo and behold, the wig wouldn't fit...it just kept sliding off her head. That was my mistake...I should have tested it with a bun when it arrived. Having said that, my daughter is incredibly petite...her doctor predicts she won't surpass 5' when she's full grown Obviously, her head isn't that large. My point? If you're an adult or are purchasing this for a teen or big child, it likely won't fit. I finally had to put her hair in a low bun at the nape of her neck to make it work.

Unfortunately, because her natural hair was so low, we couldn't do the up-do we had planned because her bun showed if we did. We ended up leaving it down, brushing it out, putting bobby pins in strategic places to help it frame her face and to contain it, and then I hair sprayed it in place. Styling was especially difficult because the wig is sparse. It's a lot of work to hide the netting underneath. The netting is a yellow-beige color and stands out like bright white against the purple and teal. We finally got it looking decent though, and she actually got many compliments on it throughout the evening, hence the higher star rating despite all the complaints.

Once the wig was brushed and styled, the waves looked beautiful. Just don't buy this expecting it to look great out of the box. It won't. It takes work.

A beautiful, natural, dewy finish.. Let me start by saying, I did NOT order this from Amazon. I ordered it from Sephora. The reviews here regarding whether this product was a fake or not made me a little leery. So, I'm reviewing the real Josie Maran Vibrancy foundation and not the Amazon version, real or not.

As usual, I ordered the lightest shade, RG5. It's a nearly perfect match. It's described as being for fair skin with neutral undertones. I typically prefer foundations with pink undertones, but this actually worked really well for me.

The consistency is on the thin, runny side, which isn't surprising since oil is an ingredient. Having said that, this foundation sits on the skin so beautifully. It looks like real skin. It's definitely not a matte foundation, so if that's your preference, this is not the foundation for you. This foundation gives you more luminous, dewy-looking skin. I don't typically care for dewy foundations, but again, I was surprised to like this one. It just made my skin look healthy and plump. It didn't look at all heavy, which is great because it didn't settle into my fine lines. I did notice it took a while to set. Again, not surprising considering the oil content, but you'll want to make sure you set it with powder before trying to blend blush/contour/bronzer, etc. Otherwise, you'll likely look pretty streaky.

Many reviewers here have mentioned a smell. I didn't notice that at all, which is another reason I think the product people are buying here might not be legit.

The only reason I gave this 4 stars instead of 5 is because my t-zone gets oily fairly quickly while wearing it.

I'd recommend this for more mature skin and dry skin types. If you're oily, you can definitely still wear it, you just might have to blot a bit more than usual.

Overall, though, a great foundation. Just make sure it's what you're looking for. It's a very specific look.

Better then most at this price point, depends on which one you get So it's honestly not bad at this price point. It sheds a bit but all units have some shedding. For the mix brown I give 4 stars.The face front is about 2 inches and is meant to be cut and plucked for a natural look. I did neither in the photo. I just folded it under the the front as I'm afraid that cutting will make it look lifted in the front and obviously show it's a wig without some glue to put it down. You can see the mesh upon close examination. Makeup might help to conceal this.... Or make it worse. What I did like was the fullness and length. The weft was not too easy to be seen even when pulling hair apart. This is good compared to other brands where the wefts are often very visible, especially in the back and crown of a unit. Because the simulated scalp is narrow, you won't be able to change the part. It's also a bit flat near the part so it's gonna take some work to give a bit of volume. I would have enjoyed this much more had the color been a rich brown and if the scalp was a bit more realistic. Would I wear in public? Probably not. Would this be good for photo shoots or costumes ? yes. Would I buy other colors from this brand? Yes and I haven't done that with other brands on Amazon. For the purple ombre: I give 3 stars. It doesn't have the lace in front. This is more pure costume. The black is very shiney and the front of wig where the part is shows a bit of the black backing for construction. If it laid more flat and had the lace I would have given the purple ombre 4 stars. Dull the shiney with some powder like dry shampoo or maybe even dark eyeshadow. The fake scalp is actually better on the purple ombre compared to the brown mix. The ombre for the blonde is also a 4 star. Hair at the crown is a bit flat but the rest of the style is beautiful. The brown to blonde has the 2 inch lace like the long brown one. It's not as full on the head but you don't see the wefts unless you pull it apart a bit.  I feel the color is much more realistic. Hair feels pretty good for a synthetic. Note if you play too much , it will get a knotty feel. Again, good for photos. Some people might actually wear it daily but I don't know if it took take daily abuse. Length is great.

Light, daily primer I was a little leary about a spray but it feels so refreshing to spray on. It also makes it much easier to use a light amount. It really does make a nice smooth surface to apply makeup to and reduces the powdering or blotchy look of your makeup.

another solid epilator from Braun (plus no more underarm bumps!) Some quick thoughts on this model specifically:
* Removes smaller hairs (0.5mm) than older models, so you can be more aggressive as stray hairs start to grow back
* The "massagers" on the epilation head really do help
* You can use it dry or completely-wet, but not damp (e.g., right after the shower won't work)... and I must say that using it under running water dramatically reduces any discomfort, although it's a bit harder to notice stray hairs
* You can't use it while plugged in (that would be a serious safety hazard in the shower!) but it means that whenever the battery eventually stops holding a charge, you'll have to toss the unit)
* I wish this included a trimming head like other models, for the cases when you have longer hairs you want to attack (they have to be 7 mm or shorter before this will really pull them out)
* This doesn't include an attachment for facial hair like some do (which is OK)... just make sure that your epilator is clean if you're going to use it on your face, because otherwise it will make you break out
* The small spotlight on the unit makes it much easier to see hairs you may have missed
* The exfoliating brush is a nice touch, because epilating frequently leads to ingrown hairs. It says to use it a day or two before epilating, and it's super-gentle... almost feels like it's not doing anything, but I found it's more effective and more comfortable (if more slow) than just using a loofah. The "wait 2 days" advice is good because otherwise your skin gets sensitive

And some thoughts on epilation in general:
* This seems obvious, but I have to say it: it only hurts when a hair is being removed. This means that the first time you epilate, it's very uncomfortable. But since only a small percentage of the hair grows back before you epilate again (assuming you do it at least once every 3 months!), the subsequent touch-ups really aren't bad at all, especially on your legs. (Underarms are less comfortable, and bikini area even less so. Face is also quite sensitive, though that probably varies by person, depending on how much tweezing you normally do.)
* The first time you epilate, your legs will be unbelievably smooth. But hair grows back at different rates, so after a month or so of epilating (maybe one time each week), you'll have tiny hairs here and there, that are starting to grow back but are still too small to get. It's less of an issue with this epilator than others, and the hairs aren't really visible. So if you think someone's going to be touching your legs, then shave :-D but otherwise life is much easier if you just epilate once a week or so. Then if you don't bother doing anything for a month or so, you'll have a few stray hairs here and there, but nothing like someone who shaves regularly and then skips a month (or even a week... or even 3 days). Visible stubble is entirely a thing of the past.
* Remember that the exfoliation is important to prevent ingrown hairs (just little bumps on your legs--mine don't turn red). But if you wax, or if you age ;) you'll have to do that anyway. And this unit's exfoliator is more gentle than a loofah
* And how could I forget the #1 reason to epilate: no more underarm bumps. You know, the ones that you ALWAYS have, despite a million products on the market that say they'll banish them but don't? Sometimes when you epilate, your skin will be red for 30-90 seconds afterward, but then it fades. So NO MORE BUMPS. That alone is reason enough to own an epilator, IMO :) This also helps with bikini-area bumps, but I find in those cases that the redness can take several hours to fade, so it's fantastic to use the day before swimming but would not be a good choice immediately before pool time
