This awesome makeup remover is made in the United States.

Nice Starter Kit to Healthier, Hydrated, Smoother Skin! I try to take diligent care of my skin, now that I am getting older. So, Codex Beauty Labs Hydration Hero Kit looked like something I could use. I decided to give it a try.

There are three components in this kit. I believe there is enough product here for at least five treatments. The exfoliating scrub is finely textured but effective. The texture is made of natural jojoba grains. The castor oil in this scrub really cleans the skin. A little of this exfoliating scrub goes a long way. Next, there is a Bia Hydrating Skin Superfood. It contains comfrey and marsh mallow to hydrate and soften the skin and to prevent irritation. The milk thistle in the cream soothes the skin.

Included in this kit are also four sample packets: two are of hydrating oil. This is an oil and takes time to be absorbed, but it is highly effective. The other two are oils to use to cleans parched skin.

In short, this is a nice start to healthier skin.

Very small This pillow is a lot smaller than what I expected. Tried it out and the pillow only covers my head and lower neck area. I was hoping it would have more support but it’s pretty flat.

It’s still a good pillow for a smaller tub though. It’s plastic mesh inside so it dries very easily. I think it’s comfortable inside the tub but the size runs smaller than expected.

Super soft and strong These are such a great deal. $1.75 a piece which I think is very fair. You get 4 different color silicone ear savers. These stay put and don’t slide around in my hair which is a plus.

They’re strong and flexible. They conform to the shape of your head. The masks bands stay put behind the slots. Perfect ear savers that will last forever. Highly recommend these to everyone, so simple to use and so effective in keeping masks stay put!

Not harsh and smells fresh! Got this for my boyfriend who’s not big into using facial products but now he is! He loves this scrub. The texture is thick, it’s a bit opaque and not harshly gritty. It’s a more finer grit and it felt nice on his skin.

It smells fresh, like citrus almost but it’s not overpowering. His skin is definitely moisturized after using this and he’s added it to his daily routine. Definitely recommend!

Extremely fragrant These bath bombs are beautifully packaged. Each one with tissue paper, a sticker than labels it’s unique scent, all in a bed of paper hay.

Love the care and quality that went into this product. One bath bomb will change the color of my tub and make the water feel silky. Definitely love these! This would make a beautiful gift to anyone.

Love the convenient handle This does a great job exfoliating the skin and it’s a great size. I don’t think it’s too hard or too soft. The fabric side is great to lather up soap. I just flip the elastic band over to use the other side. Convenient to use and great to throw away after it gets old. Very happy with this product!

Straightforward and easy to use First of all, beautiful design and very easy to use. You plug this in and just shock the hairs away. It’s a little warm after awhile but that’s normal. I’m surprised the sunglasses were actually thick and heavy. Overall, very happy with how many shocks you get out of this product. Will last a long time and definitely worth the price!

Reduces frizz and adds shine Absolutely love this shampoo. It doesn’t lather like other shampoos but it’s not suppose to. There’s a huge misconception that when a product is super soapy and there’s a lot of bubbles, it’s cleaning. That’s simply not true. You have to read the ingredients to see if those ingredients clean-which this shampoo does.

Personally, this shampoo did a great job at cleaning my hair. It took 2 pumps for my hair that’s medium length. It’s a huge bottle that comes with a lot of product. The shampoo itself is thick and clear (no color added). I let my hair air dry and there’s was dramatically less frizz.

I was shocked at the results. My hair is soft and shiny after three uses and I love how my hair looks and feels. I think it’s well worth $16 for the quality and quantity of shampoo you get. Very happy with this shampoo and would get again!!

Great quality set The cape is comfortable and large enough to prevent any hair from falling on me. The case is faux leather and zips open easily. I’m really impressed with the scissors—they’re sharp and heavy. The combs are hard plastic. The clips are metal and durable (they won’t bend). And the cleaning cloth is velvet. Cut my hair beautifully. Very happy with this product. Built to last.

Love this natural deodorant You get a lot of product and no chemicals. All natural and safe for everyone. I love that it’s unscented. My armpits are sensitive to fragrances and this helped me stay fresh the entire day. Felt confident working with this on. Goes on smooth and feels creamy upon application. Very happy with this!!

Love the jar and smells like jasmine Like the size of this jar it comes with a lot of product. Smells like jasmine and it’s all natural ingredients. The paste goes on smooth and it’s very creamy and thick. Helped me stay fresh all day and hid my B.O. very happy with this product!! A little goes a long way. Half a pea size for each armpit was more than enough for me because the product melts into the skin.

Works but takes a little practice They come labeled in steps. It’s easier to watch the video instead of the instructions. I recommend doing one eye at a time if doing it on yourself. Nice travel shampoo and conditioner These snap easy and close. They’re thick and smell floral. They did a great job cleaning my hair and it feels softer and shinier after using the conditioner. Perfect sized hand sanitizer This is a nice gift for yourself or loved ones. It’s a nice sized bottle with a lot of product. Smells like spices and cleans great My dad is not a big fan of soaps but he loves this one. It smells like spices and is very nourishing on his skin. It cleans great as well. Suds up nicely and is easy to grip. Definitely recommend!

Very large wipes These wipes are very large and can cover my entire body. Great for long trips where I’m unable to shower or after a workout so I don’t feel so oily and sweaty. They smell like lavender and are moist wipes. Definitely recommend!

Has everything you need plus more! This is a very good poly nail gel kit. The lamp is much bigger than I expected. Works well. The kit comes with instructions for beginners. Very moisturizing and larger hand wipes These are very handy to have with their packaging. Each wipe is a moist wrap that you can wipe your hands or body with. My skin feels pretty moisturized and refreshed after this. Very happy with these!

High quality soap that smells minty This is a refreshing and invigorating soap for men or women. It’s very fragrant, like mint or spearmint. It’s nicely packaging and suds up well. Leaves skin feeling nourished. Definitely recommend!

Quality nail tips! These nail tips are really strong and have a thinner base so you can glue them on strongly. I use them in combination with poly gel and they stay on forever. Really strong hold, easy to cut, file and shape. Highly recommend!

Beautiful quality set The jade roller is really beautiful and I love the pink color on it. Really refreshing to use when placed in the fridge. The rollers are nicely sized and roll on with ease. Carrying case is quality.

Great for everyday wear. Set is on the smaller side but a little goes a long way.

Nice value size This shampoo smells clean and nice. Helps my hair feel clean afterwards. The shampoo is a gel consistency and lathered fine for me. Easy to rinse and hair wasn’t greasy afterwards.

Helps shrinks pores This smells very refreshing and has lavender flower water in it. Feels very cooling on the face. It’s a thick cotton mask and comes with a lot of juice. Skin is so soft afterwards.

Fun to do! These are so fun to do. I put it over my feet and go about my day. Afterwards you just wait for the skin to start peeling! Wouldn’t do it every day, more like every few weeks when my feet are very rough and have calluses on them.
Nice and cold on the eyes This is very refreshing and helps to wake me up during the day. The metal ball is nice and cold. There’s caffeine in it. No scent.

Nice brick of soap The ivory soap smells very clean, no define scent though. It lathers well and is nice to hold and grab on in the shower. Leaves skin normal, no dryness on my body. Felt clean afterwards.
Smells so clean and fresh This smells very clean and refreshing like citrus and mint. The bottle is a nice size and the body wash feels nice on the skin. Felt clean afterwards.
Very small for $5 This soap felt drying to me. Very small and pricey for $5. This is the size of a golf ball it’s so tiny. Ingredients are okay but not moisturizing to me and did not have any scent.

Sharp tools I like how all of the tools are sharp and strong and can pick tartar away. Everything is solid except the mirror is not close up it’s like zoomed out it looks strange in the mouth but it didn’t fog up for me. The light on the mirror is handy.

Works great! This is great to travel with. No mess and easy to use. Works great and saves a lot of bottles. Smells very fragrant and make my hair feel so soft.
Is waterproof! I sweat a look and wipe my face quite a bit so took this for a test run and it works! Didn’t smudge or come off with me wiping a towel over my brows and looks natural.

Gorgeous hair pin Everything is so delicately made. All the stones and beads are in the right place. Very stunning.

Quality product and a great value... I have been a longtime user of Coppertone Sport 30 and this Mountain Falls sport sunscreen is virtually identical at a fraction of the price.
For comparison the active ingredients are the same but in slightly different percentages.
Active ingredients in order listed for both products:
Avobenzone: both 3%
Homosalate: Coppertone 8% Mountain Falls 10%
Octisalate: Coppertone 4.5% Mountain Falls 5%
Octocrylene: Coppertone 6% Mountain Falls 10%
The Mountain Falls contains 8 oz. while the Coppertone bottle is 7 oz.
I compared both products side by side on a full day cycling ride and they performed identically so if you go through sunscreen the way I do, the Mountain Falls is a quality product and a great value.

Painless and easy to use, but the device gets super hot I have been using this hair removal device for 2 months now. I used it once every 2 weeks so I've used it 5 times so far. Now, the sessions will be only once a month until all the unwated hair is removed. The manufacturer recommends using it once every 2 weeks for the first 5 sessions and then once a month after that, so using it multiple times a week won't change the outcome. The areas I use this device are my legs, under arms, bikini area and upper lip. The only difference I've noticed so far is the upper lip hair. It is growing significantly less, like almost 90% is gone. The rest of the body hair still grows the same amount, but the hair started to grow softer. I assume the hair is finally becoming weaker. I am half Greek and half Italian, I have olive skin color with dark hair, so it might take over a year for me to see some results. Overall, the device is very easy to use and it is painless, but it gets super hot to the touch after about 5-10 minutes of continues usage. I use the device on my legs first and then take a break until it cools down, and then I continue using it on other parts of the body and stop to cool it down again. I have to admit it is frustrating to stop the session to cool down the device. I don't know if other hair removal devices get this hot. Nice SPF for your Face (with safe ingredients). I have photosensitivity, so I use a lot of sunscreen. Because of that I have looked into safe brands. Badger is my favorite. However, I had been using their regular sunscreens on my body as well as my face, and realized maybe I should try this one that is specifically for the face. I'm glad I did.

Zinc oxide is a safe sun screen ingredient. The downside is that it can leave a white-ish residue on your skin. I found with Badger's (and all brands using zinc oxide) this was true. I am very pale so it's not a huge issue to me. And I solved it best by exfoliating my face a few times a week (the white tint seems to grab more onto dry patches) and also after putting on the sun screen, I use that mineral powder makeup and I just tap on a little of that to get my regular looking skin color back. But with the regular badger sun screens, like most with zinc oxide, you really have to rub it into your skin. It sort of starts to "melt" a bit and smooth out, and on my body it's no big deal. But on my face, with sensitive skin, I like to rub it as little as possible.

And that is where this facial sun screen lotion comes in perfect. It is easier to smooth onto your face. It is creamier and lighter in texture. There is a slight white-ish hue, especuially if you overdue it, but it seems less than when using the other bigger tubes of Badger sunscreen. And it feels nice on my skin and leaves if feeling soft afterwards.

But it seems to be working as far as sun protection. i would love if it smelled a bit more like rose because I love roses and their scent. It is real rose. Badger does not use fake fragrance.

This is now what I will be using on my face year long. (Unless they come out with a facial lotion with SPF 30, which would be great.)

My go-to stampers These are the stamping plates that I use all the time. I stamp over gel nail polish with konad stamping polish, Essie polish, or Sallie Hanson insta-dri polish. When you first pull off the blue protective film, clean the plates really well with acetone. Then, I usually paint, scrape, roll, and then clean everything off without actually rolling the first stamping on my nails. I find the first stamping doesn't go well on a fresh plate, so I just don't waste my time.
After doing that, they stamp fine all the time. I have found at least one image in every stamper bundle that has stamping issues. I just don't use that stamp. These plates have intricate designs that transfer well. If you find that not all of your design is trasferring, first clean the plate really well with acetone. All that built-up dried polish affects the stamp. There are lots of good videos on stamping troubleshooting, too, if you are having trouble.
I stamp with a konad stamper, and scrape with an old credit card or empty gift cards. Metal scrapers will damage the plates.

Love the product and the customer service! So, I read a lot of reviews on facial products with charcoal before deciding this was probably the right one for me. I have dry skin...not flaky dry, but dry enough that I never get shiny and I don't even have T-Zone oil after an entire day of wearing non-oil-free makeup. The thing about charcoal is that it brings out a lot of toxins and also helps balance the amount of sebum in the skin, which can lead to drying when you have dry skin to begin with. After reading reviews on this particular product, I noticed people saying they felt it might actually be moisturizing, yet it still contained charcoal. Ding ding ding!!! That was all I had to hear.

So when I got the product, I couldn't wait to try it. It's not what you think of when you think of a "mask" from the 80's or on TV. It's not a thick, caked on, scaly/alien looking thing when you wipe it on. It's actually quite thin and has a very mild and delightful smell (though there is no fragrance added as it's all natural and organic). I use it about 3 times a week, and while others have said they have oily skin and find it to be moisturizing, I can tell you that I have dry skin and it has NOT made my skin greasy in any way, NOR has it dried my skin out. My skin remains balanced and looks healthy. At first, I could tell some toxins were being drawn out because my skin was "purging" some junk (got a few pimples on my chin the first week), but after that my skin has been clear and radiant.

I would also mention that Amazon shipped me an item that was soon to expire. When I contacted the company to find out if that's normal for this product they assured me that is not their expectation and they corrected the issue IMMEDIATELY. They truly went above and beyond what I thought was necessary to ensure my satisfaction. I will certainly continue to use this item and support this small company. It's clear they care about what they're doing, and that's more than anyone can say about any of the major brands out there!

But THIS Growom Garden Hose Nozzle works wonderfully, was easy to install, and is NOT made of plastic! It's a winner for me.

NOT SILK I was disappointed when I opened the package to find that these "silk" scrunchies were more like a sheer (yes, you can see the rubber band inside) chiffon/polyester material. The colors are just as pictured and they work as they should, but I need silk or satin scrunchies because I have curly hair and other materials cause me frizz.

Soft, Not Too Tight I love these headbands with the buttons sewn on. So convenient for mask-wearing! These are soft and fit my head really well. They don't pop off the beck of my head from being too tight. I like the designs and the neutral tones.

Disliked The Smell I am sad to say that I was not at all impressed by this product. It was the scent. While I could smell an undertone of mango, it mostly just smelled like chemicals, which I found very unpleasant. As far as the lather, it was decent but not great. I wouldn't recommend this nor would I order it again.

It's OK If you've ever used the product Liquid Bandage, then you'll be familiar with this scent. I don't really "like" it, but I don't dislike it either. It's just kind of medicinal. I do like the size of the bars which fit neatly in my hand. Not that anyone can travel anymore due to the pandemic...but if we could, this would be a nice travel size soap. Each bar lasted me through about three showers. Take it out of the shower after each use so that it doesn't stay damp and melt away. It has a rather unusual texture; a bit grainy like it's made of baking soda. It lathers nicely though which is a bit surprising given the texture. Overall, I like it.

Fragrance and Pump a Failure... I was very disappointed in this product. It has a VERY strong scent that lasts a long time....you have to wash up with another product to get rid of the smell. Second, the pump didn't work at all. I had to scrounge around in my other bath products until I found a pump that fit and then switch them out. I wouldn't recommend this product.

No These pads burned my undereye area after about 4 minutes of having them on. I removed them as soon as they started to burn but my skin was still very irritated the next day. Thankfully, I didn't have to waste a lot of them because the box arrived 17 pairs short...instead of twenty pairs in the box there were only three pairs. The box was smashed and had been taped back up, so apparently it had come open at some point and some genius decided that i'd never notice I was seventeen pairs short...(insert eye roll here). I couldn't recommend these.

Truly lightweight! A lot of hair wraps for hair drying are just so heavy! I've even found microfiber ones just make all the water pool in one spot making that area heavy. Not only are these incredibly soft and cozy, but the moisture was also wicked away nicely and didn't pool in one spot making it uncomfortable. I was really impressed compared to any other similar product I've tried. My hair came out as shiny as ever but much less static-y than is the norm, another pleasant surprise.

If you like Thierry Mugler's Angel, NEST's Cocoa Woods, or Elizabeth and James' Nirvana Bourbon. I've sampled an earlier version of Pinrose's petals before and wasn't really impressed with the tiny square they used to use (as shown in the product photos). It looks like they got smart with this newer version by having a folded up, soft, fragrance wipe (about 6'x6") in each packet. It definitely makes for a much more versatile sampling experience. I generally prefer using fragrance on the back of my neck and on my collarbones and the wipe was great for that as well as running it over my hair, arms, back of the knees, etc. It's ultimately not strong but I was amazed at the staying power (6+ hours)!

Initially I didn't care for Gilded Fox as a scent. It was very masculine straight out of the package and the cacao note was more bitter than I was expecting. Once it was on my skin and there was a bit of a dry down coming out I fell in love.

Great product missing a few otherwise nice for thin haired children and those with thin hair Missing a few pieces and broken butterflies so going to return otherwise very happy with these. I think it is great for those with fine hair as an adult with fine hair this worked fine. So I imagine young children would be easy. I got these for a 1990s party and to hold back so layered pieces during the day/workout. These are not like the 1990s ones I had as a child so definitely will be on the lookout for the originals which were larger in size. However, these hold fine you just cant tell they're butterflies as easy because how small they are. They are perfect for newborns and toddlers ! Not for those with any other hair aside fine.
Hope this helps if so please click helpful ! I really do think these are adorable for children. Hopefully they will bring them back as the larger size .

Actually worked on my acne!! I was having a pretty bad breakout and this really helped me get it under control!!
It didnt even dry my skin out! I am very happy with this purchase!!

It actually works!! My nose is looking so good So I was not sure what to expect when using this and I was happy with the results.
You definitely want to use steam to open your pores up first or you wont really see any results. As I was using this I was getting disappointed as I did not see it doing anything. The I looked at the ducking thing and there was stuff in there it got off my skin. Then the next morning my nose looked soo much better!!!
Every time I use this my face looks better and better, I wish I had taken before pictures!
Oh and start on the low setting cause wow does this thing have sucking power!!!

Every one smells amazing!! Great set! I got this for my husband for christmas and boy am I glad I did. He doesn't wear cologne ever and thankfully he loved these scents and so did I! I am so happy i got these!

Not sure it works. I don't know much about Jade rollers, I decided to try this one out and have used every day for a while...I cant tell a change in anything. So I don't know if it is just me or what? Since other people seem to like this?
Very cute tho and love the little stone that came with it!

good for the price. I bought it for home use and i'm not at all a professional. However, I doubt this will be good enough for professional use. They are small and for thin fingers. For an occasional trim at home this seems to be a good choice.

Smells like suntan oil The oil itself is great, but to me it smells like suntan oil. I use coconut oil, also scented but very lightly and it dissipates quickly, after a shower. Although I love Neutrogena stuff and use many of their products, I will stick to [[ASIN:B00P8CQK90 Fractionated Coconut Oil - 100% Pure Premium Grade - PUMP + SQUEEZE CAP + FREE Recipe eBook! - BIG 16Oz - Best Carrier Oil & Base For Essential Oils, Aromatherapy & Massage - Great for Roll-On Bottles - Soothing for Skin & Hair!]]

Working just fine My husband is very happy with this razor. I think of Wahl as a hair clipper and probably wouldn't have thought of them when replacing his razor, but I am glad to have learned that they make just as good of a quality razor. He uses a regular razor in the shower, then runs an electric around to catch any missed spots. Because of this the battery doesn't need to be charged very often. The battery life indicator is very helpful as is the razor's ability to charge very quickly. He likes it. He is not raving about it being the best razor ever, but we are both happy with this unit.

OK for the price Well, I do have a setting light. These polishes work fine. I think some of the premium ones, like OPI, work better, and are easier to see what colors are in the bottle. But, for the price they are OK. Gel polish is a pain to use.

OK I had never used one of these before, so I didn't realize how much of a mess they can make.

First, I saw that the USB charger did not come with a plug. I have plenty, so it wasn't a problem, but it would have been if I hadn't.

The plug that covers the USB port is not attached to the unit and I can see it very easily lost.

There is no hose. The whole unit needs to be picked up and rotated to use this item. I found it a little cumbersome, especially when I couldn't figure out which button was the off one when I was using it.

If you don't get the nozzle in just right it will come off and you will get sprayed. Again, without being able to see the "off", it gets messy.

The water canister isn't very big. I frequently have to fill it twice per use.

All in all, it is an OK unit. I don't have the expectation that it will still be working in a couple of years. But, it is very nice to use now. I will likely buy another WaterPik type device when this breaks. I just don't know if it will be this brand or if I will upgrade to a better one.

Working fine We have been using this for several months and it hasn't died yet. That shouldn't be a big deal, but there seems to be more and more stuff that doesn't last. It is easy to use and does a good job.

small and weak, but it does the job I have the Amope, which only has one file. This has three, from coarse to fine. But the files are quite a bit narrower than the Amope. I thought this would be a bigger deal, but most of the time only part of the file is being used as I am working on the tough spots like the heel or edge of the toe. It doesn't have a lot of power and it kind of slows down a lot. But it gets the job done. I like that it is rechargeable as the Amore went through a lot of batteries.

sticks, but it works The lever to lift the brushes up and down is tough to push. I don't know if it will get better with time, but the dozen or so times I have used this has not helped. But it works well to brush my dog and I am finding pulling the fur off the bristles works just fine.

got them for my palm tree These are the same as epsom salts. They should not be used in gardens unless you need more magnesium. Too much is not a good thing, so all of the internet stuff recommending epsom salts are really bad advice. But, palm trees often need supplemental magnesium, so I got this. The effect takes time to show, so I am not going to lie and say my palms instantly look great, but this is a decent product and it should work just fine. But no, your tomatoes will not grow better if you add this.

Sharp This has very sharp tines that scratch my dog. The packaging is all in Chinese. I don't like it when a company doesn't bother to write the packaging in the market's dominant language. Two stars because it does actually brush, but that's about it.

works, but not self-cleaning This has longer than average tines, so it got down into my double-coated dog's fur. The tines are a little sharp. But it is not self-cleaning, meaning there is nothing to press and collect the fur. Because the tines are extra long, I had to empty this brush less often than with some, but it still was a pain to stop and pull the fur off. I have gotten spoiled with the self-cleaning ones.

I like this Primer This was my first time trying a primer. I was having pics taken during 90deg weather and thought I'd try it. Generally, I do not wear makeup so this was a stretch. The directions said to spray 8-10 in away from the face - I had trouble spraying from that far away. When I did manage to spray it, I got it onto my eyes which could be user error but......

Once on, it tingled a bit but did seem to minimize my pores. My makeup definitely went on better and seemed to stay on better in the heat/humidity. I'm definitely going to keep using it since I seldom wear any makeup. I'm not sure if I had to apply daily that I would bother.

very thin oil When I have used argan oil in the past, it has been thicker and had an 'oilier' consistency than this product. I did not have to squeeze the dropper - it just dripped off. I also needed to use a fair amount which is unusual for this type of oil.

It smells nice and blends well but I did not find it moisturizing at all. Strange?

Good not great This helped with frizzies slightly but not nearly as much as I had hoped. I needed many more than 3-4 drops. Perhaps 4-5 times that? It was difficult to measure out because of the strange glassed dropper.

Over all, I liked it but did not love it.

Ouch! The nylon bristles on this are VERY stiff! My daughter likened it to using a porcupine in her hair.

The brush itself is small which is probably best for smaller hands.

Amazing This is an amazing soap. The packaging and presentation are top notch. The bottle is heavy and will resist being tipped. It is also refillable. The soap cleans well and has a great scent.

Worth the extra money.

Good basic bath pillow I like this bath pillow. I wish the head/neck part were slightly larger but it is decently comfortable. The back portion is smooth which I like - I like not having any indentations which can irritate my skin

Solid performer.

Surprisingly good At the current price of $10 for the set, I honestly wasnt expecting much. Turns out this set is pretty good. It fit fairly well in my hand though the handle could have been longer. It did a nice job detangling my daughter's hair with a minimum of fuss.

The set smelled strange on arrival and needed to be washed prior to usage. -1 star for that

Works for my daughter I have only let my teen use deoderants due to health concerns. I like the ingredients on this product and felt confident in ordering it for her. The true test came when it arrived - would my picky teen agree to use it? YES! She loves 1 sent and said the other 2 are "ok". That is high praise from her.

Several weeks after starting to use it, I've heard 0 complaints. From a kid who complains about everything, this is excellent indeed!

Dramatic These are dramatic indeed! They're pretty long - longer than any I've personally seen before! They are a little poky as in the corners as you apply them but once they're on, you really cant feel that.

The curve is natural to my eye so application is much easier than the last pair I tried.

They're so long that I could not wear my glasses with them. The long lashes short lashes is a bit odd to me but they look similar to what is pictured.

Some had corrosion on them I think these are pretty cute in an odd way. My teen hated hem and my 4th grader loved them.

Unfortunately, several had corrosion on the clip!

OK not great Packaging says it's waterproof....it's not! This mascara is pretty thick so it dries more slowly and gets in my glasses which is annoying.

I also the company's philosophy but IMO, $18 for a tube of non waterproof mascara is too much.

Perfect for shows & dance recitals This eye shadow is perfect for stage works, dance recitals and goofing off during covid19 confinement. They're glittery and bright shadows ... certainly not every day wear. But, during lengthy periods of home confinement, many rules go out the window.... and letting my kids wear makeup for no reason is one of them.

-1 star because I expected the color to be 'deeper'.

An ok set I'd describe this set as 'ok'. I did not really care for the scent. Its not so bad that I'll give the stuff away (as I have for other hair products) but I would probably not order it again.

I guess I was expecting more of a miracle - I've heard great things about keratin products - known for smoothing curly frizzy hair. My hair pretty much looked as it usually does. Which isnt a bad thing I guess, but no great miracle here.

Interesting These eye patches are interesting.  Less cumbersome than full masks,  they go on fairly easily.  They stick together so you do need to be careful.  They stay on long enough to walk from bathroom to bedroom and feel good to the skin.

These are ok Oddly enough, the scrunchies are not of uniform diameter. The various colors fit differently. One is too small for my hair and the other fits well. I guess the too small one will go to my daughters. The fabric looks cheap - especially on the longer 'scarf' ones.

The ones that fit work fine. The elastics seem sturdy. I'll just use them while we're on this quarantine where no one can see me anyway.

Mediocre set This is a mediocre set. It isnt especially bad nor good. The scissor blades don't meet in the middle so they dont cut very well. One set of nail clippers has a weird angle and leaves ridges on the surface of the nail. The other does a better job but for some reason launches the pieces of nail far away - not great for keeping the house tidy. The case doesnt stay shut.

Overall, most of the pieces work they just dont do a great job. I'd have preferred a simpler set with fewer pieces of better quality.

Reminds me a little of Ponds The consistency and fragrance remind me of Ponds which my grandmother used to use. It goes on a little heavy but absorbs fairly quickly. For me it is probably best suited for a night cream but I was also happy to use it outside on a windy day. I felt like it really protected my skin. It kept it soft and well hydrated all day.

I didnt think I was going to like it but I did.

Matches my skin tone perfectly I was a little surprised but this matches my skin tone perfectly. It also provides a decent amount of coverage.
It's a little thick on my skin - I think I'll like it better in the winter when my skin is drier -during the summer heat its a little heavy. I do like the fact that it contains sunscreen which I sadly do not use often enough.

I do really like it but it is a bit heavy. I dont generally wear makeup on a daily basis so that will take time to get used to it.

Smells like a old fashioned dr's office I LOVE this stuff! It smells like an old fashioned dr's office. Clean, antiseptic. The scent does not last so no worries if you're not as fond of that scent as I am.

It goes on cleanly, and leaves no sticky residue. It is a little thinner than most - more liquid than gel but that makes it easy to rub into my hands. I seriously think its the best sanitizer I've used. And I've used quite alot!

I got it to put in my classroom, but I think I'll use the cheaper gel stuff there and keep this for my personal stash!

Shockingly good When this arrived, I was disappointed - it looked like it was the wrong shade for me by a mile. Shockingly, it blends in and is fine. It's consistency is a bit like a thick cream but it blends in easily. It did not transfer any color to my white mask (another shocker!) and even after a 3.2mi walk, my face looks pretty good. (another shocker)

Cant comment on the blemish issue but if you're looking for a lightweight summer tinted moisturizer definitely give this one a shot.

Soft! I let my teen open the package and she said "they're so SOFT!" They are soft indeed. The colors are wild IMO. Depending on your fashion sense, they'll either match with everything or nothing. ;) But they are comfy to wear. Very comfy.

Some headbands advertise as being able to be used as masks/head coverings..... These will NOT work for that - they arent wide enough. But as headbands, they're great. Especially if you like bright bold patterns

Similar to other such products I find these lashes similar to other such products I've tried .... difficult to use. I'm starting to think its me! They are hard to apply correctly but I followed some advice to use 2 layers of liner - which makes them look less natural but they stay better.

Given that I've left my house only a handful of times to go grocery shopping in the last 3mo due to Covid19, I cant comment on how long they last - only my initial impressions. Hopefully someday I'll have somewhere to wear these again!

Shaver works great The shaver works great. Gives a nice close shave and does not irritate the skin at all. The trimmer on the other hand, does not work at all. My husband tried it on his sideburns and it basically pulled the hair and nipped at the skin. The hair was not trimmed at all.

The devices feels solid and is comfortable to hold. If your primary reason for getting it is to shave, you'll be happy with it. If you're looking for a trimmer, might want to look elsewhere.

LOVE the product Hate the packaging I LOVE the product but Hate the packaging. First, there are no instructions in English on the container. This means I have to come back to amazon, find the product page and look to make sure I got it right. Also there are only 15 little pads in this large, heavy duty plastic container. The pads are dry, some sort of resealable envelope would have worked just fine. I'd even be appeased if there were a refill package available. But I don't see one.

The pads are easy to use. They do a phenomenal job cleaning - and I used it after taking a 3mi walk on a 90deg day with sunscreen on. My face felt clean, soft and toned when I was done. No residue, no slime, pores seemed smaller. Amazing product.

I like it but I like this hairdryer quite a bit but I feel like the company is trying to oversell it. Promising to dry long thick hair in 10min is a little silly. My daughter has a med amount of thin fine hair. Her hair was mostly dry and it took 10min to finish it off. That actually is longer than it normally takes. it is also a little awkward to hold- it is just a bit top heavy.

Why do I still like it? It is on the quieter side for a 2000watt dryer. It also left her hair very sleek and shiny. In that sense, it worked better than any dryer I'e ever tried on her.

Softer not shinier hair I'm not big on shampoo but when I use it, I want to make sure it doesnt dry out my hair. This worked ok. Not drying though I did have to use a ton to get it to lather or even spread evenly through my hair. I'd say my hair is marginally softer, It is definitely NOT shinier.

There is a mild unoffensive scent that does not linger. Its clear so I dont think it has any added dyes etc. I'd say this is better than most shampoos for those with naturally curly hair.

Uncomfortable This mask bracket is super uncomfortable - its too hard on my nose.  On the bright side, it does help keep the mask off my skin and helps minimize my glasses fogging.  There is a slot to kind of 'hang' the mask on it but it doesnt work at all with my fabric masks.
Nice headbands Soft stretchy material with buttons that are a decent size without being obnoxiously large.  Does not scream 'MASK ACCESSORY'!  My teenager is very happy with them

Not for me These really didnt work well for me. They pull on my eyelids rather than gliding gently. Also they are too light and do not blend. The pictures show deep colors and I was just not able to achieve those deep colors or blend the colors together.

The formula is supposed to be waterproof and long lasting but these had worn off within hours. I had a slight glitter effect left but that as it.

Perhaps on someone with a different skin tone they would be better.

Why??? I was excited to get this because my girls are at an age where they like to play with hairstyles. I tried using this on my youngest who has thinish straight hair and it basically 'crimped' her hair. No curls. Just flat straight lines where the iron ended and a slight wave in between each line. Also, it only has 1 temp setting - high making it is easy to damage your hair.

So, yes, this thing is small and you can tuck it into your suitcase but I'm not sure why anyone would bother since it is essentially useless.

Gentle on skin not so much on hair This brush is gentle on skin.  It isnt the gentlest on long silky hair.  The plastic feels a bit on the brittle and cheap side.  The self cleaning mechanism works well.  The tines are short and spaced close together and it tends to pull more on the topcoat than the undercoat.  I'd say this brush is better suited to larger dogs with shorter hair like a shepherd rather than dogs like my spaniels.

Decent beginner set My teen has started doing her nails during the pandemic and I got this set for her. It has a nice array of items though it definitely seems more like a sampler than a full set of items. I found the tweezers a bit awkward to use but I'm not the target demographic.

There are no instructions included and rather than the pretty butterfly stickers pictured, I received stickers of bees! ?!?!

I'm probably being slightly generous in terms of stars but anything that can amuse my teen for a bit during a pandemic is welcome right now.

No instructions? There were no instructions provided with this nail polish.  I expected it to be swirly as displayed on the screen but it went on clear.  There are some instructions on the product page but that wasnt helpful as I was trying to do my nails.

Flattering colors The colors on this polish are really pretty and quite flattering.

Its so annoying that the color of the polish isnt clearly indicated on the bottle.

Other than that, this polish seems slightly runnier/thinner than others we've tried. It is just a bit messier and 2 coats are definitely needed. An led/uv light is definitely needed to cure the polish.

Natural looking These are the nicest looking lashes I've gotten.  They are quite natural looking.  I've tried a couple of other sets and they have all looked like hairy caterpillars.  In terms of whether they're easy to apply, I'm guessing it takes practice.  The tweezers provided are decent.  I do not find them easy to apply but they arent any harder (or easier)  than other similar sets.  I'm starting to think I'm just terrible at it.

Hate it :( My daughter has white blonde hair so I got this for her to share with her silver haired grandma during a trip. She complained bitterly about it. Said she could not wash it out, it made her hair blue and made her face greasy. I thought it was tween drama ..... then I tried it. Yuck. While it smells GREAT without being perfumey but it was like conditioning my hair with glue. It made it super sticky and tangled. And it stained the tub.

2 stars because it smells nice

Great travel set I forgot to bring a moisturizer on my trip so I requested this.  I like the moisturizer. I find it a little heavy as I put it on but it actually absorbs very well.  The eye cream burned a bit and my skin actually felt drier - perhaps it is tightening the skin rather than providing moisturizer?  Everything but the mask has minimal to no scent.  Overall, I like this set but I cant imagine paying $60 for it.

Takes a long time to dry and flakes off I put this on and left my eyes closed for a minute to let it dry. Before I had a chance to go back and look again, my kids took one look at me and said "Mom what happened to your face!" Uh Oh!

The liner had transferred from my eye line to the upper part of my eye in a neat little line on one eye. Less than 2h later it was also flaking off in great big chunks.

The colors are pretty and bold but they dont stay where they belong. On the upside, they do come off easily with Micelear water.

Purple does not look like purple So, I primarily got this because I liked the purple. My daughter wanted a rainbow set so I figured it would work out well. Best intentions.... She is happy with her rainbow - I do not like the purple. It is more of a pink color.... does not look at all like purple! And I only wanted the purple, so I'm disappointed. BOO!

The polish seems to last a decent amount of time. The matte finish looks a little weird - sort of like a crayon exploded on her fingers. But, she's happy so I guess that is fine.

Sort of 'meh' about it I'm really on the fence about this one. It is mostly unscented which I like. It is also fairly moisturizing. I just do not feel like it cleans especially well. Certainly not as well as my normal soap of choice. It is also, in my opinion, terribly expensive for the small bottle that I got.

For something that is touted as being for sensitive skin, there are too many ingredients that I can neither pronounce nor identify.

There isnt anything wrong with it, and I'll continue to use it but I do not love it.

No, Just, no These looked a little strange in the listing pic but I thought they'd be better in person. No, in fact, they look worse. The fabric reminds me of some old velvet curtains my grandmother had when I was a child. The are ridiculously thick - almost 2in thick. And they are super wide. But the worst problem is that the bottom of the headband - the part closest to your head is even wider than the padding so it pokes you in the head. My hair was braided when I tried it but I'm pretty certain that if my hair were loose, it would get caught in the edges.

Honestly there is nothing redeeming about these headbands.

Nice set for a teen This is a nice set for a teen. It is inspiration without being preachy. The quality of the items is pretty good. The bag holds a decent amount of stuff and the saying is printed on both sides. I think the script looks a little strange, but it does look pretty much as it does on screen. The mirror is a great size and I like that it magnifies a bit.

Pretty sure my teen is going to like it.

Wish the description were clearer I really like this cap - it fits well and is comfortable. It does not pull on either my skin or my hair. It is on the larger side so if you have a head at the smaller end of the size range, it might be too big unless you have a ton of hair.

My real issue is that the description is confusing. Is it silk or satin? (they are NOT the same!) Is it to sleep or to shower? Again, not the same thing? People just need to know what they are buying.

keeps the face looking matted this stuff works so well! my skin tends to get oily by mid day, esp during the hotter days, but man this stuff really works! the spray not only keeps the face looking matted but it also help keep my makeup lasting through the day! so amazing what a few sprays does!

i've had it for a couple of months now and i still have alot in the bottle left. it's definitely a stock up item!
they come offf.... i looked crazy! they come offf.... i looked crazy!

bump it! it helps!  my stylist always tells me my hair is too flat.  i need to not part it on one side, to switch it up to break up the heaviness because my root is so used to being parted to one side.  i never really liked doing that since i don't look right with my hair parted the opposite direction.  i stumbled across this clip, sort of like a BUMP IT, it helps give my hair some volume starting from the root!  I just leave it on for a bit after I get out of the shower and poof my hair has a bit of volume esp the front part of my hair where it is so flat.  i love love love it!

extra serum! if you love asian food, LOL then this mask is for you!  it smells like asian dessert and omahgahhhh, it works so well on the skin... it refreshens it and comes with so much serum that you can apply on after!  i love it!
not a fan it stinks and the pumping.. you have to do so many just to get some out for some suds!  my goodness!

Amazing stuff! Coming from a total Makeup Klutz, this product is - fantastic??!
I don't always wear foundation or pressed powder or anything to cover everything, but I really should.
Had an event on Sat. that I stepped it up for & tried this... long story short, IT WORKS.
I washed & lotioned my face as usual, then waited an hour or so to let it totally absorb.
Sprayed this & let it dry.
Applied a cream foundation that I've used before but, this time, it seemed to spread more evenly & easily and it looked really smooth & nice!
Received husband compliments & girlfriends at event compliments!
Whatever the magic is in this spray bottle, I'll be sure to keep it on hand.

Help for color-treated hair? Yes & thank you! My daughter has long, thick hair that she colors a few shades darker than her own & is always looking for products to keep it healthy.
And this hair mask is a winner!
The fragrance is a vague salon-type scent that’s pleasant but not overpowering. The amount of hair she has takes a lot of this, but WOW - you can see the results - her hair is very shiny & soft. It doesn’t have that cheap conditioner greasy softness - it’s a nice, swingy softness. Moroccan argan oil is the secret!
At nearly $18 for 8 oz., it’s a pricey treat but also worth it.

Thank you for taking the time to read this & I hope it’s helpful!

Very giftable with a nice selection of quality products! You pay for the boxed convenience… If you’re a Burt’s Bees fan, you’ll appreciate this boxed set.
It’s full of full-sized quality goodies packed perfectly in a sturdy box which makes it convenient to gift.
(ALSO: you don’t have to be a baby to use these! I have every intention of using them all on my almost 60 yr old self because I like their products for my very sensitive skin.)

At a little over $8/per piece, they’re priced at full retail, but you are paying for the convenience of boxed selections.

Makeup klutz me can actually use this! Very easy to apply & draw… Full disclosure: I’m a makeup klutz who has no business posting a pic of eyebrows BUT — for the 1st time, I found a product that let me actually draw some in!
