The expiration date is as follows: EXP: 09/21. This is the same expiration date that was also on the NO BRAINER Gentle Skin Cleanser. The two products are meant to be used together. 09/21 is a good date. Both products will be long gone before then.

If you are searching for a moisturizer that will prevent dry, irritated patches of skin from appearing overnight on your face, then I highly recommend that you use the GOAL DIGGER Moisturizing Cucumber Crème from Higher Education. I've been using it for three weeks and have not experienced any ill side effects such as acne, hives, blisters, etc. I seriously doubt that you will since it is made primarily of vegetables. Our moms always said vegetables were good for us. Whenever I use the GOAL DIGGER, I feel that I am playing with my green vegetables. Using it is fun.

MBA Night Renewing Serum Helps Reduce the Appearance of Wrinkles Around My Eyes! No, I'm not vain, but I don't won't to look old before my time. I'm a fifty-six-year-old Caucasian male who just retired after 34 years of government service. Fortunately, I still look as though I am in my forties. What is my secret? Simple. I don't smoke, I don't lay out in the sun, I drink plenty of water, and I moisturize, moisturize, moisturize. Lately, I've also learned the importance of using products, such as facial serums, that have retinol, which reduces wrinkles around the eyes. I don't believe in plastic surgery but I do strongly believe in using topical products that reduce the appearance of aging. Everyone I personally know who has had plastic surgery ended up looking like a clown with a lopsided mouth and huge, shocked eyes.

I've been using several Higher Education products as part of a facial cleansing and healing regimen. The products that I've been using are the NO BRAINER Gentle Skin Cleanser and the GOAL DIGGER Moisturizing Cucumber Crème. Both are excellent products; I am quite pleased with them. Thanks to them, my skin looks healthy and glowing. After I retired, I moved from Virginia to Tennessee and the change in environment caused my face to become badly dehydrated. I was waking up with dry, irritated patches of skin on my face that sometimes stung. Thankfully, with the help of the Higher Education products, I have been able to heal my skin and keep the dry patches away.

I also decided to use the MBA Night Renewing Serum from Higher Education as part of my nightly ritual. The MBA is to be used only at night. Also, the consumer is to use it only twice a week and gradually increase its usage as tolerated. Well, I've been using it every night for two weeks without any issues. However, I use it sparingly around my eyes. I've noticed a difference in the three weeks that I have been using it. Fewer wrinkles and smoother skin. The serum is light-green and doesn't have a distinguishable scent. It burns slightly when I put it on but the burning sensation quickly goes away. I use the MBA after applying my GOAL DIGGER, which moisturizes my skin, preparing it for the MBA. Like I stated earlier, I've been using the MBA for three weeks and I haven't experienced any ill side effects or allergic reactions such as acne, hives, blisters, or red, swollen skin.

The serum arrived in a 1.7 fluid-ounce pump bottle with a plastic, transparent cap. For some unknown reason, I keep forgetting that the tube has a pump. I want to squeeze the tube as though it were toothpaste. The cap prevents accidental leakage and spillage. I think it would be difficult to tamper with the tube. The tube arrived inside a sturdy, cardboard box, which contained company literature. The MBA is a good product. My only issue with it is the expiration date. An expiration date is provided on the back of the tube's crimp and on the bottom of the box. It reads as follows: EXP 09/20. This is not a good date, especially for a product that will probably be in usage for three to four months, if used sparingly. I expected it have about the same expiration date as the one I found for the NO BRAINER Gentle Skin Cleanser and the GOAL DIGGER Moisturizing Cucumber Crème, which is 09/21.

I wonder if Higher Education decided that giving products that would soon expire to reviewers from the Amazon Vine Program was a good means for disposing of aging products. Whenever I review a food or hygiene product, I always look for an expiration date. Not all hygiene products have expiration dates. I think they all should in order to let consumers know whether or not they are receiving safe products with fresh ingredients. I hope that customers who actually purchase the MBA Night Renewing Serum will obtain a product with a better expiration date. Nevertheless, I believe that MBA is good for lessening the appearance of wrinkles. MBA won't remove them completely. I don't think anything will. However, MBA will help to minimize them.

My Lips Look and Feel Great Thanks to Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm! Usually, by this time of the year (late October), my lips are already chapped. Thanks to Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm my lips are still looking, and feeling, great. I received the balm inside a short, round, 0.5-ounce glass jar. It came tightly sealed inside a form-fitting bubble-wrapped envelope. There was a tiny, round transparent protective seal on the jar and its large black lid. The seal is not very effective. I was able to easily open the cap without realizing the seal was there. The print on the jar is very tiny. After looking at the jar several times with a magnifying glass, I couldn't locate an expiration or a best by date. Many hygiene product don't have them but they should. These dates let me know if the ingredient are still fresh.

I use the Cloud Lip Balm twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening. The balm feels nice on my lips. It is very easy to smooth all over my lips. It reminds me of some expensive high-end lip butter that I once owned. The jar is small enough to fit inside the pockets of my jeans. During the day, I use Carmex Classic Lip Balm when necessary. The Cloud Lip and the Carmex are working together well to protect my lips and to keep them appearing healthy and attractive. I've been faithfully using the Cloud Lip Balm for nearly three weeks and have not experienced any adverse side effects or allergic reactions. It doesn't have a noticeable scent. Also, I would like to note that the balm has a light-yellow waxy color whereas Amazon's website shows it to have a creamy white color.

The Hudson and James Cloud Lip Balm doesn't sting or burn my lips after applying it; I hardly notice that it is there. What I do notice is that my lips are feeling and looking great despite the change in seasons. I wish I knew the price of the lip balm. At the time of this review, it wasn't available for purchase. Overall, I like this hygiene product and would strongly recommend it to anyone who suffers from dry, chapped lips.

Good value for an entry level toiletry bag This entry level toiletry bag from Gonex is a no frills waterproof organizer that has a hook for hanging and various compartments for keeping your stuff organized. Overall this is a pretty decent bag that can hold about a medium amount of items. It's easy to clean, open and hang which is nice.

There are few drawbacks. First, the fabric that forms the pockets needs to be firmer and tighter. It won't hold top heavy items while it's hanging which annoying. Second, the hook needs to be bigger. It definitely will not fit on a closet pole or seven some towel racks.

This is worth getting if you need a low cost toiletry/makeup bag and you don't have top heavy items to store.

A very nice feeling soap This charcoal activated soap from Heyedrate is one of the nicest charcoal soaps that I have ever had the pleasure of trying. It's got a very nice lather that is on par with much higher end luxury soaps yet it does a great job also keeping you clean.

The soap is about average in terms of lifespan and it contains no smell. It has a soft feel to it but it doesn't get soggy or water logged. Leaves your skin with a soft moisturized feeling. Overall I'm very impressed with this bar of soap and I think it's a great value.

good for powder but not liquid makeup I like the size and shape of these sponges, specially for application of foundation. I use liquid foundation and I noticed that the sponge was soaking up the makeup. I started using these only to apply powdered makeup like rouge or shimmer and they work very well.

Strong clipping power, case is great for traveling This has been one of my favorite nail clippers I have used. It cuts with precision, even toenails that are thick or semi ingrown. curvature of clip is wide so it will not clip nails leaving edges, and you do not have to use more than once per nail except toe nail. I also like the little case that does with it and the curved body gives thumb more leverage to hold in place when clipping. It comes with a nail filer but I didn't find much use for it.

Pleased with scrubbing properties, smells a little chemically Although the Higher Education facial scrub has a bit of a chemical induced rather than fragrant smell, its texture and cleansing power is great at getting rid of dead skin cells and dull patches. My skin feels refreshed and truly soft after using, without need to resort to facial cloths to do the scrubbing. A double pea size amount goes a long way for scrubbing face and neck, so amount will last a long while. 4/5.

light, fast absorbing The nudity facial emulsion absorbs quirkily and without leaving residue. With a lightly scented floral fragrance, it feels and smells refreshing. However, moisture is short lasting if you have dry prone skin and would recommend adding a longer lasting moisturizer if you need good moisture for an 8 hour day.

quality oil for hair/ scalp, good packaging I have been using this castor oil to promote hair growth and calm the itchiness and discomfort of my scalp due to issues with dandruff. a few drops help soothe my scalp and after some consistent use, I notice that my hair falls out less than before when brushing it. It is a legitimately unrefined oil when compared to other less expensive brands for the amount, this one is less sticky and darker, and the darkened bottle allows for good preservation from UV rays.

Does a good job shaving long hairs, but struggles to get close shave after This MHSY Electric Razor for Women does not require, or specify in the instructions, about using shaving cream or oil. It does not state anything was needed, so I did not use anything. My leg hair was quite long when I used it the first time, and it shaved pretty well. When I went to use it again, even the strongest blade setting, it did not seem to be getting the hair for a close enough shave. So it seemed to do well when the hair is longer. It gave me ingrown hair bumps in some areas. I am not sure if it's not due to not using a lubricant or not. It holds pretty well in the shower. But I don't think it's supposed to be used while you are showering. It is very light to hold. I appreciate the left and right blades for sensitive areas, however, the curve around the middle blade has no use. I am not sure what its purpose is for, as much as I have tried to figure it out, it seems to do nothing. The battery lasts quite a while, as I have had it for about a month and only needed to charge it once.

Great Product. Great Price. Great Results. My family has used Oral B rechargeable toothbrushes for years.  We end up replacing them after about 3 years or so, but, at a price under $20 each, it still is cheaper than a Sonicare.  The replacement head brushes are about the same price as the more expenseive rechargeables, and we purchase them at Sam's and on line.  And, in the end, the results are what matter.  No one in our family has had a cavity in over 7 years.  Some of that has to be the results of a good toothbrushing (especially with my children).

Nice, Pleasant Smell. Do not Completely Remove Make-up These Yes wipes feel equivalent to others on the market & they remove makeup about as well as other makeup removal wipes.

I am not a heavy makeup user - very light foundation, powder, a little blush & a little eye shadow. The wipes do not completely remove makeup/residue, so if I use the wipes exclusively, I will get clogged pores within a couple of weeks. This result is the same using other manufacturer's wipes. Consequently, while super convenient especially while traveling, if I travel with make-up wipes, I also travel with blemish cream.

Good for Regular Polish and Fingers This dip in nail polish is essentially a container size sponge soaked in nail polish remover. The sponge acts as the abrasive to assist the nail polish remover liquid complete the removal job. It works pretty well on fingers - you have th kind of twist your fingers around/about. Can't see using this for toes at all.

3-1/2 stars because limited use. Still need to use cotton ball and remove on toes.

OK Facial Pads. These charcoal pads are intended to be used after you wash your face. They are suppose to draw out impurities (charcoal side) and soothe the skin for a "healthier" look.

The pads are premoistened and have plenty of moisture. It is easy to discern the charcoal side. After about 3 weeks of use every 3rd day, I cannot see the difference in my skin. I'm not a heavy make-up wearer, so this may be a factor in trying to see noticeable differences when using/not using the Neogen charcoal pad.

Mildly Moisturizing. As an Aloe Vera product, this gel is OK. Its moisturizing capabilities are below average and its soothing abilities on tender skin are average.

The gel leans thin-ish for a "thick" gel. The smell is light and inoffensive. The seller says this can be used as a base to make homemade hand sanitizer and the thickness is about on par with typical hand sanitizers on the market.

Very Quiet. Good For Maintenance Review from my bearded spouse:

Things I like about this trimmer:
1. The dial adjustment works very well for the gate.
2. The trimmer is very quiet (especially compared to my old one).
3. The nose/ear trimmer works better than any I have ever used before.
4. I generally use a razor for shaving but the two micro screen shaving heads work well for a quick clean up (beware of an occasional pulled whisker).
5. For my beard and mustache, the large trimmer used with the gate does a fantastic job.
6. Doesn't come with an adapter to plug the USB charging cord into the wall.

Verdict: great for beard, mustache and ear/nose hair removal, but I wouln't want to use it as an everyday shaver

Cleans Well. Leaves Hair a Little Fly-Away Overall, this Argan Oil shampoo is fine. It cleans well but leaves my hair with some fly-aways, so I follow the shampoo with a conditioner when washing my hair. I can go about every other day for washing, which is about normal for most of my shampoos. The lather is adequate and not overly generous (so not a lot of additive to produce excess lather).

The bottle arrived a bit slimy because the screw cap came loose in shipping. Luckily, the bottle was sealed in plastic. The pump action works as expected.

Do Not Like the Way This Feels When Applying to My Face I'm not a fan of this "lotion". It has a odd, oily, but not oily feel when I apply it to my face. It also seems to lay on my face and I have to rub it into my skin. And, once my skin absorbs this lotion, my face still feels a bit dry, so I have to either layer this one again or use a different, more moisturizing face lotion.

I have more of a T zone face and my natural oiliness has decreased over the years. I apply face lotion both day and night. This lotion may be better for someone with noticeably oily skin who doesn't normally apply lotion on the face.
Works great, clean cuts This are sharp and make clipping nails easy.  I even used them to clip down my acrylics before having them removed.

Thick band and not practical These lashes are super pretty, but they are not very practical for daily wear. They're fluffy and huge and good for photos, but not necessarily something I would want to wear to work or to class everyday.
Just what I needed This work great for my purpose.  I needed a spritzer for my plants and this is just what I needed. They are priced right too.

Not all skin serums with Vitamin C & E, & Hyaluronic Acid are the same I did not like this skin serum since it made my face red and irritated. I have been using another brand, [[ASIN:B00G2TQNZ4 Amara Organics Vitamin C Serum for Face 20% with Hyaluronic Acid & Vitamin E, 1 fl. oz.]] for a while, which does not cause this problem, so I thought that I would try this Aura brand that was on sale. I am sorry to report that it did not work out. I have very sensitive skin, however, so others may not experience what I did. I do wear moisturizer & foundation makeup on a semi-daily basis, so my skin is not ultra sensitive since it can well tolerate the makeup.

This difference between this brand and Amara is that this one is an amber color with a subtle scent/aroma that smells slightly medicinal, which I can detect, while Amara is clear and without a scent that I can detect.

Did not irritate my very sensitive skin. So easy to apply. Seems to show an improvement albeit a slight change. I've been using this mousse and it's hard to discern if there is improvement, but it seems to me that there has been. It is not significant and dramatic like it was when I began using [[ASIN:B00GG5IZWS NuFACE Trinity Facial Trainer Kit, White]], which I became tired of needing to use so frequently and also experience a dull headache on the days of use.

I do like the foam puff that is so easy to apply to my face - no sponges or cotton balls needed. I am going to stick with this for a while since it is so much easier and less time consuming than using the NuFace Trinity instrument, and has no discernible side effects.

Great for Tough Nails This clipper is heavy-duty and sharp. It's rather thick, so it's best for people who let their nails get past their toes before trimming them; if your nail is fairly short already, it's hard to get it between the nail and your skin.

It works especially well for my husband who tends to let his nails go because they're so hard to cut. No more. These clippers are up to tough nails and they cut them easily.

The clippers come with a small case that also includes a petite nail file. Recommended for tough jobs.

Lovely Essential Oils This set of three essential oils is very useful. The oils are certified organic and never tested on animals. The quality seems very high and the oils smell wonderful. The perfectly packaged set would make a great gift for someone beginning with essential oils or for an old hand since it contains three of the most commonly used oils.

Personally, I don't use oils medicinally unless you count the calming benefits of lavender in your mister. I use them either in a mister or atomizer or as a dot of fragrance on my wrist. Essential oils don't cause headaches or change their scent when I wear them.

The kit includes lavender, lemon, and peppermint. All three smell absolutely wonderful, whether you use them in a mister or add a drop to your washer's rinse cycle. I always add a drop or two to loads containing our bedding. It's delightful.

I would definitely buy Bloomy's brand again. I'm very impressed with the fragrance and quality.

Five Stars Plus! This trimmer is fantastic! It's quiet and powerful and has a precision dial that lets you precisely set the trim length from very short to relatively long. With this tool, you won't need to change out removable trim guides for the lengths you want - and if you're like my guy, that also means you won't lose them constantly.

This razor feels great in the hand and it glides without pulling on hair - that's worth five stars all by itself. It came fully charged, and it only takes about 90 minutes to completely recharge it. The big LCD readout lets you know how much power is left - it's very convenient.

It comes with a beard trimmer, nose and ear hair trimmer, precision trimmer, body groomer, hair trimmer, guide comb, cleaning brush, comb, charging cord, stand, and a traveling bag. There's also an excellent user manual.

One added feature that's really appreciated is that you can lock it so it won't turn on accidentally in the travel bag or suitcase.

Extremely Gentle Scrubber If brushes irritate your skin when you scrub your back, this silicone back scrubber may be just right for you. The scrubber has myriads of tiny silicone bristles on one side and varying-sized bumps on the other. Use it right and you can give your back and neck a nice massage. Add soap to the bristles and get really clean.

This set would make a nice gift. It includes four adhesive (but removable) hooks, the scrubber and a foam bath sponge.

Personally, I was hoping for a more vigorous scrub and will probably stick to my scrubbing brush for my back. But I do like using this gentle scrubber on my legs.

A Lemony Treat These are far too expensive to use for everyday wipes, but as a treat, or for a super-dirty job, I absolutely love them. (With these, fried chicken at a picnic wouldn't be too messy.) Yesterday, after a couple hours of gardening in the hot sun, I used one sturdy wipe (they're about 8"X5") on my face, neck, chest, arms, and hands, as a very refreshing clean-up.

These are nothing but essential oil and water, no chemicals, so your skin won't be dried out or irritated. I absolutely adore them and will keep some in my handbag and car from now on.

Pleasing Color I don't wear much eye makeup, but the olive-colored Khaki Star really appealed to me. My eyes appear blue or green depending on what I'm wearing, and this shadow makes the green in my eyes much deeper and more apparent.

I've tried applying it lightly with a finger and it makes a nice translucent color that way that enhances without taking over. With a brush, I put it along my lashes like eyeliner and it came out very nice. If I apply it twice, it's appropriate for nighttime wear.

I wear contacts so it's important to me that eye shadow stays where I put it and doesn't flake into my eyes. This shadow passes that test perfectly, so I'll be getting a pale highlighting shade to go with this one. I'm very happy with this product.

Great for Sensitive Eyes I have very dry eyes and, in addition, use three prescription eye drops at bedtime and first thing in the morning. Since I wear contacts, I put the drops in the morning then doze in bed for another fifteen or twenty minutes before it's time to insert my lenses. During this time, my eyes tear up a little from the medication. The tears, combined with drips of medicine, create crusts around my eyes that are irritating if I'm not careful about wiping them away. They often sting and I don't have time for that -- cats are calling for breakfast and I need my contact lenses on to see to feed them.

These wipes are terrific for cleaning away excess eye drops on my skin and lashes. They're thorough and don't sting and the wipes are big so I can use one side to do most of the cleaning turn it over to make sure my lashes are completely clear. There is no pain despite my dry eyes.

I wish I'd found these sooner, and I'm glad to have them. They make my morning routine less stingy and crusty!

Solidly sandalwood I can best describe this as a light and breezy sandalwood. It hugs the line of masculine. Every time I spray it, my husband asks me if I’m burning incense. It has some real staying power throughout the day. It also works as a layering scent. I’ve matched it with a rain scent to add a more woody element.

The bottle and top are hefty and solid- you can pack this.

great for depuffing I have the pretty green jade with the rose gold frame.  I've used several of these and this is my favorite.  The gua sha tool with this roller is a bit smaller than some others.  The packaging is nice and comes with a sweet handwritten note.  I feel like this definitely needs to be used with a oil or serum, which is part of the instructions.  You can text "Janebook" to the number provided in the instructions and they'll send you a link to en eBook.  Unfortunately, the link is through Facebook, so if you don't have an account (and I don't), this won't work.  the manufacturer has included some helpful videos on this product page.  Overall, this is therapeutic to use and helps me to de-puff.

Smells Kinda like Old Spice This hair paste is awesome! for the price, it almost even out performs some way more expensive hair products! I used to use Paul Mitchell hair paste, but this is probably going to be my go to now.

This stuff does have somewhat of a smell, but it smells sort of like the original old spice. It's not too strong though, but if you want something scentless, then you may wanna try something else.

Cooling Natural Aloe Vera Seriously there’s nothing better on a sunburn than Aloe Vera.  It’s natural and won’t harm your skin.  This aloe has a clear color so there’s no artificial dyes contained in this gel.  Just pure headlining and soothing properties.  I feel for the size of the bottle, it’s a great bargain and it’s effective.

Mask Brackets These really do help to make wearing a mask a little easier to breathe.  I don't like wearing mine and I don't have to for very long, but this does help with air circulation underneath your mask.  If you're having a hard time, give these a try.  They are a great value and seem to be very sturdy.

Coffee Scrub I didn't notice a distinct fragrance from this scrub.  It does faintly smell of coffee but I had hoped there would be more of a spicy smell.  But, this is a nice feeling scrub against your skin.  It does make your skin feel energized.  I'm not sure how long it would take to make my cellulite become less visible but I will keep using it for the mere purpose that it does feel good.  I would say too that it would make a good gift because it's so unique.  I do recommend this product and for the price it's a good value for either a gift or keeping it for yourself as a treat.  Enjoy!

Reusable Makeup Removal Pads with Laundry bag If you are concerned about the environment and like a simple way to remove your makeup, these are for you!  You use these microfiber pads once and you can wash them in a bag that is provided for you in this pouch.  It couldn't be easier or better for our environment.  I feel this would make an excellent gift for someone as well.  Everything you need is all included in this ziplock pouch.  It's a big savings financially to have pads that can be washed and reused over and over again.  I think you'll enjoy this product very much.

Dried Flower Buds I want to explain why I didn't give this neat product a better rating.  First let me say that I do like the idea - i love it in fact.  I was so excited about receiving this product because it was so different and unique.  I wanted to learn how to use this product in different ways.  When I received it, I got the bag as pictured above and couldn't figure out what was inside.  There was no description on the outside at all.  I didn't know what was inside till I ripped the bag open. After I opened it, I immediately saw the beautifully colored foil wrapped buds and remembered "Oh yes, this is the flower buds that I saw that can be used as tea, bath pods and for baking."  There was no description, instructions or anything inside other than the beautifully foil wrapped buds.  I'm still left wondering how I will use them.  If I use for tea, I suppose I just wing it and drink the tea when I think it's done as there's no recipe for how long to steep to experience the perfect amount of flavor is extracted.  If I use for a bath, I'm sure there would be much more flexibility but it also advertises you can use for baking.  I have no idea how to use it for that.  If I wanted to use it for a gift, it would be incomplete not to mention that in order to even know what I ordered, I had to already open the pretty bag so that would ruin the presentation.  I feel this is a great product with great potential to be a high end gift or luxury indulgence.  They just have one more step to complete in the way of instructions and explanation on the packaging to make it achieve it's potential.  This idea could easily go viral and become very popular.

Bar of Soap with Calendula Oil It's got to be the Calendula oil that leaves your skin so moisturized after using this soap.  I first smelled the very subtle fragrance and thought I'd enjoy this soap enough to purchase it again till I also realized it's really moisturizing.  I think you'll be very happy with how it leaves your skin feeling most of all.  It's advertised as being all natural as well so if you have sensitive skin, you shouldn't have any problems with this although I'd always recommend trying a test patch first before using it in the shower all over.

Magicopper Film Mask I wasn't sure what to expect when this arrive but I was pleasantly surprised at how breathable this mask is.  It's more formed and cone shaped on it's own which allows a breathing space between your face and the mask itself.  This makes this mask so easy to breath with.  I'm not used to using masks since I spend more time at home but when I do go out, I want a mask that doesn't make me feel like I'm struggling for breath.  This is the mask for you!  It not only is very safe and the harder shell surface will keep germs out, it's also a nice breathable mask.  The price is extremely fair as well.  It comes with a lanyard so you don't have to put your mask down on any dirty surface when not in use.  It can hang from your neck comfortably.  The inside of the mask is washable so you can use it again and again without fear.

Nail Care Cuticle Nippers and accessories I ordered this mainly for the cutters.  This cuticle nipper has a double tension resistance and is easy to maneuver.  I like to keep my nails and cuticles looking good.  It's important to have the right quality tools.  This kit has the basics and the price is right.  Each item seems to be of high quality steel and feels good in your hand making them an easy way to keep your manicure and pedicure looking good.

Sugar Scrub This has a very pleasant scent and works quite well at exfoliating and moisturizing your skin.  I think the scent is a bit on the stronger side but it's pleasant and is more like something you'd smell in a spa for relaxation.  It's a small size tin so use sparingly.  A little goes a long way.  You will enjoy this little luxury very much.  It's a great value as well as a fun thing to use or gift to a friend.

Travel Electric Toothbrush Case These toothbrush cases are a good size and you can fit your electric toothbrush inside easily if you remove the brush stem.  They won't rattle around in there because they have grooves where the brush and stem both can easily fit inside and clip into place.  The reason I gave these a 3 star rating was because the clip that is to keep the case closed doesn't really clamp or close right.  It's very loose and I think that you will need a rubber band to keep the case closed.  I know that's not really a big deal but given that I haven't even used these yet I can't blame wear and tear on the fact that the clasp doesn't work.  It didn't work from the moment I took it out of the box.  I suppose if you put this case inside a toiletry bag, it's unlikely it will open even without a rubber band so really, if you need something to pack up your electric toothbrush, these cases will work and hold most brands of electric toothbrush and the price was fair.

Makeup Sponge Holder One issue I've had in my makeup drawer is that I hate to just put my blender sponge in there without being inside something to keep it clean and sanitary.  This solves that problem nicely.  It's very soft and pliable and opens with a squeeze of the ends of the container.  It's very easy to use and your sponge fits nicely inside.  It seems quite durable and like it would last a good long time.  It's also easy to clean and allows circulation in case you wash your sponge and it's slightly damp.  The air holes will allow for proper circulation.  This is a really handy gadget!

Nice feel and Great Color I really love this color and the feel of this lipstick.  I was impressed too with how pretty the packaging was.  There's nothing nicer than when you take your lipstick out of your purse and everyone sees how pretty the tube is - but I digress.  This lipstick is a great nude color and goes well with just about anything I wear - be it red or pink.  You must always have a good versatile lipstick color in your purse at all times.  Your clothes change but you always take the same purse when you're out and about.  Your lipstick in that purse should go with everything you're wearing.  The feel of this lipstick is also very nice which is a huge plus.  I think the price is fair for such a nice quality lipstick.
Three Stars Great way to get your collagen supplement. A bit too sweet for my taste though.

Decent hair ties This is the brand and type of hair ties I always get when the ones I have wear out. They are very sturdy under heavy use and stretch fairly well. They do tend to wear out after a bit of time, but that makes this value pack worthwhile so it will be a long time before you need to buy more. I have been using this brand for years and have yet to find anything else that holds my thick long hair well.

Nice set of eye shadow The Sunset Dusk Palette has 15 colors of glazed eye shadow and they all really pop! The case is well-made and held closed via a magnet. You have enough options to go bold or go more reserved, and the eye shadow lasts all day without issue. Many of the colors are glittery, which I did not know for sure if I would like, but I really do! Definitely worth it.
