I followed the instructions and bathe normally then applied the scrub with my hands to my body. Immediately, I could feel the smoothing effects on my hands and then on the body part I applied it to. This is great for applying to the skin after shaving, this allows the skin to be silky smooth with no bumpy feeling especially within the bikini area. I also suffer from body acne and while I've used numerous scrubs to tame it, this has actually been the best to relieve the itching and get rid of it within days while moisturing the area. The only downfall to this is it is a hard to get out of the bottle especially when your hands are wet in the shower.

It's OK The hairspray is adjustable for your spray desire. You can adjust the mist from light to heavy as well as the jet spray is adjustable.  The bottom portion (where water is held) of the bottle material is thicker than most spray bottles you'll find in big brick and mortar which somewhat justifies the higher cost. However, I found that they should have made the top (spray portion) of the bottle thicker with a better mechanism. I've owned several of these types of bottles that I get for $1 in big brick and mortar and know too well that over time the trigger will malfunction so I was expecting a higher quality here but that was not the case. Therefore, unless you simple want a bigger bottle to hold more water over the conventional spray bottles found in the local well-known brick and mortar stores then this may work for you but just know it's the same bottle just bigger with a slightly better material. Just don't expect a better quality trigger than the ones you would've found in your local W or T stores.

Great curls in lashes Oh, I think I must be in the season of choosing bad lashes for myself as these were much longer than I anticipated. However, the good news is they have gorgeous curls to them. Though these didn’t work for me as they are too long and I don’t like the look on myself, the lashes themselves are nice and the glue is everything! The glue makes putting on the lashes easy. I can’t say if the glue works in keeping the lashes on long because I used my trusted T&A glue of the same type to try on another set of lashes and then took those lashes off and apply this lash with their glue. I have not used the glue by itself yet as my tend to reach for my T&A lash glue first out of habit. I digress, the lashes are nice for those who like long curly lashes, it just isn’t for me which sucks as I love the curls in the lashes. I’ll probably see if they offer smaller size curl lashes as those would work great for me.

Good cleanser This is a very good cleanser. It took off all the dirt and oil from my face without me needing to wash my face multiple times. It applies thick and really seems to get into your pores. I have oily skin with enlarged pores so I like that it does a good job cleansing my face. Unfortunately, I had to deduct a star as it seems that my face was slightly drier than normal after washing it with this cleanser. I could see this being a good cleanser to use to wash off makeup from your face to the end of the night.
Didn’t work for me It did not adhere my lashes. The lashes would not stick. I became annoyed and went with another trusty eyelash adhesive.

Ok The nails are thin, not the thinnest I’ve encountered but I wish they were a little stronger. They give you 2 packs so you can easily do your nails numerous times if they pop off. I used nail glue instead of the nail sticky tabs provided, I use those to stick the nails to tooth picks so I can cure other colors over or against this nail and other clear nails. They last me a good week & a half which isn’t bad as long as you prep your nails.

Pigmented and pretty Oh my gosh, I’m so shocked at how well these worked. To try them out, I placed them on my bare eyelid with no primer, concealer or powder and was shocked how the color and glitter popped on my melanin oily skin. They’re small, kinda like pills,  only slightly bigger than my biggest vitamin pills but so easy to use. Some colors are super pigmented while others are not, you’re basically going to to get the shimmer effects with the ones that aren’t has pigmented. I’m darker skin and did a swatch on my arm and you can see how some are pigmented from one swipe while others aren’t but the lighter you are is the more it will show. I know I’ll get lots of use from them as I’m not in full makeup a lot and I absolutely love the color choices and glittery effects.

Work and customization needed! I got the full set with closure and oh my goodness, they did joy watch in color. First, this hair has so much golden-reddish hair throughout it that you’ll definitely need to die this to use it. It is not a natural black hair. I’m not sure if it’s normal for these bundles to have these streak of highlighted hair throughout as I don’t buy much bundles but this is the second bundles I’ve gotten for Amazon that has this throughout. Second, the bundles and the closure do NOT match! The bundles were black for the most part but the closure was definitely brown, you’re definitely going to ha e to dye this! Third, the closure is done for you to have a box-y face look. You’re definitely going to need to pluck this so I hope you have good plucking skills. The hair is soft though and of good density. Just be prepared to dye the hair or have the hair dye.

Therefore, you’re going to need to work with this hair. You’re not just going to wash it and make a wig or sew it it. You’ll need to do some prep work first to get it right

Nice This is a nice wig. It doesn’t have any combs in the back but it looks nice straight out the package. I recommend putting some dry shampoo to full down the shine and concealer at the top. It’s definitely something that can be worn out the house. The back wasn’t  too short either but that will also depend on how you comb your hair under. I have thin hair with my hair in a ponytail underneath
Nice The nails are nice and you get a lot of tips in the pack.

Pro quality This tool is really good in cleaning up the cuticles. The pusher works very well and the little scraper gets under the cuticles to get rid of excess skin or debris. This is a professional set and I love using this for prepping my nails for applying nail extensions such as acrylic or press-on.

Not bad Initially when I took this out the package, I was disappointed with it as it was super shiny and look like doll hair. Once I placed it on my head, it didn’t look bad. It was actually wearable once you dull down the shine of the hair as it looks like doll hair but is a few step up from doll hair. I can actually run my fingers through the hair without much snags and I didn’t encounter any shedding. This is a great cosplay wig and isn’t too bad of a wig.
Thin The end of the hair seems very thin to me. It also feels dry so deep conditioning it is highly recommended.

Beautiful The mannequin head is absolutely beautiful. She has eyelashes and makeup on. She displays your wigs so nicely. I like using her to style my wigs as she shows me how it’ll look once I doll up my face with makeup.

Looks nothing like photo First, this is definitely not a 1B, but a 2. This is brown and definitely not black. Next, I’m well aware of a lot of items on Amazon uses influencer pictures that aren’t of the actual item but many are on par to the item, this is not one of them. This does not look like the stock photo, instead, I thought someone time wrapped me and dropped me in 1970s era. I felt like one of the older church ladies or a hippie as the hair is super thick and curly. The bangs are so long too. It’s going to take a lot of work to get it to look good. You’re going to have to cut, trim, then style the hair. This is a lot of work if you do not have the hairdresser skills, so you’re basically will end up messing up the wig and wasting your money.

Long & don’t itch The hair is pre-stretched and good braiding hair. It’s one of the softest synthetic braiding hair I’ve felt. My daughter is finally into braiding her hair & I  got these for her hair. The hair isn’t itchy and the color is nice. It comes with 8 packs but it wasnt enough to do her full head of hair, some black hair had to be added in order to complete her entire head.
Just Ok I thoughts his mascara would make my lashes pop more but unfortunately did not. It is just like any other mascara. Nothing special and doesn’t make your lashes appear longer or fuller.

Better suited for smaller heads The headband wig’s hair is nice and soft. The length seems true. However, the cap is on the smaller size. My head is 23” and it was snug on my head, definitely not very comfortable.

Great cleanser This is a gentle cleanser for all face types. I have oily skin and I can use this product without it making my face oiler. It feels like it really cleans my skin as though it’s really getting into the pores. I don’t have to wash my face twice to remove all dirt from it.

Nice The set is nice and very portable. It is a one-finger UV light that omits he plugged in to operate. It is not wireless. This would be great to travel with as you could easily do your nails using a power bank. The glue works. I find curing it longer than normal helps it to last longer.

Great face scrub This SELF/ish men's face scrub is a great one. It has a very subtle scent (not like the face wash which has a strong lemon-y scent), the texture is not too thick, and when you apply it you can feel the grainy stuff in it exfoliating your face. It feels great and works well. I have been using this face scrub every few days (using their face wash every day) and am very pleased with the quality and performance.

Wish i could see better Does the job but it is difficult in the lighting I have to see through the window and be sure my items are submerged fully.  It seems like the window is tinted on mine, could just be that the black tray makes it look dark
Five Stars i likes these color

A unique cleanser I'm always on the lookout for good skin care items that don't test on animals. This one took me a few tries to figure out. The instructions confused me a bit because it's unlike anything I've used before. You need to put it on but wait a few seconds before rubbing it at all. It will foam up and then it says to roll it.  I had to try a few times to figure out how much to use since it went on clear. There is a mild smell to it.  I think it smells good. Very fresh. I think my skin looks pretty good after use. It feels nice and refreshed as well. I'm interested to see how it does after continued use. Overall, I think I really like this one. I just wish it were a bit more affordable.

Does what it should This works as a hair straightener should work. It is a nice vibrant purple color, which makes it a little more fun.  It is comfortable to hold and easy to use.  I like how the long swivel cord makes it even easier. The cord also has a velcro strap attached for easy storage. It heats up very quickly.  It comes with some nice accessories as well. You get two travel/storage options. There is a nice velvet-like bag or a hard shell carry case. You also get a comb, two clips, a heat resistant glove and a booklet to show how to achieve certain hair styles. I tested the glove to make sure it actually works. It does help, though you don't really want to hold your hand there for too long.  Perfect for those accidental touches, though honestly, I will never remember to put it on first. The on button and the temperature display is very easy to see. This is a good item, priced much better than many of the other options that seem to offer the same.

Pretty equal to a regular conditioner I appreciate that this product uses natural ingredients and is cruelty free and paraben free. I was hoping that this would be a great moisturizing treatment for my hair, but I think it is probably geared more for scalp moisturizing.  Since I do not have issues with dry scalp I can not give an accurate review on the effectiveness there.  I can say that this stuff smells really good. It is a floral scent that almost reminds me of rose, but far less obnoxious.  You really only smell it during use so it isn't one that lingers.  It did leave my hair feeling pretty soft, which is nice, but it tangled really easily immediately after rinsing.  I have very fine hair so that is pretty common, but still annoying.  However, after washing and detangling, I do think my hair looked pretty good.  I think this is a pretty good product, but it feels pretty much like any normal conditioner to me, rather than a hair mask. Considering the price, I was hoping for a little more.  I would like to find somebody with a very dry scalp to try it out to see if it benefits them more than it did me.

Great for dry hands As the weather gets colder I have a harder time keeping my hands from getting overly dry,. This stuff has been really good to combat this problem.  I have really only remembered to apply some about once a day but it has still helped tremendously.  I have even applied it to my dry, cracked heels and it has helped to soften and improve that skin as well. I imagine if I was a little more consistent with it I would see even better results.  It is a thicker lotion that absorbs really easily and is very moisturizing.  It does not leave skin feeling greasy at all. There is really no smell to it either.  It leaves your hands feeling soft and smooth and looking healthy. It comes in an easy to dispense tube which is very handy to keep in the most convenient location for you.  It is cruelty free and contains good ingredients. I don't have very sensitive skin, but I think this would be gentle on all skin types.  I will definitely continue to use this to protect my hands this winter!

motion part works, but strong scent This appears to actually deliver on the "motion sensing" part. The scent seems to be reactivated by arm movement. I don't know how this works, but I'm guessing it has to do with friction and how the product layers on to your body such that you "scrape" off some of it when you're active. If you've frequently found yourself with body odor issues during or after exercise, this can be a very good thing. My main problem is that I'm not a fan of the strong scent. It's just a bit overbearing for my tastes. There are other similar deodorants in this series (the "Cool Rush" version smells better to me) which I'd go for. That being said, at $7 a stick (the current price), this is also pretty pricey and I'd need to really be worried aobut workout-induced odor to put out that sort of cash on a single stick.

soft, comfortable, and effective for eye comfort I was interested in using this as a cool eye pillow to help deal with swelling and irritation around my face and eyes due to allergies. I followed the instructions on the package, put the mask in a plastic bag, and placed it in the freezer overnight. The pillows exterior is super soft and comfortable even on sensitive skin (I'm 51 and my skin is thin and quite sensitive). The interior is flexible without being too bumpy so it lies smoothly and without too much weight on your face. Mine stayed cold for quite a long time, though it does help to flip it over to the cooler side after awhile.

The lavender scent at first is quite strong, but it doesn't tend to dissipate very far. My husband is sensitive to floral scents and I asked him if he could smell it from across the room and he could not. If you want it to not smell so strongly, you can store it outside of a plastic bag. If you want it to retain more scent, then you can store it in a plastic bag.

Note: I was provided with a sample of this product in order to assess it.

very vigorous at exfoliating This is a medium-sized mitt with a layer of very rough, but strong fabric on both sides and an elastic band at the wrist to help it stay on. The fabric is held together by solid stitching which was flawless on my mitt. It is super strong despite being thin. The fabric is rather surprisingly rough when you rub it against your skin. It's like sandpaper that does not do any damage. It leaves your skin feeling smoother and cleaner after use because it so vigorously rubs off outer dead skin cells. If you have thin or super sensitive skin, I'm not sure how this would feel. I'm the sort of person who scratches hard, so I loved this. It felt effective and it felt invigorating. The type of rough stimulation likely stimulates blood vessels close to the surface of the skin. I wouldn't be surprised if it had positive effects in terms of cleaning through increased blood flow.

The only point about this which I was not happy about was the inner seem around the elastic band at the bottom (see photo). The interior is stitched well, but it is also sealed at the edges with what seems to be melted plastic. Mine had sharp edges that I had to trim off with scissors in order to stop it from digging into my wrists uncomfortably. This ragged edge should be more refined. Though cutting it off isn't difficult, I'm concerned that cutting off too much will result in fraying the elastic resulting it in eventually unraveling so one must trim lightly and carefully.

Note: I received a free sample of this product for my assessment.

pretty average across the board First of all, my hair is very long and I'm 56 so it is aging. It has gotten coarser, dryer, and duller as I've gotten older so what I need from a conditioner may be different than someone with a different type of hair. I found that this conditioner took about three days of use before it actually made my hair start to feel soft, but even after some time, it wasn't as soft as some other conditioners can make it. On the bright side, comb out was easier with this than some other conditioners. It also didn't weigh my hair down or flatten out the natural waves. It left my hair bouncy and full of body. However, it also didn't do much for shine enhancement or split ends/repair as far as I could tell.

The scent on this conditioner is very herb-like (as you'd expect) and not especially strong which I prefer in a conditioner as I don't like the scent lingering in my hair. It is fairly thick and a smaller amount goes a long way. I think the claims about "hydrating" are sound, but my hair isn't super dry or brittle (though it is a bit dry), but there are other qualities (softening, shine enhancement) that I wasn't satisfied with.
it's so soft the picture look like is two different wig but is not is just close up and the hair is so soft, and it doesn't have a chemical smell either.

Comfortable Adjustable wig band that keeps the edges and baby hair laid; it is very soft and comfortable; it has high-quality velcro that adjusts and is 100% ultra-fine polyester fiber, breathable with a wide band, and fits most heads.

hair mask Naturally formulated for deep conditioning and hair thickening. It penetrates deep into roots and coats it with silk protein to strengthen and leaving hair with soft, tangle-free and glowing hair.

sharp! I have been cutting my kids' hair for years.  After trying these shears, I immediately threw away my old ones.  They are a lot sharper.  I haven't tired the thinning shears yet.  This is certainly a good value.

Decent selection This set has a decent selection of colors. I could stand to have fewer grays myself. I am new to gel colors. After a few YouTube videos, and his was an easy experience. My nails do look better than traditional polish, and it lasts longer. It was hard to get off, but that was probably more about my inexperience.

Worth it to an extent Got these to try out and see if they really did solve the spot acne that pops up. I don’t have terrible acne, but I do get those ones that pop up from time to time, and these did seem to help some rather quickly. I tried them first in the morning, trying to see if I really could do my makeup over them, I had two on my face, one lower chin and the other lower cheek, and the short answer is NO. They are clear, but they are definitely a plastic type film on the outside and makeup was NOT going on them, and covering them without everyone immediately noticing them! So quickly I took them off, and opted to try them at night. I did use them at night, a little skeptical to say the least, but they actually really did reduce the size of the blemishes dramatically by the time I woke up the next day! I don’t know how they truly work, but one blemish was a rather deep one and it really took it down! I was impressed, and you get so many of these I feel like they will last a long time for a rather cheap price!

Great lashes! This set of 4 pairs of lashes are exactly as advertised! These are actually great quality, and they are a flexible band and super easy to put on which is what I’ve been look for! Some of the bands are SO stiff that it makes it really difficult to put on and actually KEEP on, and these are the total opposite! They stay on all day with no problems, and the special tweezers are SO helpful and make it even easier to put them on! They are lashes that you can reuse multiple times without problem, and definitely still give you a noticeable look without being over the top. Highly recommend these!

Nice Gift Set for Price This gift basket of 18 moisturizing bath bombs is a great deal for the price of $21.99. I have to admit though that I got these for myself. But I would have no problem giving these as a gift.

These bath bombs are a bit smaller, 2.5 oz, than the 4 - 4.5 oz bath bombs I usually get because of my tub size. But there are 18 of them and they handled the amount of water in my tub just fine. With these types of gift baskets you often have the product just on the top layer and the rest is filling. There are two layers of bombs in this basket.

The gift basket didn’t have any broken or loose parts in the weave. The fabric lace accent is well done. There is a gift card attached with the message on one side and lines to write your personalized message on the other. The only issue I had with this is it was glued to the top. I had to remove it carefully so I wouldn’t tear the card or cellophane wrapping. Then the card wouldn’t just stick back on. I’d prefer the card to arrive not attached, but I suppose they do this to make sure it arrives with the bath bombs since there isn’t a box.

The bombs themselves are individually shrink wrapped to protect them and each are labeled with a tasteful sticker for the scent. They fizzed well in the water and gave a nice color to the water. The scents are really nice and lasted throughout my entire bath. I could definitely feel the oils during my bath, but they didn’t leave a lot of residue in the tub or make it slick getting out.

I’ve had these sitting on my bathroom countertop for several days, and everytime I walk into the bathroom it smells wonderful. It’s like having potpourri out. This was an unexpected surprise. I’ll also most likely reuse the basket once I’m done with the bath bombs.

This is a nice gift set for under $25 or a treat for yourself. I’ve been very pleased with these.

Most Of The Effort Was Put Into The Packaging The Sleep Welle Natural Calming Tea by WelleCo put a lot of effort into the presentation to reflect a high end product. The price also reflects that at $68.50 for 50 tea bags. The packaging was nice, but I didn’t think it was THAT nice. The canister is unique, but I expected something heavier and more substantial for the price.

The flavor of the tea is nice, but doesn’t seem anything particularly special. I’m having to use two tea bags for an 8 oz. cup for it to be strong enough to really taste. I had some sweetener and it is a pleasant cup of tea. I don’t feel like it helps me sleep, but I make it the afternoons for a relaxing break. But having to use two tea bags makes the pricing even more ridiculous, since I will only get 25 cups of tea from it (not even a whole month’s worth at 1 cup/day).

A word of advice: don’t give up on it when you open the container and smell it. It smelled not so pleasant to me. But I was game, and still gave it a try. It definitely smells a whole lot better than it smells! It also smells much better once it’s brewed.

Honestly, I can’t find anything to justify the cost. It does taste nice brewing it with two bags. I’m just not living the lifestyle of spending over $100 for a month’s worth of tea.

works fantastic but pricey I mainly use this oil for conditioning my goatee and shaving my legs (I’m a cyclist) but I’ve also used it to moisturize really dry areas. The oil does a very good job of conditioning and softening my beard and preventing fly-aways. You need to use it consistently and it takes a little time for it to really take effect but I truly does work great. Your beard will be softer without looking oily. It’s also scent free which I strongly prefer. Another review said it has a lemon scent. I’m not getting that and typically I’m pretty sensitive to odors. If there’s a scent it’s very subtle. I also use this oil for leg shaving. It makes the shaving process faster and safer (little to no cuts or nicks). Oil is preferable to cream so you can see what you’re doing and where you’re shaving. It’s thick enough to not require much product but not so thick that your razor is instantly gummed up. I’ve also used Pacific Shaving Company oil (too thin) and Shave Secret oil (too thick). Since this is an oil, I don’t often use it for moisturizing but it’s very effective in that capacity particularly if you have a very dry and stubborn area. I’m giving this product 5 stars because it works great for all it’s intended uses but the reality is that I’m unsure how often I will purchase it due to it’s high price. I will have to wait and see how long a bottle lasts. So far a little bit goes a long way so it very well may end up being worth the high price.

rich I like the smell. It says it’s Neroli essential oil. I would simply describe it as a midl cologne-like scent. The moisturizer is rich, creamy and silky. I would not describe it as a light moisturizer although it’s also not as heavy as some. However, I reserve it for situations that call for a strong moisturizer. It absorbs well and I like the container.
unpleasant scent It seems like my skin doesn’t react well to this face wash. It made my skin tight and even burned a bit. I also really dislike the smell of it.

smells great I’m a fan of Disco’s moisturizer so I thought I’d give this a try. The application process is different but I like it. I wet my face and then apply the stick like you would deodorant. Then using my hands I massage it into my skin. It only creates a minor lather which is a complaint of mine. The final step is to rinse it off. I use a washcloth for that. The process is simple and not messy. I love the eucalyptus scent. It does a good job of cleansing without overly drying. That being said, this isn’t a particularly moisturizing cleanser. I’m fine with that though as I like to have a variety of face cleansers for different situations.

Great set...All you need in one bundle. Great gift for someone. I am a fan of MARLOW products...I have several others not included in this set and all are great. I'll break down each product briefly below.

BAG: Very nice, basic black but well padded and holds it's shape. I basic in shape but I higher quality then usual.

SOAP: Great balsam/fir scent. Excellent balance of exfoliation and suds. Leaves body invigorated, soft and smelling great!

SHAVE: Has a tea scent, hint of some sort of alcohol. Builds into a creamy texture, not much sud but decent coverage. Does it's job. Finishes with a clean scent.

FACE WASH: Nice balsam/fir scent to it. A little goes a long way! Very slick, seems to not penetrate but wash the exterior of skin. Takes some work to wash off. Finishes with a green tea scent and refreshed.

FACE MOISTURIZER: Has a tea/alcohol scent at first...Goes on smooth. Dries fairly quickly, leaving a sweet green tea scent. Leaves face feeling soft not oily.

POMADE: Great scent, more cologne like. Goes on easy, not too tacky or slick. Does a decent job.

LIP BALM: Awesome balm!!! At first I thought it was an odd addition to the set. But man I love this balm. Goes on with a hint of sweet tea. Not waxy, not glossy, just a perfect balance that keeps lips moisturized.

Nice product. Smooths nicely. Pretty straight forward. Come 2 to a sealed pouch. They are stacked in the pouch so they can be a little difficult to get apart and straightened out. No noticeable or standout scent to them. Apply smooth, nice that they have slits so you can shape it to your contour. They do a nice job refreshing and smoothing my eyes.

Thin but works well. Not crazy about the scent. The cream is fairly thin, with a pudding like consistency. Applies and spreads well. Leave a hydrated feel without an oily or shiny residual. Happy with it's performance, just not crazy about the scent. Smells earthy, like peat moss.

Amazing scent. Brings out the color in my skin. First, the scent is AMAZING...Sweet blood orange with a grapefruit bubble gum undertone, maybe even some jasmine and peppermint, something that awakens your olfactory. Its very strong but not overpowering. Truly one of the best things I've smelt.

APPLICATION: Goes on fairly oily and blends pretty well. Immediately brings color to my face, I have medium skin and it starts with an apricot redness but fades back to an awakened tone. I really enjoy that about this, I see others complain about this so maybe it's not best for fair skinned people?.

Once dry, I am left with a matte sheen that is well hydrated. You expect it to feel oily but it's more like a raw feel. A really nice balance of hydrated but not wet and definitely softer. I really enjoy this product as well as their others I've tried and will happily continue to use this as my nightly regiment.

Nice brush. Good fit for my 75lb bullies. [[VIDEOID:5d66b612355cbdece6627644534d9174]] The biggest downside to this cleaner is it's price. Price is subjective, but you don't feel like you are getting a $50 product. The logo is just a crappy sticker, it feels pretty thin, isn't very powerful and didn't come with a wall plug (only cord, not a huge deal but for the price...). There are similar ones for less.

Performance wish, I like it a lot. Coming from a manual one, this makes for much easier work to wrangle my dog an let this do the work. It is not very powerful but that is okay as it doesn't scare my dogs. This is a 4 star product but I feel I had to remove another star for it's price/value.

Thickened but dried out my beard. I would give it 2 stars but I actually like the (opposite) effect it had on my beard. It ended up drying out my beard but gave it a fuller effect. The conditioner itself is a thick lotion like consistency, very hard to squeeze out. Scent is a light spearmint that doesn't transfer to my beard well. Disappears after rinsing. End effect left my beard and face feeling dry and chapped, not what I want from a conditioner.

*update* Stopped working. **update** Unit stopped working after a few days. New (and tested) batteries placed in it and it won't power on. The second part, which is my original review stands true...However, I can not longer give a good rating to a product that lasted a couple days. Your results may vary.

Nice little dispenser. Good goldielocks size, not too big, not too small. Doesn't get in the way but doesn't get overlooked. Sanitary design and functions well.

Great investment protection. Price seems a bit high, but you are getting a very nice case that is a great fit for you high priced hair dryer...So the price is a bit relevant in that sense. Every item fit securely in it's place and the box has a nice hard shell to it. The hard shell is a medium strength...Sturdy, not floppy but not crush proof but does a great job of protection and would feel safe packing this in a suitcase for travel.

Nice set. Great gift. Nice set for the money. Packaged nicely to make for a great gift. Colors are on point and so far they are holding up will on my wife, who is a nurse and bangs her hands around all day.

Great for it's price! Really nice iron! 5 stars based off of it's value at a $35 price point. Is it a top of the line, 5 star iron? No...But for this price, it is an excellent value for an entry level device. The handle is very ergonomic with an on/off button with +/- temperature control. It heats up quick enough, giving you a temp readout on the LCD display. The iron itself is a little thin and somewhat cheaply painted but it functions nicely. The clasp opens and closes with ease but has good retention. My wife was unsure if she'd like one of these and she is very happy with it and it's results!

Good stuff. A bit cologne-y but not overpowering. Good stuff...The oil is on the mild/medium side, not to greasy or shiny, a good balance. Scent is very cologne like with a strong backbone of sweet lemon rind/lemonhead. It's in no way overpowering but has a fair presence. I find the scent enjoyable and the oil decent, I would prefer it a little more slick but this is a great happy medium and I can just go extra if need be.

LOVE this!!! So soft and soothing! It's like getting petted by my dog, haha. The bristles are so soft and smooth, they remind me of petting my dog. Works up a great lather, the bamboo is solid and heavy duty. Head size is a little on the small size but good enough to get the job done. You need this brush!

Look good. Need a lot of liner. My wife is pretty happy with these. Nice aesthetics, decent magnets...Trick is to find the right amount of liner, it requires a good amount for a strong cling but not a crazy amount.

Smells good, but not how I want to smell. The scent is very pleasant...Just, in my opinion, not the best scent for a beard serum (male). It smells very sweet, candy/sweet tarts, with a floral rose bouquet. Excuse the gender stereotyping but it's more feminine, even teenage. Reminds me of grade school and the roll on candy perfumes the girls would use.

I like the serum, it's more of an oil though. Fairly runny. Does a nice job on my skin and beard. I do like it and the scent I'm just embarrassed to smell that way in public.

Good if you like cologne. If you're a cologne guy, this is more for you...It's strong enough you probably don't have to wear cologne with it. Scent starts off as clean laundry, then comes a little cedar spice, ending with a sweet vanilla...Combined for what I personally wouldn't call "manly" but more of a "man who is trying to smell good"... Has a designer fragrance to it, a little body spray but a bit more classy.

Performance is okay. The balm is very fluffy ad soft like coconut butter. It doesn't tame as much as I like but softens and gives a nice glow.

Overall I want to hate on this but just can't... I can see why some might hate the cologne smell, it's quite strong and different from the dozens of balms I've reviewed... BUT if you like wearing cologne, you'll love this. It's a bit high in price but hey, you'll be saving in cologne price.

Love the ergonomics. Tough to get a close shave though. This is a tough one to review...Works great on my neck and face but not so great on my bald head. The ergonomics are fantastic, it's a hefty metal body with nice curves. The blade nestles in the top groove with metal surrounding it...This makes for a difficult close shave from my bald head curves, I like to press down harder and get a close shave but the surrounding metal prevents that from happening. However, on my neck and cheeks, it does well, particularly with a dry shave.

The foam is nice but nothing special. Doesn't slick up great but has a nice scent. The holder is okay...Sturdy but holds the blade loosely. Also, as of now, I don't see where I can get replacement blades.

Good stuff. Classic patchouli scent. Not bad...Large size, pumps a thick tan cream. Fair amount of sud/foam. Pretty strong, classic, patchouli scent. Scent washes out a bit with the soap but leaves a nice, light amount behind. Does a good job at cleansing and softening.

Would never go back to regular razors... I've had my eye on this for awhile, and finally got it for Christmas. There were a few key reasons I wanted one. First, wet/dry shaving sounded great, especially dry without wasting water down the drain. Also, the cost of replacement razors for the venus and similar items is ridiculous, so I'd only change it when it got very dull. Plus, I hated throwing away the plastic and adding to the landfills. The reviews of this seemed promising, and I'm glad to say, I definitely agree!

The razor works really well dry shaving, and its so much easier then balancing precariously on one foot in a wet shower. Not too loud, once you get started you forget it's making any noise. According to the package, you need to replace the foils once a year and the razors in the machine every two years. Imagine the money I'll save! Especially if you go thru multiple 8 packs of venus razors a year. It doesn't get as close a shave as the regular razor, but thats not a big deal for me. I'll use this on a normal basis and get out the razor when I need the babysoft feel.

I'm a big fan, and will never go back to using traditional razors full time.

Sparkly and smooth I’ve never tried something particularly like this, though I have tried microdermabrasion with an at home machine. I have hormonal breakouts on my chin and some blackheads on and around my nose. I used a warm towel on my face for a few minutes to open up the pores.  I started on my nose and you wouldn’t believe the crap that came out. Yucky yellow goo. I used it on the lowest setting and that was a fair amount of suction. Maybe after some normal use I will move up to a higher speed but to start that worked really well. My skin felt a lot softer and smoother after use. I like the different heads that come with it. I tried a few of them and they were all very different, so they'll definitely come in handy. The pore cleaner is easy to hold with the silicone handle. Easy to charge and easy to clean! I’m a big fan. This will definitely become part of my regular routine after a nice warm shower.

Deeply hydrating I have previously used minzon snail cream and really like it. I was excited to get more snail-centric cream! As I get older(late 30s now) I have more dry skin issues. This is very creamy and dense. A deeply hydrating cream for sure. I use it at night before bed so it has time to sink it. It doesn't sink in fast, but that's fine with me. I love the citrus fragrance. Orange-y and fresh but not overpowering. The jar is heavy and expensive feeling, nice packaging overall. I like most of the ingredients a lot, though there are a few I don't love (dimethicone and butylene glycol) which is why It's 4 instead of 5 stars for me.

I love it! I use this after a shower and it sinks in within a minute which is great. An easy to use dropper and glass bottle which is my preference over any plastic containers. It has a thin gel like consistency and I didn't notice any scent. The two big ingredients besides the retinol are aloe and witch hazel which are very calming and good for the skin. It has Jojoba oil, which is a 2 on the comedogenic(pore clogging) scale. 0-1 is my goal since I can have hormonal breakouts on my chin, but so far, so good. Its super easy to use because it doesn't sit on top of the skin, you can continue with your other skin care like moisturizers or oils because it absorbs so nicely!

Happiness all around. I tried curology but found it really harsh and didn't like the things I read about the company. I also didn't like that it's difficult to cancel and sometimes they just ship and say whoops sorry we already sent your new supply. I didn't have the time or patience to talk to some derm at curology and keep using myself as a guinea pig for their adjustments to the custom product. Anyway.... I've always found zinc helpful for my skin and niacinamide was in one of my curology products so I thought, hey for like 7 bucks, lets try The Ordinary. After using this morning and night for a few weeks, I'm like WHOA. I'm in my late 30's, have had hormonal breakouts for like 2 decades, recently stopped taking birth control and my chin/jawline has been going hormonally bananas. A few cystic and white heads galore. To be honest, nothing upsets me like a bad blemish. It makes me want to wear a mask like phantom of the opera. Super self conscious about it. Since using the Ordinary my chin area has calmed down, is a lot less irritated and red. The spots that seemed ready to go have diminished and lessened. This product is so simple, gentle yet quite effective. I was tired of all the acne things that dry the crap out of my face. I'll definitely keep this in my skincare forever. I love it, I love the price. I'd pay many more dollars to keep my skin clear but I am really super into the affordability. Happiness all around.

Works very well! I find soaking my nails with clips and cotton in acetone both tedious and laborious. It’s the only thing I absolutely detest about gel polish. This is the second steam gel remover machine that I have used. This one feels like it’s more substantial and well-built than the other one(steam off brand). Comes with 2 plastic acetone dishes and 4 additional finger hole sheets. I like that it has a click on/off button versus the push button which was the reason I returned the last one(Plus it only powered on 20% of the time).

I use my electric nail drill to take off the top coat and wear down the polish a bit. It gives the steam somewhere to penetrate. If you skip this step, it won't be effective. Also, make sure to use 100% acetone. With the right steps, it takes off my gel polish (even with glitter) in 10 minutes. Depending on the brand and how many layers of polish, it usually takes 10-15 minutes to get the polish to curl up and then with a steel tool, the polish easily pushes off.

The timer on this one seems to turn off after five minutes but I didn’t really mind that, you just click it off and turn it back on to continue. This one isn’t as comfortable to rest your fingers in as the other one, but as long as it gets the gel polish off easily I’m willing to deal with it. After 2+ months of use, I’m happy with this! So much easier, faster and kinder to your nails.

Fantastic I've tried a lot of different under eye patches. These are super awesome! The packaging is really nice, the lid looks like there's drops of water on it. I thought maybe something leaked but...nope. Fake water droplets that looks really cool. They don't slide down, even when I'm going about my business in the house. They stick really well. They come with a nice little set of tweezers so you can pull out each individual patch. No fragrance which is great. I leave them on for 10-15 minutes as the instructions say. I give it a few minutes after removal and the rest of the serum sinks in nicely, it doesn't just sit on top of my skin. My skin feels soft and hydrated under the eye. They're fantastic!

Nice! This works great! Gives a nice matte finish for those who don't want the super shine. Definitely has a strong hold, stays through the day, including sports and activities. Smells really good. A great styling wax.

Nice hold First impression is that the smell is mainly eucalyptus based, but not too strong. The texture out of the can is at first very creamy, which I thought may affect the holding power, but once I worked in a couple of fingertip sized scoops into my hair, I found that the pomade started to take hold and firm up. My hair held its shape throughout the day and was easy to fix with a comb if needed. When washing it out, despite containing oils and wax, regular shampoo seemed to do the trick. Little to no residue leftover in my hair after a shower.

Fun! I used the first inception of bubble masks which was a clay cream like texture in a jar. That jar dried up and stopped working. These are so much better! Upon opening, it seemed very saturated so there's no lack of bubbles. Easier to apply, bubbles up and has a nice cooling tingle bubbly sensation. Fit well and adhered nicely, didn't drift at all. I didn't detect any strong fragrance, maybe a light herbally mint - though it does have parfum on the ingredients. That works for me as I don't like strongly scented products. My skin looked calm and felt hydrated afterwards. A great bubble mask!

love!! I sometimes get eye pain from an autoimmune disease. These help me relax and it relieves some of the tension I feel in my eyes. Having something on your eyes also forces you to step away from the screens and just zone out. Sometimes I use the heat eye mask and put on a meditation. It's an awesome way to reboot. I love that I can throw one in my overnight bag when I'm away from home so I can use it to de-stress. Soothing scent as well. I'd get these again!

Perfect for my needs I use headbands often to keep my hair out of my face when I'm working, doing yard work, hiking etc. I just don't like fussing with my hair too much if I don't have to. These are really comfortable, not too tight. They don't slip off either which is great.  You can double it to make it a thinner band. Cute patterns and super soft material that isn't too heavy. Especially in the summer, the lighter the fabric, the better. I have cotton ones, but I like the softness and light feeling of these better. I'd get more!

nope. I thought this would be a nice moisturizer to use before makeup to make sure my skin is hydrated. I like the tube dispenser, but beyond that, It's awful. It was sticky, never really sunk in and this pink stuff just settled into my fine lines. It said it's suppose to smooth them, not settle in and exacerbate them. I had to wash it off before I put any makeup on. If you're not fair enough this would give you a weird white pinkish cast like sunscreen.

Works so well! I work with my hands and often they're dry and sad. Don't forget the extra hand washing lately, so I definitely needed some help. This stuff is great!  I use it in the evening sometimes with beauty gloves to really let it sink in while I sleep. I do occasionally use it during the day as well. Sinks in fast, it doesn't stop me from doing my work. Feels like it creates a nice barrier to hold in moisture but isn't sticky or tacky. No fragrance which is my preference. A nice price point as well.

Great set! This is an awesome set for a newbie to polygel! I've never done polygel before and was curious if I'd like it better than the traditional tips. I don't love those because of the glue and thickness of them and this is the perfect solution to get length without the thickness. Polygel is easy to work with because it doesn't harden until you cure it, so you can make sure it's just how you like it. It's easy to use the dual forms included with the set. Comes with some cute colors, base and top coat a few nail art things to experiment with and the little uv light. The gel polish colors have great opacity with 2 coats. Really, this is just about everything you need(just grab some rubbing alcohol and acetone) to give it a shot! And, super bonus of the carrying case to organize! A fantastic price for what you receive.

Velvety finish, amazing formula I am super picky about formulas and colors for lipsticks. I'm on a forever quest for my perfect red - my number one favorite so far is cruella by nars. This is a tight second! It's a much different shade then cruella, so it brings a totally different vibe. It's a beautiful true red falling slightly warmer than cool toned. The formula is amazing. I like that it has a matte finish but it's not a matte that sucks the life and moisture out of your lips. It feels very comfortable, not like a heavy lipstick. You can easily get an undone faded look, like you're not trying too hard(compared to going all out with lip liner etc). I love the way it wears too, it doesn't just disappear in certain spots. Great staying power overall. I'd rank this with more expensive beauty brands, it's an amazing formula. I've got my sights set on the color wine stain next!

Nope The premise of these made sense but the execution is lacking. My hair is just a bit beyond shoulder length so I got some hair left out at the bottom that looked nuts after I removed these. They coil up into itself in a roll, so you don't really get a falling curl. More like a jacked up Annie. The silicone at the top and the bottom ripped out my hair when I was trying to remove them. They're too time consuming for me, I'd rather use my curling iron and get the curl I'm expecting vs. these which may leave you with some nutty looking curls.

3 and 1/2 stars: a basic lip balm I've tried a few other products by Hudson and James so I was intrigued by this. I've made a lot of beauty products at home so I'm very familiar with the ingredients. Going into the winter in New England, I need some good lip balms. This feels nice on the lips. Has a very mild orange scent, but nothing artificial. Not sticky at all and I like that it's in a glass jar. I was surprised by the term "cloud" in the name since this was hard and dense. Depending on the temperatures of your climate, both cocoa and shea harden up quite a lot but will melt at certain higher temperatures. Shea butter is easy to whip but this seems like it was just melted down and poured. I thought it would be more fluffy. I like that the ingredients are organic and fair trade but I still can't seem to justify the cost.  Shea butter, sweet orange essential oil and cocoa seed butter are some of the most affordable oils and butter so twenty bucks for this seems very high. I'll use it up but it's not a stand out product for me.

Love! I got this for multiple uses. I can put it on the back of my neck or temples for headaches. I can roll it on my face for depuffing with some facial oil. It's chilly but feels really nice. I would use something smaller for the under eye area but it does the rest of my face nicely.  I thought the material of the roller would be more of a soft, squishy texture but its not. Thats fine, just a little outside of what I imagined. It would also work well on a burn or sore muscles. Its easiy to wash and rinse clean before putting it right back in the freezer. Overall, I think this is an awesome thing to keep in the freezer!

Deep and sexy I really like the idea of these scent wipes, you can throw one in your bag for on the go fragrance. I never understand when people carry around an entire bottle of perfume, seems too heavy and what if your expensive scent leaks? These are the perfect solution. After opening, I left it and reused it again the next day. Put a few drops of water on it cause it had dried and dabbed on my wrist. Still smells delicious.

I'm a total perfume junkie and I really like Gilded Fox. It reminds me a bit of Elizabeth and James Nirvana Black. It has a deep, sexy scent with notes of amber and vanilla-y caramel. Warm and alluring for sure. Not really a floral for me, which is great because I don't like flowery smells. I don't mind some hints of jasmine or rose but overall I like warm, woodsy scents. I'd definitely check out some of their other offerings.

A nice set to use before makeup application l really like this set! The size is perfect to try something new without buying them individually and obviously, they're great for travel. The entire set is meant to be used together before makeup application for a good base. I like them all but particularly enjoyed the prime essence and priming water. They both feel very light, sometimes I use them without the primer. As for the primer in particular, it's heavy on dimethicone which is something I usually try to avoid in my primers. While it leaves a silky feeling, I just am not a fan. I think it's just a cheap filler that a lot of products rely heavily on. I feel like my skin can't breathe when there's silicone primers on it. But that is just personal preference. I will use it on occasion when doing a full face. Overall I think this is a nice set so I'm happy I tried it.
They work great! These are really nice, substantial bobby pins. They're not thin, so they have good holding power. I really like the mix pack of colors. These will last me a long time!

Pretty nice I just turned 40 (ouch.) so I thought this would be a nice addition to my skincare. It looked interesting with the "magic wand' roller ball applicator. It does help with my under eye puffiness and goes on smoothly. I don't really notice any particular plumping, brightening or difference in my fine lines. I think the roller ball is a bit gimmick-y, but its not bad. Is it worth the price tag? Questionable. It is relaxing but I can use any eye cream with other beauty tools. My favorite item to use with cream is a vibrating metal rod tool that feels nice and cool and does a better job at depuffing. The goal is to drain your lymphatic system...water retention in the face is real.

I expected more organic ingredients, but there are only 3 marked organic. I included the ingredient list below since I didn't see it here on amazon. I've using it daily for almost 2 weeks in the morning and evening, but it pills a bit so it doesn't work well under makeup. I'll keep it for evening use. I like it and I will continue to use it. I don't think it's revolutionary but it's pleasant and easy to use.

Water (Aqua), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil (1), Capryloyl Glycerin/Sebacic Acid Copolymer, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (1), Diheptyl Succinate, Brassica Alcohol, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil (1), Coconut Alkanes, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Citrus Aurantifolia (Lime) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Peel Oil, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Peel Oil, Eugenia Caryophyllus (Clove) Leaf Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Salvia Sclarea (Clary) Oil, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Chlorella Pyrenoidosa Extract, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Citrus Limon (Lemon) Fruit Extract, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Lactobacillus Ferment, Lactobacillus Ferment Lysate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Punica Granatum Extract, Saccharomyces/Copper Ferment, Saccharomyces/Iron Ferment, Saccharomyces/Magnesium Ferment, Saccharomyces/Silicon Ferment, Saccharomyces/Zinc Ferment, Undaria Pinnatifida Cell Culture Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate, Caffeine, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Glucoside, Citric Acid, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Sclerotium Gum, Sodium Phytate, Squalane, Alcohol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Citral, Citronellol, Eugenol, Limonene, Linalool, Sodium Copper Chlorophyllin - (1) Certified Organic Ingredient

cute! I've tried a few other stamping plates and I think there is a learning curve. Some trial and error but once you get the hang of it, these are fun! Comes with the same tools I've had in other sets, all the things you need to use them. A nice assortable of plates with winter and st. patricks day themes. I like the one with all the dots and different shapes. A nice set at a good price point.

Buttery I've never used anything by Pippa of London so I was curious to try this. It goes on buttery smooth with no tugging which is lovely. It's easily blended out with a makeup brush. I like this particular color with my blue/green eyes. I'm not super impressed by the staying power. I applied it around 3 and by 9 there wasn't much left. I'm not an eye rubber so I was bummed to see how much it faded. I don't think I'd get more but I'll use this one, maybe with the addition of another color by a different brand.

So many options! I've never tried this brand before so I was curious to get to testing. Before using on my nails, I did some testers to see the outcome. The confetti ones I did on a white gel color base, one of the glittery ones I did on black. I love the grey with the subtle glitter in it. Everything applied smoothly with no lumps, except for one (not pictured in the testers, but the top left in the company's photos). That one was a bit odd but maybe for someone with more finesse and skill. This set comes with base, top and matte top coat. The glittery ones have good pigment to them, you don't need any color base to make them pop. In my photo, I only did one coat. I was pleasantly surprised by the outcome. I do my own and some friends' nails on a regular basis. They're super excited to do the green for St Patrick's day and the confetti ones for Easter. This is such a great set, with so many options, I'm very happy!

So hydrating New England winters have my skin feeling parched. especially as I get older(40 at the moment). This Murad cream is more dense than I expected, but not in a bad way. Goes on smoothly and keeps my skin feeling hydrated. A little bit does a great job so this will last a while. My only hang up with some Murad products is the fragrance they use sometimes. Thankfully there is no added fragrance in this cream so I'm very happy. There's a light scent to it but nothing overbearing. No irritations or issues. Recommended for sure if it's in your budget!

Foams nicely This is a Japanese face wash product.  I do wish the ingredients were listed in English.  The lather is good, leaves face feeling fresh, and the citrus scent is nice.  I feel like the price is a bit more than I'd spend though.

Working okay so far, doesn’t lather much So far, I am liking this shampoo and body wash. I have a lot of trouble with allergies and need shampoos and other products that have no perfume or fragrance added. I like that this is all natural. So far, I don’t seem to be having any allergic reaction to it and it works well. The only thing I don’t like about it so far is that it doesn’t lather very well. That’s just kinda weird for me, as I’m so used to judging products as working better when they lather up. But, as I said, it does seem to work. So far, pleased with this shampoo, even though I wish it would lather up and foam.

Let Amazon donate to your favorite charity! Use Amazon Smile (smile.amazon.com) when you order and Amazon will donate to the charity of your choice when you make a qualifying purchase. Check out how Amazon Smile works at https://smile.amazon.com/gp/chpf/about/ref=smi_se_rspo_laas_aas. My shopping is donating to my favorite charity, Canines for Independence at no cost to me. Awesome!
Nice and sharp Great nail clippers which are very sharp. Quite a contrast to some others that we've ordered. Very pleased with how sharp these are and how cleanly they clip nails.
AMAZING Absolutely love these lashes! Super natural and light, easy to apply and wear! Love the variety of all the styles and how lightweight they are!

this stuff is AWESOME for lashes this stuff hasn't done as much for my eyebrows as i'd hoped it would, but my EYELASHES! my goodness! my eyelashes look much thicker and longer than they were before. this stuff is AWESOME for lashes, good for brows if you don't have huge bald patches within your brows the way i do (i noticed the areas where i have brow hair have thickened up a bit, but my bald areas are still bald lol)

Reduced Puffiness and Wrinkles I have to admit, it was the snail mucus secretion extract that drew my attention. I don't know if it is the snail extract or the other ingredients but it is working for me - reduced puffiness under my eyes and fewer wrinkles.

It goes on thick and take a long time to absorb. I'm not sure I'd have it on while sleeping, since I roll around a lot and my pillow would get creamed. Fortunately, I'm 'retired' and sit in front of my computer for at least 5 hours a day. I'm all alone, so it's a good time to wear the goop.

I'd like it even better if they could reduce the light fragrance even more. There does not appear to be any added fragrance. Instead it comes naturally from the ingredients used. Better than the reverse.

I'll Change Brushes More Often These are so much less expensive than OEM that I'm sure it will lead me to change brushes more often... and that is important.

They snap firmly in place and perform fine. Bristles are about the right level of soft. I did have one bristle fall out, but the can happen with Oral-B bushes as well. The one thing I miss is that I have been buying Oral-B bushes that also have a few rubber type scrubbers among the bristles. I like that combination.

Great tooth brush with a nice carrying case that makes traveling easy. It's a little pricey, as the cost for electronic toothbrushes has gone way down as of late, but this is a great tooth brush with many different brushing modes and makes your teeth really clean. This is definitely up on the higher end, so it makes the price tag more reasonable, though.

dissolves my makeup, smells and feels nice I use this in the shower to dissolve my makeup. I used to go through an extra step where I used make up remover wipes to remove it before getting in the shower at night. Now I can eliminate that step and just use this in the shower. It quickly removes make up, even my mascara (I don't use waterproof mascara, so I can't speak to that). The liquid is thin, colorless, and has a very light scent. It's almost like water. No residue is left.

Oz Naturals makes great products. Oz Naturals is a favorite go-to of mine for beauty products. I have tried many of their moisturizers, serums, and facial cleansers and am never disappointed.

This is a one ounce glass bottle, pump action. Clear serum.

Though I can't know what it does on a cellular level, really, I do know that using Oz products (along with other good skin care products and eating healthfully, along with exercise and good sleep, and genes - really, the stuff we put on our faces is only a part of good skin care) keeps my skin looking good. Many people can't tell my age, and that means I'm doing something right. So since Oz Naturals is also reasonably priced (under $18 at time of this reveiw), I feel good about purchasing it.

What I wish is that it were easier to pump - it kind of jets out so it's more difficult to control how much you want.

This is not a "luxe feel" type of serum, so be aware of that. It feels more dry (though not drying to your skin-there's just no sits-on-top-of-skin thicker feel that some serums have) after you put it on rather than with that emollient feeling some serums have. That's probably also because of the hydraulic acid quality in it. It's a serum blend of hydraulic acid, vitamin E, retinol, and other ingredients.

I use this at night, applying it to my cleansed face. I wait a few minutes and then I apply my moisturizer.

Love their product; love their company.

Okay but nothing special. A plastic jar full of lavender-colored and -scented bath salts. (Apparently some of my Pre De Provence products are showing up in one review - so while this reveiw is for bath salts, I have the lavender lotion as well, which I do love the scent of it but as with the bath salts, wish the bottle were nicer).

There was no seal on the top of the jar, just the lid. That's fine, but I would wonder how long it would sit on a shelf before purchasing and how "fresh" the scent would last. That said, when I opened the lid and took a whiff, it was pretty powerfully scented. I like the lavender aspect but there's another scent there that I don't like and can't figure out what it is. It's off-putting. It doesn't linger in the water, so that's good.

I sprinkled some in my bathroom sink that I'd filled with warm water. The water turned a slight lavender shade as the bath salts turned clear. The salt crystals did melt pretty quickly, though as with any bath salts I've used there are always a few that are stubborn.

The water felt soft enough, I suppose-nothing really special, but that strong scent wasn't as apparent in the diluted water.

I did think it a bit pricey at just under $17 (at time of this review). For that price, I'd like a glass bottle or something prettier in the jar design itself, though the lavender-colored crystals do look pretty. Still, there are plenty of bath salts out there that are half the price and smell about the same, so what would make me want to purchase this one exclusively? Something that made it attractive to me, and that would be a pretty bottle/jar that I could display in my bathroom in my basket of bath goodies. Or, to give someone as a gift.

This plastic jar makes it seem like one of those cheaper jars of bath salts you can buy at Big Lots, which I can do for less than half the price if I want bath salts. Pretty it up some so I feel I'm getting my money's worth. You cold say Pre De Provence has quality ingredients and maybe that's why the price, but I'm not finding it special enough to pay almost $17.

A different approach to my skincare When I first looked at this Phytema Anti-Aging Hydrating Serum, I thought it looked so weird for a serum, and then, when I put a little on my skin, I wasn’t so sure I was going to like it at all. My first reaction was that I didn’t want to use it. Not only did it feel a little thick and sticky, there were those micro-beads in there that felt strange for a serum. I honestly thought, at first, that maybe I’d received a facial wash with scrubbing beads, but when I added water to it, it didn’t lather or foam.

I looked up the product online and found the French company who makes this serum and other beauty products. I was a little reassured so I decided to give it another try.

I applied a little of the serum on the back of my right hand. What amazed me is that once it sinked into my skin, the skin of my right hand took on a glow. I’m a skeptic when it comes to beauty products—the claims companies make don’t often pan out or are exaggerated—but I could see it, and still do, that glow/illumination on my right hand versus my left hand, and over 30 minutes later it is still there. I love that glowing aspect of it.

As for softness, I really don’t see any difference from this product and others but that doesn’t bother me. What I am interested in is how it is illuminating my skin as advertised. As for what other claims the company says the serum does, that’s a little more difficult to determine except with continued use over time, but if I like how a serum feels and if it gives my skin that glow, then I’m happy enough to try it and see what happens.

There is no irritation to my skin, no burning, itching, redness.

The beads do soften onto the skin as you apply it. Here’s what the company says about how to apply (which is kind of a weird different way to apply it-I still want to do the circular thing!): ‘Apply with the flat of the hand, without making circular motions, but starting from the middle of the face towards the outside of the face, to explode the jojoba micro-beads and to release the vitamins E and C on your skin.’

It is a little difficult to apply a serum onto your face with the flat of your hand, but I did try patting it with my fingers and that worked better.

It will feel sticky when you first apply it, and you can feel those beads. However, the stickiness goes away and the beads do melt onto your skin.

The price isn’t shown on Amazon. I looked up the price on the company’s website and it’s $49.90 Francs (I am assuming it’s Francs), and that’s only about $8 in American dollars. So I don’t know what the final price will be here on Amazon or how they’ll do that. I’d pay a decent price for this serum just for that glow.

It is advertised to be partially organic and mostly natural. The company’s advert reads: ‘99.85% natural ingredients of which 28.79% organic. Phytema ™ Skincare Radiance Serum is an ultra-concentrated anti-aging, anti-radical & anti-stain active ingredient. All the effectiveness of white mulberry, cucumber and bearberry, to prevent and fade pigment spots. Natural smoothing agents provide an immediate tightening effect to your face. No phenoxyethanol, no silicone, no paraben.’

I’m willing to give this serum a try, and this company I’ve not heard of, Phytema, a try.

Lovely scent. This is a LOT of shampoo and conditioner—two huge bottles of each for a total of four bottles—so if you like them, then you’ll be happy. I put one of each down in the guest room.

What I like the best about this shampoo is the scent. Really pleasant, and for me, not too strong. It’s a lovely scent that’s not too coconutty. The scent of it would have me use it just to have my hair smell great.

As for what it does and how it works: I don’t find this shampoo to be any better than many shampoos I use—I have my favorites that I regularly use that work well with my hair. This Tresemme Botanique shampoo and conditioner didn’t weight down my super baby fine hair, so that was great. My hair was shiny afterwards, so that was great as well.

It’s a good shampoo with a nice scent that cleansed and conditioned my hair decently.

One thing I wish—since the bottles are so big, a pump dispenser would have been so much easier to use. I think I will pour some of each into a smaller bottle with a pump dispenser and put the bigger bottles in the cabinet. They really are way too big to sit in my shower/tub area. It’s kind of like they are for refillable bottles.

If you like the Tresemme brand, then you’ll be happy with this shampoo and conditioner. The price is reasonable for how much you are receiving, the scent is lovely, and it does a decent job of cleansing your hair (there are an awful lot of suds lathering, so I don’t know if that’s good or bad).

Took off black nail polish in one wipe! This is a huge bottle of Mountain Falls nail polish remover (16oz). At $5.99, I don’t find that unreasonable as this bottle will likely last me years. Though I only polish my toenails and not my fingernails so I don’t use as much as those who regularly polish their fingernails along with their toenails.

The scent isn’t overwhelming and that’s a plus. None of them are going to smell good—wouldn’t that be nice, to have a nail polish remover that smelled spiced or like your favorite body lotion or body spray!

What surprised me the most is how effectively it removed some black nail polish I had on my toes that I’d done for Halloween. I’d done my fingers too and the generic polish I had took a few more swipes and wipes than this Mountain Falls. The MFalls took it off in one wipe! So, it’ll be replacing the other generic I had - bye-bye!

What would also be really cool along with nail polish that smelled good is if the top of the applicators were smaller so you could squeeze out or pour out a little less—I often drench my tissue or cotton ball.

All in all, this is a good generic/Amazon brand product. I’d recommend it if you use a lot of polish remover. A big 16 ounces will last a good while. For me, this bottle is a little too large, but it’ll sure last me a long long time.

A nice little starter, or travel, set For Christmas I’d bought my guy the Rugged & Dapper candle that smelled like a walk in the forest in the winter! I wanted to keep it for myself, it smelled so good. He loves it.

So, I ordered this travel-sized set for him to try. He’s a kind of wash-and-go guy but I this set will be a nice set for him to try out something new.

Do note these bottles are small—they are travel-sized; think travel or sample sized. They won’t last long. This is a starter set or something you do take to travel with.

There is a shampoo/body wash, a facial scrub, facial moisturizer, and a lip balm.

The shampoo and body wash has almost the same type of scent as the candle—not as spruce tree forward but it does have a pine-y woodsy scent. I see other reviews compare it to floor cleaner but I like the scent—the reason people may think that is the pine scent may remind some of some types of floor cleaner, but for me it is a fresh woodsy-pine-scent.

The facial scrub has tiny beads in it. The scent isn’t quite as apparent in the scrub as it is in the shampoo/body wash. It does have an exfoliating quality to it.

The moisturizer is unscented. It’s a light moisturizer. It’d be good for my guy in winter when our air is particularly dry.

I like the lip balm a lot. It’s very emollient and feels super good going on (I tried it!) It has a cool refreshing feel to it after you apply it. Really nice lip balm.

I think my bf will like this set a lot to try out using specialized skin care products instead of just using soap on his face and go.

Rugged & Dapper is a little on the pricy side for someone who’s doesn’t follow a skin-care regime so I don’t know that he’d purchase these items again; however, the price isn’t all that bad for someone who does regularly use specialty skin-care products.

He’ll enjoy this set, but if he does not like something, I’ll come back to report that here.

I hope my review helped you today.

Nice healthy glow to my skin This Serum by MERLOT is a thick white cream, though it is a serum and not a moisturizer (it will moisturizer your skin, however!).

Pump out just a little and apply to face, throat, chest, and then the rest can be rubbed into your hands.

The fruity scent at first I thought would interfere with my morning coffee—I usually use unscented before I have my coffee, but it didn’t overpower and it dissipates quickly.

This morning, I washed my face with a little Erno Laszlo cleansing oil as I usually do, patted dry, then applied a little of this Merlot serum. It feels amazing going on my skin and smooths on very well—there’s no dragging feeling or feeling as if I have to apply more for good coverage.

This feels and looks like a moisturizer rather than a clear serum, so you could use it alone, I suppose, but I apply it in the morning (it does read that it’s a sunrise serum!) and enjoy my coffee, letting it fully absorb into my skin, and then apply my moisturizer. It leaves no sticky or ‘tacky’ feeling.

I have sensitive skin with slight rocasea and this serum did not irritate my skin, cause any redness, stinging, or itching. It left my skin feeling soft, and there was a glow to my skin as well, not like a highlighter glow, but a healthy sheen to it, a clean skin healthy glow/sheen.

It has resveratrol, which is an antioxidant agent—in a plant, resveratrol ‘attacks’ bacteria or fungi that is attacking the plant, so the idea behind it in skincare is for resveratrol to ‘attack’ bad elements in our environment to keep our skin healthier.

I can’t comment on what it really is doing on a cellular level, and it’s difficult to determine what it will do for my skin over weeks, but when I try out serums to review (and I’ve tried out a LOT of them!), I go by: can I afford it: yes!; does it glide over my skin easily and nicely: yes!; is it emollient: yes! does my skin feel amazing afterwards: yes! does my skin immediately look better in any way: yes! Is it irritating my skin: no!

If you are looking for a serum that isn’t expensive—$22 at time of this review, which is as good a price or better than many L’oreal Serums you find in the drugstore—and want something that feels great going on, won’t upset your skin, and leaves a healthy glow, then this is one to try.

I hope my review helped you today.

Works better as a body mist because of the strong scent. (A thought: If you think of this as more of a body mist instead of a face mist, you may be happier with it. The strong perfumed scent is a little much to take sprayed directly on the face. However, when after toweling off from a shower, I sprayed this over my body, and even a little on my damp hair before blow-drying, with just a tiny spritz around my face, and it did much better—I smelled good and it’s not as strong as a regular perfume would be.)

I love facial mists. They soothe and calm my skin, and refresh my face, and my mood. I want to give this 4 stars because it seems to be a nice mist, but there are unknowns. I’m giving it 3 stars based on how I like the feel of it, and the scent, though strong, is nice but a bit much to spray in my face—

This Valjean face mist in Glow comes in a really nice heavy glass bottle—I like glass bottles because I can reuse them, or I can check to make sure they can be recycled, which is important to me. But reusing them by making my own face mist is nice—would be great if Valjean offered refillable options so once this bottle is emptied, I can put in more of the same product.

This mist feels amazingly refreshing. You’ll need to note that it has a pretty strong scent. And the scent is kind of a perfume scent; that was a surprise to me. I wasn’t sure I liked that at first, and still I have to be careful when I spritz it.

However, I like this scent. And though it can seem to be strong when I first spray it, it doesn’t overpower me or linger too long. If you spray it and it lands on your clothes, the scent will linger longer but it’s soft and I like the tones of the scent. But, again, on the face I have to be very careful.

There isn’t a lot of information about the company or the product on this Amazon page, which is puzzling, for I’d like to know a bit more about the product I’m putting on my face. I googled the company and couldn’t find much there either. Except for a dermatology site that indicated the same thing I did: why doesn’t this company list more about their products.

Am I just spritzing perfumed water on my face with a few minerals added? How much? What’s the perfume scent? They don’t even tell me what the scent is. However, on the back of the bottle is the list of ingredients and I suppose that helps. But I’d like more on this Amazon page, or that I can google.

To that end, I’ll continue to use the facial mist for times I need a boost in mood or I’m sweaty after a workout or it’s hot in the summer.

Not expensive for good product, when you break it down in its parts .... Then using a damp paper towel or washcloth, wet the tattoo, and then carefully peel off the backing paper. Let it sit a minute or so then wash gently with warm soapy water.

Quality: Large selection of designs and also placements (bracelets, necklaces, accent pieces etc.). This set has both unique designs and colors. These last several days depending on where you place them. For me, I found that the necklaces would last one day, but bracelets or pieces placed on my arms lasted 2-3+ days.

Effectiveness: The ones that have black backing or outlines/accents in black look the most realistic versus the single color gold/silver. Also, these will last longer if you clean the area of skin prior to application with rubbing alcohol.

Now I can do anything I like and that little Turbie Twist is going to stay put all by itself. That right there is enough to convince me to never be without one again.

It has an additional interesting feature. When comparing it with a regular bath towel, it dries the hair more evenly and prevents dry spots and wet spots when you take it off.
