Vague Label Ingredients, But Lathers Well, Smells Good I am pretty picky when it comes to my body washes. I like one that has good ingredients, and a great smell. When I saw the label for this saying Argan Oil, Coconut Oil and Tea Tree Oil, I knew it would be right up my alley. I love all 3 of those ingredients and they work well with my skin. I was excited to use this. When it arrived and I checked the ingredients label, I was shocked. Like so many other reviews, I don't see any of the above listed on the label. Some ingredients are very vague. Some of the ingredients I had never heard of before and had to look up. My suggestion to the company is to make the label a bit more descriptive and clearly put what is inside. What essences? What type of vegetable oils? Since it is so unclear, if you have easily irritated or sensitive skin I would stay away from this. The vague label makes it hard to use by anyone who may have allergies to certain things.

On the other hand, I will say that I do like the body wash. It smells fantastic, like a herbal scent. It lathers nicely and feels good on the skin. Doesn't dry my skin out.

If the label was changed and I knew exactly what was in this I would easily bump this up to a 5 star rating. But because I have no clue what is inside this, I have to bump it down.

*Please note that I was sent this product either complimentary or discounted in order to provide my honest experience, thoughts and review.

Good For Eyelash Newbies! I have struggled with applying fake lashes for YEARS! I could never get them on right, one would come out better than the other, my eye would almost get glued shut, you name it. I was very interested to see how these would work for the lash challenged person like myself.

I have become much better at applying eyeliner over the years, and I will suggest that if you do want to try these, that your eyeliner game be pretty good. The "eyeliner" pen is your glue with these. It comes out looking like eyeliner, a black color. You set the lashes on top of the eyeliner after a few seconds, and set them into place. These do come with a tool to help you apply your lashes, but I didn't find it to be all that helpful. My fingers and a pair of tweezers did the job. These did go on fairly easy. My first few times it did take a bit of fixing to get a better fit. Once into place, they seemed to dry really fast and stayed on very well.

For someone like me who is lash challenged, these went on easy. Does take a bit of practice, but a lot easier than dealing with regular glue, waiting for it to get tacky, and trying not to make a mess. These are much better and easier in my opinion.

Imported Luxury Soap The Way I Remember It! Traditionally, over 100 years ago, France was the capital for manufacturing fragrant soaps -- one French brand available up until recently was Le Chatelard Savon de Marseille, and that's been impossible to locate and purchase these past few months, at least in violet.  During my own girlhood, 30-40 years ago, Germany was the place the best "toilet soaps" came from, from the brands Puhl's and Verly, now no longer in existence.  By the 1990's, Portugal was the country manufacturing the best quality large luxury bars:  Claus Porto and Castelbel still available with some diligent searching here on Amazon and in specialty stores.  But it looks like Turkey is catching up with the fine soaps coming newly onto the market.  I'd recently bought another Turkish brand of violet soap I like very much, but this Olivos brand Violet surpasses all; a sweeter but still satisfactory crisp, rich scent and smooth creamy lather like the finest goat's milk products (it's olive oil formula).  Also this soap comes in gift boxes containing three round bars like the old imported Puhl's brand we used to buy in downtown Cleveland department stores, the soaps individually wrapped in violet-purple tissue paper just like Puhls, (and Verly's two-packs).  It really brings back the good old days of beautiful quality imported cosmetics.  I can't praise this product enough, especially for the nice reasonable price (we pay that much for one big hard-to-hold Portuguese bar which can cripple a person if dropped in the shower).  I hope I can keep finding this and Beauty-Ways, a superlative seller, will continue to make this brand available.

The Pretty Soap is Worth It I love Castelbel violet soap -- they offer at various times and places wild violet, spring violet, and violet blossom,in different pretty wrappings, so I buy whatever is available from sellers on Amazon or when it's (rarely) available at our local TJ Maxx. It's a nice big fat triple-milled quality bar, usually oval (the Spring Violet type is rectangular) which lasts both in the shower and on the bathroom sink, and Castebel adheres to genuine violet fragrance, not the hideously sweet vanilla additives so many other soap companies use.

Only drawback: if you can find any fragrance of Castelbel soap in the TJ Maxx and Marshall stores, it's a terrific bargain, $4.99 I think, but from any seller on line it's much more expensive, plus shipping cost. Just one of those things where the rarity of a favorite scent ups the price -- the Maxx and Marshall places tend to stock their shelves only, in fact exclusively, with rose, vanilla, and lavender fragranced soaps and lotions so one really has to shop on line if they happen to find such ubiquitous scents loathsome. If the brick and mortar stores boo-hoo about losing business, they deserve it, with their appallingly limited stock these days. Best to dish out more money and get what one wants from ordering on-line.

Helpful tips The color is beautiful (Sara)...I quit going to the nail salon because they would always nick my cuticles and the cost was too much. Now I am learning to do this at home with pretty great results. Some tips for learning newbies: 1. If at all possibly avoid getting the probase past your nail and into your cuticle...very difficult to remove powder from there. 2. After applying activator don't rush filing and shaping your nail...this is critical for your end result. 3. The finishing gel is thick and very sticky..avoid going outside the nail onto skin as it will not come off easily. 4. Plan for about an hour for the first couple of times doing your nails. 5. Get yourself a course file and a good buffer for the filing/shaping step.
That's it! I really enjoyed watching netflix and doing my nails at home for a fraction of the cost! Good luck and happy filing :)

Bargain priced, easy-to-use IPL hair removal The latest craze in hair removal is IPL: Intense Pulsed Light. Owing to improved light technology, hand held devices that can provide the requisite intensity light to perform IPL at home and at an affordable price are now available.

I've tried a number of these IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) devices for hair removal. Compared to the others I've tried, this one is bargain-priced, and seems to offer similar functionality. About the only thing you give up is a LCD counter of the number of flashes. Since this thing is rated to half a million flashes--more than enough for pretty much anyone's lifetime--an LCD counter of the number you've used is pretty pointless.

Operation is pretty trivial: You plug in the power supply, (the hair removal tool is NOT battery operated; you must have it plugged in), you choose the power level (five settings, chosen by rapidly pushing the power button)) and then you aim it at a body area with hair you'd like to remove. It is recommended that your body is freshly cleaned and that the hair be shaved before starting. You can choose either on-demand flashing (via the button on the side) or else continuous flashing when skin contacted is detected. Switching between the modes is accoplished by a long press of the button on the side.

The light is extremely powerful and could damage your eyes with continued direct exposure. Therefore, you should never look directly into the light and a cheap pair of folding protective eyeglasses are included in the box.

The light is triggered by a touch-sensitive metal area in the front of the device. Using very slow-motion photography, I was able to capture a snapshot of the light (see photos). But the light duration is extremely short.

You run the tool over the area where you want to remove hair, and make sure you exposure all the hair follicles in that region. You will not see any immediate results. The light signals your hair to stop growing, but it requires multiple treatments over several weeks before you will be expected to see results. Eventually, you should find a substantial reduction in the hair in the treated areas.

In the box, you get the tool, a power adapter, a cheap pair of sunglasses, and an inexpensive disposable shaver.

This device only offers one mode: Hair removal. Other IPL devices offer other modes (skin rejuvenation and acne treatment). Whether that's a loss depends on whether you believe those other modes really work anyhow. The jury is out.

One thing you don't get with this tool is any attachments that can make it easier to address certain body areas. Some IPL removal tools include these. The actual value of such tools is subject to debate and the fundamental functionality (which is a flash of high-intensity light) does not change.

On the whole, this device promises acceptable IPL hair removal at a bargain price. Compared to other devices that promise the same functionality, it costs as much as 80% less (at time of writing). Assuming it works equally well, it represents major value.

Pros:

** Hair removal IPL, simple to use
** Extremely inexpensive relative to the competition

Cons:
** No digital counter of the number of uses on LCD
** Mediocre aesthetics
** The wall plug is wide and the plug direction is such that it will take up multiple spaces on some extension arrays

Note that the model of this device is Ai05. This model (and others from the same manufacturer) are available from multiple brands on Amazon, so you may want to shop around.

IPL hair remover works well, good ergonomics The latest craze in hair removal is IPL: Intense Pulsed Light. Owing to improved light technology, hand held devices that can provide the requisite intensity light to perform IPL at home and at an affordable price are now available.

I've tried a number of these IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) devices for hair removal.

At this point, I can say that these IPL devices all work pretty similarly, with only a few differnces separating them. Among the most significant differences:

** Does the device only address hair removal, or does it also promise to do "skin rejuvenation" or help with acne?
** Does the device offer the "ice" functionality, where a heat-sink near the flash head reduces the effective heat at the skin
** Does the device offer a LCD readout of info such as number of flashses left, power level, etc
** What are the ergonomics of the device itself: Gun shaped or tube shaped or...?
** Does the device include attachments that modify the shape/size of the head for focused use in places like the lips?
** What is the maximum number of flashes for which the device is rated (most devices are rated for 500,000-1,000,000 flashes, which is equivalent to a lifetime)

If all you need is hair removal, just about all the devices offer that, and should provide equivalent functionality.

This one is mid-priced, and offers typical, functionality for a mid-line IPL gun:

** Hair removal only
** No ice functionality
** LCD screen
** Comfortable gun shape
** No attachments to change the flash end shape
** Rated for 500,000 flashes, 5 power levels.

Operation is pretty trivial: You plug in the power supply, (the hair removal tool is NOT battery operated; you must have it plugged in), you choose the power level (five settings, chosen by rapidly pushing the power button)) and then you aim it at a body area with hair you'd like to remove. It is recommended that your body is freshly cleaned and that the hair be shaved before starting. You can choose either on-demand flashing (via the trigger button on the gun-shaped body) or else automatic flashing when skin contacted is detected. Switching between the modes is accoplished by a long press of the gun button. Auto mode is indicated by flashing of the power indicator bars.

The light is extremely powerful and could damage your eyes with continued direct exposure. Therefore, you should never look directly into the light and a cheap pair of folding protective eyeglasses are included in the box.

The light is triggered by a touch-sensitive metal area in the front of the device. Using very slow-motion photography, I was able to capture a snapshot of the light (see photos). But the light duration is extremely short.

You run the tool over the area where you want to remove hair, and make sure you exposure all the hair follicles in that region. You will not see any immediate results. The light signals your hair to stop growing, but it requires multiple treatments over several weeks before you will be expected to see results. Eventually, you should find a substantial reduction in the hair in the treated areas.

In the box, you get the tool, a power adapter, a cheap pair of sunglasses, a disposable razer, an instruction booklet, and some non-descript cotton-tipped swabs.

This device only offers one mode: Hair removal. Other IPL devices offer other modes (skin rejuvenation and acne treatment). Whether that's a loss depends on whether you believe those other modes really work anyhow. The jury is out.

The ergonomics of this IPL device are good. It's gun-shaped, which I find to be comfortable in the hand. The power attaches to the bottom/end of the gun, which gives good flexibility in aiming the gun and does not interfere with holding the gun in a way where you can see the LCD.

Overall, this IPL gun does what it promises to do, and offers an LCD screen and good ergonomics. This isn't the cheapest IPL device you can find, but the combination of gun-shaped ergonomics and LCD readout are nice.

Pros:

** Hair removal IPL, simple to use
** Convenient, easy to hold and point gun shape
** LCD readout of number of flashes left and power level. Also indicates the mode (automatic, manual).

Cons:

** Not the cheapest IPL device offering hair removal

7 head shaver. Waterproof. The on/off button is easy to accidentally toggle when using First off, I'm going to review this for face/beard shaving. I don't have a bald head (yet, anyway), so that isn't my focus.

I have used rotary floating blade shavers for decades (usually Norelco). They work best on my face, especially for the neck region. These shavers have always featured three heads.

Well, here we have seven heads. Seven heads!! I have used very similar shavers to this one with five and six-head shaver attachments. This is one more. The question is: Why do the high-quality venerable brands stick to three heads, and these shavers use so many more?

The answer isn't quality of shave. In fact, I was impressed at how well this shaver cleared the stubble on my face at the end of the day. It was comfortable, and managed to navigate the nooks and crannies of my face and neck as well as my low-end Norelco (if not better). But it's no match--not even remotely close--to my top-of-the-line Norelco (though that costs about 4x as much, so that's probably not a fair comparison). But--and this is huge--the ergonomics of the shaving heads leave something to desire. First off, there's very little reservoir under the cutting heads for shaved hair (see photos). This means you'll need/want to wash the head (it's water immersible) after each shave. Second, the middle head of the seven doesn't pop up. To remove it, you have to twist it off. It's a bit of a pain--and there's even less room under this head for hair than any of the others.

The third issue I have with the cutting heads is that there's no obvious way to replace them without simply replacing the entire shaving head assembly. Based on my experience with other shavers quite similar to this, expect the blades to get dull after a bit of use, and factor in the cost of an entire replacement head unit when they do.

In terms of seven vs six vs five heads? Well, the motors in these shavers are effectively the same. So if you have seven heads, the amount of power you provide to each head is less than it is in a five head design. That's going to affect the maximum speed and also the ability to easily tackle heavy stubble. Given that I don't sense a huge amount of improvement with seven vs five (or six) heads, I'd be inclined to veer towards fewer heads.

In general, I'd suggest that you can interchange the 7/6/5 head assemblies if you want to get a replacement.

In the kit you get:

Seven head cordless shaver with LCD readout of charge remaining
Waterproof (IPX level not indicated)
Nose hair trimmer attachment
Hair clipper attachment
Two face cleaning attachments
Three length guides for the hair clipper attachment
Charging cable (requires USB-A power source). The charge port on the shaver is a standard USB-C port.
Small cleaning brush

Shave is controlled via a simple on/off button on the back. Given how you would normally hold this--palmed (see photo)--I found it annoyingly easy to accidentally push the power button when I was using it.

The non-shaver attachments are a mixed bag. On the plus side, the nose hair trimmer works very well. This is in contrast with the nose hair trimmers that come with clippers, which are worthless. The nose hair clipper here works as well as the dedicated nose hair clippers I've used. On the minus side, the hair clipper is quite mediocre--it operates at a low speed and struggles with any amount of hair. It's about as good/useful as the clipper that's integrated into some shaver handles. Those can clip a bit of trim hair, but they are an exercise in frustration for any serious hair removal. Same here. The face cleaner attachments are probably OK, but I can't imagine using them.

On the whole, I'd consider this a decent little kit useful for shaving your face and for nose hair removal. The remaining attachments are, in my opinion, not very useful. While it does a good job of shaving out of the box, my experience is that the heads get dull somewhat quickly, and you need to buy a not-inexpensive replacement assembly. Also, cleaning the assembly is a nuisance.

Pros:
** 7 head shaver does a good job on face
** Waterproof (IPX level not indicated)
** Nose hair clipper works well
** Li-Ion battery: 2 hours charge for 90 minutes use
** Charge port on shaver is standard USB-C, so you can use charge cables you have at home
** Can lock the power button for travel (by holding for 3 seconds)

Cons:
** Too easy to push the power button when palming the shaver in the hand during use
** Hair trimmer has limited usefulness
** Face cleaning attachments not very significant
** Shaver head assembly doesn't provide much room for hair and will need to be cleaned after each shave
** Middle head of shaver attachment difficult to remove for cleaning
** Must replace entire shaving head unit when one/more blades get dull
** 7th head in shaver assembly does not float like outer heads

Note that there is a dizzying number of similar 5/6/7 head shavers sold on Amazon. As far as I can tell, having reviewed many of them, they are all made by a handful of companies and work pretty much equivalently well. The snap-in attachments even work across different models and brands. There are variances in features like level of waterproof and how the power switch works (and the body shape), but the function is pretty similar. So shop around for price.

You recieve seven masks one of which is a pack of undereye patches. I'm really happy with theses. Plus they look lovely on my vanity.

Little quantity, high price point This is a decent mask, but I didn't find it to be anything special. I have better masks that I'll reach for over this. The ingredients seem very nice. It does give my face a nice glow. The price point is ridiculous for the amount of product. If the mask was either the most amazing mask I've ever tried, you recieved more quantity for the price, or it was alot cheaper in price. Then I'd say go for it, but as it is I really don't recommend spending the money. There are alot better masks out there including here on Amazon.

Works perfectly I wanted to try this because it's the perfect size for what I need it for. I make a formula to spray on my synthetic wigs to make them smell nice and freshen them up between washes. This has a nice even mist spray which is exactly what I need. Plus I love the green. I recommend this bottle if this is the size you're looking for.

Pleasantly surprised! I have used this de-stressing cream both am and pm. I usually don't use something like this during the day bc I try to keep my products to a minimum. For this reviews sake I used this during the day under my makeup and it looked good. Now I use this at night. We expose our skin to alot of stresses in the environment and at night our skin rejuvenates. So I feel this is great to use while I sleep. This jar may seem small but a little goes a long way so it should last some time. It's not greasy, spreads across my face easily, and it absorbs well. It's very hydrating and it doesn't leave a shine on your face. I do use this sometimes during the day if I'm not wearing any makeup. (Like I said it looked good under makeup, I just don't use a separate moisturizer on makeup days I use a few other products and it'd be too much) Anyway when I wake up in the morning my skin really feels good. It's soft, smooth, and supple. It even has a bit more bounce back of you know what I mean. I'm impressed with this cream. It's fragrance free and doesn't irritate my skin which can be mildly sensitive. So I definitely can say I recommend it.

Works really well but it's a bit too pricey I absolutely love a really good brightening mask. This mask feels very good on my skin. It yields very nice results. I'd use this before an occasion where I need to look my best. I used at night at night and it was easy to use. It didn't slide everywhere. I saved all the serum to apply to my skin the next few nights. Yes this is a very good mask. About as good as a $10-$12 mask. Which is a tiny bit pricey for a single mask for the average person. Now as good as it is $26 at time of this review is way too much for this mask. The products great and like another reviewer said if you have the disposable finances then go for it.

Very good but contains alot of fragrance I was excited to try this serum because I tried one other skincare product from Winky Lux and I was very impressed. First let's say this packaging is unbelievably beautifully with gorgeous dissolvable orchid petals in the serum. This is a hydrating balancing serum. It makes my skin feel very soft, it works well with my other skincare products and under makeup.
Now the ingredient list is a tiny bit disappointing when I look how far down some of the really fantastic ingredients actually are. The real reason I took off a star is because. I personally don't love putting alot of fragrance on my skin. Fragrance (parfum) is listed midway down. The scent I admit is lovely very floral. The scent lasts a long time. So I decided to use this on my decolletage (my chest area) I usually like to bring my skincare down into that area anyway. This way the strong yet beautiful floral scent is there but so is the skincare benefits. I recommend this if you don't mind putting alot off fragrance on your face. If it didn't contain so much fragrance I would have given this 5 stars and yelled "GET IT" from the roof tops, because it does make my face feel so soft!

They stay in place It was kinda hard getting my hair through the hole. Mostly because my hair is very curly and it kept catching on the little spikes on the inside. Once I got it through though, it stayed in place all day. It wasn't loose but it wasn't as tight as a ponytail and I kept having the urge to tighten it, which of course I could not do. It did not however work well at all for my daughter, 5. It started out ok but had completely come undone by the end of the day.

Flimsy The brush is really flimsy so it just bends when it's supposed to brush your hair. Some assembly is required for the brush but the insert piece that is supposed to stabilize it doesn't stay in well which just makes the brush more flimsy. The spray bottle does a good job spraying but only sprays for slightly longer than a normal spray bottle. The comb is pretty nice though. It's durable and works well for thick curly hair.

Blendable and Long Lasting Color I love eyeshadow! I don't leave home without some on and I have to admit to being addicted to new colors! This sunset palette is ideal for the warmer colors that nicely compliment brown eyes. There is a range here, too, of matte and metallic as well as a range from lighter colors to dark. Some of the colors that initially look darker (like sunset), actually are a lot lighter than you would expect once applied to the eyelid. I like how blendable they are, too. They mix nicely not only with each other on the lid, but with other brands as well, which is important to me as there are some tried and true favorites that I love to mix with new colors for a fresh twist. This is a great palette for all year-round. As it lacks cool colors, it isn't one that I would use exclusively, but it has been nice experimenting with it so far, and I haven't hated any of the colors at all. I know that I will enjoy using this on my eyes!

When used with an eyeshadow primer, this shadow easily lasts all day long and into the night! It comes off well with a makeup wipe or other eye makeup remover. I wear contacts and none of the colors have irritated my eyes either.

Lathers Well, Cleans Well, Nice and Portable for Travel This shampoo bar is great for travel away from home. It measures 2 5/8 inches in diameter and about 7/8  inches deep. It fits easily into carry-on luggage, a shaving kit, or a backpack. To me the scent smelled more like chalk than coconut, but it lathers well, cleans thoroughly, and washes out well with no residual scent, so I'm not docking it any stars for the scent. I don't see myself reordering it at the current list price of $13.00 (13% off the original price of $15.00), because there are many other bars with a more pleasant fragrance that do just as good a job, but I will gladly use the rest of this bar without complaint. No matter what, shampoo bars are handy for traveling and are great for the environment, and I like the eco-friendly packaging of just a simply, recyclable cardboard box and no plastic wrapper.

Can Definitely Feel the Heat This order comes with two 60 ml tubes of slimming cream. I use a disposable glove to apply it, and that keeps me from accidentally getting it in my eyes or anywhere else I don't intend for it to be. My focus area with this cream is my abdomen, admittedly one of the hardest areas to lose belly fat regardless of method. The burn is delayed for about 10 minutes, but when it starts, I can definitely feel it. It's a strong sensation, but not painful, and it reassures me that the cream is activating. Like probably many other folks who use this cream, I am also doing other things at the same time to try and lose weight: watching what I eat, exercising more, drinking more water, etc. Therefore, even though I am very slowly seeing a reduction in my belly fat, it's difficult for me to say how much of that is from using this cream and how much is from the other measures that I am taking to produce the same result. I consider $12.98 for two tubes a reasonable price for adding this cream to my weight loss efforts, and will continue to use it as long as I continue to see results.

Very Nice Pre-Wrapped Gift Set for Moms of All Ages This is an absolutely wonderful gift set that is even nicely pre-wrapped with colorful paper and a beige ribbon and bow. The back of the box has a label explaining what's inside, but because of the type of adhesive and the type of glossy wrapping used, this label can be easily peeled off with no sticky adhesive remnant on the wrapping paper (see my before and after photos). Inside the wrapper, is a plain white sturdy cardboard box. Inside, there is a wrapped square bar of scented soap, a box of dried rose petals that look and smell pretty, and three rose and lavender scented bath bombs that spell out the word "MOM." The "O" in "MOM" is shaped like a pink heart. All these items are resting on a bed of white nesting paper. Both the wrapping paper for the soap and the cardboard of the box containing the rose petals have the same pattern as the outer wrapping paper. Among other ingredients, each bath bomb contains coconut oil, sea salt, and shea butter. For the dried rose petals, it says to place them in still, warm bath water. It also says to drain the bath as usual as the dried florals are biodegradable. This gift is not just for Mother's Day, it's for any mom, any day, who would enjoy a thoughtful gift and a relaxing bath with these lovely scented bath bombs.

Brushes do not spin, they vibrate When I first tried this facial cleansing brush I thought it was broken, the brushes would not spin they just vibrated.  Upon further review of the product information page I could see that the device did in fact work by vibration.  The set comes with three brush heads for dry, normal and oily skin.  There's also a wireless charging base that can hold one of the brush heads, a charging cable (USB to micro USB) and a "user guide" which is not very good (it states that there are two brushes, there are three, a number of other problems).  The guide also recommends replacing the brushes after using for 3 months but I couldn't find any replacement brushes.  May be a good facial cleaner but it just tickled my face and didn't feel like it was doing much else.

Cleans Well and Shrinks Pores I got this for my wife, and here is her review: I liked this Not My Mama's Bubbling Face Wash before I even received it, because I thought the name was cute. The plastic 6 oz bottle has an iridescent label that reflects light just like bubbles do, which is kind of cool. The ingredient list is full of natural components, which is good. The bottle has an inner safety seal, so there was no leakage during shipment. This also reassures me that the contents have not been tampered with. The wash itself applies smoothly. Best of all, though, are the results. This cleans my face thoroughly and gently, and shrinks my pores well. My skin feels smooth and fresh after using this. I have very sensitive skin, and it's extremely hard for me to find a face wash that cleans well without leaving my face feeling dry and irritated. This face wash does exactly what I need for it to do. It currently lists for $20, but it takes very little to clean my entire face, so I expect it to last a while. After trying so many disappointing facial cleansers, I am quite happy with this one and definitely consider it a good value.

Wonderful Scent, Mositurizes Well This Gryph & IvyRose Coat of Arms Body Lotion smells so good that I can't seem to stop sniffing my hands once I've applied the lotion. It comes in an 8 fl. oz. (240 ml) plastic bottle with a push top cap and a couple of cute sea turtles on the label. The lotion is thick and white and contains lots of ingredients that are wonderful for my skin--oils, botanical extracts, aloe, shea butter, etc. My skin is left smooth, soft, well hydrated, and smelling wonderful. This body lotion currently sells for $14.99, and I consider it a good value for kids and adults alike.

So Soft and Comfortable, Perfect Size for Me This bath pillow has turned out to be absolutely what I want in a pillow. I tried a prior one that was much bigger with supporting sides that ran halfway down my back, and found that it put me at an awkward angle in the tub that put way too much pressure on my tailbone and was extremely uncomfortable. I ordered this one to replace the other one, and I am thrilled with it. It's incredibly comfortable to rest my head against, and stays in place well using the two large suction cups on the back of it. I usually like to slide deeper into the tub about halfway through my bath, and this pillow is small enough and light enough that I can simply and easily readjust it to my new position, and it's still just as secure and just as comfortable after I've moved it. When I'm done bathing, it has a handy plastic hook attached that I can use to hang the bath pillow on the towel rack to dry. This pillow currently sells for $12.99, and I feel like it's a good value.

Nice Presentation, Great Positive Message, Very Giftable This gift set makes a great first impression. The box is black trimmed in gold. On the cover there is a gold outline of a compact mirror. Inside that outline it says, "Not a Day Over Fabulous." Inside, there is a nice large white woven cosmetic bag (that of course could be used for lots of other things, too), a 4" square jewelry plate, and a gold compact mirror. All say in flowing script, "Beautiful girl you can do fabulous things." The compact case has the same inscription on both the front and back cover, which is great. In its brand new state, the writing on the compact mirror doesn't show up well from a distance, but I think with use the engraved area will darken a bit and the writing will be better seen. The message is meant for the one holding the mirror, anyway, and not others nearby, so even if it doesn't darken, it still delivers inspiration where it's intended. The mirror quality is good. These items make a perfect gift set to give to a girl in age or a girl at heart, and I'm sure would be appreciated by either.

Great for Home or Travel, Easy to Use This B.O.B. Bars Over Bottles Conditioner Bar Ultra Moisturizing is absolutely perfect for me. The packaging is simple and recyclable. A small cardboard box just large enough to hold the conditioner bar, and a simple paper wrapper around the bar inside. That's it. No bottle, no plastic, no waste. Love it. This bar works great for home or travel. Since there is no liquid for TSA to have to approve, I can keep this in my carry-on luggage if I'm flying somewhere. It's small size makes it easy to pack.  One of these bars lasts forever, so I can keep it in my travel kit and use it for multiple trips. It's also good for home use, taking up very little space in my shower caddy. The scent of this conditioner bar is very pleasant. This conditioner bar contains Pracaxi oil, which is a vitamin rich hair oil that hydrates, promotes hair growth, and strengthens damaged hair. This conditioner bar is also vegan and is cruelty free. That is an awful lot of good reasons for me to absolutely love this conditioner bar, and I am happy I ordered it.

Strong Clay Scent I like everything about this BOB Bars Over Bottles shampoo bar except the scent, which unfortunately is a major player with me. The shampoo bar is packaged in an environmentally beneficial way, with a recyclable cardboard box just large enough to contain the soap and its paper wrapping. It is plastic free, vegan, cruelty free, and it uses natural ingredients. The ingredients include green clay, lemongrass, rosemary, and peppermint. I truly enjoy the scents of lemongrass, rosemary, and peppermint, so I didn't give the green clay part any thought at all prior to ordering this bar. Unfortunately, the scent of the green clay overwhelms the other scents enormously, and I don't find the wet clay smell enjoyable at all. The soap lathers and cleans well, and rinses out nicely. However, I don't want to wash my hair with something that smells unpleasant to me, especially since there are so many competing shampoo bars that smell wonderful and are just as environmentally friendly.

Great for Legs and Underarms I ordered this for my wife, and she is thrilled to have it so that she can be ready when shorts and swimsuit season arrives. Not having to shave every day will be an absolute blessing for her. This SmoothSkin Pure Fit Intelligent Ultrafast IPL Laser Hair removal device comes with the device itself, a power cord, an optional precision head for use on smaller areas, and a detailed instruction book. Since this device does not work if the skin is too dark or the hair is too light, it is important to check the online skin suitability chart before purchasing to make sure that this device will actually work for the user. My wife's skin and hair color fell within the effective range, so she was good to go when this arrived. Also, since this device can make the skin photosensitive during the course of treatment, winter is the best time to start the initial 12 week course of hair removal. For those who live in a place where there really isn't much of a winter, just be aware that skin needs to be protected from the sun during this treatment period. Since my wife is still in the early phases of this treatment and it's already mid-March, she'll be cutting it kind of close. Worse case scenario, though, she can at least get a month or so of treatments done and then resume and/or start her treatment over again when winter is back. This SmoothSkin device has two modes for treatments, Glide, which is just like it sounds and is a continuous firing as the device glides along the skin in a steady movement, or Stamp, which is a single controlled burst at a time, designed for areas where you want tighter control over when and where the light fires, such as on the upper lip. There are also three treatment intensities, Power, which is the highest setting and good for larger areas, Gentle, for sensitive areas (also recommended when first starting IPL and getting used to how it feels), and Speed, the fastest treatment mode, for quickly covering larger areas and for doing fast touch-ups. This sounds complicated, but after my wife began doing these treatments once a week, she found that it was actually fairly easy to do. Granted, she is just doing legs and underarms for now, which are fairly basic. My wife's initial opinion of this SmoothSkin Pure Fit IPL laser hair removal device is extremely positive. It's easy to learn, easy to do, can be done in the privacy of our own home and at a time that is convenient for her, and is far cheaper than having either IPL or laser hair removal treatments done in a shop. Not only that, but so far it's working.

Skin Still Felt Oily Hours after Applying this Even though I applied this Auntie & Me Liquid Gold Organic Anti-Aging Face Serum very lightly on my face, and even though my skin is very dry by nature, my face still felt very oily hours after applying this face serum. I tried massaging it in several times during that period, but it just never seemed to absorb very well. Since, as stated, my skin is normally very dry, feeling oily and greasy is very uncomfortable and undesirable to me. Based on the rave reviews, I had very high hopes for this serum, which is why I ordered the larger (and incredibly more expensive) 66 ml size. Lesson learned. I will pass this along to my sister, and maybe she will have the incredible results that seem to elude me. Based on my personal results, however, I'm rating this 3 stars.

Good for Medium to Short Length Man's Hair I'm male with relatively short, somewhat thinning hair.  The brush works great for me.  The bristles are relatively soft and flexible so it doesn't feel like I'm trying to tear my scalp off. Comb is too stiff but I can see where someone else might like it.  Now the fun part.  I didn't know what that little metal-tined thing (photo 2) was for.  I figured it was a mustache comb and I have a mustache so I gave it a try.  Worked great!  The little tines penetrated the mustache hairs and felt great on the underlying skin.  Kinda like an exfoliater!  I loved it.  Couldn't find a description of it on the product's page so I reviewed a couple of similar products and discovered that it's actually for cleaning the brush.  Not for me - I'm using it on my mustache.  Nice product and seems to be high quality. Highly recommend.

Nice Set, Great Gift All around a very nice set, especially for the price.  I've paid a lot more for a lot less.  The bombs themselves are very nice. Very good aroma and they actually do moisturize as opposed to most others.  The ones I've used so far colored the bath water.  Not a problem as it didn't cause any "rings" on the tub and I came out with skin the same color as when I went in, minus some dirt.  I'll be buying some as Christmas gifts.  Recipients will think I spent a lot more that I actually did!.  Highly recommended.

Good, Not Best I have some other nail files that are very similar but are a bit stiffer and seem to last longer.  After one use I can see wear on these files whereas I can't see it on my other files.  And although they have the same grit they don't seem to cut as aggressively.  They're good but not the best.  Recommended for the price.

Work Great, Nice that They're Two-Sided Four Pack should last a good long time.  I've been using one for a couple of weeks and it doesn't show any signs of wear.  The aggressive side is not so aggressive as to tear up the skin - I've had some in the past that did. Ouch!  The smooth side is great for a final smoothing.  I've included a photo showing the exact size of the pads.  One slight negative, and I don't know whose fault it was, but one of the pads arrived broken.  Looked like it could have been packaged better.  Despite that, highly recommended.

Passed the "Grab a Hair" Test Very nice set of tweezers along with an exceptionally sharp small pair of scissors.  The case looks good and is secured by a snap connector.  There are individual slide-in holders for each pair of tweezers and the scissors.  There isn't a slot for the brush but I just put it in with one of the tweezers.  The quality of the tweezers is outstanding.  They appear to be very well machined and they passed my "grab a hair" test.  What I do is try to grad a single fine hair off of my arm.  If the tweezers get it in one try and can hold on to it to pull it out, they pass.  Each pair of tweezers passed the test.  Another thing I like is that this set doesn't have a bunch of needless junk in it that just takes up room.  This set can fit in my shaving kit without taking up extra space.  Highly recommend.

Cleared-Up Nasal Congestion But Only Temporarily Nasal congestion has been part of my life for the past 40 years or so.  Hate to say it but nasal sprays have been the one and only thing that tends to relieve the congestion.  Usually once a day before bedtime.  Ordered this product to give it a shot.  I followed the instructions and added the product (actually two products) to a hot bath and hopped in.  Sat soaking for about 15 minutes with no relief.  Then I put a muslin washcloth over my face and started pouring hot bath water over it.  After about five minutes of deep breathing (in through the nose, out through the mouth) the nasal congestion started breaking up somewhat.  Didn't completely break up but got better.  Drained the tub (tons of sandy debris left) and took a hot shower to rinse the clay, etc, off.  That's when the congestion broke loose.  I was able to blow my nose and breath through my nose with very little to no congestion.  Unfortunately the relief didn't last all that long, probably about three hours.  At 36 bucks a pop, that's 12 dollars per hour for three hours relief.  Pass, I can buy a lot of nasal spray for $36.

IMHO Not Fragrant and They're Tiny The pictures of these "petal balls" on the web page are bigger than the actual balls.  I was kind of expecting the opposite.  I followed the directions and put one of the balls in a dish and poured boiling water over it.  It was kind of fun to watch it re-hydrate but that was about the end of the enjoyment.  The "fragrance" given off by these petal balls was akin to a weak tea although I surely wouldn't drink it.  As for putting one in a tub, I suspect the "bloom" would clog up the drain and just create a mess.  Plus I don't want to take a bath in a pot of tea.  I'll have to pass on this one.

Not at $34 a pop I've got a bad back and regularly do Epsom salt soaks in very warm to hot water.  I usually pay about $5 for a bag of Epsom salt that's good for 4-5 baths.  That's about $1 per soak.  The Pursoma Digital Detox Bath Soak did about as much to relax me and relief pain as the Epsom salt and with the Epsom salt I don't have to shower to remove the "mud" and rinse out the mud/dirt from the tub after using it.  I suspect more of the relaxation comes from the hot water and length of time a person soaks as it does from any additive put in the water.  With the Epsom salt baths I can also add in a bath bomb for a couple bucks more and enjoy the aroma and moisturizing effects of the bomb.  I'll stick with my routine.

Not Just a Name, The Shampoo and Conditioner Really Are Purple I got this shampoo and conditioner for my wife--here is her review: I wanted this shampoo and conditioner because it said it worked really well for gray and white hair--as a senior I have plenty of both--and because it got good reviews re fragrance and how soft it left hair. When I was in the shower and squirted some shampoo into my hand, I was amazed to see that the shampoo really is a dark purple color. I asked myself if I could live with it if it actually turned my hair purple, decided I could, and lathered up. The shampoo did an excellent job of creating a strong lather, and my hair felt really clean when I rinsed it out. The shampoo has a soft floral fragrance that is very pleasant. I took a quick look in the mirror to see if my hair was purple, and it wasn't, so I then squirted out some conditioner into my hand. It was purple, too, although thicker and lighter in color than the shampoo. As I rubbed the conditioner into my hair, the wonderful floral scent of the conditioner filled my shower--what a delightful sensory treat! I checked my hair again when I got out of the shower and dried off--still no purple hair, thank goodness. However, when I squirted some shampoo into my hand to take a photo, there was a big purple stain on my hand when I washed the shampoo off. I squirted the conditioner in a different spot on my hand for that photo, and it did the same thing. I've washed my hands several times since then, and the purple stains are still there. So...even though the product information online says it works fine with gray and white hair, I look down at my purple stains on my hand and I have to wonder. Since I love the smell of this shampoo and conditioner and how incredibly soft it leaves my hair, I'm going to continue using it. If it turns my hair purple at some point in the future, I'll do an update and give everyone fair warning.

Some Good, Mostly Bad, A Little Surprising The good: The scent - prior to mixing the powder with water, there is strong orange scent, which I like.
The bad: It's a powder that you have to mix prior to use. Directions say to mix it in a bowl or just mix it in your hand prior to use. Well, I went with "hand" option. The first time I got a thick paste that was pretty gritty, which I like, but it left my skin dried out but with a feeling that there was still some residue on it despite having rinsed quite well. Second attempt produced a thinner mixture which was again gritty enough but still left me with the same results.
The surprising: Although I didn't care for this product as a "facial scrub" it did have an interesting side effect: it lightened an age spot that's on me cheekbone area. After the first use I noticed it but didn't really attribute it to the scrub. After the second use if was more pronounced and I can't attribute it to anything other than the scrub. While some may consider the lightening of age spots a good thing, I don't. If I wanted to lighten anything I'd buy a product that claimed that ability. The fact that it had that effect kind of tells me I don't want to use the product anymore. Between the hassle of having to mix the scrub and the effects it had I'll not be using it again. Some products I order but don't end up liking I'll give to other family members but not this one. Not recommended.

Good gritty feel I like a facial scrub that I can actually feel scrubbing and this Disco scrub meets that criteria.  In the attached photo you can see the grit contained in the scrub.  The directions say to use a amount equal to a penny and my experience says that's enough to do a good job of exfoliating facial skin.  The scent to me seemed like a burnt avocado, not particularly pleasant but I'm not using it for the scent and the scent rinses off.  I deducted one-star for the price which seems a bit steep to me.  My regular scrub costs significantly less and exfoliates as well if not a bit better.  Good to try, good as a gift but I probably wouldn't buy again.

Smells Nice, Cleans Well, but Very Tiny Bar--Update I ordered the Vitamin Papaya facial beauty bar. The online product information says the facial bars typically last 2-3 months with daily use. This is such a tiny, tiny little bar, I can't even remotely imagine it lasting as long as they claim. This little bar measures 2 1/4'" x 1 1/4" x 1/2". It weighs 1.3 oz. The soap comes with a facial sponge that is 2 5/16" in diameter. The soap lathers nicely and cleans my face well. The scent is very pleasant. I do not see myself reordering this little bitty bar of soap, however, when I can buy a full size natural, handmade bar online for the same price from quite a number of different sellers.***Update. I discovered the way to make the soap last as long as claimed is to apply it using the face sponge provided. It only takes a tiny swipe of the soap with the facial sponge to have enough lather to wash my whole face. After using a number of other facial cleaning products after I initially wrote this review, I switched back to this facial bar and realized that, using it with the facial sponge, it leaves my face feeling incredibly smooth and blemish free. I am happily upgrading this little bar to a 5 star. It may be small, but it does an amazing job!

Buffalo horn comb A natural, ( non synthetic ) comb, cuts the static cling of dry hair. Helps return hair to luster, and repairs splits ends.

I can only hope the buffalo horn that was used was horn left after carcass was used, or that horn is found.

I'd hate to think they were killing buffalos just for the horns.
Denture tooth paste This is my first  dentures . Dentist didn't give me much instructions. This is a  long standing product so can only imagine good review.

Travel shave brush with travel pouch Don’t know why portable shave brushes gave to be so expensive. Though looking at prices if silver tipped badger brushes this is priced pretty reasonable, and a nice leather case. The safety razor I bought to go with it, fits nicely in the soace provided. Bristles are soft. This would be a nice gift for anyone who shaves and you’re at a loss what to get.

Plastic is plastic Not sure about sturdiness, or even to take this seriously. You have to slide blade in, there is no lift up piece that holds blade. Unless a tool, but your fingers are in for some slices.

Also as stated is plastic. This is something I ng where your choice of blade is gonna matter and this merely holds. Save your money or spend it on shave soap. Even to the beginner, this would seem like a toy.
BUT, GREAT for travel. Dont worry about leaving a good razor at hotel.
You can still have your shave and and not worry about being left behind.

Looks great and works well! I have a very eclectic look in my house and I like the style of this!
-The white part is not plastic. It’s heavy and solid. I’m not sure if it’s breakable as I don’t want to find out.
-There is a “max fill” sticker inside which is visible through the slits. It cannot be removed. I remedied this by spinning it to the back, but the button for the lights and power are now in the back. Not a big deal to me, but I try to give as much info as I can.
-Also, the fill tank is attached to the unit base and not removable like some other brands. It must be unplugged to be refilled, again, not a big deal.
-The lights can change colors, be set to one, or turned off by pressing the light button (on the left)
- it’s a smaller tank. I used 3 drops of eo and felt it worked well.
-along with vacuuming and carpet shampooing, I have found this to be the best way to keep dog smell from being too overpowering in my house.
-I keep hearing a little bubbling sound coming from it. It’s extremely soothing like listening to a river almost.
-Nice unit, works well. No complaints, but I will update if further use shows any problems.

Love the spray bottle! I’m working hard to create less garbage and to purchase fewer single use items - I love that the spray pump means no single use cotton pads! There is a lovely floral scent (the rose and orange blossom come through the strongest) but it is not overpowering and does not trigger my headaches.
My skin feels nice after using it, not tight or stingy. It’s a great product and I plan to repurchase.

I can use this even with my sensitive eyes and allergies. I have sensitive skin and eyes.  Without the right mascara my eyes itch and my eyelids get a reaction. I've taken before pics and even though it states to use it for a 30 day period I will post and update after two weeks to see the progress.

Big and thick with little sponge hearts!!! These are great!! They are big and thick with little sponge hearts in them... which is cute and an added plus!  I also received outstanding customer service!  So happy with it that I bout a second one!

Sturdy! Great tweezers!!
Sturdy set!!

Nice for the price This tiara is nice and vintage looking. It is lightweight but heavy enough to sit well on a hairdo or head.
Closeup, the tiara looks messy. The rhinestones are glued on a bit of centered and the adhesive is visible also, the larger rhinestones are scratched.
From a distance, the tiara looks great but at close range, you can definitely tell the quality is not the greatest.
It has two pin loops to secure.
I think the tiara is nice and it adequately priced for the quality. I do think that if the rhinestones were added with a little bit more precision then it will be all the better.

Elegant! Comfortable. This is such a pretty headband. It is a plush velvet headband decorated with strands of champagne/rose gold colored rhinestones. It is comfortable to wear and can be worn as a headband or sitting on top of the head as a headpiece. I like that it is heavier than the usual headband because when I wear headbands they tend to slide back and fall off, perhaps due to my oval-shaped head. When wearing this headband it stayed in place.
Since it is rhinestone chains/strands on the headband, when I slide it on it tends to pull my hair. So I have to be careful when putting it on by tying my hair back or wearing it when I slick my hair back, so I won't pull my hair.
When I received it did notice that there were three strands that had come undone and others seemed like they were loose. I contacted the seller and they helped resolve the issue.

Beautiful and comfortable headbands!! These headbands are beautiful. They are both plush and wrapped in velvet fabric and decorated with lots and lots of rhinestones, specifically rhinestones strands/chains attached to the headband.
The headband is comfortable to wear. I have worn them and I am happy to say they don't slip/slide back as I have experienced with others.
The headband is about 3/4 of an inch high or thick. I found that I could wear them as regular headbands or wear them tilted, almost like a tiara, with a hairstyle that can hold them in place. Since it does have rhinestone chains be careful when putting on or taking off since hair will get caught and pull it.
I had an issue with one of the headbands (small rhinestones) coming undone. When I received it two of the strands were unattached. I contacted the seller and they quickly helped to solve the issue.

Elegant! Can wear it as headpiece too! This is such a pretty headband. It is very sparkly and elegant.
It is also comfortable to wear. Other headbands tend to hurt me behind the ear but this one has not done that. This could be because of the velvety fabric.
I like that it can be worn as a headband but also like a headpiece/tiara if you wear it slightly tilted. I will definitely be using this on the next military ball, whenever they start back up again.
The headband is plush and thick. It is covered and a velvet type fabric and is decorated with rhinestone strands/chains.
I do suggest to be careful when putting on or taking off since it could pull your hair, so don't remove too quickly.
For the quality, I think the headband is well priced.

Faded matte style, ordered Maple Road I like this lipstick. It is creamy and does not leave my lips dry.
I ordered Maple Road and I like the color; the description appears to be pretty accurate. Comparing my picture to the one on the listing, I think it is close to the "one coat" shade. It has like a faded look to it, hence the matte style. I do think it's closest to a red-orange with a brown tint to it as opposed to a red tint. I wore it for about eight hours and it lasted the entire time. I like this lipstick and I would like to order Chilly Jilly but I think the price is on the high side for this lipstick, so I will probably pass on it.

tinted lip gloss These lipsticks are pretty cool. They are black but the colors are shades of red.
They have a cherry smell to them.
It is creamy but like a lip gloss. These are mostly shaded lip glosses and not a matte color lipstick.
I like that the lips stay tinted pink when wiped off.
They did not leave my lips dry.
I am wearing #12 in the picture.

sparkly, some wider than others These headbands are really nice. The crystals are very pretty and sparkle nicely. They appear to well attached to the headband.
I did notice that some of the ends of the headbands were a bit sticky as if the felt was not properly wrapped.
Some of the headbands are wider. I don't know if this is because of how they were packaged, (which was a very secure packaging), that caused some of them to widen. This is a problem for me beauty I already have issues with headbands sliding back with my egg/oval-shaped head, so a wide headband will most certainly slide off.
Aside from these two minor issues, the headbands are great. At less than two dollars a piece I think for the style and quantity these headbands are priced accordingly.

Nice, elegant and comfortable These headbands are really nice.
They are headbands wrapped in a velvet type fabric.
The faux pearl appears to be properly secured to the headband. They did not appear loose in any way.
They are very comfortable and actually stay on my oval-shaped head, which causes my headbands to slide back. I did not have that issue with these. They stayed put!
The only thing that concerns me is the end of the wrapped fabric. I hope it holds long enough for many uses and does not unravel.
Other than that they are very pretty and at less than five dollars a piece I think these are priced accordingly for the style and quality.

nice and elegant with all the rhinestones in place This headband is really nice, elegant, and comfortable.
It is thick and does not slide back like some of my other headbands. It does not hurt the back of my ears.
This is actually the third black rhinestone headband that I have ordered, but I have had issues with others having the rhinestones falling off and/or the rhinestone strands peeling off.
I am happy to say that all the rhinestones and rhinestone strands were in place.

fast drying, great for face washing and removing makeup These pads/gloves really come in handy for removing makeup and/or face washing. I really like that they come with their bag and are washable. I hang them up after use and they dry very quickly. After a couple of uses, I gather them up and wash them in their little bag.
The pads are thin and do not hold a lot of liquid which I like.
These pads are a good size for the face and neck.
The gloves are easier to use for face washing since they are a little bigger.

several layers needed, easily wipes off These are nice colors but several layers are required to achieve the color of the eyeshadow stick.
Once on the color does not last very long.
I spread the eyeshadow with my finger and I end up completely removing it from my eye.
That being said, the eyeshadow easily wipes off.
I like the color options but I think I would rather have them in powder form.

great for resin projects I like this UV Led light.
I do not use this for nails, but for resin art projects.
It is large enough to fit large silicone molds in UV light.
I really like the light does not have to sit on a table to turn on, or by motion (which is an option). I can hold it up, set the seconds, and direct it towards my resin mold. This comes in handy for larger resin molds.

colors as described, longer curing time but no stickiness when dry I like the colors of this set. They are just as described/pictured.
I did a quick manicure for the purpose of trying the gel polishes out and they really worked well.
They took about 90 secs to cure under the UV light for each coat (base, color, top) but at the end, they were completely dry without any stickiness or the need to wipe them.
They have a resin odor to them but it is not overly strong.
Overall, this is a nice set.

keeps my makeup from defining my wrinkles This is a nice small set, perfect for travel or just to try it out.
I just recently started using a Touch in Sol primer and I really liked it, so I decided to try these out.
Just like the other primer, these worked great on my skin. It went on smooth and absorbed quickly.
Not a lot is needed so a little will go a long way.
These helped with the appearance of my makeup. I had started noticing that my makeup was defining my wrinkles and damaged/large pores and making them more noticeable. The Touch in Sol primers has definitely improved how my makeup looks.

Great scent!! Works very well on my dry hair. I absolutely enjoy the scent of this John Frieda Shampoo & Conditioner. It smells clean, fresh, and sweet.
It leaves my hair feeling clean, without residue, and very soft and manageable.
I live in a very dry area and my hair lacks moisture and looks very frizzy. This definitely helps with the dryness and frizziness.
I really like what it does to my hair but the scent is definitely my favorite.
The set is a little high in price but it works very well and makes ups for the price tag.

lightweight, blends well on my yellow undertone skin Love this product.
Great on my dry acne-prone skin.
It feels lightweight and blends well on my yellow undertoned skin.
A little goes a long way so that helps with the (high) price and time between reordering, which I plan to do when I go through this container.

Several pieces fell off. Defective/Damaged. :( I was looking forward to receiving this headband since, in my opinion, it's very pretty.
Unfortunately, it arrived with two decorative pieces completely off, glue and decoration, and another piece fell off as I was handling it.
The glue completely fell off of the headband. I figured I could glue it back, (which I shouldn't have to), but one of the flowers has a large purple rhinestone missing that is not in the plastic package nor the shipping box it came in.
When I inspected the rest of the pieces I notice that another flower is becoming unattached and barely hanging on.
The glue that is used dries a dark yellow which does not look good, in my opinion, and is very visible because they add a big blob of glue.
The headband itself looks nice and of decent quality. I think they (designer/seller) have the right idea they just have to attach the pieces in a more secure way, making sure the rhinestones are in place as well as packaging them in something that will protect the headband like a box, instead of a thin plastic bags.
The package includes a nice decorative hairpin with a nice thank you note and origami heart...sadly it is the only nice thing about ordering this headband.

Nice colors. Not creamy. Not long lasting. Nice colors
Lip pencils were a bit on the dryer side, not a creamy liner.
The color came off like normal wear liners so I would not consider these long lasting.
I was expecting long lasting lip liners and they are regular lip liners.
I think they are a great price for the set, and if I were expecting regular lip liners I probably would have given them 5 stars.

too complex, may need 2 people & need the right length... This did not work for me.
I have long hair and the way it's meant to be used (according to listing instructions) it is impossible for me to use it. My hair sits below my bra line and I can't lower the bun shaper that far down. Perhaps two people are needed for long hair.
I tried it on my mom's very short hair and it seems you have to twist in opposite directions (as pictured/in the video) to lock the hair in place. I was able to roll it up and create a bun, but it was really tight at the base and I have to roll it enough to secure the top hair. She tried it on her own and was not able to do it on her own on her shoulder-length hair.
I give it three stars because you can create a bun, but it is too difficult, the hair needs to be the right length and two people may be needed, which is not practical.

Great coverage on my acne scarred skin The foundation provides great coverage.
I have acne-prone skin and have dark spots, uneven tones, ​and acne scars and this foundation does a great job in covering all the imperfections.
Another thing that I like is that a little goes a long way. A pea-size amount covers most of my face. I don't like thick layers of make-up, since it clogs my pores up, so I usually just wear one coat and one coat of this foundation provides great coverage.
I have been wearing this foundation for about 2 weeks (off & on) and it does not cause break-outs.
I hope they continue selling this because I have found my foundation.
Love the bag and the primer, the sponges not so much.

Great coverage for acne scared skin! I love this Phoera foundation and the BB cream works well with the foundation.
This foundation provides great coverage. I have acne-prone skin and have uneven tones, dark spots ​, and acne scars and this foundation does a great job in covering all the imperfections. A pea-size amount covers most of my face so a little goes a long way. I don't like thick layers of make-up, since it clogs my pores up, so I usually just wear one coat and one coat of this foundation provides great coverage. The BB cream has a thin consistency and does good in blending tones, but not the dark spots (which I expected because of the consistency). I have been wearing this foundation for about 2 weeks (off & on) and it does not cause ( additional) break-outs.
The primer works well and I like the brush, but the best part of this set (for me) is the foundation.

work well but not the right style These work well.
I went through a couple of eyebrow tattoos prior to getting it positioned right on my mom's eyebrows.
The film is a bit noticeable so I tried to cut close to the tattoo to keep it from being too noticeable.
My mom did not like them because they were very dark on her skin and they were too arched and long from her natural look.
They work well for temporary use but I have to look for different lighter styles.
They are fairly easy to remove just like regular temporary tattoos.

Not for me. Hair felt like it has a film over it. This avocado nourishing scalp hair mask seems to work but is not for me.
The smell is very nice. I did not expect it to smell like bananas but it does have a significant banana scent, which I liked.
I used this after shampooing and left it on my hair for 5 minutes as suggested. I did not use conditioner.
My hair felt soft while on my hair and after rinsing, Once I was air drying my hair, my hair was not as soft.
It was manageable but it had some elasticity which i did not like.
Once fully dried my hair felt like it had a film over it.
it did help with fly aways and frizzyness.
I had to use a significant amount because of my long hair, so I do not expect this to last long/ many uses, thus I consider the price a bit high.
I will continue to use it a couple of times and if there is a positive change, I will update.
Yet as of now, after this bottle/tube, this will not be a hair product I will continue to use.

lightweight, good on my acne-prone skin Feels nice and lightweight on my skin.
It does not leave my face looking powdery.
I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and this does not make me break out.
At thirty dollars I do think it's a bit high in price, especially when the same product in a different shade is half the price.

nice colors, not hard to open Very nice set of claw hair clips.
I really like the color options.
Ten of the claw clips are matte colors, one is clear and the other is a frost white.
The claws are not tight so it does not take a lot of force to open them. I mention this because my mom who has arthritis has a difficult time with tight hair clips/claws.
I have long hair (to my lower back) and these held my hair fairly well.
They come in organized in a box making them a nice gift set.
Overall these are good hair clips and in my opinion, for the quantity and quality, they are priced accordingly.

Cleaner teeth/mouth. Charge/battery is long-lasting. This flosser leaves my teeth/mouth feeling so clean.
After brushing I thought my mouth was clean but then I used this water flosser and my mouth and teeth felt truly clean. I could definitely tell the difference.
The stream jetting out is pretty strong.
It comes with different jet tips in a case to keep them together.
The battery lasts a long time.

easily wipes off, 2+ coats needed The liquid lipsticks do not go on thick.
It goes on thin and a couple of coats are needed to keep it from being sheer.
It has a faint chocolate scent, in my opinion.
It will easily wipe off. It is not long-wear or smudge-proof in my opinion. I will come off while drinking or eating something.
The lipstick did not dry my lips.

nice, comfortable wig nice wig, color has brown undertones so it's a darker blonde color
soft and manageable hair
fits comfortably
just a bit high in price compared to similar styles

matte finish, perfect tangerine shade, long-wear I love the color!! It is definitely a long-wear lipstick.
I love orange/tangerine shades but they are difficult to find so when I saw this shade I had to order it in hopes that it was the color I was looking for.... it was.
The color is like a tangerine color, mostly orange but with a bit of red.
The liquid lipstick dries quick to matte finish.
It is long-wear and agree that is kiss proof, peck kiss proof.
It will stay on if I am drinking something or even eating, but if wipe my mouth with a napkin it will come off. So a touch up after eating may be necessary. I don't need to use an oil or makeup remover to remove the lipstick, which is what I like.
Overall, I am really happy with this liquid lipstick. It is the perfect shade with the perfect matte finish and the right amount of long-wear!
Definitely will be re-ordering.

two for five is a great investment for my razor Glad that extra cartridges for Bladelife razor holder are available to order.
At $5 for 2 cartridges, in my opinion, this is a good investment to extend the life of my razor blades.

Love the color. Long-Lasting. Need one coat. I like this Rose Pose liquid lip color. It is a light rosy tan metallic shade.
It is long-lasting and I did a paper test soon after applying it and it did not stain the paper, at all.
I really like that a little goes a long way. I only need to apply one light coat to give me the shade I want.
Overall, I really like this lip color. I like the fun packaging and the whole bakery theme.

don't care for the smell, won't use it Absorbs quickly and does not leave skin oily.
It moisturizes my skin and leaves it soft.
The only issue that I have is the scent, I don't really care for it. When I have used this on my face, the smell lingers. For this reason, I don't use the product. My mother does not find the scent bothersome so I guess it's just a matter of taste.
I myself would not reorder because I won't use something if I don't like the smell despite the results.

A very good face product! Am in process of trying out some new "pore reducing" products and am really enjoying this product. I have actually, probably like most people, gone through mountains of facial soaps and scrubs to try and finding that is amazing. I have been using this as a soap and Kyoku serum and have been getting numerous compliments on how well my skin has been looking.
It is a low sudsing cleanser that has a very strong peppermint-like tingle that my husband and I both love! This might be an awkward point to make but I also like it because it tastes good, not that I eat it but there are times when I'm in a hurry and don't "splash" enough on my face and there is a bit left on my face and the dripping water sneaks into your mouth...am I the only one this happens too 😒 but it doesn't taste like chemicals so I feel a little better about using this versus some other brands.

AMAZING POLISH! I won’t ever use another kind! I LOOOOOVE Sally Miracle Gel! It lasts so long without chipping! It is so beautiful and shiny!

I purchased two sets from a Sally store near me. I loved them so much I wanted more colors so I came on here to look! I was so happy when I found this! Now that I’ve used this polish, I don’t think I’ll ever use a different type!

The set doesn’t come with the gel top coat you need to set the gel, but I already had it from the other sets I have so it wasn’t an issue for me. But if you don’t, you should be aware of that!

I love the colors I received! I love that it doesn’t need a UV/LED light to set! So no extra step! It’s such amazing polish!

Very Moisturizing and Didn’t Notice a Scent! Didn’t Notice a Difference in Wrinkles/Dark Circles It feels very moisturizing. I can’t really speak to sensitive skin, but gave it 4 stars because it doesn’t have a scent and I didn’t notice anything that would bother someone with sensitive skin, but since I don’t usually have sensitive skin I can’t really speak too much on that! Like I said, it doesn’t have a scent, which I LOVE! (I never understand why companies make Facial products with strong scents! We have scented lotions and perfumes for that! I don’t mind a light scent but hate when it’s strongly scented so was so happy this didn’t have any scent at all!). As I said, it felt very moisturizing. I can’t say I noticed any difference in my small wrinkles and didn’t notice any difference with the darkness under my eyes. But it was very moisturizing so I enjoyed it anyways! But if you are purchasing it specifically for help with wrinkles or darkness under your eyes, I’m not sure you’ll have much luck! But I have only used this 1. I used all of it and used it every other night most times. Maybe if you use it Day and night and/or repurchase more and continue to keep using it, maybe it would make a difference? I can’t speak to that! But if you want something moisturizing that doesn’t have a scent, this is a great under eye cream for you!

Meh... This is an okay eye mask...

First, I’m not sure if the size or shape is off. It kind of poked me in my inner corner. If I put it any lower so it wouldn’t do that, it left way too much of my under eye uncovered.

I like that it has sticking on the back, because most gel under eye masks slide off easily. However, these didn’t stick well at all. As you can see I’m the last photo, it lifts up and that was taken right after I applied it. Every time I tried sticking it back down, it would just lift back up again.

Finally, it wasn’t hydrating at all. When I applied them, there didn’t seem like there was much substance on them at all. I didn’t think too much about that though, because I’d used masks like that before that were still very good. However, after leaving these on for the recommended time, I didn’t notice any difference and my under eyes didn’t feel any more hydrated than before. A moisturizer would be better, and I wouldn’t have to wait around with it sitting on my under eyes to do that.

Overall, it’s okay. It definitely isn’t great. Unfortunately, I definitely don’t recommend it at $6 (at time of writing this) for 1 pack that only includes 1 set of under eye masks. There’s much better options, especially ones you get more than 1 set and for less money.

Pretty Decent Set! Avoid If Sensitive to Smells! This is a pretty decent set! For $25.99 (at the time of writing this review), you get a lot of items!!

I love that it comes in a cute little caboodle box! Everything fits in it great! So all of the stuff is together in one place and it’s small enough that it’s easy to store!

The little pots of glitter cake together in a little zip lock bag, which I appreciated because some of the glitter had spilled out, so that kept it contained. It was only a few glitter particles, but I was still glad it was contained to the little bag! The poly gel tubes each come in their own little bags too, which I thought was nice. None of them leaked, but if they had it would have been very messy had they not been in a bag and still messy if they weren’t in separate bags. So, even though mine didn’t leak, I’m glad the company thought of the possibility and planned ahead just in case!

The polishes all come in their own box. I wish they would have labeled the OUTSIDE of the boxes. The only thing on the boxes were “Nail Polish” on 2 of them and “Gel Nail Polish” on the rest. Since 2 were supposed to be the top and base coat and only 2 said “Nail Polish,” I figured those were the top and base coats. I was wrong. I’m not sure why 2 said “Nail Polish” and the others said “Gel Nail Polish,” especially since they’re all supposed to be Gel polishes 🤷‍♀️ So, I had to open each box and look at each nail polish bottle to see which ones were which. The base and top coats were labeled on the outside of the bottles. BUT, the colored polishes weren’t labeled in any way. So the only way to figure out which color was which was to open each one. A minor inconvenience, but annoying when they could have just labeled them with the colors! So, I ended up putting a dot of the polish on the top of each box so I’d know in the future. It would just be nice if in the future the company labels them better!

The polish STINKS! It smells like burnt plastic 🤢 All Nail Polish stinks, but I’ve gotten used to the “regular” stink of nail polish. Smelling burned plastic while painting my nails is not something I’ve gotten used to! But, for the price of everything I got, it’s something I can deal with. But if smells bother you, this is not the kit for you!!!

The UV lamp works okay. I took a few times of turning it on to get the nails to dry, but it’s small so I wasn’t expecting too much and they did and it was still faster than if I painted my nails with regular polish and waited for them to dry. So I’m happy!

Overall, it’s a good little kit! I love that it comes all together in the cute little caboodle box. I love that you got an assortment of polish colors and an assortment of poly gel colors. I love that it came with the base and top coats. I love that it came with a UV lamp. I love it came with the tool needed for the poly gel nails. I love it came with glitter, foils, and strip tape to decorate the nails. I didn’t like that the polishes weren’t labeled better and I didn’t like the burnt plastic smell of the polish.
