But for everything I love and the affordable price for everything you get, I can get past those 2 things I didn’t like!!

I’d say the only thing that would make me tell you to avoid getting this kit would be if you’re sensitive to strong smells because of the burnt plastic smell from the polish. Other than that, I’d recommend this kit!!

Meh... I like false nails, but I don’t like really long ones. When I saw these looked short, I thought they’d be great! I wasn’t too sure about the diamond gemstones on them. I was a little worried they would look too gaudy, for my taste at least. But, the images of the nails on the hands in the product photos they didn’t look too bad, the ones on the thumbs seemed a little big but I figured that was okay.

So, I get them and see the diamond gemstones seem way bigger than they do in the product photos. But, I figure they’re worth a try anyways!

It took me FOREVER to sort them into their separate sizes. Of course, when I was laying them out to take the photos of them, I noticed that the plastic part you pull off the nail to reveal the adhesive have numbers on them 🤦‍♀️ Wish I would have seen them when I went to apply them! The instructions say NOTHING about them having numbered labels. And, the numbers are REALLY hard to see. So if you don’t have perfect eyesight, you might have a really hard time! I have perfect eyesight and still had trouble. I showed in a photo the best I could the number on one of the nails. That one is labeled 2. In the photo I have with them all separated and labeled, so maybe it will help someone avoid the headache of figuring it out!

The nails themselves I feel are kind of small and the thumbs I think are too big. Like my fingers aren’t too big. The 0 ones were too big for my thumbs. I had to go with the 1 ones. But then the 2 were too small for my middle finger. The 1 ones fit good, but there was only 3 of them and I was already going to use 2 of them for my thumbs. So I had to use the 0 ones for my thumbs which were too big, so they looked weird. I feel like only having 3 of each size isn’t enough. I wore these before taking the photo showing them all separated. I kept the ones I had worn and taken off to include them in their size group. Having only 3 of each size, if one size fits 2 different fingers, you’d need 4 so you wouldn’t have enough, which is an issue I had.

I don’t like that there’s only 2 sizes with nothing on them, both tiny, pinkie kind of size nails. Usually when I wear something - gems, designs, etc. on my nails, I either have the designs on my ring and pointer finger, just my ring finger, maybe my thumb as well. But not every finger. But with these you pretty much have to, except for your pinkie. The 2 sizes that have the other design on them (the 5 and 55 ones), those sizes are so darn close that it’s almost impossible to tell the difference. So it doesn’t give much choice to have those on different fingers either. I ended up putting them on my pointer finger. So every finger had a diamond gemstone except for the pointer fingers that had the other design and the pinkies that had nothing.

I like that the set comes with the stick for your cuticles, the nail file, and a alcohol swab. The nail file is great. The nails stick well. I used the cuticle stick to push back my cuticles, filed my nails, and then used the alcohol swab on them. Then I attached the nails. I used them as stick on ones, with the adhesive only. If you wanted them to last longer, you could use glue as well. I just wanted to test them out how they were so I only used the adhesive that’s on each nail. They stuck very well. The only issue I had was the size 1 ones that I used for my middle finger didn’t curve over my middle finger well, so the corner looked like it was sort of lifted. But it still stayed stuck on well and didn’t pop off throughout the 2 days I had them on, doing all the normal things I do every day. They probably would have lasted much longer, but I didn’t want them on anymore. I didn’t like how big the diamond gemstones were. I didn’t like they had the diamond gemstones on so many nails. As I said, I would have preferred only having them on the ring finger, maybe pointer finger, possibly thumb. But not all. I didn’t like the ones on my thumbs (the 0’s) looked so big since I had to use those on my thumbs instead of the 1’s since I had to use those on my middle fingers.

Overall, for $15.20 (at the time of writing this review), I don’t think they’re worth it at all. If you feel your fingers are the right size to have better options when choosing sizes, if you like bigger gemstones, if you like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then you would probably really enjoy these. Like I said, they apply well and stick well. But, if you’re like me and don’t like big gemstones on your nails and don’t like gemstones on pretty much every nail, then these probably aren’t for you. Honestly, I can get a set that has more size options and designs I really like at the drugstore for way less. So these just aren’t for me!

A Great Mascara AND A Great Lash Curler! I have pretty small, hooded eyes, so it’s hard to find a lash curler that works for my eyes. The biggest issue I have is them pinching my eye when I’m clamping down to curl them. I always have to lightly clamp down to see if I’ll pinch myself and, if I will, then adjust. Then, I end up having some parts not curled. I’d been looking for a new curler for a while, when I saw this I figured it was worth a try since I also got mascara.

Someone in the reviews had said the package came damaged. Mine also did. It wasn’t too bad, just seemed a little beat up. But, the products inside were completely fine and didn’t seem damaged at all, so I was okay with that.

I am very picky about my mascara. Well, not so much the mascara as I am the mascara wand. With my small, hooded eyes, it makes it so I end up with a lot of mistakes of the wand hitting below my lower lash line or onto my hood. So, I prefer thinner wands. I wasn’t sure what to expect with this mascara, but I was also getting a lash curler so I figured I’d hopefully like at least 1 of them. I’m happy to say that the mascara wand isn’t too thick. It’s not extremely thin, but still thin enough so it works for me. It also has a little bend to it, which helps with application. The mascara goes on very easily and doesn’t clump up after a few coats, which is great! It stays on all day without smearing. But, it also washes off easily at the end of the day, which I always love. It’s hard to find a mascara that stays all day without smearing or smudging, but is easy to wash off. So, it’s nice this does both!

The lash curler is amazing! It’s lightweight. It feels so nice. I love the red, black, and gold. It looks so fancy! It fits my eyes really well and curls my lashes AMAZINGLY without pinching my eyes at all! I’m really happy with it! It also comes with replacements for the rubber part on the curler, so that was great!

For $11.99 (at the time of writing this), it’s an amazing deal! You’re getting an amazing lash curler and an amazing mascara. You can’t beat that! If you’re looking for a great mascara, a great lash curler, or both, you should definitely give this a try!

Pretty Great! So far I’m really enjoying this! It comes with a dropper, which I like. It’s consistency isn’t too thick or thin. It glides on smoothly, and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue. It has no scent, which I also love.

I am 34 and still suffer from hormonal breakouts. When will they end?! 😤 I get them around my mouth and chin area. I’m always looking for something to help with the hormonal breakouts. Usually, I get a pimple or 2, it usually takes forever to go away, and a lot of times there’s a red dot left behind where it was that just seems to hang around forever, sometimes even after a new breakout has come there’s still a red mark where the old one(s) were! By the time the breakout finally goes away (at least mostly other than the red mark that sometimes stays), it’s time for another! Vicious cycle 😠 So, I’m always looking for something that will help! I’d love if I could find something that would keep the breakouts away completely...if anyone knows of that magic, please let me know!! But, I’d be happy with something that would help get the breakouts to go away faster and leave no marks. I also have some indentations (scars) where I had breakouts in the past and picked them (oh, if only my past younger self could know what I know now!). So, I’m always looking for something to help make those go away or at least lessen them.

This says it’s an intensive 21 day treatment. The product information on the product page says, “Achieve a flawless complexion in 21 days.” The company is even is so confident in that claim that it also says, “We're confident you'll see results in 21 days with our acne treatment. And if you’re ever unsatisfied, no worries! We back it up with a 100% guarantee!” That is a bold claim, and they are backing it up! So, when I saw that I definitely wanted to try it!

It doesn’t say exactly what you do AFTER you’ve used it for 21 days. I guess since they are guaranteeing a “flawless complexion” in those 21 days, so they didn’t feel the need to say what to do once those 21 days were over. 🤷‍♀️ I did see someone asked if they could continue using it after 21 days, and the company responded saying, “The optimal time is 21 days, but you may use it even longer, as you see fit.” So, that answered that question.

I have been using the serum for 21 days every night, and some days even in the morning. I did notice that my hormonal breakout wasn’t quite as bad, but I still got it. It did seem to go away slightly faster too. But, I definitely do NOT have a “flawless complexion.”

I honestly didn’t think I would get a “flawless complexion” after using this for 21 days. That is a pretty bold claim. I honestly don’t like the fact that they are making such a claim. That sets people up for disappointment if they really believe that using this for 21 days will give them a “flawless complexion.” The fact that they offer to backup that bold claim by offering a 100% refund if the person isn’t “satisfied with the results,” makes it a little better. But, I’m sure they know most people probably aren’t going to take the time to send it back after using it for 21 days. 🤷‍♀️ Even though I didn’t think I’d get a “flawless complexion” after using this for the full 21 days, I at least hoped it would help lessen the hormonal breakouts and help them go away quicker. It did seem to do that. Now, since my breakouts are hormonal, that might be a factor in why I still got them even while using this regularly. So, if you suffer from acne and it isn’t hormonal, it might heal up current breakouts and keep any future breakouts away. I can’t really speak to that.

So, if you see that this product is saying you’ll have a “flawless complexion” in 21 days and that’s why you’re getting it, I think you might be disappointed. But, if you have realistic expectations - that this will help lessen the breakouts and help heal them up a little quicker, then I think you’d like this. Overall, it helped lessen my hormonal breakouts, helped them go away a little quicker, and my skin seemed smoother and less red in the areas. So, I’m happy with the results. But, boy do I wish it really did give me that “flawless complexion!” 😉

Great Mask! A Lot of Product! These are great masks! There seems to be a lot of product on the masks, which I wasn’t sure I’d like at first. But, after using a few of them, it really seems like your face is getting the extra benefit of the extra product. With most sheet masks, there’s product on them, but once they sit on your face and you remove the mask, there’s only a little residue left, that you rub into your skin. With these masks, it seems like there was a lot left after. So, I rubbed it into my face after. With all the excess product, I feel like my skin is getting mote of the benefits. You can feel the bubbling, which feels interesting but in a good way!

The only weird thing I found was, with most sheet masks, you apply the mask, let it sit for the appropriate time, remove the mask, rub in any excess product left over, and you’re done. With these masks, however, the instructions say to re-wash your face after removing the mask. It says, “Apply the mask to face after cleaning. Remove it after 15-20 minutes. Re-clean skin until it is completely absorbed.” That makes zero sense to me. “Re-clean skin until it is completely absorbed” 🤷‍♀️ If you’re washing your face after removing the mask, the product won’t be absorbed, it will be washed off. So that makes no sense. I’m not sure what that’s about. So, I would leave the mask on for the 15-20 min, remove the mask, rub in the excess product for a minute, then rinse off my face.

I love that you get 10 masks! A lot of facial sheet masks you only get one or you get 10 but at a higher cost. So, I love you get 10 of these, and that they didn’t skimp at all on the product on the masks! I definitely recommend these!

I value reviews and always try to provide the kind of information I’d want to know about a product before making a purchase. So I hope that this did that for you and was helpful to you in making your decision! If so, please click “helpful” below!

Amazing! YouNeed This! I wasn’t sure about this at first because the product page says that it’s for “oily, trouble, acne prone skin.” I have normal to dry skin, more on the dry side. But, I do suffer from hormonal acne, so I figured I’d try it! And I am SOOOO glad that I did!

First of all, it has the cutest name - “I woke up like this” - and it comes in pink packaging! So I was a fan of that! It comes in a jar that has a seal on it, which I always appreciate. I usually prefer pumps and don’t care too much for jars because you have to put your fingers in, which can lead to bacteria getting in the jar and then you putting bacteria on your face when you use it again. BUT, they have a little spatula type tool that comes with it. So, you use that to scoop out what you need and don’t have to put your fingers in the jar. Such a nice touch! I’ve seen that before with more expensive moisturizers but not with such an affordable one! So that is amazing!

I’m honestly not sure why they call it a “cream.” To me, the texture is like a gel moisturizer. It has that thin, gel like kind of texture. And I’m not mad about it! A little goes a LOOOOONG way! The first time I used this, I applied how much I do of my normal moisturizers and it ended up being waaaaay too much! I had to wipe some off! So after that, I used way less and it worked out fine! So that’s even better since it’s a,ready affordable, but with such a little amount going such a long way, this will last you for a while.

It glides on the skin so smoothly and leaves you with a dewy face. It absorbs well. It doesn’t feel sticky or greasy after. I’ve been using it before makeup, and it works great! I haven’t had any issues with any makeup products I’ve put over it!

There’s no scent either, which I’m happy about, but honestly I love the way this works so much, I wouldn’t have cared if there was a scent! 😂

This is something I will DEFINITELY repurchase, and I will be sure to have backups on hand! I’m loving it that much!! If you have dry skin, don’t let the “for oily, trouble, acne prone skin” part scare you off and make you think this won’t work for you! It’s been amazing for my dry skin! I only get hormonal breakouts around my mouth and chin area, and other than my time of the month, I don't suffer from acne. So, even if you’re a dry skin person who gets acne sometimes, a dry skin person who never gets acne, doesn’t matter, this will work for you! I seriously recommend trying it out if you have dry skin and are looking for something to moisturize!

Such Pretty Extensions! These are really pretty. They look natural. Not shiny. They blend in well with my hair. I found that 1 set was enough, you couldn’t see the clips at all, and my hair isn’t really thick but not extremely thin. They’re easy to clip in and they feel like they’ll stay put, not loose at all.

One thing I didn’t like was that they were a pain to open from the packaging. They had plastic ties and netting and it was a pain getting it all off because I was afraid of damaging the extensions. But I worked slowly and was able to do it. Another thing was they got pretty tangled, but once I saw how long they were it wasn’t a huge surprise. As long as you brush them out good, they are okay.

If you’re looking for a little thicker, fuller, and/or longer hair, I’d recommend these! They are great quality for such an affordable price!

Pretty! This is a really pretty wig! Looks natural. Not too much shine. It’s long. Thick enough, but not where it’s heavy. Covers the wig cap well. The color is pretty too.

It’s long so it can get tangled up easily. But if you brush it out well, it isn’t too bad, and you can run your fingers through it to easily get the tangled out too. It doesn’t shed much. It shed a few hairs when I first took it out and brushed it, but that was it. The picture is of me wearing it right after taking it out and brushing it.

I think this is a great wig if you want something that’s affordable but good quality.

Okay... I wanted these because they looked short. I love fake nails, but hate really long ones. And most are so long. So, I liked that these were on the shorter side.

I like the French manicure look. They look beautiful. However, I do not like the rhinestones. I thought that they’d be smaller. But they are so big. If they fall off, it’s pretty noticeable....and they do fall off.

They come with an alcohol wipe, nail file, and stick to clean under your nails and push your cuticles back. If you use the alcohol pad, file your nails, and push your cuticles back, these last a decent amount of time. However, a lot of them didn’t fit the curve of my nails so the sides kept lifting up on some. That was pretty annoying and those areas just wouldn’t stick down. Also, not many of the nails fit well. So, in the product photo, the nails with rhinestones are on the thumb, pointing finger, and middle finger. I usually prefer my nails with accents (like rhinestones to either be on the thumb and ring finger or pointer and ring finger, not the first 3). I couldn’t find a nail to fit my middle finger, except for one with rhinestones so I ended up with rhinestones I’m the first 4 fingers, and I just didn’t like the look of that. It seems like you don’t have many options for fit with these nails. And I didn’t like how big the rhinestones were. So these just aren’t for me.

Great Tools! These are great! I had used a Jade roller before, but never a Gua Sha, so I really appreciated that these came with a little pamphlet telling you how to use them.

The Jade roller is great quality. It doesn’t squeak at all. Rolls nicely, without any skipping or sticking. The bigger side is great for your whole face, and the smaller side works perfect for under your eyes.

I love using this to rub in any oils or serums I’m using. Sometimes I will put this in the refrigerator to get it cold, and then use it. It feels so nice on! It’s really relaxing whether you use it cold or room temp.

I definitely recommend this set! It’s so affordable but so well made!

My First Nail Drill and I Love It! This was my first nail drill and I love it!

It comes well packaged. It’s in a box, and everything is in it nicely.

I’ve been doing my own nails, and wanted a drill to make it easier. I was a little scared since I’d never used one on myself before. This one was so easy! It comes with instructions. It’s so easy to work! It is easy to hold and maneuver, it isn’t too big or heavy. It doesn’t get too hot. I love that all the controls for the drill are on the power cord, so I don’t accidentally hit anything and end up hurting myself while I’m using the drill! I love how it comes with so many attachments! It even comes with a little brush so you can dust off any dust. The one thing I wish is that it had a standard plug, rather than a USB. It seems so many things are USB plugs now though, so it is what it is. But, if it had the standard plug, it would have been perfect! Other than that, I have no complaints!

The ease of use and compact size make this perfect for a beginner like me!

EDIT: There’s no switch or anything to remove the different heads. You just need to pull it out. They push in easy enough, but my goodness are they hard to pull out! It makes sense since you’d been using it and it was rotating. So I wish there was some kind of switch to make it easier to take out the heads. So I’m taking off 1 star because of that.
Great Quality! Love this comb! The tail end of the comb works great to section hair. The teeth of the comb are spaced evenly apart. It feels sturdy.

Very Gentle This a really nice serum! It comes in a sturdy glass bottle with a dropper.

Even though this has glycolic acid in it, it isn’t harsh. I don’t have sensitive skin but some glycolic acid products I’ve used have made my skin red while it’s on and I would feel slight tingling. But with this one, I don’t get that at all. So I love that it’s a glycolic acid product that give me the benefits of glycolic acid, but is gentle enough to use every day.

My skin feels smoother. I haven’t noticed any fading of spots, but I’m hopeful with continued use I will! So I will update this review if I notice any fading or if I don’t!

I’ve tried a few products from this brand so far and have really enjoyed all of them! So I would recommend giving this a try!

Great Clips! These are great! You get 20 for $7.99 (at the time of writing this review) which I think is a great deal! They are easy to open and close but clamp tightly onto the finger. They are so helpful when doing poly gel nails! They keep the mold in place, keeping it flat against the nail bed without any bubbling, giving me a smooth poly gel nail! I’m so glad I got these! They’re definitely one of those things you don’t really think you needed until you get them, then you’re wondering how you ever did it without them! If you like doing poly gel nails, these are a great help!

STRONG Smell, Couldn’t Get Past The Smell to Really Use It Other Than a Drop on My Hand When this first arrived, I was going to open the amazon packaging and I could smell a strong, medicine like scent. So, I immediately thought that it must have broken in transit. Once I opened the amazon shipping package, there was a box inside. There wasn’t anything all over the box, so I opened it, and inside was a glass bottle completely intact. I couldn’t understand why the scent was so strong if the bottle was intact. Then, I thought if I can smell it that strong now, I wonder how it’ll be using it. The scent of the packaging had such a strong medicine kind of pepper smell, it was really overpowering.

Inside the box, there’s a product info card. It has the product on one side with what benefits it’s supposed to have. The other side has specific instructions on how and when to use, and a full list of ingredients. I really liked that!

The product comes in a glass bottle with a dropper. The bottle seems nice and durable. The product itself is a orange-yellowish color. I applied a little to the top of my hand and it felt oily. Someone in another review said it felt oily but they expected that since it was an oil. I’m not sure if they were talking about this product or another one. This is called a serum, so I don’t really expect it to be oily. I’m not sure if it’s some kind of serum, oil combo? I have dry skin so the oiliness wasn’t too bad for me. But, I could still feel it, so if I had oily skin I probably wouldn’t even want to use it.

Anyways, the most use I could get out of it was the little I put on the top of my hand. The scent was so strong, it made me a little sick to my stomach. I’m not usually sensitive to smells, so it must have just been this specific scent - it had a medicinal, pepper type smell. I don’t really know how to describe it, but it wasn’t for me. So, unfortunately I can’t really say whether or not this is a good product. All I can say is that it comes in a nice glass bottle with a dropper, has a really strong scent, and it feels oily. If you’re sensitive to smells, I would say this isn’t for you.

Bad Smell, Don’t Wipe Off Makeup Easily They come in a nice little disposable pack. Theres a plastic area where the top opens and closes. The opening for the wipes wasn’t big enough. It had the little plastic opening with the split in the middle, and it was just TINY! I ended up cutting the plastic part off, and then the opening was big enough.

The wipes are a good size. They are nice and soft. However, they have a weird smell - like cardboard? I don’t know. I can’t really place it, but I don’t like it.

The wipes aren’t too wet. I do a lot of makeup swatches of eyeshadow palettes and things like that. So, I constantly am using makeup wipes to wipe the swatches off of my arms. These work good for that. I wouldn’t use them on my face because, while they’re wet enough to wipe the swatches off my arms, I need to rub more than I do with my usual wipes. Given that, I wouldn’t want to use them on my face where I’d need to rub hard, pulling my skin. It’s not good to use makeup wipes to remove your makeup anyways, since it can tug at your skin and because they usually don’t remove all of your makeup. I still sometimes like to use makeup wipes to wipe the majority of my makeup off, then go in and cleanse my face. But, again, I just wouldn’t use these for that. With the odd smell and needing to rub more to get the makeup off, I wouldn’t want to use these on my face. But, for getting the swatches off my arms they work good.

So, for purposes of wiping swatches off my arm, they work good enough. As I said earlier, with the weird smell and them being not that wet, causing me to need to rub harder, I just wouldn’t use them on my face.

Came With No Safety Seal, Cream Leaked Everywhere, Leaving Jar Half Empty...Disappointing This comes in a cute pink box, and a cute jar with pink on it. The cap twists off.

Unfortunately, when I received it and was taking it out, I noticed the box had cream all over it. When I opened the box, there was cream all over the jar. When I opened the jar, there was no protective seal (which I’m guessing it how it was able to spill in the first place), and it looked like about half the product was gone (unless it wasn’t completely full to begin with 🤷‍♀️). With no protective seal, I wouldn’t feel comfortable using it on my face. But with the way the world is right now, I definitely don’t feel comfortable using it on my face. That, along with the fact that it had leaked everywhere, I just wasn’t comfortable trying it.

I can say that it has a nice, light scent. And I did rub some onto my hand and it felt nice and creamy, not too thick, and absorbed easily. But, unfortunately, that’s all I can say about it.

I really think if a company is going to produce cosmetic/skin care products, they should include safety seals. Yes, the jar comes in a box, but anything could have gotten in the jar before it was placed into that box. I don’t know anyone that doesn’t feel a little uncomfortable when a cosmetic/skin care product doesn’t have a safety seal. It’s really disappointing because I was really looking forward to trying this.

Great Palette! Great Dupe! [[VIDEOID:f3800eaac90f72192ba79de85cf049ce]] This comes very well packaged. Protected on a lot of bubble wrap. With how often eyeshadow palettes come with broken shadows, I always appreciate when one comes with extra care taken to protect it! The palette has cardboard packaging. There’s an outer sleeve cover. It has the exact same look on the front and back on the outer sleeve cover as it does on the outer packaging of the palette. The shade names are found on the back of the palette and are also labeled under each shade inside the palette, which I like. A lot of affordable palettes, they don’t have the shade names inside, which is usually fine with me because it’s so affordable and they have to cut costs somewhere. So, when the shade names are included inside the palette on affordable palettes, I always appreciate it. There’s also a big mirror that is just a little smaller than the lid. Again, a lot of affordable palettes don’t have mirrors, which is another way to cut costs for the companies to make the palette a cheaper price. Again, not something I mind since it’s affordable. So, again, when I see mirrors in affordable palettes, I appreciate it. There’s also a removable plastic sheet cover over the shades inside the palette.

The shades are all beautiful. (See photos of swatches).

The mattes have good pigment, feel smooth, not chalky at all. Brushes pick them up well and they apply on the eyes nicely. A few shades need built up a little more, but not too much where I get annoyed 😂

The shimmers/metallics are smooth, pigmented, and pretty shimmery. A brush picks them up easily, and they apply easily and look beautiful using fingers or brushes.

There’s 2 pressed glitters. 1 of them isn’t small circular kind of glitters. It’s small stars. I don’t really love when pressed glitters are in a palette. I have a love hate relationship with glitter. Love the look of it, hate how it gets EVERYWHERE, you’re finding glitter particles everywhere for a while after you use it. Plus, they aren’t safe for the eyes. Get some in the eye and you can scratch your cornea! But, smaller glitter particles aren’t too bad in my opinion. However, with the one in this palette that has stars, those would be waaaaaay more risky than smaller circular like glitter particles. The stars are bigger and have extremely pointy edges. Plus, it’s hard to pick up with your finger. So, I really don’t like that pressed glitter. The other pressed glitter is made up of tiny particles. It picks up easily, sticks pretty good on its own, great with a wet base like concealer or glitter glue. So, I don’t like that 2 shades are pressed glitters, but the palette is so affordable, 2 I don’t like and probably won’t use out of the 18 isn’t so bad to me.

There’s 1 shade that is a concealer shade. It’s a cream kind of concealer. I fear it would dry out, so I’ll be putting a piece of tape over it, with the edge bent over together to leave a little tab to pull it up if I want to use it (I did this with my Huda New Nude palette and the concealer shade hasn’t dried up). The shade is pretty thin and waxy feeling. I don’t feel I’ll ever really use it, but just in case figure I’d keep it from drying out.

This is a dupe for Hudas New Nude palette (see swatch photos comparing the 2).
- They even have the shades named the exact same as the shades in Hudas palette, except one that is named “Spanked” in Huda is named “Spaked” in this palette and one that is named “Love Bite” in Huda is names “EITE” in this palette 🤦‍♀️ 😂 (see photos to see both palettes together).
- All of the shades and their placement in this palette correspond exactly to the shades and their placement in Hudas palette, except the shades “Spanked” and “Love Bite,” and “Concealed” and “Play.” In both palettes, “Spanked” and “Love Bite” are in the first row, the last 2. But, in this palette it’s, “Spaked” and “Love Bite” and in the Huda palette it’s “Love Bite” and “Spanked.” In the Huda palette, “Concealed” is the concealer shade and “Play” is a light peach matte shade. In this palette “Concealed” is a nude type shade, that has a little peachy color to it and “Play” is the concealer shade. So, in the Huda palette there’s a light peach matte shade called “Play” that this palette does not have (this palette has a nude with a slight peach tint to it).
- Other than that, the shades are pretty spot on. In the Huda palette, the metallics feel just a little creamier, but not by much. In this palette they feel really smooth, not chunky at all. As you can see in the swatches, the metallic shades aren’t quite as metallic as they are in the Huda palette, but they are pretty darn close. The colors of all the shades are also pretty darn close. I’d say the shade that’s most off, other than the light peach matte shade not being a full on peach shade and more of a nude shade with a peach tint in this palette, the other shade that’s the most off is “Kinky.” In the Huda palette it’s a deeper, richer red. In this palette it’s more of a burnt orange type red or rust kind of red. You can see in the swatches. Then, the “Concealed” shade in the Huda palette, the corresponding shade in this palette is “Play.” The Huda one is creamier, and has more color. As I said before, the one in this palette is thinner and waxy feeling. The pressed glitters - “Excite” is made of small, red glitter particles in both palettes. The Huda one is smoother feeling, not so rough feeling. “Infatuated” in this palette is totally different than Hudas, it’s silver and stars, not red with small glitter particles.

Overall, I think this is a great palette. Good packaging, a nice mirror inside. The shades perform well. The mattes are smooth and blend easily and have good pigment. The metallic shades are smooth and pigmented and look beautiful. If you were looking for a nude/pink palette, this is a great choice! If you have been wanting the Huda palette but didn’t like the cost of it, this is a great choice instead. The colors are pretty spot on, the differences are slight where once they’re on the eye, it wouldn’t be too noticeable. Other than the star pressed glitter and the nude shade with some peach in it. This palette would definitely give you the same looks. I really do think it’d a great affordable palette!

Cute! Feels Nice! But Mirror Arrived Out In Corner This comes wrapped in bubble wrap well. The front of it is a glossy pink. Inside it is glossy black, with the glossy pink bordering the edges. There’s a nice big mirror inside.

When mine arrived, the mirror in it was coming out in one corner. Normally, when products come damaged and it can be from shipping, I don’t really complain about it in a review. Things get damaged and shipping, and most times if you contact the seller or Amazon, they will handle it well. However, this doesn’t seem to be something that happened in shipping. I feel like if it had just come loose during shipping, I’d be able to push the mirror back in. But, I wasn’t able to push it back in at all. I tried really hard, but it wouldn’t budge. So, I think it was just manufactured that way. Thankfully, the mirror wasn’t broken. But, there are small cracks in the area. So, that’s a bummer. But, the palette is still magnetic and does what I wanted it to do.

The palette has weight to it. Since the mirror was popped out some, I was able to see it’s pretty thick. I’m guessing that along with the magnetic area is where the weight comes from. Maybe they should have used a thinner mirror so it stayed in the lid better. The magnetic area is a decent size, where you can fit a good amount of eyeshadows, blush, bronzer, etc. into it. They adhere well and don’t fall out when moving the palette around.

Overall, I think this is a great magnetic palette. It’s simple but cute. I wish the mirror came in it properly and without cracks, but it’s still usable. Due to the mirror, I’m giving 4 stars.

Provides Great Coverage. Feels Nice On Skin & Looks Smooth! This comes with an outer product box. It has the same appearance as the tube of foundation - black with white wording. There’s also a little rectangle in the shade, with the shade number and name. The product packaging looks nice. It comes with a product card saying they love to hear from you and 2 samples for hair products (which I thought was odd for hair products with foundation, but whatever 😂) - 1 for “RG II Hair Loss Clinic Premium Shampoo” and 1 for “Sohair Morocco Argan Oil Hair Essence.” I didn’t try either of the samples so can’t say anything for how those work.

The foundation comes in a squeeze tube. When you twist off the main top, there’s a protective seal. I usually like pumps with my foundations. But, I don’t mind this being a squeeze tube. It isn’t messy at all. I just squirt some out onto my brush or sponge, dab it in areas on my face, then blend it out.

They don’t have a large range of shade options - there’s only 2. With BB & CC creams, they’re usually so thin that a shade that’s a little off from you is usually still okay. I got the shade “#1 Light Beige.” I’m pretty pale. I can make the shade work for me, but I do wish it was a tad lighter. See my photos. I did a photo showing a drop of this Bb Cream, then a swatch doing 1 swipe with a small amount on my finger, then took what was left on my finger from the swatch and dabbed it and blended it out. I also show a photo of a swatch of this BB Blemish Cream, where I also show some blended out. Then I compared it to a swatch of L’Oréal Infallible Pro Glow in 201 Classic Ivory and Maybelline 24 Hr Foundation in 102 Fair Porcelain (I tried to use foundations most people might have tried). As you can see, both are lighter than this BB Blemish Cream. The Maybelline is MUCH lighter. I’m pretty pale, but even that one is a tad too pale for me, so I always have to warm it up with bronzer. But, this BB Blemish Cream is definitely on the darker side for me, but I’m able to make it work.

The formula feels nice. It isn’t too thin or runny. It feels nice and creamy. On the product info page it said, “BB Cream Tinted Moisturizer Blemish Balm lets you perfectly blend & build tones from sheer to medium coverage.” Most BB creams I’ve tried are usually sheer to light, not able to go up to medium coverage. But, this actually provides a lot more coverage than I expected with a BB cream! I usually don’t go for BB/CC creams that often because they’re such light coverage. But, there’s times when I want lighter coverage and was looking for a new BB/CC cream and figured I’d give this a try. I’m really glad I did! It evens out my skin tone like I’d expect with a BB cream, but also provides decent coverage too. It doesn’t feel dry on my skin. You can also build it up too if you want, and it doesn’t look dry or cakey. I’d say you can get anywhere from really light coverage (like just evening out your skin tone and maybe covering small, light spots with a thin layer) to good medium coverage (if you build it up some). It builds up nicely enough where it might even be considered full coverage to some, but for me I consider it medium coverage 😂 I can’t build it up too much on myself because the color isn’t a good enough match for me. The more I build it up, the more it doesn’t match my skin. So, when I use this since it’s not really light enough for me, I can only use a thin layer of it. But, I did build it up just to test it out for this review and it looks nice and smooth on the skin whether you’re doing a light layer or building it up.

Overall, I think this is a really great BB cream! It gives you more coverage than other BB creams I’ve tried. I like the squeeze tube. The product feels and looks nice on the skin. I definitely recommend giving this a try if you’re looking for something that will give you light to medium coverage while looking nice, smooth, and not dry or cakey.

Gorgeous!! Such A Great Set! [[VIDEOID:a7c1d14af37e75840e647b8774b319cb]] I have been wanting to get a variety of different liquid glitter eyeshadows, but I kept only finding them where you have to buy them individually. I was happy to see this set of 4!

These liquid glitter eyeshadows are GORGEOUS!

They come in a product box. The tubes of product have gold caps and clear tubes, so you can see the shade. The brand name and logo is on the front of the tubes in gold. The applicator is a nice sized doe foot - not too big for my small eyes, but big enough. These are short tubes, so the applicator is short. But, it’s still easy to hold and maneuver. The shade number and name are on a sticker on the bottom of the tube.

You get 4
- 001 Mauve Plum - Mauve liquid shadow with silver glitter.
- 002 Rosy Gold - Rose gold liquid shadow with silver glitter.
- 003 Silver Flash - White liquid shadow with silver glitter
- 004 Sparkle Midnight - Black liquid shadow with silver glitter.

They all look so beautiful. The shimmer with them looks even with application. You can layer them well. They don’t take too long to dry. They lasted well on my hooded eyes without creasing (that is, no more than what I normally get with any eyeshadow). When the light hits these they look so beautiful.

I show photos of swatches - I did 1 swipe for each color. Then I did little areas where I layered the colors to show how they built up. I also did a video showing them.

I think this is such a great set! To get 4 liquid glitter shadows for $13.99 (at the time of writing this review), I think that’s a great deal! All other liquid glitter shadows I’ve found were sold individually and buying 4 would have been way more than this set costs! I’m definitely going to be using these up and hoping they’ll come out with additional colors soon!!

Beautiful Colors! These come together in a little pink box with gold writing and a clear window in the middle showing the glitter shadows inside. There’s a clear plastic sticker sealing the box closed. The back of the box has the ingredients on it.

Inside the box, the glitter shadow tubes are separated by a cardboard piece that has cutouts with separators for between each tube (see photos).

Each tube is clear with “Amber Dazzle” written in gold on the front of the tubes. The cap is silver with clear casing around it. The top of the caps has a gold circle in the middle (see photos). The bottom of each tube has a sticker with the shade name.

Each tube is a good size. Like the size of a full size lip gloss. The applicator is a doe foot applicator. It’s flat on each side, with a rounded tip.

All of the shades are beautiful. They are pretty pigmented with just 1 layer. But can also be built up nicely. See my photos - I did a photo of swatches that were just 1 layer. Then I did another photo of swatches that were 2 layers, where I did a layer, let it dry, and then did another layer.

I had been looking for glitter liquid shadows for a while, but it’s hard to find them as sets and be affordable. Most times I found them as singles and getting multiple ones got pretty pricey. So, when I saw this set I was excited! I’m glad I tried it! You get 6 tubes. They’re all big tubes (like the size of a full size lip gloss). Most liquid glitter shadows I have are tubes half the size of these! So this is great! Plus, you get such an assortment!

You get “Blue Night,” which is a beautiful bright blue. It doesn’t seem like it has glitter in it, just metallic look to it.

“Emerald,” is a beautiful green shade that doesn’t seem to have glitter in it, just metallic.

“Red Wine,” I’m not sure why it’s called “Red Wine.” I guess it’s kind of red. But to me it looks more like a rose gold. It does have glitter in it, but has more of a metallic look overall. The glitter I’m not sure if it’s gold or a rose gold color, but it blends in well.

“Black Moon” is a beautiful dark silver shade. When it’s built up, it looks like it has a black base with silver. It has silver glitter in it.

“Golden Goddess” is a beautiful gold shade with gold glitter.

“Silver Lining,” to me, it looks more like a cream shade, kind of like a white gold, with I think gold and silver glitter, so I guess that’s where the “silver” comes in.

Like I said, I think they are all really beautiful! I think you get a great amount of product. The packaging is nice. They work really well and build up really well. They last good. I think this is a great option if your looking for glitter liquid shadows!

Beautiful Shades! Good Formula! These come in a cute little red product box sealed with plastic wrapping. The back has a sticker on the plastic wrapping that has the ingredients listed (see photos). The box has “To be a sexy lady surprise yourself” on the front along with a red heart sticker that seals the lid and says “Surpise!” Then, under that it says “She Loves” and below that says “True Love Classic Velvet Lip Gloss.” It’s really cute outer packaging. Once you remove the outer plastic wrapping, the back of the box just has a bunch of Chinese writing (see photos), so I like they at least put that sticker on the back on the outside of the plastic wrapping.

The tubes are really small, but cute. They are a kind of matte white with “SHE LOVES” written in silver holographic letters going all around the top. The caps are matte and the color of shade of lipstick, and the bottom of each tube has a sticker that’s the color of the shade of lipstick and the number for the shade. The caps twist off and there’s a doe foot applicator. For some reason when I first went to open one, I pulled on the cap. It came right off, revealing a black cap (see photos). Luckily the cap cover went right back on and stayed on without issues. But, kind of weird it comes off like that. Like it’s not glued on or something? So, of course, I then had to see if they all pulled off like that....they did (see photos). 2 of them I thought weren’t going to come off (I was just pulling lightly, I didn’t want to force them off), but then they came off too. But, again, I’m just glad they went back on and stayed on without issue.

The tubes are small, so the doe foot applicators are small (see photos). The doe foot applicators are thin, longer rectangle shape, flat on each side. I liked them. They were small, but still easy enough to handle.

The colors are all extremely pigmented. They are all nice and smooth. They go on evenly. They don’t take long to dry. They last a good amount of time.

The only downside I see is the tubes are white, so they can get dirty easy. If you have them in your purse or makeup drawer, they will probably end up getting dirty. Also, the caps coming off like they do, like they aren’t glued on good. But other than that, I think it’s a really cute set!

Great Set! Good Way To Try Touch In Sol Primers! I had tried the no poreblem primer before when I got it in a boxy charm. I liked it, but didn’t love it. But, I’d always wanted to try their other products but never had. So when I saw this set I figured it was the perfect time! I love travel sized products, so you can try the product to see if you like it!

I really liked the priming essence and priming water. They worked way better for my dry skin than the no poreblem primer did. The no poreblem primer feels too silicone for me. The priming essence and priming water both feel so light but hydrating and my makeup looks so much better when I use one of them!

If you’ve been wanting to try Touch In Sol primers, this is a great way to try some of them! This would also work as a great gift with how cute it’s packaged!

Great Ingredients! Hydrating! This comes with minimal packaging, which I appreciate (I hate getting some tiny little item in some big box!). This comes in cute little pink bubble mailer. It’s come with a pump. This is made in the US. It’s “Korean inspired, American made.” It has no parabens, fragrances, GMO, or allergens, and is cruelty free.

The pump works well. It disperses a good amount of product, but not too much. The product is a nice, thin cream. It glides onto the skin easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky or tacky feeling or residue of any kind.

This has a lot of good ingredients like organic aloe, hyaluronic acid, jojoba, Shea butter, and retinol. These good ingredients are high on the list of ingredients too.

Overall, I think this is a great product. It feels good on the skin and my skin feels hydrated. It isn’t too pricey and a little goes a long way. I can’t speak to any long term results since I haven’t been using it long. But, so far I like it. I would recommend trying this!

Extremely Gentle! Very Hydrating! This comes in a product box. The bottle is a pump bottle. The product itself is white, a medium consistency cream feel.

It’s very gentle. It doesn’t lather up at all. You just move the product around on your face to get off any makeup or whatever. I always double cleanse, but if I didn’t, this isn’t something I’d use to remove makeup. This is something I’d use in my double cleanse - I use a makeup removing oil to remove my makeup, rinse that off, and then use this cleanser. This is marketed for people with sensitive skin, and I would definitely say it’s very gentle. I’m not saying this wouldn’t clean off makeup, but personally since it doesn’t lather up, I just wouldn’t feel like my face is totally clean just using this. But, I already always double cleanse anyways, and I like how gentle this is so I’m not overly stripping my face.

This is such a nice, gentle cleanser. After using it, my face doesn’t feel stripped or dry. Usually, after I wash my face it feels tight and dry and I need to put on moisturizer. After using this, my face doesn’t feel that way. I don’t feel like I HAVE to apply moisturizer.

Overall, I think this is a great choice for a gentle cleanser! If you’re looking for something extremely gentle, I’d definitely recommend this!

Breakouts Cleared Up Quicker & Seems to Keep Breakouts Away! This comes with an outer product box. The tube is a squeeze tube that has a cap that flips open and closed.

The box says that this is “for dry to normal skin with light to moderate acne.” It says, “sulfur-enhanced benzoyl peroxide penetrates deeply to loosen pore-clogging debris and hardened oils while killing bacteria and soothing inflammation. This has 5% benzoyl peroxide in it as the active ingredient and 3% sulfur as an inactive ingredient to fight acne. I really liked that it listed the percentage of each in the product.

This is a medium consistency cream. It glides onto the skin easily, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any stickiness or residue. It says to apply this sparingly to affected areas once or twice daily as needed. It says that dryness and light peeling may occur during the first few weeks of usage. I used this as instructed, sparingly on affected areas, and chose to sometimes use it twice a day and sometimes only once a day. If I was going out and wearing makeup, I didn’t apply this in the morning, only at night. If I wasn’t going to be wearing makeup and was staying home, then I applied it twice a day (morning and night). I don’t have sensitive skin. I have normal to dry skin, with some areas extremely dry. Usually when I use heavy duty acne fighting products, I get a lot of dryness in the area. I did have slight dryness in the areas I used this if I used it twice a day for a few days in a row. Like one time, I used this twice a day for 4 days in a row. I got a little bit of dryness in the areas I used it in, but after not using this product and applying a good moisturizer morning and night on the area for 2 days, the dryness was gone. After that, I didn’t use this twice a day for more than 3 days in a row. Once I started making sure to do that, I didn’t experience any more dryness.

I really liked the results with this! It really helped my breakouts go away a lot quicker than they do on their own or with other products I’ve used in the past. I also felt this helped keep breakouts away because I usually suffer from hormonal breakouts, but I started using this in those areas before I would usually get a hormonal breakout, and I didn’t get one! So, while this is on the pricier end for me, it’s definitely something I’ll purchase when I run out! And it’s definitely something I recommend if you’re suffering from breakouts!

Great Set! Makes Fixing Makeup Easy! This kit is so cool! I’m a huge makeup lover. With that comes sometimes getting palettes I order online that come with broken pans or having palettes I own end up with broken pans. I would always repress them myself, but it always bothered me because they never looked quite the same afterwards. I also like to de-pot singles and put them in magnetic palettes, and it can be complicated and/or I can end up breaking the product. I didn’t even know they made sets like this, but, when I saw this, I needed to try it!

There’s a medium sized magnetic palette in plastic wrapping and then the fix kit in a small box. When you open the box, you’ll take out a plastic box, a small magnetic palette in plastic wrapping, and the makeup repair solution in plastic wrapping. So, you ask, where are the rest of the parts? They fit together in that plastic box! It makes it nice and compact so everything is all together but not taking up a bunch of room. The plastic box, you lift off the main lid, you’ll see a layer that has a strainer type thing in the center and a layer that has 3 circular areas filled with black. You remove the plastic layer with the 3 circular areas, and it reveals 3 black cylinder tower type things. You can lift the layer with the sifter, which will reveal just a bottom plastic part of the plastic box. In the bottom, you’ll find a plastic bag that has the empty tin pans in different sizes - you get 3 sets of 3 sizes. I thought it was nice to get 3 sets of the different sizes. You also get 2 black tools to help put the powder products into the pans or circular areas to flatten them.

Overall, I think this an amazing kit! Is it something anyone who uses makeup needs? No. Especially when everything you can do with this kit, you can DIY without it. But, this kit does make the process easier. So, if you’re a huge makeup lover, order a lot of makeup products online (where you could end up getting broken pans), travel a lot where your products tend to break, just end up with broken products at home, or de-pot products a lot - then I’d say this would be a great kit for you or as a gift for someone who know who fits those things! Again, it’s not something you NEED. But, it’s definitely something that makes things easier!

Feel Soft and Creamy! Not too Pigmented But Do Build Up Well! These come in an outer product box that is sealed in clear plastic wrapping. Once you remove the plastic wrapping, the product box has an open window in the front where you can see the eyeshadow shadow sticks (see photos). The back of the box lists the ingredients be the manufacturer (in China). It also has the cruelty free bunny logo. (See photos)

The eyeshadow sticks are all in black tubes. They have the brand name “Luxaza” along with the name of the shade on the front written in the shade of the shadow stick. There’s black lids on one end and a clear lid on the other end. Under the clear lid, there’s a brush. Now...it was really weird with the brush end. First, I went to pull off the clear cap, and it wouldn’t pull off. So I thought maybe it was screw off, so when I tried to twist it, I heard the clicking sound like the crayon part was twisting out, which I didn’t want since I still had the cap on that end. I then pulled really hard and the clear cap came off. Then, I brushed my finger across the tip of the brush to feel it, and it looked like a bunch of powder came flying off of it. So I thought maybe I missed somewhere where it said the other end of the shadow stick had a powder brush. So, I went to the product page to see and it doesn’t say anything about powder. It was just what I initially thought, that it’s a brush to blend out the shadow stick. So, I brushed my finger across the tip of the brush again to see if more powder came off and none did. So, I then took the clear cap off another shadow stick and brushed my finger across the tip of that brush to see if powder would come off...none did. Then I went through doing that with all the other shadow sticks and no powder type stuff came off of those. So I don’t know what it was with that first one...or if I’m just crazy which is entirely possible too 😂 Anyways, the brush feels nice and soft. It’s short and dense, but still a little fluffy, so blends out color well. Like I said, the clear cap is a little tough to remove...I really had to pull to get it off each shadow stick. Also, you need to be careful when putting the cap back on because the hairs of the brush get in the way.

The crayon part you don’t need to sharpen. It twists up. You twist the end with the brush. There’s not too much product in the tube. I twisted them all the way up to see. It ends up looking to be less than half the size of the tube (see photos, I took a photo of one twisted all the way up). They do feel smooth and creamy. They aren’t very pigmented. To get the pigment you see in my swatches, I needed to go over them each quite a few times (about 5 times). Most are shimmers. 2 of them have glitter particles in them (“Mermaid Teardrop” and “Purple Sunset”). The glitter isn’t too bad, it doesn’t fall out and leave glitter particles everywhere. But, like any glitter, when you try to remove it, you will see glitter particles randomly afterwards (anyone who have used anything with any glitter in it knows what I mean....it’s just everywhere! 😂). I do think that a few of the colors are so similar you don’t notice a difference on the eyes. Especially “Dark Orchid” and “Dark Magenta.” I just don’t notice much difference between them. The brush on the other end blends them out well. They last okay on my eyes. I have really hooded eyes, so any type of cream shadow usually creases and wears off within a few hours. These were no different when I used them on their own. But, if I used them together with powder eyeshadow, they lasted well.

Overall, you get 6 shadow sticks for $9.99 (at the time of writing this review). If these are colors you like and you want just a wash of color, I’d say go for it! They are smooth and creamy. If you’re looking for something with really good pigment, you’re going to have to really build these up for good pigment. Since there’s other cream stick shadows out there that are much more pigmented without needing to build them up, I wouldn’t really recommend these if you want something with a lot of pigment without needing built up.

Works Great! Dries Nails Fast! This comes packaged in a nice box and well protected.

It’s a good size. It’s 128 watt! So it has great power! It dries your nails quickly! It has a digital display. The plug is a standard prong plug, which I love! So many products have USB plugs nowadays. I always appreciate when a product has a standard plug!

The shiny gold appearance of it is a little gaudy for my taste. But, I hadn’t seen an at home nail lamp with this high of wattage before, so I was willing to have the shiny gold if I got the high wattage. It actually didn’t look too gaudy once I got used to it.

Overall, I’m very happy! I think you get a great lamp, that works great with such a high wattage.

Great Set! Variety, Tools, and Labels! This comes packaged nicely. It’s all in a little plastic resealable zip lock bag. The bag is thin plastic, but feels durable.

There’s 2 small plastic jars. They have clear bottoms and pink lids. The tops screw off, which is nice so the kids won’t easily come off. There’s 2 spray bottles, one a little bit smaller than the other. They are clad bottoms with pink tops and clear lids. There’s 1 pump bottle. It is a clear bottom with a pink top, and it has the little clip that stops the pump from going down. That’s a really nice addition! Since these are travel bottles, with a pump there’s always a risk it can get pushed down when traveling and make a mess. So, it’s really nice that the little clip was included. There’s 1 squeeze tube. It has a frosted bottom and a pink top. The lid flips open. There’s also a clear spatula and a little funnel to help fill the bottles. There’s also little clear stickers that can be used as labels. They have it written in Chinese and English. There’s labels like “Moisturizer,” “Mouth Wash,” “Hand Cream,” etc.

They all seem durable enough. They are decent sizes. You get a good assortment, a little bag to hold them all, tools, and labels. I think it’s a great little set!

Work Well. Feel A Little Flimsy These come packaged in a kind of sealed plastic bag. They are easy to put together.

They feel a little flimsy. They hold my shoulder length wigs fine. But, with how flimsy they are, I’m not sure how well they’d hold really heavy wigs.

I show 1 photo that shows the 2 wig stands - One has my brown bob wig on it and the other has my pink shoulder length wig on it. The wig stands are pretty short. As you can see in the photos, the one with both the wigs stands in it (that has my brown bob wig and pink shoulder length wig), you can see the bottom of the brown bob wig is almost touching the table and the bottom of the pink shoulder length wig is bunched a little on the table. The 2nd photo is comparing the size of these wig stands to the size of another wig stand I have. The pink shoulder length wig is on one of these stands, the black shoulder length wig is on a different wig stand. You can see that this wig stand is a lot shorter than the other. So, if you were wanting to have these stand on a surface and hold long wigs, be aware they will be touching the surface of the table.

They do come with an attachment that allows you to hang the wig stand. So, if you’re using these stands for longer wigs and don’t want the wigs touching the surface, you could hang them.

Overall, I think these are nice wig stands. They are a little flimsy and pretty short. But, they get the job done.

Beautiful Glitters! These come together in a nice box that flips open at the top. There’s styrofoam at the top protecting the bottles. There’s an instruction booklet inside. There’s styrofoam holding each of the bottles in place inside, which I liked a lot! There’s stickers on the top of each colored polish. The stickers are the color of the polish and have numbers on them (like P037 and P038). I really liked they had stickers on the TOPS of the bottles so you can easily see which color the polish is. The bottles are all made of glass. They feel nice. And they are decent sizes.

There are NO base or top coats included. This is ONLY colored polishes. So, if you don’t have a top and base coat, you’ll need to get your own to use this set.

I got the chameleon shimmering color and black. Theres 6 polishes in total. There’s 5 glitter polishes - a lime green, a blue (the sticker is a little misleading, it makes it look like it’s a baby blue, but really it’s a royal blue), purple (again, the sticker is a little misleading, it looks like a pink, but the color is a purple), another purple, and a dark blue (again, the sticker is misleading, it looks like it’s a silver, but it’s a dark blue). There’s 1 solid color - a black.

Even the photos on the product page can be a little misleading. On the product page the first photo shows a dark teal glitter, a dark blue glitter, a dark green glitter, a dark purple glitter, a blue glitter and then the solid black. But those are what the shades are supposed to look like with a black base. If you look at the other product photos, especially the 3rd one, you’ll see what the colors are without a black base and with a black base. All the shades look the same in the bottle as what’s shown in the 3rd product photo without a black base, EXCEPT “P041.” In the 3rd product photo “P041” without a black base looks like a silver glitter, just like the sticker on top of the bottle makes it seem. But, in the bottle and on the finger (without a black base), it looks like a dark blue glitter.

These are glitters so they are a little thick, but they’re still easy to work with. They cure easily. They look beautiful with or without the black base. I love that I basically get 10 colors because I get 5 colors when I use a black base, and then 5 slightly different colors if I use the black base.

Overall, I think this is a cute set if you’re looking for glitter polishes!

They’re Okay... These come in a resealable ziplock bag. Inside the ziplock bag are 3 individual product boxes. Each product box holds 1 pencil and 1 sharpener. I initially thought that there wasn’t a sharpener included like the product page said, but then I saw it at the bottom of the box (I show a photo). I initially thought that it was somehow attached to the box because the thing wouldn’t come out! I had to take something and push it out.

I wanted to try these because I thought they’d be nice to help my brows stay in place but not look and feel stiff like a clear gel can do. These do that. They keep the hairs in place nicely and they don’t look or feel stiff at all. It looks natural. It holds okay. You just need to make sure you really get it in all the hairs and use it to move them into place, then run a spoolie through to spread it around better and blend it out because you do get some areas that get more wax than others, so the spoolie helps spread it around. Then you need to go in and add more. You go back and forth adding some and using the spoolie until they get how you want them and stay in place. They work well.

One thing I really don’t like about these pencils are the caps. They will NOT stay on! If you go to pick up the pencil and grab it at the top where the cap is, the cap just comes right off. Some seem to stay on better than others, but they all come off waaaaay too easily. When I first noticed it I didn’t think it would be too big of a deal, but it’s gotten pretty annoying!

The wax pencil tip wears down pretty quickly. I only used the pencil twice and you can see in my photo a brand new pencil next to the one I’ve used twice. It didn’t surprise me too much since it is wax. Plus, it’s not a big deal since you get 3 pencils, they’re good sizes, and you get sharpeners with each pencil.

Overall, these are okay. For me, I needed to work applying the wax pencil to my brows a lot more than when I add clear brow gel. But, I like the soft and natural look it gives but still keeps my brows in place. If you’re looking for something that will keep your brows in place but will keep them looking soft and natural, I recommend giving these a try!

Not Creamy, Not Pigmented... This comes in a cute outer product box. Inside, the pencil is wrapped in plastic.

The pencil is a standard jumbo kind of pencil and has a clear lid. I show a photo comparing it to a pen to show size.

I got the shade “Chalfont - 303,” which is described as a “shimmering shade of Pearl.” For me, this just wasn’t great. For me, I just think it’s definitely not worth $18 (at the time of writing this review).

The product info page describes the pencil as having “intense colour.” I did not notice any intensity of color! It says, “Use your makeup highlighter pencil as a creamy, velvety eyeshadow, eyeliner, and highlighter. Apply it to your inner corners and entire eyelid for a pop of intense colour.” This pencil wasn’t creamy or velvety. To me it felt really dry and was even kind of powdery on application. It also says, “It can be used on its own with a beautiful opaque colour payoff, or built up for extra glamour thanks to its vibrant pigment.” It didn’t seem opaque at all. It could be because I got a shimmer Pearl shade. But, when I applied it, you could hardly see it, I had to really layer it, and even then it’s just not very noticeable.

I’ve tried other Pippa of London products and they’ve been great. Unfortunately, this pencil wasn’t one of them. This was a no for me. It could have been the color, maybe if I would have gotten a darker color it would have performed as the product page describes. But, that shouldn’t be the case. The pencil should perform as described no matter what color you get. So, I wouldn’t recommend this.

Cute Brush! This is a cute brush! The back of it has an interesting feel. It feels almost matte. The design is cute.

The brush itself feels durable. It’s a good size. Th brush works well. It doesn’t feel harsh or rough on my scalp. It doesn’t pull at my hair. I really like it!

Way Too Big For Me to Use I’m an adult female, but this is way too big for me to use. I’ve always had a small mouth, it’s even been an issue for my teeth. My teeth were crowded and my dentist always said it’s because my mouth was too small for the normal amount of teeth. I didn’t think about the fact that my mouth might be too small to use this. So, unfortunately I wasn’t able to actually use this since it was just too darn big! It seems like it is a standard jar exerciser. It seems durable. Just unfortunately couldn’t work for me.

It’s Okay, But Not For Me... This is okay but there’s a few issues I have with it....

First, the mirror came with a little chunk in the corner gone. It’s not a big deal because it’s so small, but it would be nice if the mirror would have come better protected so that it wasn’t missing a piece no matter how small.

Second, this doesn’t really hold much unless you want it to be all separate parts. If you have it all put together with the side trays sitting on each side of the big oval tray, the silicone pieces over top the side trays, and the square tray sitting in the middle of the big oval tray - Then you can’t hold much with it. The side trays with the silicone pieces only hold so much. The one with the lines you can lay brushes in the grooves like shown in the photos on the product page. But, there’s only 4 grooves where brushes can actually lay, and more than 1 or sometimes 2 brushes is all that fits in each groove. The other silicone tray has the X’s that you can put things in so they stand straight up. There’s 11 small ones and 8 big ones. The big ones you could potentially fit more than 1 item in. Also, the middle tray part that the mirror goes over as a lid, if you’re going to do that, then you can only have items in that tray that the mirror will be able to lay flat over, so that limits how much and what you can place in it. If you have it all put together, then it doesn’t take up much room. But, if you have it all in separate parts (like the first photo on the product page), then it takes up a lot of room for not holding too much. I might as well keep using my cups or brush holders for my brushes, which hold a ton of brushes, and plastic or acrylic drawer organizers.

Third, I don’t like how the mirror just sits, it isn’t actually attached. It comes off so easy. One little bump and the mirror falls over. It would be nice if they would have that attached somehow so that it would fold down over the tray but still be connected.

Finally, it’s supposed to be easy to wash and dry. To me, the silicone pieces are not easy to clean. The dust collects on them like crazy. And I try to just wipe off the dust with a dry cloth but the silicone is rubbery and the dust just kind of sticks to it. If you use a wet cloth you’re able to get the dust, but you have to work really hard to get it off. I just don’t like it.

Overall, this just doesn’t work for me. I wanted it to organize things while taking up less space. But, when it is taking up less space, it doesn’t hold enough for me. If you’re looking just to hold a few small things. Like you have some small items that you just want to have a place, then this might work for you. As long as you don’t mind that the mirror isn’t attached and might come off easy.

Lots of Colors! These come in a ziplock bag. The extensions are each packaged in plastic individually there’s a rubber band holding them together. There was also a pair of false eyelashes.

You get 2 of each color - red, sky blue, green, baby pink, yellow, royal blue, lilac, hot pink, and neon yellow. I think it’s a good assortment of colors.

They don’t seem to have much hair in each extension. They seem kind of thin. I show a photo of one of the hot pink extensions, you can see how thin it is. It would be nice if they had more hair. I like that they’re longer, so I could trim them to fit my length.

They don’t come with any kind of care instructions. The product info page says they are heat resistant, but doesn’t say max temperature. The way they came, the extensions ended up being crimped in a few spots, so I straightened the crimped areas out. I used an extremely low temp and it was fine.

Overall, I think getting 18 pieces for $9.99 (at the time of writing this review), it’s a good deal. Just know that each clip doesn’t have much hair - they’re pretty thin. But, mixing them in your hair, they mix in well and look good for a fun addition to your look that isn’t permanent.

Nice Brow Pencil But Nothing Special This comes in a nice outer product box. It says it’s made in Korea. There’s no ingredients or cruelty free logo on the box.

The outer packaging of the pencil is a cream color. It has gold writing on it. It looks nice. It’s lightweight. The writing on the back of the pencil is in Korean (at least I’m guessing that’s what it is since the product was made in Korea). There is English on the back that has “Pencil” just under the cap on one end, and “Brush” just under the cap on the other end. So, it’s nice each side is labeled. The pencil is triangular shaped. The spoolie is the standard spoolie. It is soft, not too scratchy.

It glides onto the eyebrows easily. Very creamy. It has good pigment. It blends into the eyebrows well and doesn’t just blend away when you use the spoolie. I usually like micro tips because they give you hair like strokes. You can get pretty good hair like strokes using the tip of the triangle. Using the side you can fill the brows in quickly. The product lasts in my brows all day without fading or smearing.

Overall, I think this is a nice brow pencil. Honestly, I don’t think it’s any better than my drugstore brow pencils that are cheaper. So, I wouldn’t purchase this. But, it is a nice brow pencil.

Good Magnetic Palette! Comes with Metal Adhesives for Bottom of Pans! This comes bubbled wrapped well. The plastic see-through part on the lid has a protective sheet stuck to it. I like that you have the see-through part, seeing the shadows through it looks cute. The palette is nice. It has some weight to it. It has a pretty look. The palette has a strong magnetic closure. So it won’t accidentally come open. The one thing is mine was kind of bent. It’s lifted up in the front right corner. I tried to add a photo showing it. I can see it because I know it’s there 😂 but hopefully you can see what I mean! But, the palette is simple and works well and looks nice.

I’d say this is a smaller magnetic palette. The eyeshadows I put in it in the photo were small pans. I then added 3 eyeshadows in normal sized pans at the bottom to give you an idea of the difference. It is a good size to hold a good amount of eyeshadows. Since I just started depotting eyeshadows, I don’t need anything too big. So, it works for me!

I LOVE that this came with 12 circular metal pans that have adhesive on the backs, so you can stick them to any pans that aren’t magnetic. I have just recently started depotting shadows from palettes and it surprised me how many weren’t magnetic! So the little adhesive stickers have come in handy!

This palette holds a good amount of shadows! Plus you get the adhesive metal pans that come with it! The only downside was the front right corner being kind of bent up. But, it does it’s job and it’s still cute. If you’re looking for a cute, affordable, small to medium magnetic palette, I recommend this!

Great Starter Set! This comes packaged together in a cute purple box.

There’s 8 tubes of poly gel. Each tube is sealed. There’s a nice sized pink nail file. There’s a dual headed tool - one end has the flat metal side to apply the poly gel. The other side is a brush. There’s a bottle of base coat and a bottle of top coat. There’s also a bag of dual forms.

This has everything you need EXCEPT for slip solution, which you can just use alcohol so that’s not a huge deal. The product info page says, “you can use alcohol ,cleanser or base coat to instead, They act the same effect.).” Also, one of the photos on the product page says, “Base coat could be used as a slip solution. It will make it easier to make gel smoothly. No alcohol or nail cleanser needed!” I’ve never heard of using cleanser (what cleanser do they mean? 🤷‍♀️) or base coat as a slip solution. But I’m pretty new to poly gels, so I could just not know. Unless it’s just this brands base coat that can be used as a slip solution? 🤷‍♀️

There’s a good assortment of colors. You get “clear,” “nude,” “pink,” “orange red,” “bean paste” (I’m not sure why the product info page calls it that but it’s like a pinky mauve type color to me), “brown” (this is like a light tan color), and 2 “color changing” (one looks like it goes from a hot pink or purplish pink to white and the other looks like it goes from a pinky red to a white).

Overall, I think this is a great set. There’s a good assortment of colors. The poly gels work well. You get everything you need (EXCEPT the slip solution). So, I think this is a great set for anyone, especially someone starting out with poly gels.

Cute Little Organizer! This is a cute little organizer! It’s heart shaped. It holds a good amount of products without taking up much room. It can’t hold items that are too big since the little compartments aren’t huge. Like one compartment can hold 2 tubes of lipstick. I have short little lippies that are kind of like small pencils. I can fit about 5 and 1 tube of lipstick in a compartment. So, you can fit a good amount of smaller items. If you want to store anything bigger, you’ll want to get an organizer with bigger compartments. But for the little things cluttering up your counter, this is perfect!

Good Assortment...I didn’t get the golden silk line though These come in a sealed bag that you rip off the top part and there’s a ziplock. It’s nice so you can keep everything in the bag if you want. Then, inside that there’s another ziplock bag that has everything inside it.

Everything is individually sealed.

I was supposed to get:
15 piece nail art brush set ✅
1 box of nail art rhinestones (in a white container which different sections for the different colored rhinestones) ✅
10 assorted colors of nail stripping tape ✅
12 pots of foiled stickers in 2 colors ✅
6 pots of colorful white nail glitter ✅
1 box of half cover clear false nail tips ✅
1 box of nail decals golden silk line ❌ I did NOT get this. It seems in place of this I got a jar of more rhinestones but these are all gold rhinestones in different shapes and sizes (see photos)

So, I didn’t get the nail decals golden silk line, which stinks. But, at least I got something else in place of it instead of just being short 1 item.

Everything is separated nicely. The brushes all look and feel nice. They work well. The nail tips feel nice. I like that the foiled pieces are in both gold and silver and that you get so many. I also really liked that the colored rhinestones are in the little container with separate areas to keep the colors separated.

Overall, I think this is a nice set for nail art. You get a bunch of different things, and I think the price is pretty good for everything you get.

Beautiful Multichrome Pigments! [[VIDEOID:bde866136544c24b41b9800127851a48]] These come with the 2 jars in a little bubble wrap bag. Inside the jars are held together with some strong plastic sealing (see photos). I really liked that because it helped ensure the jars didn’t break or the lids didn’t come loose and end up with powder everywhere! So I loved that!

The jars are plastic. On the lids is a sticker with the brand name, it’s placed on there unevenly so probably done by hand. The lids twist off and there’s a protective seal on the jars inside. Be VEEEERRRYYY careful when you pull off the protective seals. They are easy to lift and pull off, but I ended up dropping one of the seals after I took it off and it got pigment all over (see photos).
