Matte liquid lip NOT a gloss. So drying it’s like it pulls every bit of moisture out of your lips! Color - “Stone”

I don’t like matte lip products. Usually, they’re way too drying. I don’t mind semi matte lip products that aren’t too dry. But, for the most part, matte lip products just feel too drying on my lips. I was a little confused by the product page for this. The title said it was a “lip liner and lipstick set,” but also said it was a “matte lip gloss” and “liquid lipstick.” I’m not sure how it could be matte and a gloss at the same time. It’s one or the other? So, I looked at the description, whcih said it was a “high pigment lip gloss and lip liner.” It talked about not being sticky, which to me definitely implied a gloss. I’ve never heard a matte liquid lip being described as sticky or non sticky. So, I decided to give it a try. Unfortunately, it’s NOT a lip gloss.

This is a matte liquid lip (NOT a gloss) and a lip liner.

The lip liner is great. It’s pigmented, creamy and smooth. It glides onto the lips easily. It’s easy to get it where you want it. It lasts well on the lips. It doesn’t feel too dry after applying it, but I did top it with a gloss.

The liquid lip on the other hand is horrible! It is waaaaaay too drying! It is NOT a gloss at all! When applying it, it has a grainy, rough feel. Once it drys down, it’s like it sucks every bit of moisture out of your lips. I even tried putting a really moisturizing lip balm on before this and it still seemed to suck out all the moisture leaving cakey, dry looking and feeling lips. It shows every single line, even lines you didn’t even know you had in your lips. It’s crazy! It’s not sticky like it claims, though I don’t know why it would be since it dries down completely matte. I don’t know how well it lasted because I couldn’t stand it on my lips for longer than about 10 minutes and had to take it off. It came off really easy though, so I don’t see it lasting too long.

I really hate when product pages are so wrong. This one gave mixed info, not making it clear what it was. I don’t like that at all. It’s like they were trying to make it so people who liked lip glosses would be interested in it, but also make it so people who liked matte lips would be interested in it. You can’t have it both ways. Just describe the product for what it is and let people decide if it’s something for them. Trying to sell it as both is ridiculous!

The color “Stone” is pretty. It’s similar to my actual lip color, which is what I prefer.

Overall, this isn’t for me. I really liked the lip liner and for the price it isn’t bad just for a lip liner. But, I HATED the matte liquid lip. If you’re someone that likes extremely matte liquid lips, you might like this. But, I honestly don’t know about that. This is the MOST drying matte liquid lip I have ever tried! I give it 2 stars for the lip liner being good and the nice color, but I took off 3 for the horrible description on the product page and the horrible liquid lip.

Very thin, looks and feels like nothing on skin but sets makeup in place well! I have loved a lot of the By Terry products I’ve tried. I tried a mini of the loose Hyaluronic Hydra Powder, so I was excited to try the pressed powder version of it. But, I recently tried the By Terry Hyaluronic Hydra-Powder palette that had 4 different pressed Hyaluronic hydra-powders in it. It had colored powders, not translucent like this one. I got the “Fair to Medium” so it contained a pale pink, a pale bone colored shade, a pale bronzer, and a light bronzer shade. I didn’t like the light colored shades at all for setting my makeup. They seemed to make my skin look so dry, which I thought was so weird since it’s just a pressed version of the loose Hyaluronic hydra powder, which I loved. But, the loose Hyaluronic Hydra Powder only had 2 ingredients - silica and hyaluronic acid. The Hyaluronic Hydra-Powder Palette had a lot more ingredients, so I’m guessing that’s where the difference came from. They were also colored and the loose powder was translucent. This pressed powder is also translucent. It does contain more than 2 ingredients, I guess since it’s in pressed form rather than loose. But not a ton of ingredients (full list at end of review). But, given it had more ingredients and they were similar to the ones in the Hyaluronic Hydra-Pressed Powder Palette I tried and didn’t like, I was worried I wasn’t going to like this one either. But, I’m glad I tried it because I ended up loving it!

This comes in a nice outer product box. It comes in a nice compact with clasp closure, a mirror in the lid, and a powder puff. I never use the powder puffs that come in compacts like this, but it seemed nice enough.

The powder is very thin. It almost seems like you don’t pick any up when you dip your brush into it, but you do. Usually when I dip my brush into a powder, I have to dab off the excess from the brush before applying it to my face. I don’t have to do that with this. It only picks up a light amount, which is just enough for a very light layer. I have normal to dry skin, more on the dry side with some extremely dry areas. This doesn’t dry out my skin like the powders did in the palette that I tried. This goes on smoothly, sets my makeup in place with a very light layer, and doesn’t look dry, powdery, or cakey on the skin. It lasts well throughout the day.

I did notice that if I applied too much, I could get a dry look and feel to my skin. It’s so thin that it’s easy to think you haven’t applied any and to add more, which is when I get the dry look and feel to my skin. With the Pressed Powder Palette I tried, I found those powders worked well with a thin layer and didn’t leave my skin looking and feeling dry, but they also didn’t seem to set my makeup in place unless I applied more, which ended up giving me the dry look and feel. With this powder, I can apply a very small amount and my makeup seems to be set in place well and I don’t get a dry look and feel to the skin. So, I’m not sure why I got such a different result with the powders in the Pressed Powder Palette vs this one. Given they have similar ingredient lists aside from the color ingredients, the only thing I can think of is that this one is translucent and those ones in the palette were colored so that much

Overall, I think this is a great powder! It’s very thin and looks like nothing on the skin, but sets my makeup in place. It doesn’t feel or look dry on my skin. It works really well!

FULL INGREDIENTS
Talc, Silica, Mica, Ci 77120 / Barium Sulfate, Octyldodecanol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Magnesium Stearate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Diisostearyl Malate, Methicone, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Hyaluronate. (T3355a1).

Great IF need quick application, need to last no more than couple hrs, & only need couple uses I got the style “A201.” I have really small, really hooded, and downturned eyes. With such small, hooded eyes, a lot of full lashes can end up poking me in my inner corner. I like the inner corner of the lashes to be shorter. Somehow, I missed seeing that the inner corner of the “A201” style was the same length as the outer corner. I also like the outer corner to be longer and lifted to give my eye a more lifted look. While the “A201l style isn’t bad, it isn’t as good as “A202” would have been. I’m not sure how I picked so wrong 😂 I think I just saw the “A201” style looked more natural and “A202” looked darker/thicker/fuller, so I went with the more natural looking ones? No clue! I’m usually so picky when choosing lashes and so particular, I don’t know how I missed that! But, “A201” worked well enough.

I liked the idea of self adhesive lashes. No glue, no magnetic liner, no magnets. Just pop them on and be done! Easy peasy! I had a feeling they weren’t going to stick to well, but figured they were worth a try because…..”WHAT IF THEY DID?! Wouldn’t that be something?!”

They did stick….but not for long. These are perfect for anyone who only needs the lashes to feel secure for no more than a couple hours, after that, they start lifting and feeling like they’ll fall off at any moment. You get 4 pairs for $14.99 (currently down from regular price of $16.99), that is $3.75 (or $4.25 at regular price) per pair. Not too bad. At that price, some might not mind them only feeling secure for a short while. Like if you’re someone who does makeup looks on Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/etc., you might only need the lashes on for a quick photo session or video. These would work well for that.

They did say you need to apply these BEFORE makeup. I tried it that way and then applied my eyeshadow and it was fine. I also applied them after applying my eyeshadow. They stayed secure longer when applied BEFORE eyeshadow, but did stay secure for about 40 min when applied AFTER eyeshadow.

After the first use, they don’t stick very well. If you applied them to clean, dry skin, they stick much better and stay secured longer. But if applied to eyeshadow, they don’t stick as well the second time, even if you make sure to clean them off after.

Overall, I can’t really recommend these unless you only want lashes that will be quick to apply (few seconds), don’t need them to last longer than a couple hours, and don’t mind getting only a use or 2 out of them. If that works for you, go for it because they do stick.

Only meant for gel polish! Works well when used correctly This is ONLY meant for GEL polish NOT for acrylic powder, dip powder, Poly gel, or builder gel. Why? I don’t know. I’m guessing whatever chemicals in it breakdown the gel polish won’t breakdown the acrylic powder, dip powder, Poly gel, or builder gel in the same way.

This works great! I have tried other gel polish remover before and they just don’t feel right on the nail. It’s hard to describe, but it’s just a weird feeling I get in my nail bed when I’ve applied them. I’ve been trying out different ones hoping to find one that doesn’t feel like that and works really well…I finally found one!

This is easy to use.
-USE NAIL FILE TO REMOVE TOP COAT. This step is important. A lot of people think this step isn’t necessary with a gel polish remover like this. That it’ll remove the top coat too. It might, I haven’t tried it. But, I’m guessing it wouldn’t do it as quickly and easily. Just take a nail file and lightly buff off the top coat. It doesn’t take much.
-Apply a thin coat of the gel polish remover just like you would any nail polish
-Let it sit for 3-8 minutes. It will start to crack/bubble.
-Take a cuticle pusher and use it to push off the nail polish. It should push off easily. You can always add another coat of the remover if it’s not fully off.

I found for me with 2 coats of gel polish on, it usually took me about 10 minutes from start to finish. So much easier than acetone or even a drill! As long as you remove the top coat by filing it off before applying this remover and give it time to work and soften the polish, it’s easy to scrape off!

As a side note, even though this says it’s not meant for acrylic powder, dip powder, builder gel, or Poly gels, I tried it with dip powder. It worked well but did take longer for it to crack/bubble and I had to do 2 coats of the remover. It also worked much better when it was a solid color dip powder and not a dip powder with glitter in it.

Extremely hydrating but lightweight. Does have essential oils & fragrant ingredients though This comes with no outer product box, just the bottle. But, the bottle is sealed with plastic wrapping around it. It is made in the US. The ingredients are listed on the label.

This is supposed to be cruelty free, gluten free, silicone free, sulfate free, paraben free, talc free, 100% vegan, and have clean ingredients. It didn’t have any labels on it saying it was cruelty free, but the brand’s website said they’re cruelty free. It also said they use natural and organic ingredients. But, they are not certified organic. It states, “Our products are made with natural and organic ingredients, however, they are not certified organic. All of our products are made in the U.S. using top-quality domesticated and imported ingredients.” I’m not surprised they said they’re not certified organic. I love their honesty. I’ve seen lots of skincare brands claim their products are 100% organic when they definitely aren’t. Most skin care products are water-based and water can NOT be certified as organic, so the possibility of finding a 100% organic skincare product is close to impossible.

This claims to be hydrating, brightening, and soothing. It claims to target fine lines around the eyes, reduce appearance of dark circles and puffiness, and hydrate the eye area. It claims the key ingredients are triple peptides, bergamot oil, and citric acid. I included a full ingredient list at the end of my review (marked with 🟣). I included some info on some of the ingredients before that (marked with 🟢).

This comes in a nice pump bottle. The pump does squirt out too much if you’re not careful. I find if I carefully press it so I’m not pushing it down all the way, I get enough product and don’t waste any. It’s a thin gel consistency. It glides on nicely. It absorbs quickly leaving my under eyes feeling really hydrated and smooth. I have pretty dry under eyes. If I apply concealer, I have to make sure to moisturize them really well so they don’t look dry and cakey. A lot of the moisturizers that hydrate my under eyes enough are thicker and end up being too heavy to use concealer over. This is PERFECT! It’s thin and lightweight, but feels extremely hydrating! It gives my under eyes enough hydration and plumps them up. It doesn’t leave a sticky residue at all. Concealer goes over it beautifully and looks nice and smooth.

I haven’t been using it long enough to say anything about how it works long term on dark circles, firming, etc. But, I can say it’s really hydrating and plumping if you’re looking for something extremely hydrating under the eyes. I’m hopeful for other benefits long term given the ingredients, but even if I don’t get any more benefits, I’m still loving how well it hydrates my under eyes while being so lightweight! Just keep in mind it does have some essential oils and fragrant ingredients in it, so if you have sensitive skin, you might want to avoid this or at least check the ingredient list to see if they’re things that you’re sensitive to.

🟢Info on ingredients
Saccharide Isomerate, which is a 100% natural and plant-derived moisturizer. It binds to the skin stronger and longer than other moisturizer ingredients do so it can keep skin hydrated longer than usual.

Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 & Palmitoyl Tetrrapeptide-7 - These are peptides combined to create a compound called Matrixyl 3000. Matrixyl is a highly-effective peptide composition that has been shown to stimulate the production of collagen and elastin, fill in fine lines & wrinkles while restoring elasticity.

Sodium Hyaluronate, which is a form of hyaluronic acid (HA). Helps skin hold onto water, making skin more plump and elastic.

Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 (aka Argireline), which is called “natures Botox.” It is a synthetic peptide that has several different potential wrinkle-fighting and anti-aging effects. It's so effective, that experts say it's the closest thing to Botox you can get. It prevents the muscle movement that leads to wrinkle formation. Argireline also promotes collagen production and optimizes the function of collagen, which both fight fine lines and improve moisture levels in the skin. It’s good for anyone looking to smooth wrinkles caused by repeated muscle movement in areas such as the forehead and around the eyes.

Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, which has great anti-inflammatory properties and antioxidant properties.

ESSENTIAL OILS, PERFUMING INGREDIENTS
It has some essential oils and perfuming ingredients in it - Bergamot Fruit Oil, Orange Oil, Linalyl Acetate, Geranyl Acetate, and Linalool. These are super common and cheap fragrance ingredients. They oxidize on air exposure and the result can be quite irritating to the skin and can lead to allergic contact dermatitis and they count as frequent skin sensitizers. It is best to avoid them if you have sensitive skin.

🟣FULL INGREDIENT LIST
Water, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Saccharide Isomerate, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Sodium Hyaluronate, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Carrageenan, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis Oil, Sclerotium Gum, Xanthan Gum, Carbomer, Polysorbate 20, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Triethyl Citrate, Linalyl Acetate, Geranyl Acetate, Terpineol, Linalool, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.

Reduced redness & hydrating, but need ingredient list in ENGLISH! This comes in a nice outer product box. Made in Korea. The brand’s website said it’s 100% vegan, excluding animal ingredients and animal experiments. It also doesn’t include parabens.

It comes in a nice compact. It’s a compact like a cushion foundation where you open it and there’s a kind of lid that holds the sponge applicator, and you lift that lid to reveal the product. You press the applicator sponge into it (or your own sponge or brush) and then apply it. The brand’s website said the included sponge applicator is an “eco puff” made of “eco-friendly corns” and is “99.9% anti-bacterial and water-repellent,” which makes it safe on skin and keeps puff clean.

This is a liquidy but balm kind of texture. It isn’t as thick as a balm. It just feels like a cushion foundation. But this isn’t a foundation. It has a very light, mint green color to it. It’s so light that it’s almost white but has the green color to it. When applied, it reduces redness. It doesn’t do as well as my more pigmented green correctors, but it does a nice job while being hydrating and lightweight on the skin. It’s something that works well before applying foundation. It is lightweight enough to wear well under foundation. It isn’t a primer really, it doesn’t smooth out the skin or fill in pores. But, it does reduce the redness in my skin so then I use less foundation and concealer. If you have a TON of redness or it’s REALLY red, this might not be enough since it isn’t extremely pigmented. But, it will make a difference. I like it isn’t drying on the skin either.

I’m just not sure how I feel about it though. It works well on the skin. But, I do like to know what’s in my products. I don’t like that they provided barely any product info, and the ingredients on the product box weren’t in English. They also didn’t include them here on the product page. Not even the product photos provided any real info on the product - what it does, who it’s for, how to use it, ingredients, etc. I had to go to the brand’s website to find out more. Yes, it’s a simple Google search, but it’s not really something you should have to do.

Normally, I would just go to the brand’s website to find the list of ingredients when they’re not included on the Amazon product page. But, the Jung Saem Mool website didn’t have them on their website either. I looked for them elsewhere and did find an ingredient list on Korean Beauty Box, but didn’t think they were accurate because they didn’t include centella asiatica, pine sprout, or green calamine powder, which are supposed to be in this product. So, I translated the ingredients from the box myself. But, I’m not that confident in the ingredients provided on the box.(I included a photo from the box, and also included the ingredients at the end of my review in English)

It doesn’t seem like a complete list of ingredients to me. It has the first ingredient as titanium dioxide. It has tocopherol (vitamin E) as the 3rd ingredient. The rest of the ingredient are 7, kind of versions I’d guess you’d call them, of centella asiatica. There’s nothing else listed. It’s kind of odd. The brand’s website said this is supposed to have “2 plants - pine sprout containing fresh moisture and centella asiatica roots.” I saw the “centella asiatica roots” in the ingredients when I translated them. But didn’t see any “pine sprout.” I also saw something about “cica pine water” on the brand’s website, but again, not sure what that’s supposed to be? The brand’s website also mentioned “Natural green calamine powder covers reddened skin tone.” Again, I didn’t see any calamine powder at all in the ingredients.

The 7, I guess versions, of Centella Asiatica are:
Centella Asiatica Extract (5,159,235ppm) - Well known soothing, antioxidant, and moisturizing ingredient. Anti-inflammatory. The main biologically active components are Asiaticoside, madecassoside, asiatic acid, and madecassic acid. All of which are in this.

Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract (0.035ppm)

Centella Asiatica Root Extract (0.03ppm)

Madecassoside (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Madecassic Acid (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Asiaticoside (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica.

Asiatic Acid (0.0025ppm) - One of the main biologically active components of Centella Asiatica. It’s less prominent than it’s sister component, Asiaticoside, but it still contributes to the well-established moisturizing and wound healing abilities of Centella Asiatica.

Overall, it works well. It reduces my redness, feels hydrating on the skin, and works well on its own and under foundation. It feels lightweight on the skin. If they provided the full ingredient list, it would be something I’d be willing to purchase. But, right now, I don’t like they didn’t include them and don’t like that they can’t even be found online as far as I could tell. And I just have a hard time believing the ingredient list I translated from the box is the full ingredient list. I don’t know. If the ingredients aren’t a big factor for you, this is nice and works well. If knowing the ingredients are important to you, I’d look elsewhere. There’s other similar products that actually provide a full ingredient list, and a lot of them are far cheaper. I give it 3 stars.

Use as last step of skin care routine. Dip puff into content and gently apply and dab on skin.

Use as lightweight skin tone corrector to correct sensitive skin tone covered by masks instead of applying heavy, caking makeup.

Love the shape and shade! Worried how shape will hold up over time though LOKNGXU Eyebrow Pencil

🟧OUTER PACKAGING
This comes in an outer product box that is inside a sealed plastic bag. Ingredients are listed on the box. It is made in China.

🟧CRUELTY FREE STATUS
This has a cruelty free logo (PETA). But, I don’t think they’re actually cruelty free. The brand name on the box says AMIIR. I did a search for the brand name, manufacturer name, and cosmetic production license name and nothing showed up on PETAs website where you can do a search. So, if you’re cruelty free, you might want to look into it some more.

🟧DUAL ENDED
This is dual ended - one end the pencil, the other end a standard spoolie brush. The box was a little smashed when it arrived. Unfortunately, the part with the spoolie had kind of bent and came out. Fortunately, I was able to pop it back in (as you can see in the photos, but can also see the line where it bent some). Once popped back in though, the spoolie worked fine so I was happy about that! The spoolie is nice. It’s not too rough. It works well.

🟧MY BROWS - THICKNESS, COLOR
I don’t have unruly or thick brows, but they also aren’t really thin. They’re a little sparse in areas, but for the most part not bad. I just like to lightly fill in the sparse areas.

I have a hard time getting the shade for me. I have medium to dark brown hair. My brows are like a muted black color. Whenever I get brown brow pencils, even the dark brown ones, they tend to be way too warm and don’t look right in my brows. I’ve found the best luck with charcoal, gray, dark gray, and black shades. Though, some of those are too pigmented and can be way too dark in my brows.

🟧SHADE OF PENCIL - 3# Dark Grey
With this pencil, I was excited when I saw a “Grey Brown” shade. I’ve tried others that were similar in name and the shade worked well for me. But, with this one, in the product photos the hair they showed with it looked more like ash blonde and said “suitable for maroon or coffee color,” which definitely wouldn’t work for me - coffee color maybe, but maroon no way! But, the actual brows in the photo looked like the color would work well. But, then I looked at the photo they had all the shades on the arm to show it was waterproof, and in that the shade “Grey Brown” definitely looked more like a light brown or ash blonde kind of brow shade. They also had a “Dark Grey,” which looked like a charcoal black kind of color - not full on black, but not gray. I was a little worried it might be too dark, but figured I’d have a better chance with “Dark Grey” than with the “Grey Brown” shade given they used the word “maroon” when describing who it would work for.

Fortunately, the color “Dark Grey” does work really well for me. It can be too dark so I have to use a light hand, but I find a light hand is easy with this formula.

🟧SHAPE OF PENCIL
I tend to like precise, small tipped brow pencils. My usual go to ones are the Nyx Micro Brow or Elf Ultra Precise Brow Pencil. They’re affordable and have a really small tip so I can get good hair like strokes and they work nicely.

This is a unique shape. Triangle shapes are usually too thick for me to get precise, thin hairlike strokes. Not with this shape! This is more of a diamond shape. There is an extremely thin line where you can easily get thin hairlike strokes. You can also use the really pointed tip to get thin hairlike strokes.

**NOTE: I will say I’m a little worried how the shape will hold up. I’ve been using this every day since I got it and notice the shape is wearing down…like the defined and pointed areas I love so much. It makes sense that those would wear down, just like any pencil does and will eventually need sharpened. But, it’s not like you can really sharpen this back into that original shape. So, unless you’re careful and try to use it evenly on both sides and tips to kind of make sure it wears the same and kind of maintains the shape….and who has the time and patience for that?!…it’s going to eventually end up being like a chubby angled liner shape. So, we’ll see how much I like it at that point? With the price and how much I like it, depending how long the shape lasts for it might be worth it to me to just purchase a new one at that time. So, I will just have to see how long the shape lasts and go from there.

🟧FORMULA OF PENCIL (HOW IT APPLIES, WEARS)
The formula is really nice! It glides onto my brows easily. It’s really creamy. It doesn’t skip at all, doesn’t tug at all. It doesn’t feel or look waxy. It is pigmented, so like I said, it can be too dark for me. But, it glides on so easily, it’s easy to use a very light hand. It blends in with my brow hairs nicely. When using a very light hand and the thin line, I get perfect hairlike strokes and don’t even need to use the spoolie to blend them in because they look perfect and natural! Though, if you want more of a faded look, the spoolie can do that too! You can also press harder for it to be darker since it is pigmented. It lasts well throughout the day. Usually with really creamy formulas, they just wipe off when I blend my brows with a spoolie and if they don’t, they wear off quick. So, I usually like ones that are in the middle of waxy and creamy - waxy enough to last, but creamy enough to glide on easily. With this one being so creamy, I expected it wouldn’t last well - it would just go away if I used a spoolie in my brows or it would wear off quick - but it actually lasts all day long even through a hot day outside or a day at work running around and sweating!

🟧OVERALL THOUGHTS
If you’re looking for a great brow pen, I’d definitely recommend trying this one out! It has a unique shape that works well, it has a great formula that is really easy to work with, and it lasts well all day!

Good Kit, But No Bottle and You Will Need Acetone Since I recently requested and started using a Gel Polish kit, I found myself in need of some gel polish remover tools, so I requested this product from Vine. This review is for: Nail Polish Gel Remover Tools Kit for Women with Nail Clip Caps, Nail File, Nail Remover Cotton Pads,Brush, 2-in-one Cuticle Scraper/Pusher.

First things first, I was surprised to come here to write this review and discover that I received no dispenser bottle as listed and pictured in the product description. Since this kit does NOT come with the remover liquid, you are going to have to buy some acetone. (In my state, you must be 21 to buy it.) Since this came with no bottle, I followed the directions on the acetone itself, and used a glass measuring cup in which to pour it. (This way if I didn't use it all, I could easily pour it back into the bottle. Note to self, buy another measuring cup!)

With that out of the way, this kit worked as described. I used tweezers and soaked the little pads in acetone and then wrapped it around my nail and applied the clamp. I did this to all of my nails at once, because my husband was here to help me with the second hand. If you have no one to help you, then you're going to need to do each hand separately. It is impossible to do much with these clamps on your fingernails. Once the clamps are on, you need to wait at least 20 minutes before removing them, to soften up the polish.

Once I removed the clamps I set to work scraping off the polish. It does NOT come right up like regular polish does, but if you've soaked them for 20 minutes, and you applied it in thin layers when you originally polished them, it's easy to scrape the rest of it off. Once you're done, your nails look pretty bad. It will be necessary to buff them out and then wash them and apply some moisturizing lotion because your nails and the tips of your fingers will be very, very dry.

I have heard some real horror stories of people trying to get gel nails and gel nail polish off, but this kit made it much easier and alleviated my fears. Other than the missing dispenser bottle, I'm rather happy with this kit.

Great for My Sparse Lashes My lashes are a bit sparse and a mascara that makes them look more full is like finding a unicorn,. But this time, I hit the jackpot. This review is of: Waterproof Mascara 2 Pcs Silicone Brush Head 4D Natural and Long Lasting Lash Blast Volume Mascara.

I love this stuff. I can't deal with the whole false lashes thing, I don't do well with glues, and the magnetic ones don't seem to stay on well. When I tried this mascara I was hoping for fuller looking lashes and that's what I got! I do two coats and that does the trick for me. The brush is short so it's easier for me to apply as I seem to have more control, It's also a dense wand which seems to lift up and thicken my lashes without that super chunky look.(However, if the mood strikes for super chunky look, I'm sure I could achieve that with another coat of this mascara.)

I've gotten to try a few bougie mascaras from Vine, some with high price tags, but none of them has worked as well as this one. Also, for this price? This mascara is a deal!

Works! The last time I was at the hair salon, my stylist used spray wax on my hair and I was amazed by it. Never having heard of spray wax before and loving the hold that it gave my hair, when I saw this available for request on Vine, I asked for it. This review is of: Got2B Glued 2in1 Spray Wax, translucent, 8 Ounce.

Being that this is an entirely new product for me, it took me a few tries to get just the right amount to hold my hair back from frizzing and flying away, but I did find it. I like this better than hair spray because it doesn't make my hair crunchy while still keeping my style. I do sometimes have some flyaways near the end of the day, so I don't know if the hold fades or what exactly is happening, but 9 hours of hold is pretty good. I am considering buy more of this when I empty this bottle.

Love This Stuff! In addition to being a lotion addict, I also have a thing for body washes which is why I requested this from Vine. This review is for: HASK CUCUMBER + ALOE Body Wash 2 Pack- Refreshing, vegan formula, hypoallergenic, dermatologist tested, pH balanced- 2 Pack of 24.5 oz Bottles.

Yesterday was our first hot day of the year and we spent about four hours working outside in the sun. By the time we were done, I was tired and felt dried out. What a perfect time to try this body wash!

It smells so good and it felt refreshing on my skin. It creates a nice foamy lather, so it works perfectly with a loofah. It felt like my skin was hydrating instantly and have I mentioned the lovely cucumber scent?

HASK body wash is a good value considering how large these bottles are, it’s creamy and lathers well and it smells wonderful. It checks all my boxes!

Smells Wonderful, Good Lotion For Dry Skin It's nearly summer here in New England, which means lots of time swimming and sunning. As a result, quality lotions are needed. That is why I requested this one. This review is of: Spanature Aloe Vera Hand & Body Lotion Travel Size Selection Made In Korea 75 ml/2.53oz (4pcs)…

As the product information states, this comes as four cute boxes of lotion, great for gift giving. Inside the boxes, all four tubes of lotion do have foil caps, so your safety was considered.

The lotion itself smells light and airy to me, not heavy. It's also not very thick, and for that reason I do not like it as a hand lotion. I'm washing my hands all the time and I really need something thick to really moisturize and coat my hands. However, for a body that's been in the sun and/or water, this lotion is absolutely perfect and quite effective. It's a bit thin as I said, but it absorbs quickly and seems to last for at least 3-4 hours. (I am talking really dry skin here, so for you, it would probably last longer.)

Overall, I'm very pleased with this Spanature Lotion. I think these would make for a nice small gift or stocking stuffer, or of course, a gift to yourself.

Lovely Being that I'm a lotion addict, I'm always on the lookout for new ones to try. When I saw this one was available, I requested it and here we are. This review is for: ZEROID Intensive Lotion Intensive Care for Severe Dry & Disordered Skin (200 mL).

I'm not exactly sure what "disordered" skin means, but this is a good lotion for dry skin. Between the sun and the pool in the summer, and the cold New England winters, it's always a battle to stay moisturized.

I found Zeroid to be a decent lotion. I cannot detect any scent from it at all, which is fine, but I generally like lotions better when they have at least a faint scent to them. This bottle is fairly small and the asking price right now is a bit hefty for what you get.

Scented or not, I expect some great things from a lotion at this price, and I'm just not seeing anything great here. It's good, it's moisturizing and it lasts for most of the day, but almost all lotions do and you can buy several of them for this price.

It's a good lotion, not great and I don't think I will be buying it once this bottle is gone.

Excellent Moisturizing As many of you already know, I am a lotion addict. That addiction is now branching out to facial serums and moisturizers. This ampoule is one of the better ones I have tried. This review is of: ZEROID Dermanewal Revitalizing Ampoule | Restore Energy to Stressed Out Skin | (30mL).

I've been using this each morning for about a week now and I love this stuff! For whatever reason, I wasn't expecting much from this product and as it turns out, it's one of the best things I've tried from Vine.

I can detect no scent from this serum, which is good. What I do detect is healthier looking and ALIVE looking skin. The directions for this serum are rather vague and consist of one line "Apply liberal amount to the needed area." I didn't really know what to make of that, but I've been applying it to my face and to my neck. It's a clear fluid and it goes on easily and smoothly and my skin does not appear to be sticky or have any residue left on it after a moment or two.

I feel like my skin is...radiating brightness, if that makes any sense? The last two days I've used this only, with no makeup and I had a few compliments on my skin on both days! Whatever is happening is noticeable enough for my co-workers and even one client to comment on.

The redness on my cheeks has faded to a barely noticeable healthy looking flush. I've had no breakouts and my skin looks bright and healthy. I don't know what else to say other than I love this. It's affordable too, which is just an extra bonus. I'm very happy with this serum!

Effective and Comfortable Being that my hair is thin and fine, I have trouble keeping sleeping caps or bonnets in place overnight. I thought this one might actually stay on, so I requested it from Vine and here we are. This review is for: Auban Sleep Hair Wrap Bonnet Eye Cover Black Satin Cap Large for Sleeping Silk Cap Double Layer for Long.

This cap is super comfortable, so let's start with that. The outside is made of cotton, but the inside is satin. This means that it will NOT frizz out your hair if you move around a lot at night. I recently got a 2 inch trim off the bottom of my hair, but even if it was still 1/3 of the way down my back, all of my hair would fit, (and stay!) inside.

The fit is loose enough around the edges that you could pull it down over your ears and even over your eyes, if you wanted to. I do. On the other hand, it's tight enough that I did not need to use any bobby pins or hair clips to keep the cap on. Seriously, this sleeping cap is my new favorite thing. I hope that the elastic holds up for a while-if it doesn't I will come update this review, but as of right now, I'm very happy with this cap.

I Like It! Being that I'm always looking for new ways to stop my hair from frizzing overnight, when I saw this cap available on Vine I requested it and here we are. This review is for: Auban Sleep Hair Wrap Bonnet Eye Cover Large Black Satin Cap for Sleeping Silk Cap Double Layer for Long Hair...

In short, I like it. The satin inside keeps my hair from frizzing. The band that goes around your head is flat, which I like. Some have a type of...cord-like elastic that leaves its imprint on your forehead for hours after you wake up.

I do find that this one slips a bit, so a bobby pin tucked in the back will help it stay on overnight, especially if you're an active sleeper like I am.

I find this bonnet to be better than average and I would get another one in the future.

Great For Allergy Season! Being that this has been a terrible year for allergies, I thought these wipes might help clean and protect my eyes, so I requested them from Vine and here we are. This review is for: Acuaiss Cleansing Eyelid Wipes, Hygienic & Hydrating Eyelid Wipes with Hyaluronic Acid and Aloe Vera...

These wipes are very handy! Because they are individually wrapped you can tuck one in your pocket or your purse. The wipes themselves are large enough to wipe both eyes with no problems.

I requested these mostly for the morning. With my allergies being so bad this year, I often wake up with some serious eye gunk. These are great for that! They are gentle enough and I don't have to worry about any stinging or other issues.

Regarding ordering, for whatever reason these took a few weeks to come in, and when they finally arrived the box was pretty beat up. There were no worries though, as far as the product itself is concerned, I just thought I'd mention it.

Overall, I am happy with these eye wipes.

Satin or Silk? Since I discovered that silk/satin hair bonnets or pillow cases can help preserve your hairstyle overnight, I've been a big fan. I go through them like crazy because I tend to sleep hot and after a while the bonnets don't freshen up as nicely in the wash. I requested this bonnet to try and here we are. This review is for: Satin Bonnet Silk Sleep Cap for Women, layajia Satin Bonnet for Curly Hair Long Hair Women Sleeping etc...

I like that the front of this cap has a flat strip at the front instead of the elastic. Sometimes the elastics leave marks on the front of my head that last for a long time. That said, I don't know if these cap is silk or satin, but I'm guessing satin. It doesn't seem to muss my hair overnight, but I think the product description should do better so you know exactly what you're getting.

I found this bonnet to be a perfect fit, but like most other bonnets, I have to use a bobby pin or a larger hair clip to keep this on overnight. I am a tosser and a turner, so this is not unusual for me.

Overall, I like this bonnet, it fits okay and it does not muss my hair. At the current price of $14.99, it's reasonable and I got exactly what I expected.
Four Stars Great pins. One of them came broken.

Apply it outdoors I bought some of this in the Caribbean last week for my toes. I was tempted to buy 3 and get 1 free but am glad I didn't now. I bought a lighter color that turns a darker sparkly pink outdoors. If you apply it indoors you can’t tell if it’s going on neatly.

The Good: It does change color in the sun - the colors are nice
The Bad: It doesn't go on evenly. It tends to streak and is difficult to apply. I didn't find it to be quick-drying.

I applied it indoors then went outside and could see how it had gone out of the nail line all over my toes and I had to use a Q-tip w/nail polish remover to clean up around the nail. It wasn't easy to do that and not remove polish that was already on there, even when waiting a few minutes for it to dry. I applied a couple more coats but still had to clean up.

The final look is ok but doesn't look like a professional pedicure that's for sure. I'm not sure my nail-tech would appreciate having to apply this. Perhaps if I had purchased one without glitter it would have been easier to apply. I think the concept is great, and glad I tried it but also glad I didn't buy for gifts.

The 3-star average rating this has been getting is fair.

Couldn't get it to stay in place It is open at two ends. There are no directions, only diagrams of how to put it on. Take a look at the photo attached.The first diagram shows that you should put your hands in through both openings and try to get your hair in there. For me impossible. It kept slipping. This page shows it closed at the crown as if it is one domed piece, but in reality with both ends open it is not. The band provided does help, but I couldn't put it over the black mesh, I had to use it over the nylon cap that came with my wig. At least I could get that one on. I'm disappointed. Suggestions graciously accepted.

A four plus star rating... this is why They're pricey. Two dollars less would be a fairer price. However, these are about the nicest makeup remover pads I've used. Not like the type you’ll find at dollar stores that are thin, small and tear.

These are sturdy and I can get by with just one at each use. They feel good on my skin. They don't leave a residue or greasy feel on your skin after use. Admittedly I do rinse off though after using any makeup remover pads with chemicals as I have sensitive skin, and get hives from some products. This hasn't happened yet using these.

If the price doesn't bother you, go for it! They're nice and do the job.

convenient pump bottle for daily conditioner The pump bottle is nice, convenient and easy to use. The conditioner is good for everyday, not too rich, easy to rub into your hair and rinse out. Seems to make hair softer. It does contain fragrance, and I don't like the smell that much - it smells like almond or maybe vanilla. But it's not too bad.

GREAT SCENT & effective moisturizer with a novel "gel butter" texture I *LOVE* the scent. Normally I do not like face creams with scent since fragrance can sometimes irritate my skin. But this one doesn't bother my skin, and it smells SO GOOD. I would wear this smell as a perfume if I could -- it's light and refreshing, almost like a peach and white tea scent.

The cream has an unusual texture -- like a "gel butter". Richer than a gel cream, but it still has that slippery feeling. It leaves skin shiny at first but dries / absorbs fully after a few minutes.

The cream ingredients are also excellent, packed with top antioxidants (like NELUMBO NUCIFERA GERM EXTRACT aka lotus seed extract, CENTELLA ASIATICA LEAF EXTRACT, and MADECASSOSIDE) in addition to the various great sprout extracts that give the cream its name "blessing of sprout". All the plant extracts have proven anti-oxidant or skin-soothing benefits.

The main moisturizing ingredient is SHEA BUTTER - my skin likes shea butter, especially now that I'm older, especially in winter. Very good for dry skin.

Okay! This lipsticks colors looks good, They are cheap and have an off scent to them. and tried testing those lipsticks but after hour I felt irritation so I don't suggest for everyone, Make sure before use.

Very Nice!! The bottle is very pretty and Beautiful packaging!, It smells really good but scent doesn't last long. I'm having to reapply throughout the day. So I took one star for the reason. very pleased with outcome!! While castor oil has many beauty benefits like hair growth, I have only ever used it for health reasons. Very nice like it! Having owned water flossers in the past and not being happy with them I wasn't sure what to expect but decided to give it a shot. Great colors I was very happy to see these came in a pretty little giftable box and had cardboard separators as to avoid breakage. Also, the gold & bronze shades are perfect for fall.

Thin sponge Not sure about this product. This is my 8th konjac sponge. I try different brands. This one is the thinnest one I've ever had, being about 1/3 of the thickness of others I have used. The thinness makes it feel very flimsy, so hopefully it will last as long as it should.

Everything needed to remove gel polish. This review is for the VANALIA Gel Nail Polish Remover Kit. It comes with 2 bottes of of gel polish remover(doesn't smell bad), 1 bottle of liquid latex peel off cuticle protector, 1 cuticle pusher, 1 nail file, and 2 cleaning pads. First use the file to remove the top coat from your nails,  brush the latex onto the skin around your nails, apply a thick layer or gel remover and wait 6 min, then use the pusher to remove polish, and then peel off the latex.  Everything needed to remove gel polished nails is included. It all comes in a cute box. I think this would make a great gift when given along with a box of gel polishes.

Pretty palette. This review is for an essence Welcome to London Eyeshadow Palette. You get 12 eyeshadows in both matte and metallic shades. The eyeshadows blend well. I especially like the shimmery golden shade. There is a mirror inside, but no applicator. The case has a magnetic closure and is nicely decorated with a London theme. I think this would make a great gift.

Soothing foot cream. This review is for a jar of STRIDE Foot Cream. This cream helps with rough heels and moisturizes dry feet.

The ACTIVE ingredients listed on the product page are:
Deionized water, green tea leaf extract, cocos nucifera (coconut) oil, dodecane, cetearyl alcohol, polysorbate 60.

The cream while in the jar has a soft, almost wipped appearance. When applying it feels kind of waxy, which feels soothing on my feet. The smell kind if a fresh scent and isn't very strong. I like this foot cream a lot.

Feels cheap, easily bends. I purchased these because it included a set of two, and I desired having a set in each of my two bathrooms for whenever I needed them. The price point was amazing and it includes every type of tool you might need for acne extraction. However, the quality leaves something to be desired and does not feel like it will last a long time. I have already accidentally bent one of the picks, not while using it, but when I was opening the box it came in.

Saves me money! These replacement toothbrush heads fit my Oral B /Braun electric toothbrush perfectly.  The actual brush head is slightly smaller than the Oral B head but it is not a drawback.  I am happy with this product and would purchase it again.  It was less expensive then the Oral B brand.  5 stars.

Great polish My daughter was sick of paying more money at the salon for them to paint her acrylics, so I got her the "CIMIY Gel Nail Polish Set 8 bottles - Manicure Colors Infinity with Top Base Coat for Forest Nail Art Natural Daily All Seasons for Nail Profession Salon and Starter at Home Soak Off UV LED 0.32oz" to paint her nails with.
This polish requires an LED/UV lamp, so I also had to buy that for her. Other than that, this polish is great. It came with a base coat and a top coat, as well as 6 fall-inspired shades. The polish is very beautiful and doesn't make a huge mess. I had her put them under the lamp for 3 minutes after each coat and wound up using 2 coats of the colored polish on her nails. This gel polish hardens very nicely an doesn't get any dents or fingerprints.
Overall, I recommend this polish to people who are tired of overpaying at the salon.

Great polish, messy to apply and/or remove I grew tired of paying to have my gel done at a salon, so I decided that I would do it myself now. After looking for a while, I decided to get the "ANZUO Shimmer Gel Nail Polish Set Christmas Party 6 Colors UV LED Soak Off Gold Silver Nail Polish Kit for Women" with hopes that it would work well.
I'm glad that I did, because this polish is great. Aside from the fact that the glitter is very messy, this polish is very nice. It is very smooth and hardens quickly, as well. Whenever I went to remove the polish, I could glitter everywhere. I kinda saw it coming, but it was still a little bit annoying. This polish does last quite a long time, though.
Overall, this polish gets a 4 out of 5. If the glitter wasn't so messy, my rating would be higher.

Great, very natural-looking I was tired of paying twenty dollars for my eyebrow pencils, so when I found the "Marshique Skin Fit Flat Auto Eyebrow Pencil(Golden Brown)- including Spoolie Brush, Soft Texture, Natural Looking, Long Lasting" I didn't hesitate to get it.

I love the way my brows look after using this brow. You can definitely tell the difference, but its not too noticeable to others the way other pencils are.

PURPLE! Awesome colors! Love this powder ! So easy to use and create unique fun effects I had never tried decorative nail powder before ; in fact never even heard of this product so was curious to give it a go and so glad that I did!! Its super easy to use and creates some really cool effects with relative ease.

In a nutshell, you use it with gel nail colors: Apply your basecoat, color (this suggests plain black or white for the best effects) then top coat. Do not use rubbing alcohol at this point as you would typically do, but instead apply the powder, which is just like eyeshadow with an eyeshadow type applicator then seal with one last coat of gel top coat.

It has a chrome like effect and blends nicely , to create all kinds of effects. It is very easy to use, much easier than gel nail polish itself and can even hide imperfections! Love it !!

Very relaxing, all natural. Clinical but clean scent. Pricey for size! On the fence on this product for one reason: price!! Don't get me wrong - I love a good bath and maybe I am crazy but I will pay up to $20 to my favorite retailer for their beautiful CBD bath bombs (which yes, also includes a crystal) but as an avid bath salt user from basic to boutique; I cannot for the life of me understand what is in this product that justifies that price point. I compared to some of my premium brands too; just to see what this might have that they don't

After a long spin class followed by 30 minutes of strength workouts I was feeling the muscle burn so I added this to my bath and soaked for 20 minutes. The smell is not my favorite but it is one I am used to from some of the other brands I use and it is consistent with the natural ingredients. It is hard to define but I would say it has an almost clinical smell. It reminds me of a very clean hospital - not bad, just not my personal favorite scent. That said, they do use all natural ingredients so for that I am willing to pay more and I will say it was very relaxing, and helped with the muscle soreness.

You do also get a rather large crystal in the bag -I like crystals but here is a watch out just in case you are not bothered one way or another - the crystal weighed 1oz so you are getting 8oz salts which is enough for one bath with 1/9 of the bag weight being taken up by the crystal.

Now to be fair, the ingredient list does show all natural with no fillers that you might see in cheaper products such as coconut oil or unsourced scents and I really do feel crazy relaxed after this bath! Just wish it was maybe enough for 2/3 baths !!

Great since and buildable hold ! Has a great scent so that’s the first thing I noticed. Smells masculine like a fresh cologne but certainly not overpowering . Scent mutes a little once applied so it still smells nice but won’t bother you either .

Has a nice amount of hold and it’s a good semi matte with just a hint of shine. It has a good amount of hold that is buildable with the right amount of product and it washes out easily with no residue.

Impressed and would buy again

I will buy again: Smells great, is natural and a great size for travel with a portable container I love this. It looks like something you might get from a Farmers market or local beauty boutique - it has a very handmade feel, in a good way!

Perfect size for travel which is important to me as I am on planes weekly; this is a great scrub that smells lovely. I got "relax" which has a calming lavender scent and it is natural and chemical free. Does a really great job of exfoliating without being too rough or too soft.

I will buy again as it smells great, is natural and a great size for travel with a nice, portable container

Cute wig, good quality and fun look Got this for a teen who was heading to a costume party as the wigs you get in costume stores tend to be more money for sognifolrss quality

Okay kit, not very durable and lamp not the best I have tried many of these kits and though they are great when they come with everything you need to get your nails done; the quality can wildly vary.

I would think it's comparable to the $400 dryers. I have never used one of the Dyson hair dryers.  I have heard women LOVE them.  I am not ever going to spend $300 - $400 on a hair dryer.  No way!  This one looks a lot like a Dyson.  I can't imagine how a Dyson would be better than this one.  This one is great!  I LOVE it.  I have curly hair and it works wonderful for me.  I dry my hair upside down with the diffuser on cool.  That really helps to cut down on the frizz.  It takes awhile but it's worth it.  I change out the nozzle and use one of the other tools to dry and lift at my scalp.  It gives me a lot more volume.  The dryer is a little heavier than some of my other dryers.  Yes, I have several.  I also like that you don't get all hot and sweaty when drying your hair.  My husband loves that I don't heat up the bathroom!  I really can't say enough good about this dryer. I cut a piece of velcro to wrap around it and it works great to keep it untangled.  Highly recommend!!

Nice for a costume. This wig is a lot shorter than it looks in the picture.  I know it says it's a bob and that it is.  It comes down to just above my chin.  It would make a nice wig for a flapper costume.  It isn't realistic.  It's very shiny!  The part is white and really stands out.  You could tone down the shine with dry shampoo. They are big! I really wanted to use these on my face.  But they are too big for that!  Check the measurements. They are great for all over body exfoliating though. If you're wondering if they work, they do! Masks are hot.  We all know that.  They are hard to breathe in.  You end up sucking the fabric up in your mouth and can't get it out.  These are simple to use.  I just place it in my mask and put the mask on my face.  It stays put.  It holds the mask away from your mouth and nose.  They do make you sweat under the plastic.  But at least you can breathe easier.  You can easily wash these with soap and water.  I just lay them out to dry.  They fit kids as well.

They actually work! I desperately need height on the top of my head.  These clips actually do provide lift.  I don't know how well they would work on straight hair.  I always end up with an indention near the root where I clip these.  That doesn't matter that much on my hair because it's curly and the waves it creates works with curls.  I use my blow dryer with these in to speed up the drying process.  The air does flow through somewhat.  But these things are painful!  I haven't figured out how to use them without them pulling.  If I put them close to my scalp, they pull.  If I put them down a little, they pull.  I usually just dry them as quickly as possible and take them out.  They do work.

If you don't mind cutting it a little, you'll like it. This is an extremely messy bun!  I like the tousled look but this is a little much.  There's lots of really light colored strands sticking out.  The ends seem to be lighter than the rest of the hair.  I just took my scissors and cut those off.  Now I like it!  The hair texture is not shiny.  It looks like real hair.  At least it looks like my hair!  I got this in a lighter shade because you can never tell how dark they will be.  I have medium brown hair.  This was lighter than my hair.  I just spray it with root touchup spray and I can get it to match.  I put my medium length hair in a ponytail, wrap it around into a tiny bun and then put this over it.  I secure it with a few bobby pins.  Such a great look with little effort.

For traveling or at home. This makeup organizer has a spot for everything.  You can easily lay the mirror flat and put it in your suitcase.  The mirror acts as a cover to hold your makeup in the compartments.  You can take it all out and use it on your counter at home.  The whole thing is about 14 1/4" long and 1" deep.  It has foam inserts for your makeup brushes and eyeliners, lipstick or concealer tubes and a wavy type insert for laying your brushes flat as you use them.  The mirror has slots to make it stand up or you can hold it in your hand to use.  It's 6 1/4" x 7".  It is not magnifying.  The bottom has tiny foam pads to keep it from moving around.  It can easily be cleaned with soap and water.

Love these! You get two different size rollers in this set.  One is a facial roller with different size ends.  One end is 1 1/2" and the other is 1".  The larger one is great for all over your face - forehead, cheeks and neck. The smaller end is good for around the eyes and chin area.  Put this in the refrigerator and it's heaven to use!  Feels wonderful.  And at the same time it's helping to firm your face and neck.  The other box comes with dermarollers.  Two different sizes - one has a 1 1/2" head and the other is a 3/4" head.  I use the bigger one all over my face and then apply moisturizer.  It really helps it to absorb better.  The smaller one I use gently around my eyes.  But I mostly use it on my eyebrows with growth serum.  I roll the area first, apply the serum and roll again.  It helps to open up the hair follicles and allow the serum to absorb better. It's slightly painful and leaves your face red.  But it clears up in about an hour for me.  The handles are comfortable to hold while using.  They come in nice clear plastic cases.

One of the most natural looking wigs I've seen. This wig is beautiful!  It does not look like a wig.  The roots are dark and the rest is blonde.  The crown is very layered and you can't see any part.  There are not fake wig areas that show.  It's got wig combs in the front and the back.  There's lots of volume on the top.  It's a short tapered cut around the ears and back of the neck.  It's very easy to style.  I just fluffed it up with a comb.  I have medium brown hair.  This is a lot lighter than my natural color.  So, I can't pass it off as my own hair.  But other than that I would totally be able to fool people.  I loved the cut so much I decided to cut my hair the same way on the crown.  It gives me so much more volume.  You really can't do wrong with this wig.  It's excellent quality at a very low price.  I wish I could get it in medium brown.

I got #30 - dark brown. First off, the top part looks very realistic.  It's not a flat part.  It's staggered.  You can work with it and it looks very realistic.  There are virtually no bangs on this.  The front hairline looks fake.  I am going to try to cut some bangs and see if that helps the look.  But the hair color is not to my liking.  It has orange highlights.  But mostly around the front!  There's large clumps in the front and the back is mixed in better.  I tried spraying it with root touch up spray to tone them down some.  The hair is shiny.  You will have to use dry shampoo on it to get rid of some of that.  It does not come with any wig clips inside.  It does have the adjustable strap.  I wish there weren't so many issues with this wig.  I love the realistic part!!  The best I've seen in any wig.

It is bright! I can't say anything bad about the light this mirror provides.  It has three light levels.  I usually just use the same one.  The daylight one can be a little too much.  You can definitely see every flaw in your face!  I like that you can use this with batteries or USB charged.  I have so many other things plugged into my outlets.  This is just one less.  There are two fold out mirrors - one on top on the left side and one on the bottom on the right side.  They have different levels of magnification.  Those would be a little better if they were a little larger.  The middle mirror is the perfect size though.  This stands up on a base.  I just wish the mirror tilted back a bit farther.  It's kind of difficult to do my eyebrows without lowering my head down.  I may make a stand for it to lift it up about 2 -3".  But it's a nice light and magnification.

Helps your skin absorb moisturizer. I love the combination of these two rollers.  The microneedle roller is great for rolling your face before applying moisturizer.  It helps your skin absorb it better.  I also use it on my eyebrows.  I have very sparse eyebrows.  I am applying hair growth serum on them.  I roll my eyebrows, apply the serum and then roll it again to help it get better absorbed.  It really seems to be helping!  I have fine hairs growing back in.  I also like the derma roller.  I put it in the refrigerator.  It feels so good to roll over your forehead and across your eyes.  Helps to relieve headaches too.  This is a nice duo to add to your daily facial routine.

Too flat! Well, I finally got a hair topper that actually matches my hair.  That is so hard to get.  The hair on this is a little shiny but not bad.  I can spray it with dry shampoo and it dulls it some.  So, that's not a problem.  It has (3) clips - one on each side and in the back.  I would like a clip in front also.  I have some small clips I can sew in to help the front stay in place.  The part on this is very fake looking.  But most of them are.  I sprayed it with root touch up spray.  That helps a lot!  But I haven't been able to figure out how to use this without it being totally flat on top of my head.  It just screams fake!  The hair is very thick also.  I will have to thin it out and cut the length off some.  There's a lot you have to do to make this presentable.  I will keep working with it.

Easy to clean and works well.  The LED light, however, is of little use. I have more nose hair trimmers than I should admit.  They dont last long because I abuse them.  I have more hope for this one because it does seem well designed, and it has one advantage.  The motor is running about twice as fast as the others I have.  So the claim that it does not pull is accurate.  Hard to gauge the longevity of this trimmer.  It seems well made but it is very light and only time will tell.  It cost a third of what I spent on my last one, and it has a faster motor, so I am moving the right direction.  The LED light is nearly useless, but I did not take any points off as it is so dim it will not waste the battery.

Safe ingredients These bath bombs exploded with aroma when I opened the box. Each bath bomb is individually wrapped in tissue paper and has a sticker describing the color and the scent. After the sticker and tissue paper are removed, there is a plastic barrier to protect the bath bomb from getting wet before it is supposed to. They are heavily perfumed. The tissue paper and stickers make for a nice display in a bathroom bowl until they are used.

The ingredients used are all natural and safe. Baking soda, citric acid, Shea butter, coconut oil, sea butter, olive oil, fragrance, and plant extract. These are all items we have in our household. When my wife has made her own bath bombs in the past she used many of the same ingredients. I like that there are no unknowns on the ingredient list. I also like that there are no dyes for the safety of my white tub but also for my children’s skin.

I have found bath bombs to be an awesome motivator to get our children to take baths. While bubbles are fun, bath bombs seem to have a longer lasting effect. The bath bombs have an instant fizzy effect when they meet water. The colors ooze out and the aroma fills the tub. My smaller closed in tub area has a more intense scent than my more open tub. These bombs are fragrant and have long lasting fizzy effects in the tub. The kids are happy and like taking bath bomb baths so I am pleased. Knowing they are made of safe ingredients leaves me feeling comfortable using them with the kids.
