Thin with short hairs Hair is soft and silky, but it’s thin. More like 130% density. There’s too many short hairs at the closure, especially considering this is only an 8in wig. Ends are nice. Lace is great. Cap fits snug on my 22in mannequin head.
Cute for cosplay I mean it’s decent at this price. Hair is soft and tangle free. Pretty Ombre color. Cosplay, pictures, bedroom fun or testing out a color. Not for everyday wear.
Great quality for the price! No complaints! Mannequin head is 22in

Pretty decent quality Hair is very soft and feels healthy. Feels a bit thinner than 150% density, but not by much. Some noticeable short filler hairs at closure. All in all very nice unit. Mannequin head is 22in
Great quality Soft and healthy hair. True to density. Nice lace. Nice ends. Great quality unit. Mannequin head is 22in
High quality No complaints here. At this price it’s pretty perfect. Beautiful color. Soft realistic hair. Pretty decent lace tab part. I’m happy! Mannequin head is 22in
Soft and thick Really nice natural hairline. Hair is soft and healthy. True to density. Nice ends. Just needs a little styling and she’s good to go! Mannequin head is 22in
So fun! Looks better in person than in stock photos lol definitely a cosplay wig but it’s really cute and fun! Mannequin head is 22in

Pretty color but poor quality The color is awesome but everything else about this wig is bad. It’s super thin and not evenly cut. The hair feels dry and kinda brittle. It’s not sewn in well at the hairline and the cap doesn’t fit my 22Inch mannequin head. I can’t recommend this.

Ash blonde Pretty shade of blonde. Hair has a nice texture to it. Lightweight. Decent lace tab part. Ideal for cosplay, pictures, or for trying out the color before making a bigger purchase or permanent change. Mannequin head is 22in

16in body wave Hair is soft and healthy all the way through the ends. I took off a star because it’s a bit thinner than 150% density. More like 140%. Nice hairline. Lace is soft. Great quality unit! Mannequin head is 22in. Pics in natural sunlight.
Ombre blonde wig The hair texture feels great and the color blend is pretty. But it sits really funny on my 22in mannequin head. Smaller heads only. Cosplay only. Pictures in natural sunlight.
14in closure Top half is great. Hair feels soft and full. Bottom half feels crunchy, like there’s product in it.

18in lace frontal The unit I received is very nice. It’s true to density and actually longer than the stated 18in. The hair feels soft and healthy. Awesome parting space and natural looking hairline. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.
Short and curly wig Shed a bit when shook out but otherwise nice. Soft hair. Cute style. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.

Braided wig It’s pretty heavy- but it’s really cute and nicely done. The braids are tight and look realistic. Knots are pretty bad though and will require some skill to cover them. Mannequin head is 22in. Pictures taken in natural sunlight.
Mid grade These seem pretty mid grade. I question the durability and longevity of them. They appear to be made from a bunch of short pieces.

One of my favorites! One of my favorite amazon wigs! The first one I received had track issues, but the seller quickly rectified. The second piece I received was perfect. The color is a perfect ash blonde shade. Hair is soft. Hairline is very realistic. Baby hairs in front. Roots go all the way through the wig down to the nape. Deeper part than most other middle part wigs on amazon. People think it’s my hair! What’s preventing 5 stars? The hair comb being in front instead of the back as well as the part needing to be plucked. If I could I’d give 4.5 stars. LOVE this one, no Regrets!

No regrets I adore this unit! Braids are tightly done and are a beautiful mix of colors. Lace is transparent. Hairline is perfect and realistic. My only complaints are the braids are a bit itchy when touching my skin on my shoulders or chest, there’s no comb at the nape and the wig itself is fairly heavy. That being said, the pros far outweigh the cons. I love it and do not regret my purchase!

Gray roots and very yellow hair Disappointed. Pros: hair is very soft with a perfect wave. Part and hairline is awesome. Cap is comfortable and lace is transparent. Great manageable length.
Cons: The roots aren’t brown, or if they are it’s a very ashy shade to the point it looked gray. Maybe it was just mine but it looked terrible, especially up next to the yellow blonde. And it’s very yellow. It looked more of a honey blonde on my screen, but it arrived very very yellow. My skin tone works with most hair colors, but not this one. It aged me with the gray roots. Unfortunately I had to return. If this unit was made in any other shade of blonde with better roots it would have been perfect. So sad.

Only for short oily hair I got this for my husband. He has shoulder length, curly, thick hair. He did not like this stuff at all. It smells nice,  but he said it was hard to spread around and left his hair feeling dry. This might be good if you have short oily hair, but if not I would not recommend for any other hair types.

Nice unit at this price point! Not a bad unit for the price! I was very hesitant on ordering and it’s been in my wish list for awhile but there were no reviews... I got an amazon gift card recently so I figured now would be the time to try it. The hair is soft enough, not incredibly soft but not terrible. It’s a bit on the shiny side but some baby powder can take care of that. The part is excellent. Looks real without a cap on underneath and goes deep. My head is 22 inches and this fit great. A comb at the nape of the neck is a must imo and this has one. I love the pretty colors. The pink is more peachy orange pink than pink pink but that’s ok. It goes from a super dark brown root to the peach pink to lavender to white/platinum blonde. One major dislike, and a reason I took away a star, is that it’s only rooted on top and along the front side of the unit. The rest of the hair underneath starts with the peach pink. Common at this price point but I’d rather pay a few dollars more and have it rooted the whole way through. But this is the only wig with this color that I can find so it is what it is. The lace is light enough to be nearly invisible on me. Not scratchy, the unit was comfy to wear. The hairline could stand to be plucked more naturally if I ever find the time. All in all im happy with it! Thanks!

Short, frizzy, matted hair on original and replacement unit but responsive customer service I was really excited to get this wig. The images provided on the listing looked like the color I’ve been looking for. I posted a question asking the seller to provide images of the actual unit and the stock pictures I uploaded are the ones that were sent to me. Before I go any further I’d like to say the seller provided fast and courteous customer service, which is why my rating is 2 stars instead of 1. I’m terribly disappointed in the wig itself. The first unit I received, upon first taking it out, seemed nice and I was excited. There was a comb at the nape of the neck, the part looked nice and the hair itself felt soft and moved nicely. Then I tried it on and noticed a large bump on top of my head, which is what the picture with the red circle is. Turns out at the beginning of the track the hair is all short, frizzy and matted, like it was burned, which is what was causing that bump. I notified the seller and requested a replacement. The seller was responsive to my feedback and seemed genuinely interested in it and concerned about the quality. I received the replacement yesterday and it was even worse... :( The hair throughout the unit was very very dry and ratty. And the same issue was at the top, short, frizzy, matted hair, but more so. Soooo bummed about this. Seems to be some serious quality control issues wherever these units are being produced. This wig would have been so great if it wasn’t for what appears to be an overheating issue when making the waves. I hope the seller can get this fixed, because the colors are beautiful. Unfortunately I had to send both the original and replacement back.

Very moisturizing with great ingredients So any product like this is going to take a lot of time to show significant results. I’m 37 with minimal signs of aging (I think) and I like to use these products as a preventive, I have been for decades now. I’ve been using this one for about a week now, in replacement of my morning moisturizer. I really like it! Two small pumps gives me enough product for a liberal application. The product absorbs well. No irritation. I have combo skin and this does a great job at moisturizing my dry areas. It doesn’t sit on my skin so I can go to work and wear my mask without irritation. Seems to be a really nice product!

Stay away! This unit is horrific! Short filler hairs all over. No combs. Terrible fake looking part. Awful hairline that shows the tracks. Even at the lace front part you can clearly see the cap. My head is 22 inches and it has a very weird fit. Doesn’t stay flat on the head, even with a wig grip. The color is very fake looking and the hair is way too shiny. Stay away from this, it’s garbage, even at the listed price.

Costume only [[VIDEOID:d63052b23ca12009436cb817ae056c3c]] If this was marketed as a costume wig I’d give it mire stars. But they’re saying it’s an everyday workplace wig, and that it is not. The hair itself feels soft and is nice, but the part is horrific. You can’t wear this without a hat. The color is lighter and warmer than expected as well. The cap has a weird fit. For a costume or bedroom wig it’s fine, but not an everyday unit in the least bit.

My client loves hers! I got this as a gift for an older client of mine. She spent a lot of money on a plastic set last year, and she loves rose quartz, so when I saw this I knew she’d love it. And she does! She says the smoothing coolness of the rose quartz feels amazing on her neck. And it’s pretty to look at!

Husband approved! I picked out this shampoo for my husband. His feedback, he likes the smell, it made his hair feel clean (which is huge because he works at a grimy steel mill), it was easy to spread around and rinsed out clean. I’d recommend!

Fun! I’ve never had one of these before and I think I’m gonna have to get some more I’m different colors! I wore it to work today and everyone thought it was my real hair! It’s soft and looks legit. My hair is purple on the ends and if I took the time I could hide it completely. Super easy to put on and pretty light on the head. My only complaint is that’s it’s a bit more yellow than the product image depicts. It looks more ash blonde online. But I still like it!

Great concept, bad quality The idea of this type of hair extension is great. But this particular unit, not so much. If I didn’t have the purple in my hair it would have looked a lot better, as the blonde under that purple is close to the shade of this piece. However, since it’s synthetic I can’t make the blonde match the purple. Not the reason for the low rating though, I know you can’t color synthetic. The hair itself feels fake. It tangles easily and is staticky. One of the clips wasn’t sewed in all the way. When I combed it out hair came out. Also, the pieces that allow you to adjust the wire are metal, not silicone, and could not be opened with pliers. They snapped when I tried. The piece did come with extra silicone pieces to tighten though. Next time I get one of these I’ll opt for a real hair one of better quality.

Bad quality- short hair except for the back So disappointed in this unit and I feel like it’s a waste of real human hair. I had to put a lot of work into it to make it look halfway decent. As it came the curls are super tight and when worn looks like some 80s Gerry curl type thing. Not a good look. Even with the tight curls you could tell how short it was on the sides compared to the back. So I took my flat iron out and straightened it out at 350 degrees. As you can see it wouldn’t go completely straight, but I didn’t want to use a higher heat and damage the hair. I’m ok with it being wavy, but as I straightened it all the tiny broken  filler hairs on top of the unit became extremely obvious. Not sure what they were thinking when they made this. It’s clear to achieve the “16 inch” length they only added long hair at the back bottom of the unit, leaving the sides short. Now the whole reason I wear wigs is because I chemically damaged my hair, and the sides are shorter than my back, JUST LIKE THIS WIG! Ugh. While it looked better wavy, it’s still a hot mess. The hairline part and cap fit funny. Like the hairline goes past the ears. The side combs are near the nape comb. The top part of the lace doesn’t lay flat to the head, I’d have to glue it down. The only way I can make this hair look decent is if I wear a head scarf with it, to pull back and hide the short sides. The hair itself isn’t even all that great. It’s a mess on top and feels dry. The only reason why I’m giving it two stars is because I can make it look cute with the scarf. If I would have paid money for this I would have returned it immediately.

Thin Eh. I’m not all that impressed. I have a few of these and I think they’re fun to wear. This one is a little darker than I thought it would be so it’s slightly darker than my roots, but that’s not the biggest deal. It’s pretty thin. Not much hair on it, so it makes it really hard for me to hide my own hair, and it’s short and on the thinner side right now. Unless I go back to being a full brunette I doubt I’ll wear it because I don’t think I can hide the purple with it.
Pretty! Pretty headband, has a very princess feel to it. Fit my adult 22 inch head fine. My only issue is that on the end the stones weren’t glued down all the way. Otherwise beautiful piece!

Hot mess This unit I received is a hot mess. It’s a shameful waste of human hair really. The hair itself is soft and pretty color. But the cap is way small on my 22 inch head. I can’t even fit it on right. The waves and bands look nothing like the product image. If I would have purchased this I would immediately return it.

Not bad for $20 One of the better $20 and under wigs on amazon. Not for daily use, the scalp isn’t legit enough for that, but great for cosplay, bedroom or with a hat. The hair is soft and not overly shiny. Doesn’t look the best on me but it’s a nicer quality unit at the price point.

Really nice unit! This hair on this wig is what I like best, it’s soft and silky. I like the color, although the roots are a bit shiny. I wish it was longer personally, I’d buy this unit in like 18-20 inch length. The simulated scalp is one of the best I’ve seen. It does fit a bit small on my 22 inch head, but I can make it work. I’d recommend, it’s a nice unit.

Really cute! Great for cosplay, bedroom fun or pictures! Don’t get this expecting to fool anyone though, it’s a cute wig, but it’s not a very realistic one. The roots are unnatural and overly shiny, and the simulated scalp isn’t the best. But the hair is soft and silky. The cap fit well on my 22 inch head and covered most of my sides. Super fun and not overpriced.

Amazing! Yet another Korean beauty product that has failed to disappoint me! I have combo skin that gets really dry but also breaks out easily. Finding a good moisturizer for my face can be tough. But not since I discovered the magic of Korean products. The hype is real, and this is no exception. I use it at night before bed. A little amount smooths on nicely, making my face feel instantly moisturized without feeling greasy or heavy. It definitely feels like it has more youthful plumpness to it (I’m 37). It absorbs pretty fast, within about 10 min I can no longer feel it on my face. Since using it I haven’t felt any tightness in my skin. It has a nice clean soap like fresh scent to it. It hasn’t caused my skin to breakout either.  I love it and I highly recommend it!

Very dry hair and too small of cap I did not like this unit at all. The lace is super dark. The cap is small and very tight on my 22 inch head. The hair is very dry and feels like it could be yaki hair. There are no roots at the nape of the wig. Really disappointed. I am returning.

Roots are RED Ok, first of all, the roots on this are not brown, they are RED! So weird! Warm red into cool ash blonde. It just doesn’t look right to me at all. I like the color of the blonde, if the roots were actually brown this unit would have been much better. At this price point the hair texture isn’t bad. It shed a bit and is kinda tangly but it was soft. And the waves/curls are nicely done. But The simulated scalp isn’t that great. My head is 22 inches and the cap fit fine. The best things about this unit is the cap fit and the hair texture. But because of the roots I don’t foresee myself actually wearing this, I’ll likely just give it away to a friend.

Nothing special It’s an ok hair conditioner. Typical drug store quality. My hair usually responds very well to *quality* argan oil. But this left my hair still feeling dry and looking frizzy. I had to liberally apply some smoothing leave in after, twice. But work well for fine hair, but I have thick, course hair and this was just disappointing.

Don’t stay on These are awful. The pieces of magnets that line the lash make it extremely noticeable you’re wearing them. They feel too heavy on my eyes to wear. I wouldn’t recommend these. Go for the kind, and only the kind, that have a thin magnetic strip across the entire lash. Sorry, these are garbage.

Really cute! This hair is super long and fluffy! It’s very adorable. It’s lightweight even though it’s got so much hair! Unfortunately the cap is too small on me. My head is 22 inches and it was really tight and the sides were pretty far back. So it’s for smaller heads only. But the hair itself was soft, the cap well made. Very nice deep realistic part. If your head is smaller than mine I’d recommend!

So cute! For the price it’s a very nice cosplay or bedroom wig. I doubt the simulated scalp will fool anyone, but it’s not terribly done. The hair is a super pretty purple color with soft hair texture and nice waves. It has nice bounce to it. My head is 22 inches and it fit great. Cap is well made. I’d definitely recommend this unit, it’s one of the nicer cheap ones on amazon!

Love! Omg I love this unit! I wasn’t expecting to like it as much as I do! She’s so pretty! The hair is very soft and silky and the waves are perfect! Bangs are a great length on me. The part looks so real. The color blend is amazing and everything about this unit looks so natural! It fit my 22 inch head perfectly! No weird smell either. I love it!! I’d definitely recommend this! She’s awesome!

SO PRETTY! I wish so badly I could give this unit 5 stars. The colors are GORGEOUS. Fun and pretty and can go casual, party, club, bedroom, cosplay etc. the hair itself is very soft and silky with beautiful waves. The lace part is deep and looks so natural. There’s a comb at the nape. Even though there is no lace front they do a great job at the part. My only issue is that it doesn’t fit my more oblong, 22 inch head. The nape comb ends up about halfway down the back of my head, the cap is too small. SUCH A BUMMER. I’d be slaying in this beauty. I wish it fit but I could feel it slipping when I tried it on. If noble could just make their caps a little bigger I’d be so happy because they have some of the best quality wigs. My head is normal size so it’s not asking much! If you have a smaller, or rounded head, GET THIS SIS. You will LOVE it!

Very nice! This is a very nice unit! I shook it out and it came right to life. The hair itself is very soft. I finger combed it and there was no shedding or tangles. The headband is sewn on nicely and the cap is well made. The color is a very pretty natural black. Nice high end unit at an affordable price. I’d recommend!

Beautiful hair!! I wish my own hair felt as amazing as this! It’s sooo soft and silky. The color is GORGEOUS. Darker roots than blend right into a medium to light brown. The color is not as streaky as depicted in the product image and I’m happy about that. It looks way more natural in person. High end hair, just perfect. Thank you! I’d recommend!

Beautiful hair This hair is sooooo nice. It’s soft and healthy feeling. I could finger comb it no problem, no tangles, no shedding, no tracks getting loose. True to length. Really nice lace part. Great shade of lace that should work with most skin tones. Nape comb, which is huge. No short filler hairs. It has a sewn in band that sits at the back of your head that really keeps this unit super secure without glue. This is definitely a high end, well made unit. I’d 100% recommend. I only wish it came packaged better!

EDIT: I was also able to try their 16in water wave headband. It’s very nice too, although not 180% density, especially at the ends. Still full at 150%. Otherwise it’s another winner!
Beautiful! This hair is GORGEOUS! Super soft and silky!! My fingers ran easily through it. The color is absolute perfection. Truly stunning, high end hair. I’d 100% recommend!

So pretty! This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Has bounce. Beautiful Ombre burgundy color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

Pretty crochet hair! This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

Pretty crochet hair! This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

Pretty crochet hair! This seems to be well made hair! It’s true to length and has the look and feel of real hair. It’s soft and flows nicely. The dreads are on the thicker side. Nice color to it. Doesn’t seem heavy. Looks like high end hair to me! Would recommend!

Misleading product images I’d have rated it higher, but the product images are misleading and the unit I received is not the same as pictures. Yes, it’s silver. A beautiful shade of silver too. It’s a short bob unit, but it’s not straight, the ends are curled. And it doesn’t have a middle part as depicted, it just has one of those middle points on top. If the product was pictured correctly I’d have given it at least 4 stars because the hair itself is soft, silky and smooth, there wasn’t any shedding when I finger combed it and the color is beautiful. Shame.
Beautiful hair! All of the hair included in this package is really nice! The color is beautiful. The hair itself looks healthy and feels soft and silky. So pretty. I’d 100% recommend!
Nice crochet hair! Feels soft and springy. True to length. Nice color. Looks and feels real. Seems to be well made. Pretty crochet hair!

So pretty! This hair is so pretty! I love the color blend, the roots look awesome. Hair is soft, silky and healthy. I ran my fingers through it no problem- no shedding or tangles. Just gorgeous! I would recommend!

Very 90s I was interested in this because it has a very 90s look to it, and I’m a child of the 90s. While it’s better than I thought it’s still not all that great. It’s a cosplay or bedroom wig, unless you cover the top part. The itself is soft and has good color, a bit on the shiny side. The simulated scalp and front hairline is bad though. This would be fun for cosplay, bedroom, or to test out the color and cut, but that’s about it. I don’t think you’ll fool anyone with this piece.

Really pretty This is a gorgeous wig at this price point! The hair is a beautiful multi dimensional red color. It’s soft with no shedding or tangling when I finger combed it. Good density. I’d recommend!

Pretty! This is a nice unit for the price! The hair is a bit shiny, but mostly so by the headband. In the natural light the color looks pretty natural.. It’s soft and silky with no tangle or shedding when I finger combed. Well made headband wig, I’d recommend!

Nice hair! It’s real hair and it feels soft and healthy. I had no issues with finger combing it, no tangles or shedding. Caps is well made and the headband is silky. Combs inside. Pretty dark brown natural black. Nice unit!

Disappointed I was expecting a better unit than what I got. This unit needs work. The lace is transparent and soft, the color is pretty. But that’s where my praise ends. The hair is tangled easily. It’s too shiny and it has a plastic feel to it. It was super staticky when I first took it out. There’s no nape comb, and it’s a bit heavy. I think cutting like 6 inches off would make it better. The part and hairline was very disappointing. Mine was not pre-plucked, as you can see in the pictures. I’m too lazy with my wigs to do the work it needs.

Came smooshed up She seems nice enough, but needs some work, some time spent in fluffing her up. I wish there were combs in it, but I guess at this price point I can’t expect much. The hair itself is soft and healthy looking.

Cosplay only It’s not a terrible unit at this price point, but it’s not all that great either. The hair is way too shiny, and it tangles immediately. The simulated scalp is obvious and the front line isn’t any better. It would be better if the hair was better quality, but it’s definitely has a plastic feel to it. I’d recommend for cosplay or bedroom use only, and I would t expect more than 1 or 2 uses out of it...

Thicker than others I’ve had the opportunity to test out several different brands of clip in extensions and this is definitely one of the thicker ones, if not the thickest. The hair has a nice density. It’s soft and silky and I could finger comb it no problem. Healthy hair with nice ends. True 1B. Very nice hair.

Hard to get past the texture [[VIDEOID:668d8ef9abdd66866a8d82b85aa8f4d9]] This isn’t my first snail moisturizer I’ve tried. It doesn’t compare to previous. This one is slimy and has the same look at texture of a certain male substance. So imagine putting that on your face and you got the idea of how this lotion feels. It moisturizers ok enough, but leaves my skin shiny and I’m still having to apply additional lotion. I have combination skin and this does great on my not super dry parts, but mediocre on the flaky skin. Didn’t cause any adverse skin reactions though.

Not bad! For being under $20 this is a nice unit. The hair is bolder color in person. It’s light and fluffy but I couldn’t finger comb it because of the tangles, I had to spritz some conditioner on it and use a wide tooth comb. The simulated scalp isn’t terrible. All in all a nice cosplay or bedroom wig!

Not bad for $80 Human hair wigs are expensive, and at $80 I don’t expect what I normally would. This isn’t a terrible unit. The hair itself is super soft and healthy. But it’s very thin, which is my biggest issue with this. It’s *maybe* 130% density, but feels like it could be less. It is true to length without any noticeable filler hairs. The lace is soft, but the 4x4 closure didn’t sit well on my head and the hair looked almost poofed up on the sides. Most likely due to my head shape. My head is 22 inches and it could be too big for this unit. All in all it’s nice for the price, just not for me.

Impressed I’m actually pretty impressed with this unit. I wasn’t expecting very much for the price. This definitely exceeded it. I took her out, gave her a few shakes, pull on the curls, and she really came to life. The hair is soft and black. There was a bit of a chemical processing smell, but nothing that won’t air out in a few days. Really nice unit if short and curly is what you’re looking for.

Not terrible Human hair is expensive so for the price this really isn’t that bad. The hair does feel over processed but a conditioning treatment should help with that. There wasn’t any noticeable shedding. The color is really pretty. Inexpensive way to test this style out!

Fancy tin not needed, great scrunches I just threw the tin away. But I really like the scrunchies. My hair is recovering from bleach damage and I need something gentle to hold my hair back at the gym. These work perfectly. I’d recommend.
Nice wig for the price The hair is soft and was easily finger combed. It’s not the most natural looking but it’s a fun change up.
Cute The colors are pretty. The hair is soft but it seems a bit frizzy. Fun wig to test a style out with!

Great skincare products I really like these skincare products! I have adult, acne prone skin. I’ve been using the face wash when I shower and since I use differin at night I use the cream after my shower (mid day after gym). The cream isn’t drying at all and actually feels moisturizing! It didn’t dry my skin out at all. It’s keeping my skin clear too. I’d buy again.
.

Great wig for the price Really nice unit for cosplay or bedroom fun, or to test out the color. The hair is soft and easily finger combed. Pretty color with some brown mixed in. The simulated scalp and front hairline isn’t all that great but for the price I don’t expect too much better. Fun wig!

Great synthetic at this price point I’ve purchased several units from this brand and am usually pretty happy with them. This one is no exception. The hair is soft and realistic looking. I could finger comb her no problem. The headband is sewn in nicely. It’s a great wig for this price!

Super nice This is a great synthetic unit. The hair is soft and looks real. They nailed the natural black color. It’s tangle free with no shedding when finger combed. The lace is soft and transparent. It has a great deeper part with a super legit hairline. My only issue is that it does NOT have a nape comb. It’s not a heavy unit but due to the shape of my skull I need it for these to stay secure. If the lack of one doesn’t bother you you’re gonna love this one!

Very soft and light hair The hair quality on this unit is very nice! It’s very soft and healthy. There was zero tangling or shedding when finger combed. The ends look great with no splits. Well placed combs and a nicely done cap. My issues and why I took off a star is this: there is a short piece of hair on the top that just kinda sticks out, you can see it in the pics. Also, it was sent to me in no kind of protective, discreet packaging, just my address label stuck on the actual wig box, for all the world to see what I ordered. Thankfully no theft of the contents occurred. Besides that the hair is just perfect!

Not the best from this brand For the price it’s not a terrible wig, but I own quite a few units from this brand and I know they can do better. The hair on this one is too shiny, the roots look very fake. It looks ok for pictures but in person you can tell. When I finger combed it was tangly and it shed. It’s pretty for cosplay, bedroom or to try out this color. The blonde is pretty true to actual 613. If I didn’t know what this brand is capable of I’d be more inclined to rate it higher, but I have some pretty nice wigs at the same price from them. The hair is just overall very wiggy. Cap and headband are well done though!

Very nice headband wig Very nice unit. True to length. Soft, healthy feeling hair with no splits or fillers. The headband is down really nice too- it’s double stitched, most are not. This unit will last you a long time even if you tend to tug a lot on the headband because of that stitching. I’d recommend!
Very nice hair Very nice unit! Hair is soft and healthy feeling and looking. No splits. No filler. Good density. Shake her out and she comes to life! Great price for real human hair!

Not bad for the price Nice thick Density. Deep black color, more like jet black than natural black. Love the length. It was a bit tangly when finger combed and she did shed. Not bad for the price but it doesn’t really look or feel real.

Silky soft Beautiful unit. Hair is silky soft and healthy. My fingers glided right through. No tangle. No shedding. Nice ends. Light but not thin. Big wide comb on top.  Really nice headband unit.

Pretty color but thin The color of these extensions is really pretty. It’s like a blonde with light light brown. The hair is soft and silky that was easily finger combed with no shedding. It seems really thin though.
Nice for the price Soft and thick hair but a bit tangly when finger combed. Nice headband. A bit on the shiny side giving it a wet look. Pretty natural looking and feeling. A.
Soft hair Hair is thick and feels soft and healthy. I couldn’t find any filler hairs. Easy to finger comb with no shedding. Nice curl pattern. A+

Great wig for the price What I love most about this wig is the color. It’s gorgeous! It’s like a brown with honey blonde highlights. The hair texture is soft and light and full. I could easily finger comb and there was minimal shedding. It looks and feels realistic. You’re going to want to pluck the part and throw some dry shampoo on the roots though- that’s where it looks the most wiggy. Lace is darker so it prolly won’t work for the lighter skin tones. Great length. Hairline is done well. Really pretty wig. Mannequin head is 22in

Thin and layered with pre-cut lace Too many issues with this unit to give it anything other than one star. I ordered the straight 16in with a 4x4 lace closure. I received a layered wig that has short filler hairs on top at the part and is layered in the back so it’s a fake 16in. It’s not even close to the claimed 200% density, more like 130%. The lace on mine appears to be pre-cut with the edge sewn. Not even sure what that’s about. Wig is not at all like I imagined from product pictures and description.

Not a fan Not impressed with this unit at all. While the hair itself is very soft and healthy with no shedding or splits, everything else about it isn’t that great. It’s very thin, 130% density at best. I hate the velvet headband- it’s not adjustable either. It’s a solid band. And there are short filler hairs on top. For $50 I’d pass.

Impressed These are actually a lot nicer than I thought they would be. They look and feel like real hair. Super pretty warm brown color- I don’t see any ginger. No shedding, no tangling. These are fantastic!

Gorgeous color This is a pretty nice unit. I took a star off because of the part. For $40 on a lace tab unit I would expect the part to be more realistic. It needs to be wider. It doesn’t look terrible as is, but for most realism you’re going to want to pluck it. Other than that it’s a really nice unit. Soft transparent lace. Hair looks and feels pretty realistic. It’s soft and I could easily finger comb. No shedding or tangling. I just love the color. It’s a pretty warm coffee brown with reddish undertones. Mannequin head is 22in

Looks better in person It looks better in person than it does in the product photos. I wouldn’t call it honey blonde either. It’s a warm light brown to a bleach blonde. The hair is soft with minimal tangle with finger comb. it does have a slight yaki feel. Overall cute wig. Mannequin head is 22in

Soft and thick Lovely wig. Hair is soft and easy to finger comb. The hair does feel like it’s 150% density, although maybe a bit thin on the ends. No strong odor. Soft lace. Hairline is done nice. Very natural parting ability. No short filler hairs. Very nice unit. Mannequin head is 22in

Really disappointed I was so so so so excited for this unit. Man was I let down. It looks nothing like I anticipated. As you can see from the pictures it’s layered, not a full 28in all the way around. It’s also thin. Absolutely not 150% density as claimed. It’s maybe 130%. There’s also a weird issue at the parting space going on. Maybe it’s just me, but I doubt it. One side lies flat. The other side seems to be thicker in a small patch and I can’t get it to lay down. Maybe if I tried using heat but I’m too annoyed to even try. The hairline is ok. The lace is indeed transparent and soft. But man, I’m feeling really let down here. Pictures speak for themselves. Mannequin head is 22in

3 functional stands for pretty cheap - not high quality, but probably good enough for most people Given that you get 3 stands for like $13, I don’t think it’s reasonable to expect high quality. However, I do think it’s reasonable to expect the product to be functional and useful. In that regard, I think it’s a success. They are made of plastic, and they are kind of flimsy, but they work. Plus, you have multiple configurations to choose from. They were all easy to put together. Textually, the instructions aren’t useful, but the pictures are pretty clear as far as what pieces go where, and it’s pretty intuitive. For the most part, you are pretty much going to use the two pieces that cross over each other and probably the ring that goes over them (there is some concern about the ring breaking while trying to snap it in or pull it off). Beyond that, you are likely to either use the hanging hook piece to attach these to or the base with the poles, which can either stand straight up or be on its side.

I could see the hanging piece being susceptible to breaking, especially if the wig is hefty. Otherwise, I think the biggest opportunity for breaking this would be during assembly or if you disassemble it.

What a treat for my dry itchy eyes! I LOVE this heated eye mask! Either I would heat it up before I headed upstairs and then by the time I got into bed it would be cold, or I would get ready for bed and then be too lazy to go back downstairs to get it and heat it up. This USB plug in mask solves the problem entirely! Now I can get ready for bed and then use this once I'm in bed to help me relax and fall asleep. It heats up very quickly and has a great range of 3 temperatures. It also has 3 options for the timer which is very convenient/a great safety feature for me since sometimes it relaxes me to sleep. Not for shaky hands and takes too long to charge I have just "had it" with my second 7140XL. I bought both for $29.95 on sale at CVS. While it shaves good, there are two problems. The first is that the "charged" light does not go on when fully charged. Morever it does not hold a charge very long.

The major problem involves cleaning this razor. I have shaky hands and fingers. Other than rinsing with hot water, one must remove the top lock and then clean each head. With my first copy, I could not get the top lock back on. Moreover two of the plastic circles about the heads fell off. So did two wires that fit delicately into plastic parts on the lock.
I finally threw it away. I have been a Norelco user all my life and this was the first time encountering such a problem. My friends could not put it together again. On Sat. Dec. 29, I turned the lock to release it. In doing so, two of the protective plastic circles again fell off as did one thin small wire clip. I could not put the razor together again.
The second razor is less than five months old.

Those with steady hands and fingers can do better. This particular unit seems to be too cheap vs. other models. There are no Norelco shops within 150 miles. I am going to try and get CVS to give me a refund. Then I will look at a different brand. The basic Braun unit has the heads
on so only the metal cover needs to be lifted off, a simple process.

If you have shaky hands or fingers, think twice. Also, the indicator when the razor is fully charged should go on. In such cases, Buyer Beware!

Easy to use,works great and has a sensor inside so you dont have to push buttons I am totally new to the idea and concept when it comes to doing gel nails at home myself. This was the first time I have owed and used a UV lamp by myself to cure my nails. I def like the initial unpackaging the machine itself looks professional and well made. It plugs into the wall the cord could be a tad longer but it was workable. I didnt read over the instructions since I have seen this machine be used both in the nail salon on a number of ocassions not regularly but I am a quick study. I have also seen ppl I watch on youtube use machines like this as well so I was familar with the concept of what your suppose to do. Now I did pair this with gel polish that I had never used before so my review may not be the best since I am unfamilar with both the product and the products used but it is coming from a first time user as I am sure there are others out there like myself. So in use I will say the machine does get warm not hot but warm depending on how long your using it. The light is very bright and def caught me off guard. The buttons are extremely easy to use but I love that the machine also has a sensor so you dont have to push the button if you dont need to which I thought was a nice touch. The only downside of that is if you lift your palm up then it goes off so its extremely important to pay attention to the numbers you were on for curing sake. I will say thou using this machine at first with the base coat that I was using it came out tacky so my first thought is great I was excited about using this and it doesnt all the way work but once I thought to just go ahead and apply the first layer of polish, cure, and then do the top coat everything was fine. So overall this works great and I look forward to using again in the future as I begin experimenting with both gel polish and poly gel (I think its called). As stated I am a quick study and I dont think I did too bad of a job my first time around.

Great quality, works great for thick,long,curly hair, and works wonders This is my second set of these brushes I originally got these for my middle daughter and we keep one in her bathroom and one in the kitchen for the times I put a hair mask in her hair and use these combs to get the tangles out and the product into each part of her hair up to her root. So when my oldest seen these and I used them in her hair she was like ok I want one now too and then I also thought these would be great for my son who also has tons of hair and curly hair at that. So now everyone has one and I think I may sadly be getting another set for my daughters when there at their dads house too. They love these brushes and I have to attest using these to comb thru their hair makes things a world easier and less of a hassle I do wish they had a grip on the handle for wet hands but really outside of that I dont have any complaints. These come in packs of 2 and even if you dont have kids using one in a purse and keeping one home is enough reasons to get these especially if you have thick hair these are amazing. My kids are mixed and range from hair length to neck length to butt length and I will tell you these are amazing at handling getting thru those thick tangles. The back has a piece that allows you to have the comb itself at different firmness I like the top one personally it is the firmest level. Overall if I am not a fan I dont know who is but I know for sure I have 4 and I will have 6 by the end of the year.

Does work but you have to be a patient person as this could take weeks to fully happen Alright so I got this for me and my husband to try on his vacation which we did this on 9/10/21 it is now 1/29/21. I will start from the beginning. This was the first time ever doing anything like this for me and my husband so we werent sure what to expect with the process. When you take these out I will caution you to watch how much you cute the parts that go on your feet as I cut my husband's too wide and some of the liquid that is inside did come out. So you know there is liquid inside each of the bags that go on your feet that feels weird on your feet and cold. We left on for the recommended time of an hour the process is explained in detail which I will give them kuddos for. Now after we let them stay on for an hour we then showered them off I placed lotion on my feet the first night again not sure what to expect and I didnt want this to dry my feet out too much as to where my husband didnt have a preference so he did not lotion his feet. He started seeing the peeling first. Now keep in mind I do get pedis and my last one was probably in March of 2020 and since then I have used a foot file and soak during that time. My peeling did not start until halfway thru the week so I thought that was important to mention. He does not get his feet done and never has. His peeling lasted about a week. We are about what a week and half in of peeling 2 weeks in since I did the foot mask my feet still look aweful and they are still peeling. I have started to apply lotion to the feet to see if this will help the process and only have seen minimal improvement. Now keep in mind I am an impatient person. Also to mention a burning and tingling sensation is expected its what we felt during the process once we were done. Overall I think I will stick to my parifan drips and doing my feet the way I have been doing I will say that it did wear down a few calluses I had on my feet its just the process I am not patient enough for I dont mind wearing socks too much but this is more of being forced to wear socks so I dont shed everywhere and even then I still find dead skin somewhere. This process was horrible to me and I think there are better ways to get these results. My husband didnt too much mind the process and his feet were in worse conditon than mind and his process didnt take as long and for me that was even more frustrating. This would not be something I would recommend unless you are a patient person and dont mind waiting like this for results I just want to let my feet breath again.

Update: 2/2 My foot is still peeling this is def something I will not be doing again for me its about the fact that this is suppose to be something that takes time but really this amount of time for me is ridiculous and I can get the results its providing by using a foot file after soaking is that process more difficult yes but I get results within an hour not almost a month. My feet look nasty and dry even lotion isn't helping.

Cute kit,love the variety but fell in love with the one in the tube First impressions I have to start with the packaging which I think was cute in a way. I have not ever heard of this brand or used it before now and since getting it have heard great things about certain products from this little kit. I will say from this kit my favorite is the primer in the squeeze tube that I add in with a matte primer and it does a great job at minimizing pores which is something I have a problem with on my nose,cheeks and chin and this does a great job at covering up those problem areas and looks great under makeup. I wasnt the biggest fan of the 2 other primers and havent really played with them a whole lot not in comparison to the one in the squeeze tube. Overall this would be the one I would repurchase and reuse time and time again.

Was intimidated by the process I got this for myself since I struggle alot with all over pain in my body everyday since having my son but honestly I got a little intimidated by it after reading the instructions and it talking about purging your inpurities from your body. To some that may seem like a nice trip to the spa but for me I am highly cautious about things so I havent yet decided if I am going to use this or not. This comes packaged as most bath salts that I buy and they look just like bath salts when you open the package. However your suppose to use the entire 10 oz bag in one bath and sit for 20-30 mins I usually will use about a cup at most of Dr Teals bath salts so that to me seemed excessive followed by a sweat and rest afterwards which no female is crazy about sweat let alone in your own bed. So overall I think the concept is there but for me it put me on the fence and I will update if I or my husband maybe tries this but this taught me to look into something a little more before clicking get just for the purpose of pain relief.

Something I will have to continue to work with First impressions of these magnetic eyelashes is that I def like the packaging i feel like its a nice way of storing everything that comes with the kit making it easy to have everything you need to apply the lashes right at your hands. I love the look and style of the lashes I think they are like a soft glam look and not too overly dramatic. The lash band is lined with magnetic pieces which you can see if looked at closely not while wearing but prior to application. The magnetic eyeliner applicator is also something I truly like as it is a felt tip which isn't bendy or floppy. Its not so stiff you can't work with it but its not flimsy as in it would be hard to apply or even get a nice sharp wing with it. The one issue I do have with the magnetic eyeliner is it almost comes across as a glue adhesive and when I say that I don't mean like with glue you can reapply as much as you need to even if you mess up with this formula one coat and you can't go back over it because it will not only pick up pieces of the other product and it also doesn't layer well. However what I do mean is that if you apply the lashes and say you its not sticking to your inner corner and you have to remove some if not alot of the adhesive is def coming with it dry or not. Outside of the above mentioned problem I just had issues with it sticking to my inner corner but the lashes look absolutely beautiful on and I def love the style that's for sure. Its one of those things where I am not used to magnetic lashes and this is my first time trying them so its something I'm going to have to get used to. I will also say the adhesive was pretty easy to remove in which I used something similar to a makeup eraser. The only issues I had were the bits that stuck im my own lashes that I had to physically remove with my hands.

Excellent Argan oil, lightweight, great for hair and body. I have dry skin and hair, so I'm always looking for new moisturizers. I love Argan oil and have had great results with it. This is a lovely oil. It's very light and absorbs quickly. I love using it on my legs. It has no color or real scent. On your body it's very nice and hydrates your skin without leaving you greasy.

I also had great results using it on my hair and a little goes a long way. I especially like it on my ends. It's wonderful to soften and repair damaged hair.

Very nice oil, would recommend. Great for anyone with dry skin who likes oils.

Love this lip scrub, my lips look amazing! I'm in my 40s and I'm loving this lip scrub.

This is the first time I've tried a lip scrub. I don't usually pay too much attention to my lips, but they do peel a lot and it drives me crazy sometimes. This lip scrub is easy to use and gets rid of all the peeling skin and leaves my lips looking even colored, plump and smooth.

You only need the smallest amount. You just dab some on your index finger, then apply it and let it sit for about a minute. You need to let the product sit so the ingredients can penetrate and soften your lips. After a minute, wipe the scrub off with a tissue and maybe a little water. I've found a tissue works best for me. Top off with some chapstick or jelly and enjoy how amazing your lips look.

I love this product and would absolutely recommend. Great to own or give as a gift. Smells great, easy to use.

Nice hand soap, like the smell and size. Very happy with this hand soap I ordered. The "stay safe" label is a nice reminder for my kids about the importance of washing their hands. The soap uses a blend of tea tree oil and lavender essential oil. It has a nice lather and also leaves your skin soft, and doesn't seem to dry it out.

The manufacturer says this product is 100% vegan and paraben-free. They also say it has no artificial colors, synthetic oils, or harmful chemicals. This manufacturer is based in Ontario, Canada and you can find similar products at the Way of Will Amazon store, or the Way of Will website.

I took off one star for the price, which I thought was high. Otherwise happy with this product, would recommend.

Long and Sturdy These are the longest nail tips I own. They are long and sturdy and they fit bigger nail beds. I compared them to other nail tips I have and these are bigger, i definitely recommend for people with bigger nail beds.

Great clips for polygel I LOVE working on polygel, however whenever i use dual forms they tend to pop up and it makes it hard to hold down while putting my finger into the lamp so i decided to try these out. I have yet to use polygel with them but they hold pretty good with a full cover nail on top of my natural nail. I definitely recommend these for beginners who struggle with dual forms.

The beautifulest of them all This nail lamp is stunning. I love the finish and the gold color. It has a nice weight to it, it does not feel cheap it works fantastically, and you can also take off the bottom if you'd like to use it for a pedicure. I definitely recommend this nail lamp it is not only great but beautiful as well. A definite eye catcher.

Pretty and Functional These satin looking shower caps are very pretty. They feel nice and smooth look satin and they are also 100% water proof. They have 2 layers one being the satin looking material and the inside being plastic so water does not enter. It also came with 5 additional regular disposable shower caps to use under the cap for extra security. These caps are a must, they look super chic and you won't be spending money regularly on disposable ones, it's a win win.

Okay Gel Polishes These gel polishes are okay. The consistency is a bit weird , you only need one coat but the bottles feel empty. They are very very light compared to other gel polishes around the same size. These do change colors but only with hot water and for a few seconds, after they go back to normal which i thought wasn't very fun. They are nice colors however, i just don't know if you get a good amount of products as the bottles are dark and feel almost empty. Regardless if you're into color changing polishes these do technically work.

amazing tweezers These eyebrow tweezers are great. They are sharp, have a nice weight and work great. They pluck eyebrow hairs easily and grab even the smallest of hairs effortlessly. I really liked this set and will definitely recommend these for people who do their own eyebrows.

All you need This make up organizer is perfect for traveling or if you do not have much space for a bigger mirror. It is small enough to carry around and makes applying makeup very easy. I love how it has silicone like holders for your lipsticks or eyeliners and brushes as well as jewelry. This is definitely something worth investing in. I got this so I can take it on the go to retouch my makeup or do it if I need to have it done last min. It is something you can easily store inside your car or office/ work area. I most definitely recommend this to make applying makeup on the go easier.

Good to carry around These hand sanitizer bottles are a great size to attach to a purse/backpack/car as it is small but not as small as a bath & body works so it is guaranteed to last quite a bit before needing a refill. I love how they have attachers to attach to bags and such that have fruits and match their overall color. It's very cute definitely great if you have multiple kids as each can get their own color/fruit and they will not fight over which is who's. I like these to leave around so I always have access to hand sanitizer.

Variety of stamp plates These stamp plates are very cute, I like how there is a variety and a theme to each one. This is the perfect set to have for different occasions/holidays. It comes with everything you need except the polish. This works great and I really like that you can take nail designs to the next level with these. I used regular nail polish with these and it worked great but they do sell special polish for stamping plates as well.

Pretty metallic shimmery shadows These eyeshadow sticks are very smooth and creamy. You have to slide it on a couple of times to get good pigmentation payoff however once you use the brush to blend it out the color slowly fades and leaves you with a sheer looking shadow. You will need to reapply a couple of times to have good coverage. Overall the colors and finish are cute however the execution could use some work. I recommend this if you want eyeshadow that is not too in your face or for tweens.

Perfect for little kids This Frozen nail kit is really perfect for kids, especially kids under 10. I got this as a joke for my girls night since our work does not allow our nails to be done, I figured this kit would be perfect and it was. It is very sheer despite the colors in the bottles looking very pigmented. It also peels extremely easy so acetone is not needed to remove the polish which is great for little kids. Overall, quality wise it isn't the best, for an adult, for a child this is perfect. I recommend this kit for your kids, it's very cute and fun!

Great Packaging These makeup sponges are great. Lately i’ve preferred using a brush to apply foundation but these sponges make me want to go back to beauty blenders. They are great for blending my eye primer and foundation but I prefer them for when I am baking my face. I like that this comes with 4 beauty blenders so you do not have to constantly be washing your only one. The packaging is also very cute and very gift-able in my opinion. I recommend these for people who like to use beauty blenders or even to include in a makeup gift basket.

Small Rainbow These Rosegin gel polishes are small, around the same size as the modelones. There is a good variety of colors and some have glitter. I like this set because you get almost all the colors in a rainbow without breaking the bank and an added bonus, depending on how you look at it, is that they are small so you’re more likely to use it all instead of the polish just sitting there. The one thing for me was that the blue glitter polish was very sheer and I needed like 4 coats to build it up but the other colors worked great. I definitely like this little set.

Good performing Mirror Powder I have seen some reviews saying that this does not work, however for me it worked and applied perfectly. I only needed to rub it two times and it applied nicely and it looks very smooth as well. My powder did not break off like others, I’d imagine it is because I was gentle with it. You do not need to rub it hard for it to apply nicely. I did have a layer at the bottom of gel polish so I do not know if that helped adhere the chrome but for me it worked great and I recommend it.

Great for resin and nails alike These flowers for nails are nice. They each come in their own container and there is a variety of shape sizes and colors. The one thing I noticed is that they totally feel like plastic flowers you’d find at a dollar store. I thought these would be dried flowers but regardless they are nice and usable for nail designs and resin alike.

Variety Variety Variety This polygel kit is great for beginners and avid polygel users alike. It includes 7 different polygels but 5 of those 7 are around the same shade. I definitely like that this kit includes a small UV lamp along with both dual and nail forms. The dual forms on this kit are very curved which are not really my style but if you enjoy dual forms but do not like it as curved you can easily buy them on amazon separately . The polygels in this kit are on the skinny side. I think these are definitely worth it on sale and would recommend you buy them then.

Some interesting Gel Polishes This jiadel gel polish set brings some gorgeous unique colors to my collection. It is very pigmented, I only swatched it once and it was full coverage. Some of the polishes in this set are very unique like the ones with fur or hair on them, I’ve never seen polishes like that before. They apply smoothly and are a nice good thick consistency. Do not let the size of the bottle fool you, these gel polishes may be packaged small but they pack a good punch. I definitely recommend this to beginners or people who like adding unique shades to their collections.
Cutest little Comb I actually got this comb because I do dogs shows and it fits with my theme of pink. It’s perfect for little Maltese. It’s sturdy and comes with a white travel carrier.
Great Great exfoliator. I usually only exfoliate once a week so this works great.
Nice The packaging is nice and it feels okay. Will use more often.
Cute and Travel Worthy This is a cute and small stylish comb. Perfect for travel.
Nice Skin I hav dry skin so I put this on after getting out the shower and this keeps my face nice and moisturized.

Strong little device. I think this might be good for diabetics too. It is a great little grinder. And runs by USB power so its very low wattage.
My mother is diabetic and has to be very careful about the shape of her toenails. Its very important to avoid infection. Regular clippers are hard to position correctly sometimes. And there is a risk of 'over cutting' the nail and causing issues that way.
With these you are shaping the nail slowly so you can control it a whole lot better. Less chances of clipper accidents.
**I'm not a doctor nor do I play one on TV. Its just my opinion that these are a good choice for diabetics.
I was given these as a vine promotion for the review. But that aside I like it and see it as a durable useful tool. Mostly because I end up being the one that has to take care of the toenail business And these make it easier to take care of.

Works Pros: I had noticeably firmer skin after one use. It was cold and relaxing.

Cons: The instructions on how to use are in Chinese. It's is a little difficult to position as the mask itself feels very much like slimy loose skin. My face turned red - but I do have very sensitive skin.

Overall I was happy with the tighter looking skin. You will definitely look like something out of a horror movie when you wear this face mask so don't wear it around small children (see picture).

Hydrates ok I was skeptical when I first opened the pouch for this mask and found a dry sheet that seemingly was just a paper towel with cut outs but when I followed the directions and soaked it in water for a minute it became thick and almost skin like. I suggest when you place it in water to soak it unfolded and flat if possible because I had just added water to the pouch and let it soak folded in that and it was difficult to unfold. The eye holes and mouth holes were a bit too small for me so I will likely cut the holes bigger before soaking next time. Overall it did hydrate my skin some but not to the point where I wouldn't need to use moisturizer as I still had some dry patches. I did not experience any redness from this and for the rest of the day my skin has felt tighter. I prefer the sheer masks that come pre mositened mostly because it saves me a step but it does do what it says it will do.

Works It is a soft material headband and it is comfortable to wear. You do need to make sure the headband is flat against your head or your mask elastic will keep popping off the buttons though. It does give your ears a break if you have to wear a mask all day. I wish the buttons were more firmly sewn in place though.

Relaxing Easy to use and comes packaged nicely - very giftable. This roller provides a nice massage for my face and has a cool feeling to it. I like to use it with my face moisturizer. The essential oil roller is a nice bonus.

They are ok I only got a 1 pack so it may take a lot longer to see any results. I have used gold under eye masks before and this one wasn't as good. I like to put them in the refrigerator for a nice cooling effect when I wake up in morning and usually the cool feeling lasts 10 mins but with these after a minute it wasn't cool anymore. My eyes didnt look any brighter underneath after wearing for 20 mins. They do feel more moisturized so I gave 3 stars because of that.

Very soothing This mask looks pretty terrifying when on but it does a fantastic job of soothing the skin. My skin is very pale and gets sections of redness easily and when I woke up this morning I had no red sections and my skin was really hydrated. It did leave my skin a bit oily looking but I used an oil paper to pull that out and my skin looked great after that.

Love these I love these silicone "cotton swabs"!! I personally have a problem with the feeling of cotton balls and cotton swabs but they are useful. I didn't even realize something like this existed so I was super excited to try it out. I used it for touching up makeup and they are really easy to use and clean. It comes with different textured heads too so it's very versatile.

Reduced puffiness I was surprised when the instructions said to leave these on for 1 to 2 hours as I am used to other under eye patches only being on for 20 mins. I had the patches on for 1 hour and 25 mins. It had a slightly cool feeling the whole time it was on. I have sensitive skin and had no adverse reaction to it. I was impressed that my eye puffiness was visibly reduced.

Smooth I have sensitive lips so I tend to only use nivea lip gloss but I wanted something with better sun protection. This one didn't cause my lips to get itchy or dry and goes on very smooth. There is hardly any scent to it and no flavor except for a slight sunscreen taste. Overall I like it because it provided great sun protection.

Haven't noticed results I've used for 3 days now and haven't noticed any difference. It might work after a longer period of use. That being said, I have sensitive skin and didn't have any bad reactions to this and a little bit does go a long way.

Great quality lashes This was my first time ever putting on fake lashes of any kind so any issues I had may have been operator error. its ok, I like the mascara alone [[VIDEOID:f23a53b981d82584b0d281561f5b493d]] This mascara is okay. The primer helps a little but I think I prefer the mascara alone.  The mascara didn't flake off. Love it I tend to have very dry skin, especially when the weather doesn't help that situation like in the winter months. For myself personally, I have a couple of spots on my face, that tend to get drier than other areas. That results in dry patches of flaking skin. Needless to say, having those spots flaking, is not ideal. I wanted to try this particularly for its hydrating and moisturizing properties. I am pleased to report that this skin care product works extremely effectively. It has a very thick consistency to it, which to me indicates that it works well through its dense property. I use it after my shower in the evenings, and it totally alleviated the problems I had of any dry patches appearing on my face. I will say that it isn't in an inexpensive price range, but I'm happy with the results that I achieved when I used it. So if you can afford it, you might justify the expense. All in all it's an excellent cream, and I would certainly recommend it if you are like me, someone who suffers from dry skin and dry patches.

Removed 60% of my blackheads I've tried many of the removing blackhead strips. Some work and some don't. So I wanted to try something new. I got this kit to test and see if it was better than those blackhead removing strips from the drugstore. I can say that this did better. Longlasting This keeps your eyebrow hairs up all day long. It doesn't leave any residue behind. I like it better than eyebrow soap. You can really get that beautiful bushy eyebrow with this product. It doesn't clump up at all.
It's a waterproof formula. It's not too gooey. It's not a thick messy formula. Overall, a great product to set your eyebrows with and long-lasting.

Extremely dry formula [[VIDEOID:7f21ea7397e60c74aab147858d033aba]] You definitely get what you pay for with this lip kit. They are very cheap and for the price, I guess it's ok, considering you get 12 lipliners but keep in mind the formula is super dry and chalky. Not impressed!

Very nice Sia is a brand that I've had the opportunity to use more than once. Generally I like their products quite a bit, and this serum actually works very nicely as well. It's a small bottle as most serum bottles are, but the really nice thing about this particular formula is that a little will certainly go a long way. You do not need to overuse any abundant amount of this particular product as it spreads extremely well, and saturates very nicely too. I find it has very nice hydrating properties, as it did a great job of moisturizing my skin and leaving it feeling soft. I do have an age spot or two on my face that have appeared over the last few years, and I was hoping that this serum would do a good job to lessen the appearance of those age spots. Unfortunately I would have to report that I haven't noticed any difference after using this for about a month now. The age spots in my opinion are pretty much just as prevalent as they were from the get go. That being said as a hydrator, this serum does an excellent job of moisturizing and softening the skin. The scent is nice too, with kind of citrusy tones. It doesn't last very long however. So if it turns out that the scent is something that you don't like, it dissipates rather quickly. I've used this serum as part of my night time routine before applying moisturizer, and I liked it very much. All in all my experience was very good, so I would recommend giving it a try if this is something you were thinking about.

Impressive This was my first time trying a mask of this type. To be honest I didn't really know what to expect, but to make a Long story short I was very impressed. Applying this mask is a little different. You should leave your face nice and damp, and apply a very thin layer of this oxygen mask over the damp skin. The mask will begin to foam up, and you leave it applied for about 10 minutes or so. After which you simply rinse it off, and enjoy your nicely treated skin. I tend to have a little bit of a drier skin type on certain areas of my face, and so I would say that this mask did dry me out a little bit. Of course the mask isn't the final step, rather it's the first one so following it up with a good serum and moisturizer will alleviate any sort of dryness issues. What I did notice is that with prolonged use, I was seeing some pretty encouraging results with the diminishment of fine lines. I am in my 40s now, and the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines are beginning to become a reality. When I would use this mask, and then apply a nice retinol serum, and a good moisturizer overtop, I noticed that after several weeks I was seeing a pretty nice reversal of the aging process. I think it's a very high quality product, and isn't the first product that I've tried from this brand. In my experience Tonica makes excellent products, with simple packaging but are highly effective. All in all I was very pleased with my use of it, and would certainly recommend it to anyone willing to give it a try.

Very nice quality mask Of the choices available I chose to take the Aqua mask. I found it to be very nicely hydrating, and was full of plenty of serum on the mask itself. Application of the mask is pretty straightforward, you just align it with your face according to the pattern on the mask, and allow it to sit for 15 to 20 minutes. I always like to apply the mask right after my shower before bed. After I've washed my face in the shower, I will apply the mask before any of the rest of my nighttime skin care routine. When I would use the mask, I would skip the serum part of my nighttime routine. I found that applying serum after the mask is simply redundant an unnecessary. After removing the mask there was always plenty of extra serum that would sit atop my skin, so I would rub the rest of it in gently with my hands until it's saturated which didn't take very long as the serum I found saturated very nicely. The mask did provide a very nice amount of moisture to my otherwise dry skin. I tend to get a dry spot or two on my face from time to time, particularly around the chin area, and I found that after wearing the mask I would not suffer from that issue. It left my skin smooth and with a nice afterglow as well. All in all I was very satisfied with my experience, so I would recommend giving them a try. A nice added bonus is that they are very affordable.

pricey but very hydrating This is a nice hydrating moisturizer. I wouldn't say this is one of a kind product but it is better than your Walmart moisturizers. It blends nicely into the skin and does hydrate for a long period of time. I hate moisturizer that after half an hour of having it on your face feel like you haven't applied anything at all, it's so dry. But I do feel it's a little pricey. I mean, I won't tell my sister to go run and purchase it. It does work well with all of my skincare products but because this is a clean formula, I do find that after a while a tends to have an unpleasant scent. Overall, hydrating and non-greasy.

My skin feels so smooth I've been using this trio for over two weeks now. And already I see my skin even out. I have a lot of acne scars in this tree or really helped fade some of it away. My skin looks a lot clearer and healthy. I use this morning and night and I feel like my skin is hydrated for a long period of time. All the formulas blend nicely into the skin giving a nice healthy glow. I think if you wanna see improvement in your skin, you need to be consistent with your skincare routine, and adding something like this can really help restore and revive your dull skin. These are lightly scented which is something I really appreciate. It is a small travel size but a little bit of product goes a long way. My skin definitely looks plumper and tighter. I am really liking how my skin looks after starting using this kit.

Great for everyday I live in sunny South Florida, so it's important that I do my best to try and protect my skin from the sun even with casual exposure. This is a very expensive and small quantity of sunscreen, but I think if you look at it for particular application it might be worth it. I used it entirely for a face sunscreen. It does extremely well to saturate into the skin and I didn't find it gave me a white cast at all, which is what I really appreciate about it. It can do very well as an everyday wearing type sunscreen that will give you protection from the sun, while at the same time moisturizing your skin. As a matter of fact, I found as a moisturizer it worked very well. I appreciate very much the sun protection SPF 50 that it has, because the sun where I live can certainly get very strong. I usually dislike sunscreens, because of the oily nature of them, but I found this one to be well balanced, and didn't leave me feeling greasy at all. I also found that it had a bit of a matte finish to it, so you didn't notice any sort of shining, especially for someone like me who tends to have an oilier t zone. In combination with that, I actually get dry areas on my chin, and this did very nicely to moisturize my dry areas while not causing any sort of exacerbation of oilier areas. All in all it's probably one of the best, if not the best sunscreen that I have ever used for my face. For everyday wear, and protection, I would certainly reach for this sunscreen without a doubt. I do recommend it.

The best facial mask ever! This is a leave in mask and it’s the most hydrating mask I’ve ever tried. When I wake up in the morning, my skin feels plumped, hydrating and smooth. I have a few dry patches on my face and this is the only thing that made this disappear. It has a strong scent. So I don’t know if this is suitable for people with sensitive. I don’t mind the strong scent but I know some people don’t like that. I thin layer is more than enough. I don’t feel any tightness when I apply it. I’m just so happy with how my skin is looking and it’s thanks to this facial mask. I just have a nice glow and my skin looks amazing with makeup. I love it.

Super gentle! I’ve been really enjoying this facial cleanser! It’s super foamy and it feels amazing when I massage into my skin. It really removes all the pollutants off my skin. I use a makeup remover and then I go in with this cleanser and it’s the perfect thing. I do not feel any burning sensation at all.  I love it!

It’s ok These were really hard to open. I just couldn’t get it right. I got the chance to try these for free thanks to the vine program. If I had paid for these I wouldn’t of been happy.
